headline: Rushes for 80 yards
story: Gant recorded 19 rushes for 80 yards and one touchdown and reeled in 1 of 2 targets for six yards during Saturday's 38-10 loss versus UNLV.
impact: Gant led the Zips in rushing with 80 yards on the ground Saturday against UNLV. The running back has two games this season with at least 80 rushing yards. Through four games, the Florida native has attempted 44 rushes for 187 yards and two touchdowns.

headline: Commits two turnovers Week 4
story: Roggow was 14-for-25 passing for 194 yards and two interceptions during Saturday's 38-10 defeat versus UNLV.
impact: During his first career start, Roggow committed two turnovers during a 28-point loss to UNLV on Saturday. The two interceptions were the quarterback's first mistakes of the season. With the Zips heading to Central Michigan next week, head coach Joe Moorhead will have to choose between Reese Poffenbarger (not injury-related), Cibastian Broughton (ankle), and Roggow at center.

headline: Out Saturday
story: Riggins (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game versus UNLV, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Riggins will miss Saturday's game versus UNLV, which is not a major surprise considering he hasn't played this season. His next chance to suit up is next Saturday at Central Michigan.

headline: Good to go for Week 4
story: Sivon (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game against UNLV.
impact: After a two-game absence, Sivon can return to action for Akron. With him available, the 2026 Zips have logged only one other game, but he flourished with five targets and receptions for 30 yards.

headline: Available for Week 4
story: Davis (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game against UNLV.
impact: Davis did not play, on paper, Akron's toughest game of September in Week 3 at Minnesota. Before then, the 2026 Zips' first two weeks of action saw him log a 13-yard reception.

headline: Ruled out Saturday
story: Monteiro (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game versus UNLV, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Monteiro will miss his fourth consecutive game Saturday as he continues to deal with an undisclosed injury. His next chance to suit up is next Saturday at Central Michigan.

headline: Set to start Saturday
story: Roggow will start Saturday's game versus UNLV, Brett McMurphy of On3.com reports.
impact: With Reese Poffenbarger (not injury related) and Cibastian Broughton (ankle) both ruled out, Roggow will make his first career start. He has appeared in all three games this season, completing 24 of 38 passes for 238 yards and three total touchdowns.

headline: Out Saturday
story: Broughton (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game versus UNLV, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Broughton will miss Saturday's contest due to an ankle injury, and with Reese Poffenbarger (not injury related) also out, Brayden Roggow will start for the Zips. It's been a solid start to the season for Broughton with 380 passing yards, four passing touchdowns and 170 rushing yards through three starts.

headline: Game-time decision for Week 4
story: Broughton (ankle) will be a game-time decision for Saturday's game against UNLV, Pete Nakos of On3.com reports.
impact: After getting roughed up in Week 3, Broughton is not immediately in the clear for Akron's upcoming game against UNLV to cap off the 2026 Zips' non-conference schedule. He continues to rehab this week, and if he needs more time, Brayden Roggow is their next-best projected QB to step under center. Broughton has been stepping up with Reese Poffenbarger (not injury related) fighting his eligibility status, giving the former an opportune time while he has been healthy.

headline: Replaces injured starter
story: Roggow was 12-for-25 passing for 131 yards during Saturday's 41-7 loss versus Minnesota.
impact: Roggow was called to come in under center after Cibastian Broughton (knee) was lifted with an apparent knee injury. Roggow completed less than half of his 25 passing attempts for just 131 yards. If Broughton remains sidelined next week, Roggow will be in line to start against UNLV.

headline: Banged up in loss
story: Broughton was 9-for-13 passing for 42 yards during Saturday's 41-7 loss versus Minnesota.
impact: Broughton was pulled from Saturday's game in the first half with an apparent right knee injury. The quarterback threw for just 42 yards on nine completions before being replaced by Brayden Roggow. Akron will host UNLV next week, with the quarterback decision up in the air.

headline: Out vs. Minnesota
story: Davis (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game at Minnesota, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Davis will sit out Saturday's game after playing against Robert Morris last week, where he recorded one reception for 13 yards. The wideout will look to recover in time for next Saturday's game against UNLV.

headline: Won't play Saturday
story: Sivon (undisclosed) won't suit up for Saturday's game versus Minnesota, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Sivon will skip a second straight game after racking up five catches in the season opener versus Wake Forest. He'll have another chance to take the field next week versus UNLV, but Akron will be down some depth out wide again Saturday.

headline: Not playing Saturday
story: Monteiro (undisclosed) is listed out ahead of Saturday's matchup against Minnesota.
impact: Monteiro has yet to play this season and will miss his third consecutive matchup as he deals with an undisclosed injury. The 6-foot-1 wide receiver will aim to be available for next week's contest against UNLV.

headline: Out for Week 3
story: Poffenbarger (not injury related) remains out for Saturday's game at Minnesota, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Poffenbarger will once again not suit up for Akron due to his eligibility status remaining unresolved. Cibastian Broughton should start under center Saturday, considering he performed well against Robert Morris last week. The quarterback will look to get his situation figured out before Week 4 against UNLV.

headline: Bounces back in home opener
story: Gant logged 12 rushes for 81 yards and one touchdown and reeled in all four targets for 20 yards during Saturday's 45-10 win against Robert Morris.
impact: After gaining just 15 yards on the ground during the season opener against Wake Forest a week ago, Gant turned it around in Week 2. The running back led the Zips in rushing yards (81) during a 35-point win over Robert Morris. Gant made his way across the goal line with a one-yard touchdown to extend Akron's lead to 21 late in the third quarter.

headline: Scores in home opener
story: Patrick compiled eight carries for 67 yards and hauled in all four targets for 65 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-10 win over Robert Morris.
impact: Patrick combined for 132 yards on the ground and through the air during the Zips' 35-point win Saturday. The running back got the scoring started after hauling in a 41-yard pass from Cibastian Broughton to give Akron the early lead. Patrick led the Zips in receiving yards (65) against Robert Morris.

headline: Thrives in win
story: Broughton completed 23 of 27 passes for 227 yards and four touchdowns during Saturday's 45-10 win over Robert Morris. He also had 13 rushes for 71 yards.
impact: After a tough road loss to Wake Forest, Broughton flipped the script in the Zips' home opener. The quarterback threw as many incompletions as touchdowns (four) in the 35-point win over Robert Morris. The Florida native ran for at least 70 yards for the second consecutive game as well. Broughton will look to carry over the momentum as the Zips head to Minnesota on Sept. 19.

headline: Leading rusher in blowout win
story: Crowell had six carries for 50 yards in Saturday's 49-18 win over South Carolina.
impact: Crowell led the Crimson Tide in rushing against the Gamecocks despite having two less carries than both quarterback Keelon Russell and backfield mate Daniel Hill. Crowell displayed the abilities that made him such a highly touted recruit breaking tackles and showing off his dynamic rushing abilities for a big gain of 39 yards while also gaining positives on plays that looked destined for no gain or lost yardage.

headline: Two touchdowns in blowout win
story: Coleman-Williams totaled five receptions (on six targets) for 98 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 49-18 victory against South Carolina.
impact: After a down game a few weeks ago against Kentucky, Coleman-Williams bounce back last week with a solid day to include a touchdown. Another week removed from the dismal performance and Coleman-Williams has bounced back even more. The speedy wideout may have put the drop concerns behind him as he has snared every ball that has come his way since week one. Coleman-Williams dynamic play showed up big time in this one as he broke free twice for long touchdowns of 32 yards and 42 yards.

headline: Touchdown in blow out win
story: Hill recorded eight carries for 15 yards and one touchdown and gathered in their only target for five yards during Saturday's 49-18 win against South Carolina.
impact: With the traditional running back workload being shared across three backs and the additional development in the quarterback running game for the Crimson Tide offense, Hill finally felt the impact in production. Hill did still manage to score a touchdown to buoy his fantasy production slightly. Things don't seem to be changing and Hill may even continue to lose some reps with as EJ Crowell continues to do incredible things when on the field. Hill will likely be very touchdown dependent in terms of fantasy production moving forward.

headline: Career day in big win
story: Russell completed 21 of 27 passes for 365 yards and four touchdowns during Saturday's 49-18 victory against South Carolina. He also had eight rushes for 35 yards with one touchdown...
impact: Russell has strung together back-to-back starts that fantasy owners have been anxiously awaiting from the uber talented first year starter. After setting a career high with 320 yards and three touchdowns passes last week, Russell topped those marks with 365 yards and four touchdowns while also rushing for a touchdown. Russell's continued improvement is extremely promising as he is starting to put himself into Heisman contention if this type of play and growth continues.

headline: Strong day in loss
story: Branch hauled in nine of 12 targets for 87 yards during Saturday's 41-31 loss to North Carolina State.
impact: Branch turned his best day of the season to this point, setting a new high in both receptions and receiving yards. Through four games, Branch has recorded 20 receptions for 203 yards and has rushed for one touchdown.

headline: Leads mountaineers receivers in loss
story: Pickett reeled in five of seven targets for 97 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 41-31 loss to North Carolina State.
impact: Pickett continued his strong start to 2026 by posting a game-high 97 yards. Pickett and Malachi Singleton connected for an 18-yard score in the fourth quarter for the wideouts third touchdown of the season. Through four games, Pickett has recorded 20 receptions and 326 yards.

headline: Rushing TD in loss
story: Lewis totaled eight carries for 32 yards and one touchdown and hauled in all two targets for 28 yards during Saturday's 41-31 defeat against North Carolina State.
impact: While Lewis was held in check for most of the contest, he was able to punch in his fourth touchdown of the season from two yards out. Through four games, Lewis has rushed for 220 yards on 47 attempts while also picking up 33 receiving yards on four receptions.

headline: DNP for Week 4
story: Sanchez (undisclosed) did not play during Saturday's game at North Carolina State.
impact: Sanchez gradually increased his snaps from Weeks 1 to 3, which saw Appalachian State's team begin its 2026 schedule by hosting a non-FBS school before facing more difficult challenges. The fact that he sat out against App State's biggest opponent this September leaves questions as to his availability, especially after he caught all six of his targeted passes earlier.

headline: Three TDS in loss
story: Singleton completed 26 of 38 passes for 317 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 41-31 defeat against North Carolina State. He also had eight rushes for seven yards with one...
impact: Singleton put the Mountaineers on the board with a three-yard rushing score in the second score to make it a 21-7 game before tossing 18 and nine-yard touchdown passes in the fourth quarter. Through four games, Singleton has thrown for 1206 yards, seven touchdowns and one interception while also rushing for two scores. The Mountaineers are on a bye week next Saturday before squaring off with Old Dominion on October 10.

headline: Continued activity Week 3
story: Hasselbeck logged one completion for 14 yards during Appalachian State's 26-21 win Saturday against UNC Charlotte. He also logged two rushing attempts for yards.
impact: Even though Appalachian State's starting quarterback is Malachi Singleton, between Weeks 1 and 3, each of their Mountaineer games include Hasselbeck. The backup quarterback logged four completions (on five pass attempts) for 51 yards. Hasselbeck also recorded eight rushing attempts, indicating that he is more of a dual-threat QB.

headline: Catches six passes Saturday
story: Pickett gathered in 6 of 8 targets for 67 yards during Saturday's 26-21 win against Charlotte.
impact: Pickett hasn't found the end zone in the last two games, but he remains the most productive wideout on the Appalachian State roster by a wide margin. Through three contests, he has 15 catches on 20 targets for 229 yards and two scores. He's averaging a solid 15.3 yards per reception while posting an excellent 75 percent catch rate. Look for Pickett to remain a reliable WR1 for the Mountaineers as long as he stays healthy.

headline: Massive stat line in Week 3
story: Lofton accrued six receptions (on 10 targets) for 90 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 26-21 win versus Charlotte.
impact: Lofton played a big role in Appalachian State's win over Charlotte, leading the passing attack and finding the end zone for the first time this season. This is clearly a step in the right direction for Lofton, who didn't play in Week 1 and was limited to just three catches on three targets for 33 yards in Week 2. This Week 3 score was his first TD of the 2026 season.

headline: Finds end zone in third straight game
story: Lewis posted 11 rushes for 46 yards and one touchdown and caught 1 of 2 targets for one yard during Saturday's 26-21 victory against Charlotte.
impact: Statistically, this was Lewis' worst game of the season, as he averaged just 4.2 yards per carry, down from 6.3 and 4.3 in Weeks 1 and 2, respectively. That said, Lewis remains a productive tailback, and he's found the end zone in his three appearances so far in 2026. He has 39 carries for 188 yards and three scores in 2026 and should remain as Appalachian State's RB1 as long as he stays healthy.

headline: Throws for 331 yards in Week 3
story: Singleton completed 28 of 42 passes for 331 yards, two touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 26-21 win over Charlotte. He also had five rushes for 14 yards.
impact: Singleton tossed a pick for the first time this season, but it was also the second time he tossed more than one touchdown pass. Through three contests, the senior signal-caller has completed 74.5 percent of his throws for 889 yards and a solid 5:1 TD:INT. However, things will get tougher in Week 4 with a matchup against NC State on the horizon.

headline: Leads team in yards
story: Pickett tallied four receptions (on five targets) for 86 yards during Saturday's 27-24 victory against East Carolina.
impact: Pickett posted a team-high in yards as the Mountaineers won their second consecutive game. Through two games, Pickett has recorded nine catches for 162 yards and two touchdowns.

headline: Nice day in win
story: Fugitt compiled seven receptions (on eight targets) for 66 yards during Saturday's 27-24 victory against East Carolina.
impact: For the second straight week, Fugitt was a factor in the Mountaineers' offense. The tight end's longest reception of the day went for 20 yards and he has now recorded 113 yards on 11 catches through two weeks.

headline: Strong showing in win
story: Lewis had 17 rushes for 73 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 27-24 win against East Carolina.
impact: For the second straight week, Lewis led the way for the Mountaineers' backfield. Lewis popped his second touchdown of the season in the second quarter on a 10-year run. Through two games the running back has rushed for 142 yards on 28 carries.

headline: Runs for score in win
story: Singleton was 20-for-28 passing for 267 yards during Saturday's 27-24 win against East Carolina. He also had 11 rushes for eight yards with one touchdown.
impact: Singleton was efficient with his arm on Saturday and recorded his first rushing TD of the season when he found the end zone from four yards out in the second quarter. Singleton has thrown for 558 yards through two games and has a home matchup with Charlotte on September 19.

headline: Scores TD in win
story: Grier hauled in all two targets for 13 yards during Saturday's 55-3 victory over Maine.
impact: Grier popped a 28-yard run for his first touchdown of the campaign in the fourth quarter of Saturday's 55-3 blowout win. The wideout also hauled in two catches for 13 yards.

headline: Leads Mountaineers receivers in win
story: Pickett notched five receptions (on seven targets) for 76 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 55-3 win versus Maine.
impact: Pickett was Malachi Singleton's favourite receiver on Saturday and was rewarded with two touchdowns. Both of Pickett's scores came in the second quarter with the first coming from 14 yards out before hauling in another on a seven-yard strike.

headline: Scores in blowout win
story: Fugitt gathered in all four targets for 47 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 55-3 win against Maine.
impact: Fugitt caught Malachi Singleton's first touchdown of the game from five yards away to give the Mountaineers a 17-0 lead at the time.

headline: Mike Willy N' Trey, Using Love, And Is It Early?
story: Are we ready for holidays? Craig Grialou isn't, and he has some problems with those who do. Nevertheless, he talks with Darren Urban and Dan...

headline: Cardinals Battled But Couldn't Overcome Slow Start In San Francisco
story: The Cardinals battled back from a 23-6 deficit but ultimately fell 36-30 to the 49ers in Santa Clara. Craig Grialou, Zach Gershman and forme...

headline: Undergoes back surgery
story: Caldwell underwent back surgery in mid-September, Nick Piecoro of The Arizona Republic reported. He will be out four-to-six months.
impact: Caldwell, the Diamondbacks' first-round pick in 2024, has really struggled to hit for power as a professional. In 465 plate appearances at High-A Hillsboro this season, Caldwell hit .213/.361/.304 with six homers and 26 stolen bases, tallying an .091 ISO. While the ongoing back problems may give him an out in terms of his 2026 stats, Caldwell has dropped out of most prospect lists. 2027 will be a crucial year in his development for the Diamondbacks.

headline: Expected to be fine after rest
story: Burnes said Monday that the right shoulder injury which landed him on the 15-day injured list during the final weekend of the regular season was fatigue-related and he expects to b...
impact: Burnes had his Tommy John surgery rehab interrupted by a teres major strain in June, and his season ended prematurely due to what the Diamondbacks labeled as shoulder inflammation. However, it sounds as if the veteran hurler will be able to have a normal offseason after resting for a bit. Burnes allowed nine runs with an 8:4 K:BB over 10.1 innings in three starts for Arizona in 2026.

headline: Lasts 4.2 innings in no-decision
story: Soroka did not factor into the decision Sunday, allowing three runs on three hits and two walks over 4.2 innings against the Padres. He struck out four.
impact: Soroka worked two scoreless innings before surrendering runs in each of the next three frames, including a solo homer to Gavin Sheets in the fourth. In four outings since returning from right shoulder inflammation, the right-handed hurler posted a 3.48 ERA, 0.73 WHIP and 23:5 K:BB across 20.2 innings. With the Diamondbacks falling short of a playoff berth, Soroka will end the 2026 campaign with a 9-5 record, 3.41 ERA, 1.09 WHIP and 114:29 K:BB over 116 innings (22 appearances).

headline: Scratched from Sunday's lineup
story: Moreno (hamstring) has been removed from Sunday's lineup against the Padres, Alex Weiner of ArizonaSports.com reports.
impact: Moreno was initially slated to serve as the designated hitter for Sunday's must-win game. However, he has now been scratched due to a hamstring issue that cropped up Friday, though he could be available off the bench as a pinch hitter. Pavin Smith will now be the designated hitter, with Jordan Lawlar entering the lineup in center field while Tim Tawa moves to first base.

headline: Scores again in London
story: Harris logged four receptions (on nine targets) for 48 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 24-17 victory over Kansas.
impact: Harris caught a 25-yard touchdown pass at the end of the first half Saturday, his fifth score through three games this season. He has established himself as a favorite target of Cutter Boley alongside Omarion Miller, but Boley and Harris appear to be completely on the same page. Harris is a must-start player after the Sun Devils' bye week.

headline: Held in check Saturday
story: Miller accrued three receptions (on nine targets) for 18 yards during Saturday's 24-17 win against Kansas.
impact: While Miller was targeted nine times for the third straight game Saturday in London, he was held to just three catches by the Jayhawks' defense. He came into the game with an undisclosed injury and it's unclear if that impacted him in any way. While he has 24 targets over the last two games, he's turned that into just 47 yards on 12 catches. He'll hope to make more use out of his targets after the bye week versus Baylor.

headline: Heavy usage Saturday
story: Brown recorded 24 rushes for 81 yards and gathered in 1 of 2 targets for seven yards during Saturday's 24-17 win versus Kansas.
impact: Brown led the team with 24 carries Saturday in London, more carries than Cutter Boley had pass attempts. He averaged just 3.4 yards per carry though as he was unable to turn his heavy usage into a big day on the ground. Still, few players in the country have the chance at this type of utilization, so Brown remains as a high-floor running back heading into the heart of conference play.

headline: Quiet in London
story: Boley completed 11 of 23 passes for 95 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 24-17 win against Kansas. He also had 11 rushes for 25 yards with one touchdown.
impact: Boley may not have packed his arm for the trip over the pond as he completed fewer than 50 percent of his passes for just 95 yards in London. He accounted for two touchdowns though, including a one-yard rushing touchdown in the fourth quarter to all but seal up the win, but it was a quiet day for the Sun Devils' quarterback. He'll look to bounce back after the bye week versus Baylor.

headline: Out for rest of season
story: Anderson will miss the rest of the season after suffering a left leg injury against Kansas, John Gambadoro of ArizonaSports.com reports.
impact: Anderson was previously reported to miss significant time, but he will now be shut down for the remainder of the campaign. The tight end will finish his 2026 season with one reception for 21 yards. This is a big loss for Arizona State, as he was a vital piece of the offense and the starting tight end. AJ Ia and Anthony Miller should see more snaps in his absence.

headline: Scores in Saturday's win
story: Smith totaled four receptions (on five targets) for 86 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-24 victory over Washington State.
impact: Smith caught his first career touchdown reception Saturday, a 38-yard score in the third quarter. After receing just four targets over the first three games, Smith was targeted five times Saturday and made the most of the opportunity with 86 yards, the second most on the team. His increase in workload early into his freshman campaign is very promising, but it's too early to tell if it will translate consistently into Big 12 play.

headline: Catches two TDs Saturday
story: Spivey gathered in 7 of 9 targets for 129 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 34-24 win against Washington State.
impact: Spivey hauled in a pair of touchdown receptions Saturday, both of which came in the first half. It was by far his most productive outing of the season beyond the touchdowns as well as he set season highs in receptions and targets and reached 100 yards for the first time this season. Spivey and Noah Fifita will now look to continue their great connection in Big 12 play.

headline: Tosses four TDs Saturday
story: Fifita was 22-for-36 passing for 297 yards, four touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 34-24 victory against Washington State. He also had 11 rushes for 20 yards.
impact: Fifita tossed four touchdown passes in his second straight game Saturday, continuing his excellent run of form at the start of this season. He now has accounted for 13 total touchdowns through four games. His road is about to get tougher with conference games the rest of the way, starting this Saturday versus Cincinnati.

headline: Out Saturday
story: Rusk (lower leg) is out for Saturday's game at Washington State, per Justin Spears of the Arizona Daily Star.
impact: Rusk was taken to the locker room in last week's matchup due to a lower leg injury, and it appears he isn't at 100 percent. Shane King and Tyler Powell are now in line to see an expanded workload. He will look to return against Cincinnati next Saturday.

headline: Scores in Saturday's win
story: Mizell gathered in all five targets for 49 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 42-17 victory against Northern Illinois.
impact: Mizell caught a 14-yard touchdown pass in the second quarter Saturday, the first of his collegiate career. He broke out with five targets versus the Huskies after accumulating just two over the opening two games. He's worth keeping an eye on to see if he can maintain a role in this productive passing attack.

headline: Productive in Saturday's win
story: Spivey reeled in all six targets for 90 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 42-17 victory against Northern Illinois.
impact: Spivey led the team in receptions and yards Saturday, also scoring his second touchdown of the season on a 10-yard pass from Noah Fifita. While it's been a good start to the season for the senior, this performance versus the Huskies may represent his ceiling given Noah Fifita's propensity to spread the ball around. He is still worth starting in the right matchup, such as his upcoming trip to Washington State on Saturday.

headline: Scores in Saturday's win
story: Hunter recorded five receptions (on six targets) for 73 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 42-17 victory against Northern Illinois.
impact: After a slow start to the season, Hunter finally got going in Saturday's win. He reeled in a 38-yard touchdown pass in the first quarter, his first of the season, and was second on the team in receiving yards with 73. Hunter is averaging five targets per game so far this season, but his two receptions across the first two games of the season is worrisome. If he can put together a few more performances like this, he'll be worth consideration as an asset.

headline: Shines in Saturday's win
story: Fifita was 31-for-34 passing for 325 yards and four touchdowns during Saturday's 42-17 victory over Northern Illinois. He also had six rushes for four yards with one touchdown.
impact: Fifita was excellent in Saturday's dominant win, accounting for five total touchdowns including a 30-yard rushing touchdown in the fourth quarter. While Fifita is usually efficient he took it to another level versus the Huskies, completing over 91 percent of his passes for over 300 yards. It's been an excellent start to the season for the four-year starter, and he is a worthwhile fantasy starter given his high floor and his experience.

headline: Huge day in blowout win
story: Marshall notched nine receptions (on 12 targets) for 195 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-6 victory over Tulsa.
impact: After putting up his first 100-yard performance a week ago against Georgia, Marshall blew those numbers out of the water coming up just fie yards short of his first 200-yard performance while also managing to secure his first touchdown of the season. Through four games it is becoming pretty clear that Marshall is the top option in this offense as he has had seven or more reception in three-of-four games and no less than five catches in any game.

headline: Three touchdowns in blowout win
story: Jackson was 24-for-36 passing for 309 yards, one touchdown and one interception during Saturday's 34-6 win against Tulsa. He also had 13 rushes for 29 yards with two touchdowns.
impact: After a few less than stellar games against tough defensive opponents, Jackson bounced back against a poor Tulsa team. Jackson threw for over 300 yards for the first time on the year while also adding two rushing touchdowns. Jackson has shown some extremely dynamic play making but with the meat of the SEC schedule coming up his consistency will be put to the test.

headline: Strong day in win
story: Bonelli caught six of eight targets for 78 yards during Saturday's 17-14 win versus Kennesaw State.
impact: Bonelli posted a game-high 78 yards in the victory and through four games, the wideout has posted 12 receptions, 172 yards and one touchdown.

headline: Touchdown in win
story: Summers gathered in seven of eight targets for 57 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 17-14 victory over Kennesaw State.
impact: Summers set a season-high in receptions with seven during the victory and open the scoring with a 14-yard touchdown reception. Through four games, Summers has recorded 16 catches for 211 yards and one score.

headline: Two scores in win
story: Owens was 24-for-31 passing for 244 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 17-14 win over Kennesaw State. He also had five rushes for 26 yards with one touchdown.
impact: Owens opened the games' scoring with a 14-yard touchdown pass to wide receiver Hunter Summers. Down seven points late, Owens tied the game with a two-yard rushing touchdown. Through four games, Owens has thrown for 837 yards, four touchdowns and four interceptions. Up next for Owens and the Red Wolves is a road matchup with Louisiana.

headline: Doesn't play Saturday
story: Clay (ankle) didn't play in Saturday's win over Kennesaw State.
impact: Clay was listed as a game-time decision heading into Saturday's matchup but was unable to play through his ankle injury. Solomon Baggett got the start at running back in his absence, carrying the ball 13 times for 63 yards. Clay will look to make his return next week versus Louisiana-Lafayette.

headline: GTD for Week 4
story: Clay (ankle) is a game-time call for Saturday's game against Kennesaw State, Kara Richey of 95.3 The Ticket Jonesboro reports.
impact: Clay will be a true game-time call for this contest. The tailback has 27 carries for 104 yards and two scores on the ground through three appearances this season.

headline: Suffers injury in Week 3
story: Clay suffered an apparent lower leg or ankle injury in Week 3, according to Kara Richey of 95.3 The Ticket Jonesboro.
impact: Head coach Butch Jones said there's no concrete update on Clay's availability for Week 4, but the team will know more "when we get back to Jonesboro," either Monday or Tuesday. Clay appeared to suffer the injury early in the game, but he was seen on the sidelines in the second half with his helmet on. The tailback has 27 carries for 104 yards and two scores on the ground through three appearances this season.

headline: Subpar showing in Week 3 loss
story: Owens completed 11 of 24 passes for 133 yards during Saturday's 31-7 loss to TCU. He also had seven rushes for 58 yards.
impact: Arkansas State looked completely outmatched in this Week 3 loss, managing only seven points, and Owens completed fewer than half of his throws. He'll look to bounce back at home in a Week 4 matchup against Kennesaw State.

headline: Makes most of two catches in win
story: Bonelli reeled in all two targets for 41 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 52-7 victory over West Georgia.
impact: Bonelli hauled in a 30-yard score in the first quarter to give the Red Wolves a 14-0 lead at the time. Through two games, Bonelli has recorded five catches for 84 yards and one score.

headline: Secures TD in win
story: Cobb reeled in four of five targets for 54 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 52-7 victory over West Georgia.
impact: Cobb led all Red Wolves receivers in yards with 54 on Saturday. Cobb connected with quarterback Trey Owens for.a 28-yard touchdown to open the scoring in the first quarter. Through two games, Cobb has recorded 10 receptions, 129 yards and one touchdown.

headline: Rushing TD in win
story: Clay tallied 12 carries for 49 yards and one touchdown and gathered in all two targets for four yards during Saturday's 52-7 win versus West Georgia.
impact: Clay received the most carries out of any of the Red Wolves' running backs on Saturday and popped a five-yard touchdown run in the third quarter. Through two weeks, Clay has received 25 carries and turned that in 99 yards and two touchdowns. The running back has also recorded four receptions for 89 yards and a touchdown.

headline: Two TD passes in blowout win
story: Owens was 13-for-17 passing for 135 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 52-7 win versus West Georgia.
impact: Owens tossed both of his touchdowns in the first quarter during Saturday's victory. Owens' first touchdown came on a 28-yard strike to Chauncy Cobb before connecting with Jaylen Boneli for a 30-yard score. Through two weeks, Owens has thrown for 460 yard, three touchdowns and four interceptions interceptions. The Red Wolves travel on the road to face TCU next.

headline: Leads Red Wolves in yards
story: Summers reeled in all five targets for 98 yards during Saturday's 42-24 loss versus Memphis.
impact: Summers was Trey Owens' leading receiving on Saturday. The senior went for 505 yards last season on 44 receptions. Summers' longest catch of the day was on 40-yard reception.

headline: Two scores in win
story: Clay accrued 13 rushes for 50 yards and one touchdown and gathered in 2-of-3 targets for 85 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 42-24 loss versus Memphis.
impact: Clay led the Red Wolves backfield on Saturday in both carries and yards. Clay's rushing touchdown came on a one-yard run before breaking free for a 75-yard receiving touchdown.

headline: Strong day in win
story: Cobb hauled in 6-of-7 targets for 75 yards during Saturday's 42-24 defeat against Memphis.
impact: After a 797-yard junior season, Cobb opened the 2026 campaign with a strong showing. Cobb's longest catch of the afternoon came on a 22-yard reception.

headline: Picked off four times in loss
story: Owens was 21-for-30 passing for 325 yards, one touchdown and four interceptions during Saturday's 42-24 defeat against Memphis. He also had seven rushes for 33 yards.
impact: Owens' afternoon was up and down. His 325 yards and 70% completion percentage were impressive but the four interceptions hurt the Red Wolves' offense. Owens and Kenyon Clay connected for a 75-yard score in the second quarter. Up next is a home matchup with West Georgia.

headline: Logs 14 snaps in Week 1
story: Little (undisclosed) playedin 14 snaps in Week 1 against Memphis, though he didn't record a stat.
impact: Little was out for spring camp but managed to suit up in this season opener. Given his limited involvement and his injury history, however, it remains to be seen if he'll continue as the Red Wolves' TE1 going forward.

headline: Starting vs. Memphis
story: Owens is the starting quarterback for Saturday's opener against Memphis, per Charles McCary.
impact: Owens won the starting job and will take the first snaps of the season under center for Arkansas State. The quarterback saw limited action in the past two seasons, appearing in only one game for Texas in 2024. He will look to maintain the starting role and start his season on a high note against Memphis.

headline: Dealing with knee injury
story: Spencer is dealing with a knee injury, Chris Hudgison of K8 News reports.
impact: Arkansas State's fall camp commenced Wednesday, but the first day did not include Spencer, and his knee injury indicates why. Not much else is public about it, but as a result, the running back's availability status has been downgraded to questionable as ASU's team prepares for its season opener Sept. 5 at Memphis.

headline: Punches out nine in Game 1
story: Sale didn't factor in the decision in Game 1 of the NL Wild Card Series against the Phillies on Tuesday. He struck out nine while giving up three runs on four hits and a walk over...
impact: The veteran left-hander surrendered a run during the first inning but shut down Philadelphia for the next five frames before he put on two runners in the seventh that came around to score on righty reliever Didier Fuentes. Sale made just three starts in September as the club managed his workload down the stretch, and he looked plenty fresh Tuesday, touching 100 mph and throwing 95 pitches (65 strikes). Atlanta completed the comeback, and should it complete the series win, Sale tentatively lines up to pitch in Game 2 of the NLDS against the Dodgers on Sunday.

headline: Launches game-deciding homer
story: Riley went 1-for-3 with a three-run home run during Game 1 of the NL Wild Card Series against the Phillies on Tuesday.
impact: The veteran third baseman came to the plate in the eighth inning with Atlanta trailing 3-2, and he delivered a three-run homer to right-center field off Philadelphia closer Jhoan Duran to flip the script. Riley closed the regular season by going 0-for-11 with six strikeouts in his last three games, dropping his OPS for the campaign to a career-worst .654 in 159 contests. Already the Game 1 hero, Riley could effectively erase all his 2026 struggles if he continues to perform in the playoffs.

headline: Touchdown in win over Vandy
story: Nimrod reeled in 5 of 7 targets for 52 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 21-15 victory versus Vanderbilt.
impact: Nimrod led all Auburn receivers this week with five catches and 52 yards. Nimrod was also able to find the end zone for Auburn's only receiving touchdown. Through four weeks, Nimrod and Keshaun Singleton have looked to separate themselves as the top two options in the Auburn passing attack.

headline: Leading rusher in win over Vandy
story: Cobb had eight carries for 58 yards with 2 catches for no yards in Saturday's 21-15 win over Vanderbilt.
impact: Cobb continues to see little work as Byrum Brown has been the overwhelming feature in the Auburn offense. Brown out carried Cobb 10 to eight however Cobb was able to average a stellar 7.3 yards per carry. Cobb continues to be a bit of a touchdown dependent option at running back due to the offensive play style Auburn has chosen to go with.

headline: Two touchdowns in win over Vandy
story: Brown completed 18 of 27 passes for 140 yards, one touchdown and one interception during Saturday's 21-15 victory versus Vanderbilt. He also had 10 rushes for 57 yards with one tou...
impact: After a couple big performances against less than stellar defenses, Brown had a bit of a rocky go in this one has he managed to throw for just 140 yards and balanced out his touchdown pass with an interception. Brown however, was able to make up some of his production with a solid day rushing, adding 57 yards on the ground and a touchdown. While Brown has struggled with his consistency in the passing game, his overwhelming share of the offensive usage and rushing ability keeps him as a strong option week-in and week-out for fantasy owners.

headline: Joining Governors
story: Fowles is transferring to Austin Peay, per App State News.
impact: Fowles will join the Governors after playing two seasons with App State. The redshirt sophomore wide receiver totaled just eight catches for 105 yards across two seasons as a Mountaineer. He'll have two years of eligibility remaining now.

headline: Lands with Governors
story: Wilson is transferring to Austin Peay, per App State News.
impact: Wilson will join the Governors after hitting the portal in late December. The redshirt freshman quarterback played in App State's bowl game loss to Georgia Southern, where he completed 12 of 22 passes for 128 yards and two interceptions and rushed 12 times for 110 yards with one touchdown. He'll have three years of eligibility to use up with Austin Peay.

headline: Remains questionable for Week 5
story: Luster (undisclosed) is questionable for Saturday's game against Toledo, Cade Hampton of The Star Press reports.
impact: Considering that Luster was questionable for Week 4, Ball State replicating his injury status is not the most surprising outcome. Without him then, Tyler Mizzell logged BSU's quarterback snaps. For the Cardinals, Luster's stats feature 55 completions for 438 yards and three touchdowns.

headline: Questionable for Week 5
story: Horton (undisclosed) is questionable for Saturday's game against Toledo, Cade Hampton of The Star Press reports.
impact: In a rare instance of letting the public know about his team's injuries before using the MAC availability report, Ball State's head coach Mike Uremovich confirmed that Horton will be questionable again, as was the case before Week 4. He ended up playing then and is hoping for a similar turnout, albeit with better statistical production than his four yards at Kent.

headline: DNP for Week 4
story: Luster (undisclosed) did not play Saturday's game at Kent.
impact: As expected, Ball State was not in an emergency situation and did not need Luster badly for the Week 4 game. Up next for the Cardinals is Toledo in Week 5.

headline: Scores TD against Kent State
story: Bonds totaled 11 carries for 36 yards and one touchdown and caught all five targets for 57 yards during Saturday's 26-13 loss to Kent State.
impact: Bonds recorded his second score of the season on a 10-yard rush late in the fourth quarter to cut the lead. The running back also posted five receptions for 57 yards, good for the second-most on the team behind Donovan Hamilton. Through four games this season, Bonds has 24 carries for 126 yards and two touchdowns.

headline: Throws one TD in loss
story: Mizzell completed 16 of 27 passes for 164 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 26-13 defeat versus Kent State.
impact: Mizzell completed his first touchdown pass of the season Saturday against Kent State. The quarterback found Donovan Hamilton on a six-yard pass to cut the lead in the third quarter. With the Cardinals hosting Toledo next week, Mizzell will be in line to start if Keldric Luster (undisclosed) is again unable to go.

headline: More carries than yards Week 4
story: Horton (undisclosed) logged five carries for four yards during Saturday's 26-13 loss at Kent.
impact: For the second time across Horton's four games in September, he logged more carries than yards, though the first time was more forgivable considering where it happened, at perennial contender Ohio State. Ideally for him, he is more consistent during the 2026 Cardinals' remaining matchups. Take away Weeks 1 and 4, Horton has 204 rushing yards and three touchdowns, separately both more than those for his 2024 and 2025 seasons.

headline: Breaks out in MAC opener
story: Hamilton (undisclosed) logged seven receptions for 80 yards during Saturday's 26-13 defeat to Kent State.
impact: Hamilton updated his career-high for not only receptions but also receiving yards. Although scoring has been a recurring issue for Ball State, he caught a touchdown pass from backup quarterback Tyler Mizzell, the wide receiver's first with BSU. The wideout finished September with 14 receptions for 150 yards. Another month like that, and Hamilton will surpass his 2025 season's production of 20 receptions for 244 yards.

headline: Set to start Saturday
story: Mizzell is set to start at quarterback for Saturday's game at Kent State, Cade Hampton of The Star Press reports.
impact: With Keldric Luster (undisclosed) only available as an emergency option, Mizzell is set to make his first start of the season. He attempted four passes in the season opener versus Ohio State, completing two for 31 yards. He's also attempted four rushes this season for a combined negative one yard.

headline: Slated for emergency QB duties
story: Luster (undisclosed) is slated to serve in an emergency QB role Saturday and isn't expected to play versus Kent State, Cade Hampton of The Star Press reports.
impact: Luster was deemed a question mark on the availability report leading up to the contest, but it appears he won't be able to give it a go Saturday and may only step in if things go awry under center. Tyler Mizzell is slated to start in his place.

headline: Good to go for Week 4
story: Thompson (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game at Kent.
impact: Thompson is looking for his FBS targets since 2024, when he was enrolled at UNLV. For that year's Rebels, the wide receiver was targeted 21 times but managed only four catches, albeit for 60 yards.

headline: Out for Week 4
story: Ward (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game at Kent.
impact: Ward is a surprise addition to Ball State's availability report, which did not include him before each of the 2026 Cardinals' first three games. He did not log any targets in September.

headline: Status questionable for MAC opener
story: Horton (undisclosed) is questionable for Saturday's game at Kent.
impact: As the 2026 Cardinals prepare to begin their MAC schedule, they may be without Horton, who gradually improved with each and passing game of their non-conference matchups. The improvement culminated in a two-touchdown performance at Liberty, and without him, Ball State's running game will be without one of its top-two options.

headline: Tabbed as questionable
story: Hamilton sports a questionable tag for Saturday's game versus Kent State, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Hamilton has put up decent numbers through his first three games, collecting a combined seven grabs for 70 yards on 10 targets. It's unclear if he'll be able to suit up Saturday due to the issue, as is the case for starting quarterback Keldric Luster, so the Cardinals' passing attack could be down some sizable weapons as conference play fires up.

headline: Questionable for Week 3
story: Luster (undisclosed) is questionable for Saturday's game at Kent.
impact: Ball State's team has been presented with an interesting dilemma, as the 2026 Cardinals may begin their regular season without Luster. If the quarterback cannot attempt to bounce back from his relatively weak Week 3 performance, Tyler Mizzell is next in line to take snaps for them.

headline: Contributes two scores in loss
story: Horton posted eight carries for 79 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 51-15 loss versus Liberty.
impact: Horton was the lone bright spot for the Cardinals during their 36-point loss Saturday. After a slow start to the season against Ohio State, the running back has recorded back-to-back games with at least 75 rushing yards and a touchdown.

headline: Struggles in Week 3
story: Luster completed 10 of 21 passes for 93 yards during Saturday's 51-15 defeat to Liberty. He also had 10 rushes for 42 yards.
impact: Luster was unable to get into a rhythm Saturday after failing to eclipse the century-mark in passing yards for the second time this season. The quarterback will look to get back on track next week as the Cardinals open conference play against Kent State.

headline: Sitting out Saturday
story: Thompson will miss Saturday's game against Liberty, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Thompson saw a little action in the opener against Ohio State before not taking the field in Week 2 against Stony Brook. He'll skip out on Week 3 as well but will get another chance to suit up next Saturday versus Kent State.

headline: Available against Liberty
story: Breveard (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game at Liberty, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Breveard will suit up for Ball State on Saturday after missing the team's first two games of the season. The freshman will add depth to the running back room.

headline: Solid performance in win
story: Smith caught all six targets for 72 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 41-17 victory versus Stony Brook.
impact: Smith averaged 12 yards per reception while reeling in six catches during a 24-point win Saturday. The Florida Atlantic transfer captured his first touchdown as a Cardinal after reeling in a 23-yard pass from Keldric Luster early in the second quarter.

headline: Scores in home opener
story: Bonds totaled six rushes for 77 yards and one touchdown and gathered in their only target for 23 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 41-17 win versus Stony Brook.
impact: Bonds scored on the ground and through the air during the Cardinals' big win Saturday. The running back caught a 23-yard pass from Keldric Luster midway through the second quarter to extend the lead and later capped it off with a 49-yard burst for another score.

headline: Starting hitting progression
story: Orioles president of baseball operations Mike Elias said Monday that Westburg (elbow) will begin a hitting progression this week, Rich Dubroff of BaltimoreBaseball.com reports.
impact: Westburg underwent Tommy John surgery in May and missed the entire 2026 season. However, because he's a position player and not a pitcher, he has a good chance to head into the 2027 season without any limitations. Westburg has slashed .264/.312/.456 over parts of three major-league seasons and, assuming health, could open next season as the Orioles' primary third baseman.

headline: Sports hernia surgery scheduled
story: Orioles president of baseball operations Mike Elias said Monday that Bradish will undergo surgery Tuesday to repair a sports hernia, Andy Kostka of TheBanner.com reports.
impact: Bradish has been sidelined since mid-September with the injury and has ultimately decided to have it surgically repaired. More should be known regarding a timetable following the operation, but it should not affect Bradish's availability for the beginning of spring training. The right-hander finished the 2026 season with a 4.12 ERA, 1.46 WHIP and 142:70 K:BB over 155 innings covering 29 starts.

headline: Game 162 canceled
story: Baz will not start in Sunday's regular-season finale against the Yankees due to inclement weather, and the game will not be rescheduled.
impact: Sunday's game didn't carry much meaning, given that the Yankees are locked in as the No. 4 seed in the American League playoffs and the Orioles are eliminated from postseason contention. Baz will end the 2026 regular season with a 6-15 record across 31 starts and a 4.11 ERA, 1.35 WHIP and 154:63 K:BB over a career-high 179.2 innings.

headline: Notches sack in Rio win
story: Smith logged nine tackles (three solo), including 1.0 sacks, during the Ravens' 34-31 win over the Cowboys in Rio on Sunday.
impact: Smith played 100 percent of the Ravens' defensive snaps for the third straight game. The linebacker has yet to miss a defensive play and led the Ravens in tackles for the second time this season. Smith sacked quarterback Dak Prescott on third and goal in the first quarter for minus-9 yards, leading to the Cowboys settling for a field goal on the team's opening drive.

headline: Scores in Saturday's win
story: Freeman gathered in 6 of 9 targets for 59 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 23-13 win against Colorado.
impact: Freeman had another high volume day Saturday, and he also found the endzone in the second quarter on a four-yard reception. While he was certainly productive in the two games with DJ Lagway, his production with Lagway has been special. He has 18 catches (on 27 targets) for 213 yards and two touchdowns through two games with Lagway under center, both of which came against Power 4 opponents. Freeman is one of the top fantasy receivers in the nation right now, especially in PPR formats.

headline: Quiet in Saturday's win
story: McGowan accrued two receptions (on four targets) for 34 yards during Saturday's 23-13 victory over Colorado.
impact: McGowan, who caught two touchdowns in each of his last two appearances, came back down to earth Saturday with DJ Lagway back at quarterback. He caught two of his four targets for a modest output and was unable to find the endzone in the relatively low scoring affair. He'll look to bounce back Saturday at Arizona State.

headline: Throws two TDs in return
story: Lagway was 19-for-39 passing for 221 yards, two touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 23-13 win versus Colorado.
impact: Lagway made his return to the field Saturday after missing the previous two games with an ankle injury. He was definitely not at his best as he completed under 50 percent of his passes, but he did enough to secure the win, including two scoring drives in the fourth quarter. Next up is the first conference road game of the season, at Arizona State on Saturday.

headline: Available for Week 4
story: Lagway (ankle) is available for Saturday's game against Colorado, Zach Smith of the Waco Tribune reports.
impact: Lagway can return following a two-game absence caused by an injured ankle, and he will look to help Baylor's team begin its conference schedule strong. Back in 2025, he completed 160 passes for 1,754 yards and nine touchdowns across SEC matchups. Lagway will look to prove that he has cleaned up his turnover rate (9-12 TD-INT ratio last season) and efficiency for a Baylor team expecting him to break out of his previous funk.

headline: Good to go Saturday
story: Porter (undisclosed) will be available for Saturday's game versus Colorado, Zach Smith of the Waco Tribune reports.
impact: Porter was labeled probable leading up to the tilt, so his availability doesn't come as a big surprise. The junior posted a strong start against Auburn, racking up five catches for 77 yards on 10 targets, but he left early in Week 2 and missed Week 3, so Saturday will be his first chance to add to the total from the opener.

headline: Expected to be available Week 4
story: Lagway (ankle) is expected to be available for Saturday's game against Colorado, Pete Nakos of On3.com reports.
impact: After a two-game absence, Week 4 is projected to mark Lagway's return from an ankle injury. The junior will have little leeway in his return, as he and Baylor will prepare to begin their 2026 season's conference schedule. On the plus side, Lagway's only game this season saw him face Power Conference team Auburn and showcase some of his talent by completing 27 passes for 333 yards and one touchdown. Ideally for him, he can clean up his completion percentage and turnover rate (50.0 percent and two TOs respectively) as the campaign progresses.

headline: Ready to go Saturday
story: Collier (undisclosed) is not on the injury report ahead of Saturday's game against Colorado.
impact: Collier is in line to make his season debut Saturday. The wide receiver missed the previous three games to start the campaign with an undisclosed injury.

headline: Probable for Week 4
story: Porter (undisclosed) is listed as probable ahead of Saturday's matchup against Colorado.
impact: After missing last week's matchup against Louisiana Tech, Porter is expected to play Saturday against the Buffaloes. The wide receiver has recorded five catches for 77 yards through two games this season.

headline: Officially listed as probable
story: Lagway (ankle) is probable for Saturday's game against Colorado, per the Big 12 availability report.
impact: Lagway's probable tag makes sense after an earlier report mentioned that he was given the "green light" to return against Colorado. Nate Bennett served as the starter in his absence but will return to the backup role. Lagway was impressive in his only appearance of the season during the opener, tossing two touchdowns despite dealing with an ankle injury.

headline: Limited for the first time
story: Jones only had 39 receiving yards on three catches in the Boise St. 32-7 win over Western Michigan on Sept. 26.
impact: Despite the drop in output, the freshman has still been a steady receiver for the Broncos. He is averaging 68 receiving yards and four catches per game. The Broncos face Utah State in the next contest on Oct. 3. Jones has a shot at improving his numbers this season as the Aggies defense is in the bottom quarter against the pass.

headline: Tallies career best
story: Wagner led the Boise Street receivers with 94 yards on seven catches and two touchdowns in the Boise St. 32-7 win over Western Michigan on Saturday.
impact: Wagner's numbers against Western Michigan were by far his personal best. His previous top mark came against Utah Street with 64 yards on four catches and a touchdown. Ironically the Broncos face Utah State in the next contest on Oct. 3. The senior has a good chance to repeat his numbers against the Aggies this season.

headline: Continues to run, tally TD
story: Riley collected 138 rushing yards on 28 carries in the Boise St. 32-7 win over Western Michigan on Sept. 26.
impact: Riley already has accumulated 592 rushing yards on 90 carries in 2026 in four games. The junior faces Utah State on Oct. 3. The Aggies defense is in the middle of the pack in the country against the run. Riley should continue to excel on the ground.

headline: Tosses 3 TDs
story: Madsen did not have to do much with 204 passing yards in completing 16-of-23 pass attempts that included three touchdowns in the Boise St. 32-7 win over Western Michigan on Sept. 2...
impact: Madsen might not be putting up a lot of yards, but he is firing touchdowns. With the three touchdowns Madsen has nine for the season. Madsen already has reached the half-way point in terms of touchdowns compared to last season where he had 18. Boise State starts the Pac 12 season when the Broncos face Utah State on Oct. 3. The senior can look for the same passing numbers against Utah State who is in the bottom third of the nation in defending the pass.

headline: Not playing Saturday
story: Gaines (upper body) will not play in Saturday's game against Western Michigan, B.J. Rains of Bronco Nation News reports.
impact: Gaines was seen in street clothes on the sidelines, indicating his absence for this contest due to an upper body injury. He will aim to be back for next week's contest against Utah State.

headline: No cast in early warmups
story: Gaines (wrist) is wearing football pants and does not have a cast on in early warmups ahead of Saturday's game at Western Michigan, Jordan Smith of KTVB reports.
impact: Gaines is officially a game-time decision for Saturday's contest, but his participation in early warmups is certainly a promising sign. Gaines will need to keep warming up without any setbacks for him to play in the important out-of-conference contest. He has 292 yards and three touchdowns through three games this season so his availability is very important for the Broncos.

headline: Game-time decision for Week 4
story: Gaines (upper body) is a game-time decision for Saturday's game at Western Michigan, Pete Thamel of ESPN reports.
impact: It looks like Boise State could not gauge Gaines' availability Friday, so with that in mind, the Broncos are expected to see if they can have him prepare for their upcoming game before deciding his availability. Even though Western Michigan does not sound like the most formidable opponent, WMU's team opened its season keeping Michigan in check, and he is on an impressive roll. In each of the 2026 Broncos' first three games, Gaines has scored a touchdown.

headline: Questionable vs. Western Michigan
story: Gaines (upper body) is questionable for the Broncos' huge showdown with Western Michigan and even if he does play, it's likely to be in a limited role, per Shaun Goodwin of the Ida...
impact: Gaines has been quite productive for the Broncos this season. He's coming off a 112-yard, one-touchdown performance last week against South Dakota and he's racked up 292 total yards and three scores through three games. However, he's a question mark for the big showdown in Kalamazoo, and even if he does play, he's expected to be limited. Expect a bigger workload for Dylan Riley and Juelz Goff come Saturday.

headline: Leads Broncos in receiving
story: Jones collected 95 receiving yards on eight catches and a touchdown to top Boise State in the Broncos 38-24 win over a stingy South Dakota team on Saturday.
impact: It has been quite a beginning for the freshman who has accumulated 232 receiving yards on 15 catches in the first three games. In addition Jones caught his first touchdown, a nine-yard catch against South Dakota. The freshman will try to add more yards to his resume when Boise State faces Western Michigan on Sept. 26.

headline: Leads Broncos in rushing
story: Riley just missed the 200-yard rushing mark with 198 on 26 carries and two touchdowns in the Boise State 38-24 win over a stingy South Dakota team on Saturday.
impact: Riley came in against South Dakota off a 206-yard game against Memphis in the previous week. He added a pair of receptions for 18 yards. The junior will look for another 200-yard day, this time against Western Michigan on Sept. 26.

headline: Reaching century mark
story: Gaines topped 100 rushing yards for the first time since last season with 102 yards on the ground on 17 carries along with a touchdown in the Boise State 38-24 win over a stingy So...
impact: Gaines added three catches for seven yards. It was the third time Gaines topped 100 yards. The last time came against Colorado State with 149 rushing yards and 22 carries on Nov. 22, 2025. Gaines will try to increase his numbers in the last non-conference game against Western Michigan on Sept. 26 before the start of the Pac 12 season.

headline: Fires Pair of TDs
story: Madsen threw for a pair of touchdowns and completed 22-of-31 pass attempts for 208 yards in a 38-24 win over a stingy South Dakota team on Saturday.
impact: Madsen also added 19 rushing yards on three carries as the Broncos opted to run the ball with 327 yards on the ground. The senior will try to increase his numbers in the last non-conference game against Western Michigan on Sept. 26 before the start of the Pac 12 season.

headline: May be available for Week 5
story: Clough (undisclosed) may be available for Saturday's game at SMU, Graham Dietz of Sports Illustrated reports.
impact: Clough's absence spans multiple games, indicating some severity with his undisclosed injury. Boston College will enter the thick of ACC play in October and would love to have him available to boost BC's tight end room. In his first two games this season, Clough logged six receptions for 50 yards, spread out relatively evenly in relatively tough matchups against Cincinnati and Rutgers.

headline: Completely stymied by Hokies
story: Dickens had six carries for nine yards and caught 1 of 2 targets for two yards during Saturday's 21-14 loss versus Virginia Tech.
impact: Dickens had a touchdown in each of his first three games this season, and had managed to be productive despite playing in a Eagles' offense that leaves a lot to be desired. But against Virginia Tech, he was completely shut down. Only Mason McKenzie, Boston College's quarterback, could find rushing room in Week 4. Dickens will look to get back on track at SMU in Week 5.

headline: Big rushing output in loss
story: McKenzie completed 11 of 23 passes for 111 yards during Saturday's 21-14 defeat against Virginia Tech. He also had 26 rushes for 138 yards with two touchdowns.
impact: McKenzie had another forgettable day throwing the football, but the quarterback had his best day yet on the ground with nearly 140 rushing yards and two scores. The Eagles managed to keep it close against Virginia Tech, but they're still going to need more out of their quarterback who's completing just 56.5% of his passes with a 3:5 touchdown-to-interception ratio.

headline: Unavailable for Week 4
story: Lewis won't be in uniform for Saturday's game versus Virginia Tech, per the ACC availability report.
impact: Lewis is only a depth option at tight end, so his absence shouldn't be much of a detriment to the Eagles' offense. He'll have plenty of chances ahead to get back in uniform.

headline: Cleared to play
story: Swanson (undisclosed) is off the injury report for Saturday's game against Virginia Tech.
impact: Swanson briefly popped up on Wednesday's report as probable and is now cleared to go. The Colgate transfer is coming off a career year but may need some injuries ahead of him to create some more opportunities to see the field.

headline: Available for Saturday
story: MacCormack (shoulder) is available for Saturday's game versus Virginia Tech, per the ACC availability report.
impact: MacCormack, who was listed as probable on the team's initial report, is now off the report and available for Saturday. He missed the last two games with a shoulder injury after gaining 52 yards in the season opener versus Cincinnati. Now that he's healthy he's set for a solid role alongside Evan Dickens.

headline: Out vs. Virginia Tech
story: Addison (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game against Virginia Tech, per the ACC availability report.
impact: Addison will miss Saturday's game due to an undisclosed reason, though the true freshman running back wasn't expected to see snaps in the backfield.

headline: Will play Saturday
story: Dopson is not on the injury report ahead of Saturday's game against Virginia Tech.
impact: Dopson will make his season debut during Week 4's matchup against the Hokies. The wide receiver has yet to record a snap during his brief career at Boston College.

headline: Available against Virginia Tech
story: Graves (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game versus Virginia Tech, per the ACC availability report.
impact: Graves is set to suit up Saturday after missing last week's matchup versus Stanford. He isn't expected to play a big factor in the passing attack due to his standing on the depth chart.

headline: Probable for Saturday
story: MacCormack (shoulder) is probable for Saturday's game against Virginia Tech, per the ACC availability report.
impact: MacCormack is in line to suit up Saturday after missing two consecutive games for Boston College. The running back should see carries in the backfield if healthy after attempting seven rushes in Week 1.

headline: Probable for Week 4
story: Swanson is listed as probable ahead of Saturday's matchup against Virginia Tech.
impact: After sitting out last week's matchup against Maine, Swanson is likely to play in Week 4's matchup against the Eagles. The wide receiver has battled through an undisclosed injury and has caught just one pass for 18 yards in two games.

headline: Out for Week 4
story: Clough (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game against Virginia Tech, per the ACC availability report.
impact: Clough is set to miss his second straight game as he deals with an undisclosed problem. The tight end has been a big target in the passing attack this season, hauling in six receptions for 50 yards. Zeke Moore and Danny Edgehille are in line for more targets Saturday.

headline: Playing through injury
story: Swanson (undisclosed) is playing through an injury this fall, per Trevor Hass of The Boston Globe.
impact: Swanson missed Week 3 against Maine, and otherwise the wideout has just one catch for 18 yards in Week 2. He's clearly hampered by his ailment, but the receiver is looking to play through it and contribute for this stagnant Eagles' offense.

headline: Sits out Week 3
story: Clough (undisclosed) did not play in Saturday's 22-16 win over Maine.
impact: Clough missed his first outing of the season with an unknown injury. The 6-foot-3 tight end will now aim to get back to action for this Saturday's game against Virginia Tech.

headline: Leading receiver as BC squeaks by Maine
story: Montague hauled in 5 of 7 targets for 72 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 22-16 victory over Maine.
impact: Montague has been hot and cold this season. He had two grabs for 55 yards and a score in the opener against Cincy, but he didn't have a single catch in Week 2. The wideout then had a career day against FCS Maine in Week 3. Given how ineffective this offense looks overall, though, it appears unwise to bank on production from Montague.

headline: Another solid day
story: Dickens tallied 15 rushes for 102 yards and one touchdown and caught 1 of 2 targets for eight yards during Saturday's 22-16 victory against Maine.
impact: Boston College only managed to beat FCS Maine by six points, but the starting running back Dickens had another good game. He scored his third rushing touchdown in three games, and surpassed 100 yards for the first time this season. The matchup gets much tougher in Week 4 against Virginia Tech.

headline: Another two-interception day
story: McKenzie completed 14 of 21 passes for 173 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions during Saturday's 22-16 victory over Maine. He also had 15 rushes for 53 yards.
impact: McKenzie once again tossed for one touchdown and two interceptions in Week 3, but it was more alarming considering it came against FCS Maine. He did get involved on the ground against with 53 yards, but McKenzie's continued struggles don't bode well for the rest of the season.

headline: Exits with hand injury
story: Anthony was removed from Game 1 of the AL Wild Card Series against the Yankees on Tuesday due to a right hand injury, Gabrielle Starr of the Boston Herald reports.
impact: Anthony's hand reportedly began bothering him after a check swing in the third inning, leading to his eventual removal in the sixth. The 22-year-old outfielder missed nearly four months in the regular season due to an injury in the same hand, though it's unclear whether his latest injury will force him to miss time. If he ends up needing to come off the Red Sox's wild-card roster, he would be ineligible to play again until the ALCS.

headline: Participant in Week 4
story: Sowell (undisclosed) participated in Saturday's game against South Florida.
impact: Even though Sowell was a limited participant, it looks like he can prepare for October in a healthy state. For the month of September, he was targeted twice and caught a 15-yard pass.

headline: Struggles again Saturday
story: Kastantin was 16-for-28 passing for 122 yards during Saturday's 14-6 defeat against South Florida.
impact: Kastantin was unable to get in a groove during the Falcons' fourth consecutive loss to open the season. To start the season, the quarterback has recorded 565 passing yards with two touchdowns and two interceptions.

headline: Questionable vs. USF
story: Sowell is listed questionable ahead of Saturday's game against South Florida.
impact: Sowell is in danger of missing his first game of the season as he deals with an undisclosed injury. The senior wide receiver has totaled one reception for 15 yards this season.

headline: Out for remainder of season
story: Clay (undisclosed) will miss the remainder of the 2026 season, the team announced.
impact: Clay had not played in any games this season and is now set to miss the remainder of the campaign as he deals with an undisclosed injury. The sophomore wide receiver will focus on getting back to full health for next year.

headline: Scores first career TD
story: Sharp totaled one catch for 59 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 55-7 loss against Iowa State.
impact: Sharp recorded his first career score in his third year at Bowling Green. The wide receiver caught a 59-yard pass from Jay Kastantin in the first quarter to get the Falcons on the board.

headline: Underwhelming performance in loss
story: Kastantin was 8-for-17 passing for 97 yards, one touchdown and one interception during Saturday's 55-7 defeat versus Iowa State.
impact: Kastanin was unable to lead the Falcons to their first victory of the campaign during Saturday's blowout loss. The quarterback contributed one score after tossing a 59-yard pass to Winn Sharp in the first quarter. Kastanin will look to turn the tables next week against South Florida.

headline: Not playing Saturday
story: Dawson (undisclosed) is listed out ahead of Saturday's matchup against Minnesota.
impact: Dawson will miss his second matchup of the season as he deals with an undisclosed injury. He will aim to be back on the field for next week's contest against USF.

headline: Out Saturday
story: Clay (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game at Iowa State, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Clay is set to miss his third straight game due to an undisclosed issue. The wideout's next chance to suit up is against South Florida in Week 4.

headline: Good to go Saturday
story: Dawson (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game against Nebraska.
impact: Dawson didn't play in Week 1, but he's ready to roll to face Nebraska. That said, he's not expected to carry a big role on offense and shouldn't be anything more than a depth option in the passing game.

headline: Remaining out Saturday
story: Clay (undisclosed) will not appear in Saturday's game against Nebraska.
impact: Clay will remain sidelined as the Falcons take on the Cornhuskers in Week 2. The 6-foot sophomore wideout, who tallied seven rushing yards in one appearance last season, has yet to see the field for Bowling Green this fall.

headline: Just one catch vs. Bolts
story: Knox hauled in his lone target for five yards in a 24-16 win over the Chargers on Sunday.
impact: Knox and fellow tight end Dalton Kincaid combined for only four targets from Josh Allen in Sunday's game, with wide receiver DJ Moore leading all pass catchers with 10 targets. Knox is up to a 4-17-1 receiving line on four targets through three regular-season games, and his production will be limited to occasional red zone opportunities as long as Kincaid is healthy. The Bills will stay home for a Week 4 AFC East clash against the Patriots this Sunday.

headline: Leading receiver in win
story: Morrow had five receptions (on 11 targets) for 58 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-28 win against Robert Morris.
impact: Morrow led the Bulls in receptions (five) and receiving yards (58) during Saturday's win over Robert Morris. The wide receiver crossed the goal line on a nine-yard reception from Jason Wright to extend the lead in the fourth quarter. In four games, Morrow has 25 receptions for 307 yards and six touchdowns, which is tied for the fourth-most in the FBS.

headline: Scores twice in Week 4
story: Hill totaled 21 carries for 64 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 31-28 victory against Robert Morris.
impact: Despite being the third-leading rusher for the Bulls on Saturday, Hill found the end zone twice during the win. The running back got Buffalo on the board with a four-yard run in the second and topped it off with a one-yard touchdown in the third to take the lead.

headline: Runs for 146 yards
story: Burch totaled 26 carries for 146 yards and caught 1 of 2 targets for nine yards during Saturday's 31-28 win versus Robert Morris.
impact: After combining for 100 rushing yards through his first three games, Burch doubled his season total with 146 yards Saturday. Despite not scoring, the running back averaged 5.6 carries per rush, including a 43-yard run.

headline: Effective on the ground in win
story: Wright was 15-for-28 passing for 140 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions during Saturday's 31-28 victory over Robert Morris. He also had 15 rushes for 95 yards with one touc...
impact: After a disappointing week against Penn State, Wright bounced back with three touchdowns against Robert Morris on Saturday. The quarterback accounted for 95 of the team's 302 rushing yards, including his first rushing score of the campaign. In three games, the Virginia native has 385 passing yards, 95 rushing yards, four touchdowns and three interceptions.

headline: Out Saturday
story: Sholder is listed out ahead of Saturday's game against Robert Morris.
impact: Sholder will be forced to sit out this matchup as he deals with an undisclosed injury. He will aim to be available for next week's meeting with Western Michigan.

headline: Won't suit up Saturday
story: Watkins will not suit up for Saturday's game versus Robert Morris, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Watkins serves primarily as a depth option, so his absence shouldn't be much of a detriment to the Bulls' offense. Still, they will be down some depth at wide receiver on Saturday with the junior unavailable.

headline: Available vs. Robert Morris
story: Leonard (undisclosed) is off the injury report ahead of Saturday's game against Robert Morris.
impact: Leonard has yet to make his season debut as he has been working his way back from an undisclosed injury. The redshirt sophomore tight end will aim to make the most of his opportunities.

headline: Sitting out Saturday
story: Gathings will miss Saturday's game against Robert Morris, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Gathings only has three catches to his name so far this season and has played very little since the opener against FCS Albany, seemingly due to injury. He'll miss another contest Saturday and will shift his focus toward getting ready for the start of conference play next week versus Western Michigan.

headline: Out Saturday
story: McNeil (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game versus Robert Morris, per the MAC availability report.
impact: McNeil, who had 20 carries in the Week 3 loss to Penn State, has been ruled out for Saturday's contest. Though he likely wouldn't play much with the starters, McNeil could have still seen a decent amount of the field if the game turned into a blowout. His next chance to play is next Saturday versus Western Michigan.

headline: Good to go Saturday
story: Andrews (undisclosed) is off the injury report ahead of Saturday's game against Robert Morris.
impact: Andrews did not play in last week's game as he was coming back from an undisclosed injury. The junior wide receiver will aim to maximize his opportunities after reeling in six receptions for 39 yards across two appearances.

headline: Not playing Saturday
story: Shelton (undisclosed) is listed out ahead of Saturday's game against Robert Morris.
impact: Shelton will miss back-to-back games as he tends an undisclosed injury. The junior running back will aim to be available for next week's clash against Western Michigan.

headline: Out vs. Robert Morris
story: Holmes (knee) is listed out ahead of Saturday's game against Robert Morris.
impact: Holmes will now be forced to miss back-to-back games as he continues to work his way back from a knee injury. The senior quarterback will aim to be back on the field for next week's meeting with Western Michigan. In his absence, Jason Wright gets the start.

headline: Logs DNP vs. Penn State
story: Andrews (undisclosed) did not play in Saturday's 55-13 loss to Penn State.
