impact: Andrews got the start in Week 2 against FIU, but he unfortunately was sidelined just a week later with an unknown injury. The 6-foot-1 pass catcher will now look to return to the field for this Saturday's outing against Robert Morris.

headline: Struggles against Penn State
story: Wright was 10-for-25 passing for 60 yards during Saturday's 55-13 defeat against Penn State. He also had six rushes for three yards.
impact: Wright completed just 40 percent of his 25 passes during Saturday's 42-point loss to the Nittany Lions. The quarterback was unable to complete at least half of his passing attempts for the second consecutive game. Wright will look to bounce back next week against Robert Morris.

headline: Out Saturday
story: Jones (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game at Penn State, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Jones, who has not appeared in a game this season, is out for Saturday's contest. It's unlikely he would've seen the field much though given his place on the depth chart. His next chance to suit up is next Saturday versus Robert Morris.

headline: Out Saturday
story: Shelton (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game at Penn State, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Shelton, who has 22 carries through two games this season, will be forced to miss Saturday's contest with an undisclosed injury. Messiah Burch should step in and lead the Bulls' backfield with Shelton out. Shelton's next chance to play is Saturday versus Robert Morris.

headline: Available vs. PSU
story: Gathings (undisclosed) is not listed on the injury report ahead of Saturday's game against Penn State.
impact: Gathings missed last week's matchup and was questionable during the week as he dealt with an undisclosed injury but appears to have gotten past it. The senior wide receiver will look to get the season back on track.

headline: Starting vs. Penn State
story: Wright will start at quarterback against Penn State on Saturday, per Pete Thamel of ESPN.com.
impact: Wright draws the start at quarterback due to Elijah Holmes (knee) not dressing for the Bulls. The signal-caller will face a tough task against a formidable Nittany Lions' defense. This marks his first career start after appearing in four games last season with Buffalo, where he was used primarily as a rusher with 15 attempts for 43 yards on the ground.

headline: Possibly starting Saturday
story: Wright may be in line to start Saturday's matchup against Penn State due to fellow quarterback Elijah Holmes' injury, per Jonah Bronstein of the Associated Press.
impact: Holmes has missed practice this week due to a knee injury that could keep him out against the Nittany Lions, giving Wright an opportunity to make the start. Although it's an opportunity to make his first start of the season, the 6-foot-2 signal caller could be in for a tough day against a talented Penn State defense expected to serve as a tough matchup for the Bulls.

headline: Hot start continues Saturday
story: Glasker caught all five targets for 131 yards and rushed three times for 21 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 41-23 victory against Colorado State.
impact: Glasker had an excellent performance Saturday, highlighted by his five-yard touchdown run at the end of the first half. He led the team in receptions, targets and yards, accounting for well over half of Bear Bachmeier's passing yards in the game. Glasker's volume remains fairly low, but the Cougars prioritize getting him the ball in space and he clearly has the ability to make big plays. The true freshman is worth a speculative add given his production through the first three games of his career.

headline: Dominant in Saturday's win
story: Martin logged 15 rushes for 176 yards and three touchdowns and reeled in their only target for nine yards during Saturday's 41-23 win over Colorado State.
impact: Martin, who failed to score a touchdown in the opening two games of the season, made up for lost time in Saturday's win. He scored a hat-trick of touchdowns -- including a 56-yard burst on the opening drive -- all of which came in the first quarter. His 176 yards rushing are his second most in a game in his career, only behind his 222 yards (on 32 carries) at Cincinnati last season.

headline: Quiet in Saturday's win
story: Bachmeier completed 12 of 16 passes for 227 yards and one interception during Saturday's 41-23 victory over Colorado State.
impact: After accounting for eight touchdowns over the opening two games of the season, Bachmeier was slowed down in Saturday's win. A big reason for that was the Cougars' domination in the ground game, led by LJ Martin's 176 yards and three touchdowns. Bachmeier will look to bounce back after the bye week at TCU on Oct. 3.

headline: Nothing doing vs. Clemson
story: Hendricks had four receptions (on six targets) for 37 yards during Friday's 24-10 loss versus Clemson.
impact: Hendricks had his worst fantasy game of the season against a Tigers' defense that largely shut down the Golden Bears offensive attack. He'll look to bounce back in a much more enticing matchup in Week 5 at UNLV.

headline: Held in check vs. Clemson
story: Strong posted three receptions (on seven targets) for 44 yards during Friday's 24-10 defeat against Clemson.
impact: Strong was held to 50 yards for the second straight game. It was a very forgettable outing from his quarterback Jaron-Keawe Sagapolutele, which certainly contributed to his quieter performance. But even last week, when Sagapolutele tossed for over 400 yards, Strong accounted for just 48 of them. He'll look to play a bigger role in this passing game in Week 5 at UNLV.

headline: Largely contained by Tigers
story: Mohammed compiled 13 carries for 51 yards and reeled in all three targets for 30 yards during Friday's 24-10 loss versus Clemson.
impact: After a three-touchdown day against FCS Wagner in Week 3, Mohammed was mostly contained by much stiffer competition. The tailback was still California's clear top back, and he turned his 16 touches into 81 total yards, but it was an overall quiet day for the star tailback. Week 5 at UNLV presents an easier defense for the Golden Bears.

headline: Struggles vs. Clemson defense
story: Sagapolutele was 16-for-29 passing for 119 yards and two interceptions during Friday's 24-10 defeat to Clemson.
impact: Sagapolutele had his worst outing of the season against the Tigers, who held him to under 120 yards passing on just 55.2% completion. He was held without a touchdown, and threw another two interceptions. It's been a roller-coaster ride thus far for the sophomore gunslinger, but he should have a great chance to bounce back in Week 5 at UNLV.

headline: Officially out vs. Clemson
story: Vargas (leg) is out for Friday's game versus Clemson, per the ACC availability report.
impact: Vargas was listed as doubtful on California's initial injury report, so his absence comes as an expected outcome. The running back is dealing with a leg injury and will miss his third straight contest. Adam Mohammed and Ashten Emory should continue seeing action in the backfield, while Vargas aims to recover in time for the team's Week 5 matchup at UNLV.

headline: Off injury report, available Friday
story: Walker (undisclosed) is not listed on the report ahead of Friday's game against Clemson.
impact: Walker is one of several skill players who look set to return to action in Week 4. However, the senior TE is a depth alternative at the position, so he shouldn't have a ton of fantasy upside even if he's available to suit up against the Tigers.

headline: Available for Week 4
story: Rogers (undisclosed) is not listed on the report ahead of Friday's game against Clemson.
impact: Rogers hasn't played yet this season, but the wideout could be on the verge of making his season debut in this Week 4 matchup. Even if that's the case, don't expect Rogers to have a big role in the passing attack, meaning he shouldn't carry a ton of fantasy appeal.

headline: Not listed on report
story: Boscia (undisclosed) is not listed on the report ahead of Friday's game against Clemson.
impact: Boscia was targeted once in Week 1 and didn't play in the next two games, but he's expected to be available Friday. Even if that's the case, expect Boscia to be a non-factor in the passing game since he's merely a depth option in the passing attack.

headline: Doubtful for Week 4
story: Vargas (leg) is doubtful for Friday's game against Clemson.
impact: Vargas has missed California's last two games, and the doubtful tag suggests he's likely to miss a third straight. If the star tailback doesn't play Friday in this divisional matchup, Adam Mohammed and Ashten Emory should remain the go-to options in the Golden Bears' backfield.

headline: Quiet outing again
story: Strong totaled six receptions (on eight targets) for 48 yards during Saturday's 49-7 victory versus Wagner.
impact: Strong didn't need to have a massive day for the Golden Bears to blowout Wagner and put up nearly 50 points. Still, the receiver, one of California's prized transfers, hasn't made a whole lot of noise this season 14 catches for 206 yards through three games is certainly still very solid, but Strong will look to surpass 100 yards and score his first touchdown with the Golden Bears in Week 4 against Clemson.

headline: Expected to miss time
story: Lewis (elbow) is set to miss a few weeks with a UCL injury, Mike Kaye of ESPN reports.
impact: The Panthers' starting left guard suffered a UCL tear during Sunday's loss to the Browns and was unable to return to the contest. With Lewis sidelined for Week 4 and beyond, Corey Bullock is set to take over as the new starting left guard for the foreseeable future.

headline: Set to practice for Chippewas
story: Blue (thigh) will practice for Central Michigan this week, per Andrew E. Graham of Mitten Football.
impact: Blue missed Central Michigan's rough loss to Miami with a thigh contusion, but the tailback is slated to return to practice this week. Blue has 24 carries for 107 yards and a score this season as well as four catches for 28 yards. His return would be a big boost for the Chippewas' ground game against Akron in Week 5.

headline: Struggles against Miami (FL)
story: Glasser was 13-for-15 passing for 88 yards and one interception during Saturday's 52-3 loss to Miami (FL).
impact: Despite only throwing two incompletions, Glasser recorded just 88 passing yards during Saturday's blowout loss. The quarterback has failed to reach the century mark in passing yards through three games this season. Glasser and the Chippewas will look to bounce back next week as they open MAC play against Akron.

headline: DNP Saturday
story: Blue (undisclosed) did not play during Saturday's matchup against Miami.
impact: Blue was previously listed as questionable for Saturday's contest due to an undisclosed injury, but he was unable to give it a go against the Canes. The 5-foot-11 running back will get his next chance to return when the Chips host Akron on Saturday.

headline: Cleared to play Saturday
story: VanWetzinga (knee) is off the injury report ahead of Saturday's game against the Hurricanes.
impact: VanWetzinga missed one game due to a knee injury but appears ready to go for this contest. The senior fullback has yet to log a carry this season.

headline: Available vs. Miami
story: Allen (finger) is off the injury report ahead of Saturday's game against Miami.
impact: Allen missed back-to-back games as he tended a finger injury but appears ready to go for this contest. The senior tight end has one catch for 10 yards this year.

headline: Deemed questionable
story: Blue (undisclosed) is listed as questionable ahead of Saturday's game at Miami, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Blue is dealing with an undisclosed issue, and his availability is now in question hours before kickoff. A final call on his status should be made prior to kickoff, pointing toward a game-time decision. The running back is the starter in the backfield, totaling 107 yards and one touchdown on 24 attempts so far this season.

headline: Scores first TD of season
story: Townsend logged two carries for 41 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 24-10 win over Wyoming.
impact: After an eight-touchdown season in 2025, Townsend crossed the goal line for the first time in 2026 against Wyoming on Saturday. Townsend took a 38-yard run to the house late in the third quarter to extend the Chippewas' lead.

headline: Rushes for two TDs in win
story: Flores was 4-for-7 passing for 32 yards during Saturday's 24-10 victory over Wyoming. He also had 28 rushes for 163 yards with two touchdowns.
impact: Flores was a force on the ground during the Chippewas' win over Wyoming. The quarterback averaged 5.8 yards per carry over 28 attempts while crossing the goal line twice. This marks back-to-back performances where the Arizona native has eclipsed 100 rushing yards with at least one score.

headline: Out for Week 3
story: Allen (finger) is out for Central Michigan's game Saturday against Wyoming, By the Belt reports.
impact: Previously undisclosed, Allen's injury is a finger problem that resulted in surgery. The tight end's 2026 season features one reception (without multiple targets) for 10 yards.

headline: Out for multiple weeks
story: VanWetzinga (knee) is out for a few weeks, By the Belt reports.
impact: At the very least, VanWetzinga will sit out Central Michigan's September schedule, with CMU having two games remaining. He has an MCL sprain, and though problematic, it not requiring surgery indicates that a midseason return is definitely possible.

headline: Leading receiver in win
story: Blue posted six rushes for 27 yards and one touchdown and hauled in 3 of 4 targets for 29 yards during Saturday's 13-10 win versus Colgate.
impact: After registering just three rushes a week ago against New Mexico, Blue picked up his first score of the campaign. The running back also led the Chippewas in receiving yards (29) en route to their first victory of the year.

headline: Leading rusher in win
story: Flores completed 7 of 13 passes for 57 yards and one interception during Saturday's 13-10 win over Colgate. He also had 22 rushes for 122 yards with one touchdown.
impact: After rushing for eight touchdowns a season ago, Flores picked up his first rushing score of the campaign against Colgate on Saturday. The quarterback contributed one of two Chippewa scores during their first win of the season. Flores will look to carry the momentum into next week's matchup against Wyoming.

headline: Out Saturday
story: Allen (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game versus Colgate.
impact: After securing one catch during the season opener, Allen will be held out of Saturday's contest due to an undisclosed injury. His next chance to suit up is next Saturday versus Wyoming.

headline: Unable to get in rhythm
story: Glasser was 4-for-10 passing for 16 yards during Saturday's 38-7 loss versus New Mexico. He also had eight rushes for negative two yards.
impact: Glasser completed just 40 percent of his 10 passes during Saturday's blowout loss to New Mexico. The quarterback split reps with Angel Flores, who did not record much better numbers than Glasser. Glasser will look to change the narrative next week in the Chippewas' home opener Sept. 12 against Colgate.

headline: Struggles in season opener
story: Flores completed 3 of 6 passes for 14 yards and one interception during Saturday's 38-7 defeat versus New Mexico. He also had 10 rushes for 27 yards.
impact: Flores struggled against the New Mexico defense early in his 2026 campaign. The quarterback split reps under center with Jadyn Glasser, who also did not perform well. Flores will look to bounce back during the Chippewas' home opener against Colgate on Sept. 12.

headline: Scores lone TD
story: Williams recorded one rush for 23 yards and a touchdown, while also reeling in one catch for 11 yards during Saturday's 38-7 defeat against New Mexico.
impact: Williams scored the only touchdown for Central Michigan during the season opener at New Mexico. The score capped off a 10-play, 75-yard drive early in the fourth quarter to help the Chippewas avoid the shutout. With only seven total completions on the evening between Jadyn Glasser and Angel Flores, Williams was the leading receiver with 11 yards. Williams will look to find the end zone again during the Chippewas' home opener against Colgate on Sept. 12.

headline: Getting at-bats as DH
story: Bregman is starting as the designated hitter and batting second Tuesday for Game 1 of the wild-card series against the Padres.
impact: Bregman is not in the field Tuesday since it is the "safest way to make sure he gets at-bats" according to Cubs manager Craig Counsell, Alden Gonzalez of ESPN.com reports. With the 32-year-old starting as the designated hitter, Pedro Ramirez enters the lineup as the third baseman and Michael Conforto exits to the bench.

headline: Not starting in series opener
story: Conforto is not in the lineup Tuesday for Game 1 of the wild-card series against the Padres.
impact: Alex Bregman has the start as the designated hitter instead of Conforto on Tuesday and is batting second. With Bregman not in the field, Pedro Ramirez is taking over at the hot corner.

headline: Scores in Saturday's win
story: Henry caught their only target for 39 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-26 victory against Kansas State.
impact: Henry was only targeted once in Saturday's win, but he scored a 39-yard touchdown on that one opportunity, his first score of the season. The Bearcats only attempted 13 passes in the entire game, the second time through four games the team has had an extremely low passing volume. That hurts Henry's value significantly, as his targets have diminished significantly in those low volume games.

headline: Scores three TDs again
story: Tabb posted 11 rushes for 124 yards and three touchdowns during Saturday's 31-26 win versus Kansas State.
impact: Coming off a three-touchdown performance in last Saturday's comeback win, Tabb scored another hat trick versus Kansas State. He scored on runs of five yards, 30 yards, and 14 yards, all in the second half, and he now has seven touchdowns over his last three games. While he is still receiving less work than the productive Gi'Bran Payne, Tabb's knack for big plays and the endzone is far more than just a fluke at this point.

headline: Quiet in Saturday's win
story: French completed 8 of 13 passes for 165 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-26 win against Kansas State. He also had eight rushes for 21 yards.
impact: French only attempted 13 passes in Saturday's win, the second time through four games he's attempted 14 or fewer. He still threw for 165 yards and a touchdown despite that low volume, but it wasn't enough to give him a productive fantasy outing. While his rushing gives him a decent floor, French's inconsistent passing opportunities makes him a difficult player to project.

headline: Out for Week 4
story: Witherspoon (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game against Kansas State, per the Big 12 availability report.
impact: Witherspoon will sit out Cincinnati's conference opener due to an undisclosed injury. The tight end will aim to suit up against Arizona next Saturday.

headline: Catches another TD Saturday
story: Gibson accrued seven receptions (on eight targets) for 68 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 35-31 win versus Miami (OH).
impact: Gibson scored in his third straight game Saturday, this time on a six-yard pass in the fourth quarter which cut the RedHawks' lead to just three points. Gibson set season highs in receptions, targets and yards which is unsurprising given JC French attempted more passes in this game than the first two games combined. Gibson's target share and knack for the endzone makes him a valuable asset heading into conference play.

headline: Three TDs in comeback win
story: Tabb totaled six carries for 78 yards and two touchdowns and hauled in all four targets for 43 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 35-31 victory versus Miami (OH).
impact: After falling into a big deficit in the first half, Tabb saw an uptick in playing time in the second half as the Bearcats chased the game. He caught an eight-yard touchdown in the third quarter to cut the lead to 28-21, then with the team down three with less than two minutes left, broke away from the defense on third down to score a 53-yard game-winning touchdown. It was a breakout performance for the Stanford transfer, and one that may earn him more touches as the team heads into conference play.

headline: Quiet in comeback win
story: Payne logged nine carries for 32 yards and reeled in 2 of 5 targets for seven yards during Saturday's 35-31 win versus Miami (OH).
impact: After falling into a deep deficit in the first half, the Bearcats began to spread the ball out and turned to Cole Tabb at running back. Tabb scored three touchdowns, including the game winner, while Payne was held to a season-low 11 touches. Payne is still the Bearcats' No. 1 back, but Tabb certainly made a case for himself to get more work as the team heads into conference play.

headline: Leads comeback versus RedHawks
story: French was 31-for-43 passing for 309 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 35-31 win over Miami (OH). He also had 16 rushes for 39 yards with one touchdown.
impact: The Bearcats found themselves down 28-7 coming out of halftime, but French provided a spark for the offense. He tossed two touchdowns and ran in another to cut the deficit to 31-28 in the fourth quarter, and then Cole Tabb's long rushing touchdown completed the comeback win. French set season highs across the board from a passing standpoint while still being productive with his legs. The fact that a 21-point comeback was needed is a bit concerning for French and the Bearcats though, and the team will need to collect themselves quickly ahead of Saturday's conference opener versus Kansas State.

headline: Scores again Saturday
story: Gibson notched five receptions (on six targets) for 79 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 62-10 victory over Western Carolina.
impact: Gibson caught another touchdown in Saturday's blowout win, a five-yard reception in the first quarter. He now has nine catches for 133 yards and two touchdowns through two games this season, establishing himself as a favorite of quarterback JC French. He faces another favorable matchup Saturday versus Miami (OH).

headline: Scores Saturday
story: Johnson recorded five carries for 26 yards and one touchdown and caught their only target for 11 yards during Saturday's 62-10 win over Western Carolina.
impact: Johnson scored a three-yard rushing touchdown late in the second quarter Saturday, his first score of the season. He is one of four Bearcats' running backs with at least five carries in the opening two games, and while he's been solid, he's been the least productive of the four. If the backfield work consolidates -- which seems likely once the team plays better opponents -- Johnson could be left out.

headline: Scores in Saturday's win
story: Tabb accrued five carries for 72 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 62-10 victory over Western Carolina.
impact: Tabb scored a 36-yard rushing touchdown in the second quarter Saturday, his first of the young season. He now has 11 carries for 109 yards through two games this season, seemingly establishing a decent role in the offense for himself. It's a bit too early to tell though, as four Bearcats' running backs have had five carries in each of the team's first two games. That number will likely shrink once the team starts playing better opponents.

headline: Scores in blowout win
story: Perry accrued five carries for 76 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 62-10 victory against Western Carolina.
impact: Perry scored a 40-yard rushing touchdown in the third quarter Saturday, his first score of the season. He was one of four backs with at least five carries against the FCS opponent, all of whom scored a touchdown. Perry appears to be the No. 2 back behind Gi'Bran Payne, but that should become more clear once the Bearcats start playing conference opponents.

headline: Four touches in Week 3 loss
story: Perine turned three carries into nine yards and caught one pass on three targets for five yards during the Bengals' 30-27 loss to the Steelers on Sunday. He also returned one kicko...
impact: Perine saw most of his offensive output in the first half and was limited to only one carry for zero gain in the second. His 18 offensive snaps were well behind Chase Brown's 40, and Perine figures to be limited to a rotational role in the Bengals' backfield this season unless Brown were to miss time. The Bengals will head home to host the Jaguars in Week 4.

headline: Placed on injured reserve
story: The Bengals placed Davis (hamstring) on injured reserve Tuesday.
impact: Davis injured his hamstring during the Bengals' 30-27 loss to the Steelers in Week 3. The injury is severe enough for the Utah State product to spend time on IR, which means he'll be sidelined for at least the next four games and is eligible to return for Week 9 against the Falcons on Sunday, Nov. 8. Ja'Sir Taylor (undisclosed) is also on injured reserve, so Dax Hill and Tacario Davis are both in line for more snaps in the Bengals' secondary.

headline: Signed to Cincinnati's active roster
story: The Bengals signed Hudson off the practice squad to the active roster Tuesday.
impact: Hudson was elevated from the practice squad for two of the Bengals' first three games of the regular season, accumulating three catches on as many targets for 17 yards. He'll now be a part of the team's 53-man roster moving forward and will contribute mostly on special teams and in a depth role on offense behind fellow tight ends Mike Gesicki, Drew Sample and Erick All.

headline: Returns to health
story: Johnson (undisclosed) was activated from the 7-day injured list Sept. 21.
impact: Johnson landed on the shelf Sept. 10 due to an unspecified injury and wasn't able to return before the end of the campaign. He played in 73 games this year for Triple-A Louisville, batting .247 with 11 home runs, 31 RBI, 15 stolen bases and 32 runs.

headline: Hit hard in fifth loss
story: Williamson (5-5) took the loss Sunday against Toronto, striking out three while allowing four runs on four hits and three walks in three innings.
impact: Williamson didn't end the year on a positive note, as he couldn't make it to the fourth inning despite tossing 76 pitches. The left-hander was part of the Reds' Opening Day rotation, but a shoulder injury cost him most of the season and derailed his campaign. After logging a career-worst 5.30 ERA, 1.46 WHIP and 36:30 K:BB in 52.2 innings, he may have to battle for a roster spot again next spring.

headline: Carries Tigers' offense
story: Davidson had 22 rushes for 159 yards and two touchdowns and gathered in 1 of 2 targets for two yards during Friday's 24-10 win versus California.
impact: Clemson quarterback Tait Reynolds only tossed for 108 yards and turned the ball over twice. The Tigers won this game with a stifling defense and a productive ground game led by Davidson, who exploded for a career-best 159 rushing yards and two scores. Davidson has gone for over 100 yards in each of his last two games and has three touchdowns in that time frame as well; Clemson appears to be leaning on the second-year back more and more.

headline: Forgettable day despite victory
story: Reynolds was 13-for-21 passing for 108 yards and one interception during Friday's 24-10 victory versus California. He also had 11 rushes for 28 yards.
impact: Reynolds threw a pick and also lost a fumble against the Golden Bears, and only tossed for 108 yards. Still, his team won by two touchdowns no thanks to him or the Tigers' offense. The true freshman clearly still ha some growing pains to work through, and an absolutely loaded Miami team awaits in Week 5.

headline: Will miss rest of season
story: Eziomume (leg) will miss the season after being carted off in Friday's game against Cal, per Nick Coppola of The Las Cruces Sun-News.
impact: This confirms Eziomume's injury is season-ending after initial concern following Friday's game. His absence further reduces Clemson's backfield depth.

headline: Injury feared to be serious
story: Eziomume (leg) may have suffered a season-ending injury in Friday's 24-10 win over Cal, Nick Coppola of The Las Cruces Sun-News reports.
impact: Eziomume was carted off the field during the first quarter after a kick return. Head coach Dabo Swinney said after the game that the injury "didn't look good" and compared it to defensive tackle Markus Strong's season-ending lower leg injury he suffered in the season opener. While it's not yet confirmed, it seems like Eziomume may miss the remainder of the season. He only had one carry through three games this season, though he took it 11 yards for a touchdown.

headline: Carted off Friday
story: Eziomume was carted off the field during Friday's game against California after suffering an apparent leg injury, per Nick Coppola of The Las Cruces Sun-News.
impact: Eziomume was helped off the field during the first quarter on a kickoff return, and the injury was significant enough to require a cart. The running back's status will be monitored closely moving forward.

headline: Bumped to available
story: Vizzina (elbow) is available for Friday's game at California.
impact: Vizzina seems to have left behind the elbow injury that was bothering him, and he's ready to suit up this Friday. That said, he lost the QB1 role to Tait Reynolds, so the senior signal-caller will return to the Tigers' active roster as the QB2.

headline: Officially out for Friday
story: Haynes (undisclosed) is out for Friday's game against California, per the ACC availability report.
impact: Haynes will continue to recover, as injuries have been a common trend for the running back. He serves as a depth option in the backfield, though he saw involvement with the team in 2024 when healthy, logging 43 carries for 295 yards and three touchdowns.

headline: Questionable to play Friday
story: Haynes is questionable for Friday's game against California due to an undisclosed injury.
impact: Haynes dealt with injuries in the preseason and is now in danger of missing this ACC matchup. Even if he doesn't play, his absence shouldn't affect many fantasy decisions.

headline: Listed as probable for Week 4
story: Vizzina (elbow) is probable for Friday's game at California.
impact: Clemson head coach Dabo Swinney said Tuesday that Vizzina's status was still TBD, but the probable tag suggests the quarterback is trending in the right direction to be available Friday. However, Vizzina lost the QB1 role to Tait Reynolds, so he'll want to prove he still has what it takes to perform as soon as he gets the chance.

headline: Scores in narrow win
story: Brown gathered in all two targets for 28 yards and had a 34-yard rushing touchdown during Saturday's 28-20 win against North Carolina.
impact: Brown's 34-yard rushing touchdown helped salvage his day from a fantasy perspective, but this Clemson offense remains extremely uninspiring through three weeks. Brown's 62 total yards were his highest output this year, and unless this offense begins to dramatically improve overnight, there's not much for fantasy managers to like.

headline: Status remains TBD
story: Clemson's head coach Dabo Swinney said Tuesday that it is still to be determined whether Vizzina (elbow) will be available Friday at California, Chapel Fowler of The Columbia State...
impact: Even though Vizzina's left elbow has gotten a lot better in Swinney's words, the quarterback's availability at California remains unknown, as the head coach said his QB's development is "minute by minute, day by day" going into Week 4. Ideally, the ACC availability report will clarify Vizzina's status, as Clemson will require injury updates by Wednesday. Vizzina has lost the QB1 role to Tait Reynolds, so the former will want to prove he still has what it takes once he gets healthy.

headline: Executes in team effort
story: Schwesinger logged six tackles (one solo) in the Browns' 21-18 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
impact: Schwesinger played all 74 defensive snaps in Sunday's contest and the captain has played all 196 defensive snaps for the Browns through three regular-season games. The middle linebacker and signal caller for the defense did not have any incredible box-score feats in the Week 3 win but practiced stellar communication that helped enable Mason Graham's 2.0 sacks and Ronnie Hickman's game-winning interception.

headline: Catches game-winning interception
story: Hickman made eight tackles (three solo) and had one pass defensed for an interception in the Browns' 21-18 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
impact: Hickman intercepted Bryce Young on a third down with 16 seconds left in the game while the Browns were up by three points. The turnover sealed the game, securing the Browns consecutive wins for the first time since December of 2023. The free safety played all 74 defensive snaps in the contest.

headline: Notches multiple sacks in win
story: Graham logged seven tackles (four solo), including 2.0 sacks, in the Browns' 21-18 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
impact: Graham played 53 defensive snaps in the contest and notched two of the three sacks quarterback Bryce Young took in the contest. The second-year defensive tackle out of Michigan totaled 0.5 sacks throughout his entire 17-game campaign in 2025, so Sunday's contest was easily a career high for the young player. Graham is up to 4,0 sacks through three regular-season games in 2026, leading all defensive tackles.

headline: Missing practice due to concussion
story: Jenkins (concussion) did not participate at practice Tuesday, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.
impact: It's not totally clear when Jenkins suffered the concussion, but it's a bad break on a shortened week. Unless he's able to return to practice in some capacity Wednesday, odds are slim he'll clear concussion protocol and be available to play Thursday versus the Steelers.

headline: Doesn't draw any targets in Week 3 win
story: Jeudy finished Sunday's 21-18 victory against Carolina with no targets or touches.
impact: It was the second straight week that Jeudy didn't log a reception, and this time he didn't even get a target (he logged just one in Week 2 versus Tampa Bay). The veteran wideout continues to be on the field fairly often -- he's recorded an offensive snap share of over 50 percent in each of the Browns' three contests, including Sunday, when he played 51 percent of the team's offensive snaps. However, he doesn't seem to be clicking well with QB Deshaun Watson, and at this point fantasy managers have little reason to include him in their lineups.

headline: Doesn't practice Tuesday
story: Wallace (knee) didn't participate in Cleveland's practice Tuesday, Daniel Oyefusi of ESPN.com reports.
impact: Wallace is in danger of missing Thursday's matchup versus the Steelers, as he was also listed as a non-participant in Monday's practice estimate after suffering a knee injury during the Week 3 win over Carolina. Isaiah Bond and Malachi Corley could be in line for increased playing time if Wallace is unable to suit up for Thursday's game.

headline: Returns from IL
story: Kayfus (ankle) was activated from the 60-day injured list Monday.
impact: Kayfus will head into the offseason at full strength after undergoing surgery in July to address a broken right ankle and ligament damage. He appeared in nine games for the Guardians in 2026 but spent the majority of his time at Triple-A Columbus, where he hit .240 with three homers, 25 RBI, six stolen bases and 15 runs over 46 appearances.

headline: Held in check in loss
story: Coppock reeled in three of eight targets for 29 yards during Thursday's 34-17 defeat against Liberty.
impact: While the targets were there, Coppock struggled to find much space during the loss. The wideout has recorded 11 receptions for 190 yards and three scores through the first four games of the season.

headline: Makes most of one catch
story: Hinton reeled in one of two targets for 24 yards and one touchdown during Thursday's 34-17 defeat against Liberty.
impact: Hinton's lone reception came in the second quarter when Chanticleers quarterback Deuce Bailey connected with the wideout for a 24-yard touchdown. Through four games, Hinton has recorded 10 catches, 220 yards and four touchdowns.

headline: Two TDs in loss
story: Bailey was 17-for-34 passing for 213 yards, two touchdowns and two interceptions during Thursday's 34-17 loss against Liberty. He also had 15 rushes for 31 yards.
impact: Both of Bailey's TDs came in the second quarter when he found Colton Hinton for a 10-yard score and Tristian Gardner for a 39-yard touchdown. Through four games, Bailey has thrown for 1039 yards, 10 touchdowns and two interceptions. The Chanticleers host Georgia Southern on Saturday.

headline: Two targets and receptions for 52 yards
story: Coppock logged two for 52 yards during Saturday's 22-14 defeat against Delaware.
impact: By logging multiple receptions in each of Coastal Carolina's first three games, Coppock indicates that he is among the upper echelon of CCU's receiver corps. It makes sense too, as he has not registered a single drop and caught all of his eight targeted passes for 161 yards and three touchdowns, averaging a TD per game. Coppock will be one to watch as conference play inches closer, with the level of competition expected to even out.

headline: Finds end zone in loss to Delaware
story: Hinton reeled in three of four targets for 42 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 22-14 defeat against Delaware.
impact: Hinton has been remarkably consistent for Coastal Carolina in the early stages of the 2026 season. He has recorded at least three catches while finding the end zone in every game, and he sports an impressive, yet unsustainable, 81.8 percent catch rate. He should remain an important part of the passing game in Week 4 against Liberty on Thursday.

headline: Makes most of lone catch
story: Lawrence reeled in their only target for 62 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 22-14 defeat versus Delaware.
impact: Lawrence made the most of his lone catch in this Week 3 loss, taking it all the way to the house in a 62-yard catch. However, he's had just three targets and two catches this year. He's not expected to play a substantial role in Coastal Carolina's passing attack moving forward.

headline: Tosses two scores in Week 3 loss
story: Bailey completed 16 of 26 passes for 250 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 22-14 loss versus Delaware. He also had 12 rushes for 42 yards.
impact: Even though Coastal Carolina had to settle for a loss in this Week 3 matchup, Bailey continued his strong start to the season -- he's now tossed for over 200 yards, multiple touchdowns and no picks in each of his first three contests. He'll look to keep this going against Liberty in Week 4 on Thursday.

headline: Catches TD in blowout win
story: Coppock caught all two targets for 26 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-7 win versus Fordham.
impact: Quarterback Deuce Bailey found Coppock for a 12-yard score in the second quarter to extend the Chanticleers' lead to 28-7. Through his first two games, Coppock has hauled in six catches for 109 yards and three touchdowns.

headline: Explodes in win
story: Hinton hauled in three of four targets for 101 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-7 win over Fordham.
impact: Hinton and Deuce Bailey connected for a 65-yard score in the second quarter to give the Chanticleers a 14-7 lead that they wouldn't relinquish. Through two games, Hinton has hauled in six receptions for 154 yards and two touchdowns.

headline: Turns lone catch into TD
story: Washington gathered in one of four targets for 23 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-7 win versus Fordham.
impact: Washington and quarterback Deuce Bailey teamed up for a 23-yard score in the second quarter. Washington now has four catches for 103 yards and one touchdown.

headline: Pops two scores in win
story: Knicely recorded five carries for 45 yards and two touchdowns and reeled in all two targets for 10 yards during Saturday's 45-7 victory against Fordham.
impact: Knicely opened the games scoring with a five-yard run in the first quarter before breaking free for an 18-yard run in the third quarter to extend the lead to 35-7.

headline: Runs for TD in win
story: Allen-Hendrix notched seven carries for 58 yards and one touchdown and gathered in 0 of 1 targets for zero yards during Saturday's 45-7 victory over Fordham.
impact: Allen-Hendrix capped the games scoring with a five-yard run in the fourth quarter to extend the Chanticleers' lead to 45-7.

headline: Tosses three TDs in win
story: Bailey completed 12 of 25 passes for 203 yards and three touchdowns during Saturday's 45-7 win against Fordham. He also had four rushes for 21 yards.
impact: All three of Bailey's passing touchdowns on Saturday came in the second quarter. Bailey connected on passes of 65, 23, and 12 yards to blow the game open. Through two weeks, Bailey has thrown for 576 yards, six touchdowns and will face Delaware on the road next.

headline: Two touchdowns in the loss
story: Coppock caught four of five targets for 83 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 31-24 defeat to West Virginia.
impact: Coppock posted a game-high 83 yards in the loss on Saturday. Deuce Bailey found Coppock on 34 and 37-yard receptions for his first two touchdowns of the season.

headline: Touchdown reception in loss
story: Hinton hauled in all three targets for 53 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-24 defeat to West Virginia.
impact: Hinton hauled in his touchdown reception in the fourth quarter when quarterback Deuce Bailey found him for a 13-yard score.

headline: Tosses three touchdowns in loss
story: Bailey completed 21 of 37 passes for 373 yards and three touchdowns during Saturday's 31-24 defeat versus West Virginia. He also had 10 rushes for 19 yards.
impact: After falling behind 24-0, Bailey got the Chanticleers on the board in the third quarter with a 34-yard touchdown pass to Clayton Coppock. Bailey found Colton Hinton for a 13-yard score before connecting with Coppock once again for a 37-yard strike.

headline: Slated to start season opener
story: Bailey is working exclusively with the first team offense in pregame warmups ahead of Saturday's game at West Virginia, Brandon Dunn of ABC 15 Florence reports.
impact: Bailey, who has been locked into a quarterback battle with Tre Guerra, appears to have won the job. In addition to working exclusively with the first team offense, he also has a captain patch on his jersey, an honor rarely given to a backup quarterback. Guerra could still see some time given the battle was so close, but Bailey will enter the season as the starting quarterback.

headline: Not slated to start Week 1
story: Guerra is not slated to start over Deuce Bailey in Saturday's game at West Virginia, Brandon Dunn of ABC 15 Florence reports.
impact: As expected, Coastal Carolina's QB1 decision has come down to the wire, and with Bailey taking first-teams reps Saturday, it looks like Guerra has still a ways to work up. The latter quarterback is still looking for his first counting stats in an FBS game setting.

headline: Expected to draw start in Week 5
story: Wilson is expected to take over as Colorado's starting quarterback in Week 5 against Texas Tech, per Matt Zenitz of CBSSports.com.
impact: Wilson appears slated to replace Julian Lewis, the second-year former blue-chip recruit who's had a rough go of it this season. His numbers don't look terrible on paper, but they do when you consider the fact that most of his production came in the Buffaloes' win over FCS Weber State. The Utah transfer Wilson, meanwhile, has tossed for 153 yards and one touchdown while completing 51.9% of his passes in relief this fall.

headline: Not expected to start Week 5
story: Lewis is not expected to start Saturday's game against Texas Tech, Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reports.
impact: Lewis has started each of Colorado's four games this season, his best performance a 366-yard output in Week 2 against Weber State. But last week against Baylor, he was pulled in favor of Isaac Wilson, who is projected to start Week 5 in Lewis' place. Excluding Week 2, he failed to log multiple touchdowns in his other three performances, and the team won only one of those three matchups.

headline: Breaks out Saturday
story: Farrakhan caught 7 of 8 targets for 117 yards during Saturday's 23-13 loss versus Baylor.
impact: Farrakhan had just one target through three games heading into Saturday's contest, but that didn't stop the sophomore from shining versus Baylor. He saw an uptick in playing time with Danny Scudero (undisclosed) out and DeAndre Moore (undisclosed) injured during the game, and really was able to shine once Isaac Wilson took over the offense after halftime. While his snap count will be determined by the injuries to Scudero and Moore, Farrakhan made a serious case for more playing time, especially if Wilson takes over the starting quarterback spot.

headline: Shines in Saturday's loss
story: Williams totaled 11 receptions (on 18 targets) for 127 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 23-13 loss against Baylor.
impact: Williams was excellent in Saturday's loss, highlighted by his game-tying touchdown reception from Isaac Wilson in the fourth quarter. He was targeted a whopping 18 times in the game and appeared to have a good connection with Wilson who took over the offense after halftime from the struggling Julian Lewis. While the quarterback situation is now in flux, Williams is set to be the favorite target of whoever starts for the Buffaloes.

headline: Inefficient in relief effort
story: Wilson completed 12 of 25 passes for 156 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 23-13 loss to Baylor. He also had five rushes for -11 yards.
impact: Wilson replaced Julian Lewis at halftime Saturday after another poor outing from the starter. Wilson got the offense going a bit better and connected with Joseph Williams for a touchdown to tie the game in the fourth quarter, but he completed fewer than 50 percent of his passes in the loss. It's too early to tell who will start Saturday in a difficult matchup versus Texas Tech.

headline: Bench at halftime
story: Lewis completed 11 of 16 passes for 75 yards during Saturday's 23-13 defeat against Baylor.
impact: Lewis led one scoring drive in seven attempts in the first drive, leading him to be benched in favor of Isaac Wilson. Wilson got the offense moving a bit better in the second half, but by no means did he run away with the job. It's too early to tell who will start under center for the Buffaloes in a difficult matchup Saturday versus Texas Tech.

headline: Taken to locker room Saturday
story: Moore (undisclosed) was helped off the field and taken straight to the locker room during Saturday's game at Baylor, Tyler King of the Denver Gazette reports.
impact: Moore suffered an injury in the second quarter of Saturday's game and had to be helped off the field as he was clearly feeling the big hit that he took. He was taken straight to the locker room which is certainly not a good sign for his chances to return versus Baylor.

headline: Out for Week 4
story: Henderson (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game at Baylor, Brian Howell of the Boulder Daily Camera reports.
impact: Even though Colorado's availability report does not include Henderson, indicating that he is available, Howell confirms what was to be expected, the running back being out for Week 4. The senior will cap off his September with a strong 24 rushing attempts for 111 yards, 4.6 averaged per carry. Up next, the Buffaloes will begin their October schedule by hosting Texas Tech on Oct. 3.

headline: Ready to rock Saturday
story: Clements (undisclosed) will suit up for Saturday's game against Baylor, per the Big 12 availability report.
impact: Clements has seen regular snaps in the first three contests but hasn't tallied any stats to date. The blocking tight end will resume his role this week.

headline: Available for Week 4
story: Atkins (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game at Baylor.
impact: Atkins will look to replicate more of his Week 2 performance than his Week 3 output. In Week 2, he logged three targets and caught all of them for a combined 28 yards. The following week, Atkins was limited to a single target that he did not catch.

headline: In clear Saturday
story: Smith (undisclosed) is ready to rock for Saturday's game versus Baylor, per the Big 12 availability report.
impact: Smith was considered probable leading up to the contest, so his availability isn't a huge surprise. The sophomore enters Saturday with 24 carries for 152 yards under his belt, including eight carries for a season-high 91 rushing yards last week versus Northwestern, and he'll look to add to that total against Baylor.

headline: Poor finale in 12th loss
story: Freeland (4-12) took the loss Sunday against the White Sox, allowing four runs on seven hits and no walks in four innings. He struck out two.
impact: Five of the seven hits allowed went for extra bases Sunday. The southpaw's five-year deal with the Rockies is up following the 2026 season, and it remains to be seen if he'll re-up with Colorado after spending each of the first 10 years of his career in the Mile High City. He turned in one of his worst big-league campaigns this year, registering a 6.65 ERA, 1.52 WHIP and 108:29 K:BB in 135.1 innings.

headline: Finishes with .300 average
story: Rumfield is absent from the lineup for Sunday's game against the White Sox.
impact: The Rockies will hold him out of the regular-season finale so that he can finish with an even .300 batting average. Rumfield slashed .300/.390/.453 with 16 home runs and 73 RBI over 155 contests during his terrific rookie campaign. Troy Johnston will handle first base for Colorado on Sunday.

headline: Smacks 13th homer
story: Tovar went 2-for-4 with a solo home run Saturday against the White Sox.
impact: Tovar blasted his 13th home run of the season in the fourth inning of Saturday's win. It has been a disappointing season overall, but he has managed to end the campaign in relatively strong form with a .302 average, three homers and 13 runs scored across 19 games in September.

headline: Keeps up hot September
story: Carrigg went 3-for-5 with a double, one RBI and two runs scored Saturday against the White Sox.
impact: It was a big offensive day for the Rockies, and Carrigg did his part with his ninth multi-hit performance across 23 games in September. Much of that production has come at Coors Field, but Carrigg contributed an RBI single in the ninth inning while also tallying his 22nd double of the season in Saturday's win at Rate Field. Overall, Carrigg is ending his rookie season in strong form, hitting .330 with five homers, 16 RBI and 11 runs scored for the month.

headline: Lasts only three innings Saturday
story: Quintana allowed two runs on two hits and two walks while striking out three across three innings in a no-decision against the White Sox on Saturday.
impact: Both of the home runs Quintana gave up came on solo homers by Brenton Doyle and Luisangel Acuna in the second and third frames, respectively. Quintana ran his pitch count up to 59 with 34 strikes and five whiffs, prompting Colorado to turn the keys to Ryan Feltner for the start of the fourth frame. It was still encouraging to see Quintana on the mound for the tail end of the 2026 regular season, seeing as he was sidelined by a sprained left for nearly four months. He'll end the 2026 regular season with a 5.44 ERA and 1.50 WHIP across 48 innings.

headline: Crosses 40-homer threshold Saturday
story: Goodman went 2-for-5 with two home runs and four RBI during the Rockies' 9-6 win over the White Sox on Saturday.
impact: Goodman extended the Rockies' lead to three runs on two separate occasions, first with a solo homer in the third and again with a three-run long ball in the ninth, with the latter being the game-winning runs for Colorado. Those two home runs brought Goodman up to 41 for the season, making him the eighth player to belt 40-plus homers in the majors. He also has a .532 slugging percentage over 570 plate appearances, which is second-best in the National League among qualified hitters behind NL MVP frontrunner Pete Crow-Armstrong (.570).

headline: Hits paydirt on the ground
story: Vick had his best game in the air with 93 receiving yards since 2024 while running one for an 18-yard touchdown as Colorado State dropped a high scoring 59-45 loss to UTSA on Satur...
impact: Vick collected 132 receiving yards on three catches against Hampton on Sept. 7, 2024, while with Virginia Union. The senior will look to add to his total in his final year against Oregon State on Oct. 3 in the Pac 12 opener. The Beavers defense against the pass is in the middle of the country.

headline: Tops century mark
story: Smith led the Colorado State receivers with 102 receiving yards on six catches and a touchdown as Colorado State dropped a high scoring 59-45 loss to UTSA on Saturday.
impact: After disappearing against BYU with one catch and zero yards, Smith rebounded nicely in what is hoped to be a breakout year. He will try to get back-to-back century yardage against Oregon State on Oct. 3 in the Pac 12 opener. The Beavers defense against the pass is in the middle of the nation.

headline: Leads Rams in rushing
story: Brown had 90 rushing yards on 12 carries to head the list on the ground for Colorado State who dropped a high scoring 59-45 loss to UTSA on Saturday.
impact: Brown added six catches for 26 yards. The only negative on the day for the senior was that he was not able to reach the end zone. The Rams take on Oregon State in the Pac 12 opener on Oct. 3. The Beavers defense against the run is in the middle of the nation.

headline: Hits paydirt twice
story: Robinson had a pair of rushing touchdowns on 13 carries for 32 yards as Colorado State dropped a high scoring 59-45 loss to UTSA on Saturday.
impact: For Robinson it was the first multi-rushing touchdown game since Sept. 21, 2024, when he had a pair of touchdowns and 156 rushing yards for UConn against Florida Atlantic. The Rams take on Oregon State in the Pac 12 opener on Oct. 3. The Beavers defense against the run is in the middle of the country.

headline: Breaks out in defeat
story: Farrar completed 29-of 46 for 344 passing yards and two touchdowns as Colorado State dropped a high scoring 59-45 loss to UTSA on Saturday.
impact: Farrar filled in this week with Hauss Hejny missing the game because of a hamstring injury. If Hejny misses the Oct. 3rd contest against Oregon State, Farrar is expected to get another start. The numbers against UTSA were a career best for the redshirt freshman. The Beavers defense against the pass is in the middle of the country.

headline: Starting Saturday
story: Farrar is starting at quarterback for Saturday's game at UTSA, Kevin Lytle of the Fort Collins Coloradoan reports.
impact: With Hauss Hejny (hamstring) out, Farrar will make his first start of the season on the road. The redshirt freshman came on in relief last week and completed 13 of 23 passes for 70 yards and an interception versus a tough BYU defense.

headline: Won't take part Saturday
story: Hejny (hamstring) won't be available for Saturday's game versus UTSA, Kevin Lytle of The Coloradoan reports.
impact: Hejny was considered doubtful leading up to the contest, and he'll indeed miss out on the contest against the Roadrunners. K'Saan Farrar will draw the start in his place, while Hejny will shift his focus to next Saturday's Pac-12 opener against Oregon State for his next opportunity to join the action.

headline: Doubtful for Week 4
story: Hejny (hamstring) is doubtful for Saturday's game at UTSA, Pete Thamel of ESPN reports.
impact: Even though Hejny was limited as a game-time decision a few days ago, and while that still may be the case, his latest update indicates that he is likely to miss Saturday's game at UTSA. Back in Week 3, Hejny injured one of his hamstrings, and in his place, K'saan Farrar came in relief. The aforementioned Farrar was far from stellar at BYU then, leaving Colorado State's updated QB1 an unknown as Hejny continues to recover.

headline: Game-time call for Week 4
story: Hejny (hamstring) is expected to be a game-time decision for Saturday's game at UTSA, head coach Jim Mora told Kevin Lytle of the Fort Collins Coloradoan.
impact: Hejny is expected to be a game-time call Saturday after sustaining a hamstring injury in Week 3's loss to BYU. If he's unable to suit up in Week 4, look for Ksaan Farrar to replace him under center. But it seems Colorado State could wait until the very last minute to have Hejny this Saturday. He has completed 64.4 percent of his passes for 619 yards and a 10:1 TD:INT in three games in 2026.

headline: Hits paydirt against BYU
story: Vick collected 67 receiving yards on five catches and a touchdown in Colorado State's 41-23 loss to BYU on Saturday.
impact: Vick benefitted from the Rams having to throw the ball in the second half after Colorado State found itself down 31-7 at halftime. Colorado State takes on UTSA on Sept. 26.

headline: Big drop in output
story: Harper only caught three passes for one yard in Colorado State's 41-23 loss to BYU on Saturday.
impact: The redshirt junior's output was the result of three quarterbacks getting into the game for the Rams. Both starting quarterback Hauss Hejny and backup, Ksaan Farrar suffered injuries against BYU. Third string quarterback Darius Curry finished off the game. Harper should be able to rebound against UTSA, whose defense is in the middle of the country against the pass, on Sept. 26.

headline: Excels in the air
story: Ross was limited to three rushing yards on one run but accumulated 85 receiving yards on four catches in Colorado State's 41-23 loss to BYU on Saturday.
impact: Because the Rams were down 31-7 at halftime, Colorado State was forced to throw the ball, and Ross took advantage of it. Colorado State takes on UTSA on Sept. 26. UTSA's defense is near the bottom in the country in defending the run.

headline: Limited against BYU
story: Brown only accumulated 28 rushing yards on nine attempts in Colorado State's 41-23 loss to BYU on Saturday.
impact: Brown also caught three passes for 17 yards. It was a combination of a tough BYU defense and the flow of the game as the Rams found themselves down 31-7 by halftime. It was a big drop from the previous week where Brown ran for 171 yards on nine attempts and two touchdowns in the Colorado State's 58-24 victory over FCS Southern Utah. The Rams and Brown should return to a running game in their next contest against UTSA on Sept. 26. UTSA's defense is near the bottom in the country in defending the run.

headline: Leads CSU in rushing
story: Robinson collected 29 rushing yards on six carries and a touchdown in Colorado State's 41-23 loss to BYU on Saturday.
impact: Robinson's numbers showed that the Rams basically abandoned the running game especially with the starters. In the first three game he has run for 106 yards on 28 carries. The 6-foot redshirt junior missed most of the 2025 season at Auburn with a leg injury. Robinson has the experience handling a large backfield role, logging 107 carries for 731 yards and eight touchdowns across 12 games with UConn in 2024. The 207-pound back is also capable in the receiving game, adding on 14 receptions for 75 receptions during his breakout season with the Huskies.

headline: Sees time under center
story: Curry completed 6-of-8 pass attempts for 70 yards and a touchdown in Colorado State's 41-23 loss to BYU on Saturday.
impact: Curry also had three carries for four yards. Curry came in after both starting quarterback Hauss Hejny and backup, Ksaan Farrar suffered injuries against BYU. Depending on the health of either or both Hejny and Farrar, Curry could get a start against UTSA on Sept. 26.

headline: Comes in relief
story: Farrar completed 13-of-23 pass attempts for 70 yards while throwing an interception in Colorado State's 41-23 loss to BYU on Saturday.
impact: Farrar replaced starting quarterback Hauss Hejny who suffered a hamstring injury early in the defeat to BYU. But Farrar also suffered an injury late in the game and

headline: Uncertain for Week 4
story: Hejny (hamstring) is questionable for Colorado State's game at UTSA, per Pete Thamel of ESPN.com.
impact: Hejny sustained a hamstring injury in the Week 3 loss to BYU, only throwing 10 passes in that contest ultimately being replaced by Ksaan Farrar. If he's unable to play in Week 4 at UTSA, Farrar -- who tossed for 70 yards and one interception on 13-of-23 passing -- would likely start in his stead once again.

headline: Held to one catch vs BYU
story: Maher (undisclosed) caught one pass for a loss of a yard during Saturday's loss to BYU.
impact: Maher missed the Week 2 win over Southern Utah with an undisclosed injury and was shutdown by the Cougars defense, being held to one catch. He'll look to be more productive next week versus Texas San Antonio.

player: BYU Once Recruited Hauss Hejny to Provo
headline: Now the Cougars Prepare to Face Him
story: On Saturday, no. 11 BYU will take on Colorado State. The BYU defense will look to slow down a CSU offense that ranks 21st in scoring offense...

headline: Adds to new resume
story: Vick, who transferred to Colorado State from Wake Forest, added to his senior year with 33 receiving yards on three catches in the Rams 58-24 victory over FCS Southern Utah on Satu...
impact: The numbers against Southern Utah, came after the senior collected three touchdown receptions out of his six catches for 75 yards on Sept. 5 in the win over Wyoming. Vick could be the beneficiary in the next game against BYU on Sept. 19 where the Rams might have to throw the ball.

headline: Career best with 2 TDs
story: Smith caught 90 receiving yards on four catches and a pair of touchdowns in the Colorado State's 58-24 victory over FCS Southern Utah on Saturday.
impact: Smith, who transferred from UConn along with head coach Jim Mora's move to the Rams, caught his first two touchdown passes in his career. Before this contest redshirt sophomore's best was 16 receiving yards against Rice on Oct. 25, 2025. Smith will look to add to his career in the next game, a tough contest versus ranked BYU on Sept. 19.

headline: Could return in Week 5
story: Smith (thumb) could return for the Cowboys' Week 5 matchup against the Buccaneers, Todd Archer of ESPN.com reports.
impact: Smith continues to work back from a procedure to fix a thumb injury he suffered near the start of the regular season. The left guard could return in Week 5, but the short lead-up to Thursday's game could set the 25-year-old back another week. Once Smith returns, T.J. Bass should revert to his role as a depth piece for the Cowboys' offensive line.

headline: Sees eight targets in Week 3
story: Flournoy caught just two of eight targets for 22 yards in Sunday's 34-31 loss to the Ravens.
impact: Flournoy logged 66 percent of the offensive snaps against Baltimore, and his eight targets were good for second on the team and a respectable 20 percent share. He obviously was unable to do much with them against a stingy Ravens secondary. Flournoy has a valuable role as the third receiver in a Dallas offense that likes to use plenty of 11 personnel, but he'd likely need an injury to CeeDee Lamb or George Pickens to become anything more than a bench stash in fantasy.

headline: Set for extended absence
story: Bullard (calf) is expected to miss 3-to-4 weeks, Patrik Walker of the Cowboys' official site reports.
impact: Bullard was hurt during Sunday's Week 3 loss to the Ravens. He was originally deemed questionable to return and didn't end up re-entering the contest. With the veteran nose tackle now slated to miss multiple weeks, rookie LT Overton may be asked to step into a larger role.

headline: Low chances to suit up for Week 5
story: Durant (hamstring) likely won't be suiting up for Sunday's game against the Texans, Joe Hoyt of The Dallas Morning News reports.
impact: Coach Brian Schottenheimer was not very optimistic about the starting cornerback's chances of playing in Week 5. Durant sustained a hamstring injury during the Cowboys' Week 2 win over the Commanders and has not practiced since suffering the injury. With current starter Shavon Revel (knee) also dealing with an injury, third option Ameer Speed may start at cornerback opposite DaRon Bland for Sunday's game.

headline: Appears to have avoided major injury
story: Revel (knee) is expected to "work into" practice this week, Nick Harris of the Fort Worth Star-Telegram reports.
impact: Revel was hurt while attempting to make a tackle in Sunday's loss to Baltimore. Head coach Brian Schottenheimer indicated Tuesday that the cornerback is likely to practice to some extent this week, so Revel has a chance to suit up Sunday versus Houston. That could be particularly important with Cobie Durant dealing with a hamstring injury that caused him to sit out Week 3 and that could sideline him for additional contests.

headline: Suffers from QB play
story: Wilson caught two passes for four yards Saturday against Virginia.
impact: This was never likely to be a great day for Wilson, even if he had 18 catches for 288 yards and three touchdowns prior to this. However, this was particularly poor, but it wasn't Wilson's fault. Nick Minicucci left this game with an undisclosed injury, and in his stead Braden Streeter went 2-for-16 for nine yards. Of course, if Wilson is without Minicucci in Week 5, that'll be a problem.

headline: Available moving forward
story: Salazer (undisclosed) is available moving forward, according to the team.
impact: Going into Week 4, Delaware released an injury report without Salazer in it, indicating that he is available. The wide receiver is still looking for his first counting stats with UD's updated team.

headline: Rushes for 49 yards
story: Silver ran 12 times for 49 yards Saturday against Virginia.
impact: Given the competition, this isn't bad, and Silver did run for over 100 yards against Vanderbilt. Of course, he also averaged 2.5 yards per carry against Coastal Carolina, so we shall see what Silver does in conference play.

headline: Horrendous in relief
story: Streeter stepped in for an injured Nick Minicucci (undisclosed) on Saturday against Virginia. He went 2-for-16 for nine yards and two interceptions.
impact: Yikes. It's not surprising that, eventually, third-string quarterback Riley Trujillo got a chance. If Minicucci can't start Delaware's next game, expect Trujillo, not Streeter, to get the nod.

headline: Will not return Saturday
story: Minicucci (undisclosed) will not return to the field in Saturday's game against Virginia, per Feathers and Field Goals.
impact: Minicucci suffered an injury during the second quarter, and it's significant enough to sideline him for the remainder of Saturday's game. The quarterback completed 4-of-8 passes for 24 yards and rushed for an 8-yard carry before exiting. An official report regarding the nature of his injury and timeline should surface after the game.

headline: Nets 52 yards
story: Lofton caught six passes for 52 yards Saturday against Coastal Carolina.
impact: The Oklahoma State transfer seems to have clearly emerged as the number-two receiver behind Sean Wilson. He has 13 catches for 258 yards and a touchdown through three games.

headline: Huge day against CCU
story: Wilson caught nine passes for 185 yards and two touchdowns against Coastal Carolina on Saturday.
impact: Wilson bested his numbers on the season in one game here. He had 68 catches for 877 yards last year, but only three touchdowns. Well, he already has three touchdowns this season.

headline: Catches two more passes
story: Roberts ran seven times for 27 yards and caught two passes for 10 yards versus CCU on Saturday.
impact: Roberts always gets a few carries, though, he's barely rushed for over 50 yards total through three games. What's notable is that Roberts has had two catches in every game this year, so he has his role in the pass game.

headline: Rushes for TD
story: Silver ran 11 times for 28 yards and a touchdown and had two catches for 10 yards Saturday against Coastal Carolina.
impact: After Silver ran for over 100 yards against Vanderbilt, things were looking up, so averaging 2.5 yards per carry against the Chanticleers isn't ideal. He did find the end zone, though, and he is still Delaware's top running back.

headline: Throws two more TDs
story: Minicucci went 24-for-32 for 302 yards and two touchdowns against Coastal Carolina on Saturday, and he also ran five times for 10 yards.
impact: Minicucci didn't have a good day on the road against Vanderbilt, but in his other two games he's gone over 300 passing yards with two passing TDs. That's encouraging for the bulk of the remaining schedule, but do note Delaware's next game is on the road against Virginia.

headline: Out vs. Coastal Carolina
story: Rehmann (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game versus Coastal Carolina, according to the Delaware team's X account.
impact: Rehmann will miss his second straight game as he deals with an undisclosed problem. The wideout will aim to return against Virginia next Saturday.

headline: Active in passing game again
story: Roberts ran three times for 14 yards and had two catches for 42 yards Saturday against Vanderbilt.
impact: Jo Silver is clearly the lead back for Delaware, and Roberts and Viron Ellison are sharing carries behind him, but Roberts has four catches for 122 yards and a touchdown, which is interesting.

headline: Out for season
story: Spiller (undisclosed) has been ruled out for the remainder of the 2025-26 season.
impact: Spiller will miss the rest of the 2025-26 season due to undisclosed reasons according to team reporting ahead of Week 2. The 6-foot junior will end the season with one carry for six yards. Spiller will look to rest and recover ahead of a comeback next fall.

headline: Dealing with undisclosed problem
story: Rehmann is dealing with an undisclosed problem, according to the Delaware team's X account.
impact: Rehmann's undisclosed problem explains why he was ruled out for Week 2. It is unclear how long the wide receiver will be out moving forward.

headline: Nets 30 yards
story: Wilson caught three passes for 30 yards Saturday against Vanderbilt.
impact: Wilson had 68 catches for 877 yards last season, and he opened this year with six catches for 73 yards and a score. Playing an SEC team on the road isn't easy, and it will be easier going forward for Wilson.

headline: Big game against Vanderbilt
story: Lofton caught four passes for 142 yards and a touchdown against Vanderbilt on Saturday.
impact: Lofton, an Oklahoma State transfer, had three catches for 64 yards in his Delaware debut. Now, he's delivered a few more big receptions, and he's done it against an SEC team. Lofton is definitely a receiver to keep an eye on.

headline: Rushes for over 100 yards
story: Silver ran 16 times for 109 yards versus Vanderbilt on Saturday.
impact: Silver didn't play much against Merrimack, a game he wasn't needed in, but against an SEC opponent Delaware gave a scare he got 16 touches and ended up over 100 yards. That's encouraging.

headline: Considered 'fine' after sporting boot
story: Waddle is believed to be "fine" despite being seen wearing a walking boot on his right foot following Sunday's victory over the Rams, Sam Jane of The Denver Post reports.
impact: Concern was raised about Waddle's status after he was spotted -- per Jon Heath of Broncos Wire -- with a boot on his foot Sunday night, but Jane's report indicates Waddle is not dealing with any sort of serious setback. More will be known about Waddle's status either at the start of or after Denver's Wednesday practice session.

headline: Finds paydirt in Week 3 win
story: Bryant recorded two receptions for 44 yards and a touchdown on two targets in Sunday's 30-26 win over the Rams. He also scored on a two-point conversion.
impact: Bryant reached the end zone for the first time this season with 7:44 left in the third quarter, connecting with quarterback Bo Nix on a five-yard catch. The second-year wideout has seen his snap share gradually climb through the first three weeks, topping out at 70 percent in Week 3. The Broncos have been without Marvin Mims (foot) for the past two games, however, so Bryant could see a slight downturn in playing time once the Denver receiving corps is at full strength.

headline: Notches eight stops in Week 3
story: Barnes registered eight tackles (five solo) and a defensed pass Sunday in a 31-24 victory against the Jets.
impact: Barnes tied with D.J. Reed for the second-most tackles on Detroit behind Christian Izien (11). Barnes has been consistent to begin the campaign, recording between six and eight stops in each of his three games so far. He also has 2.0 sacks on the campaign, halfway to his career-high total over 17 regular-season contests last year.

headline: Posts another strong performance in Week 3
story: Clark finished Sunday's 31-24 win over the Jets with seven tackles, including 1.0 sacks, and a forced fumble.
impact: Clark continues to start at safety for Detroit with with Brian Branch (Achilles) and Kerby Joseph (knee) both on the PUP list. Clark logged just a 45 percent defensive snap share in Week 1, but he upped that to 86 percent in Week 2 before playing every one of the Lions' 61 defensive snaps in Week 3. The veteran defender came up with a huge play late in the contest, sacking Jets QB Geno Smith and causing him to fumble with less than a minute remaining and New York nearing the red zone while trailing by seven points. The sack was Clark's first since he played for the Jets in 2024.

headline: Racks up 11 stops in Week 3
story: Izien posted 11 tackles (nine solo) and one defensed pass Sunday in a 31-24 win over the Jets.
impact: Izien paced the Lions in stops while playing all but two of the team's defensive snaps. The 26-year-old appears to be fully recovered from the groin injury that caused him to sit out Detroit's season opener. Izien has taken on a starting safety role with Brian Branch (Achilles) and Kerby Joseph (knee) both on the PUP list.

headline: Goes for 66 yards in Week 3 win
story: TeSlaa caught all three of his targets for 66 yards in the Lions' 31-24 win over the Jets on Sunday.
impact: Detroit's third receiver, TeSlaa played 48 percent of the offensive snaps against New York but made the most of his opportunities and ended up leading the team in receiving yards. With Jameson Williams continuing to struggle to get going early in the season, TeSlaa could start earning a couple more looks from Jared Goff. It's still unlikely to be enough to put TeSlaa in the redraft fantasy mix unless one of Williams or Amon-Ra St. Brown misses time with an injury.

headline: Optioned before season finale
story: The Tigers optioned Hurter to the rookie-level Florida Complex League on Sunday.
impact: The transaction was merely procedural, as Hurter wasn't in line to pitch in Sunday's season finale versus the Pirates after tossing 1.2 innings in relief a day earlier. The Tigers reinstated Jack Flaherty (forearm) from the 15-day injured list in a corresponding move. Hurter wrapped up the 2026 season with a 3.06 ERA, 1.10 WHIP and 24:15 K:BB in 35.1 innings across 29 appearances.

headline: Closes season with two-inning outing
story: Flaherty (forearm) was reinstated from the 15-day injured list Sunday and struck out one batter while allowing one hit and no walks over two scoreless innings in the Tigers' 4-2 lo...
impact: Flaherty, who had been on the shelf since July 21 due to right flexor inflammation, made a pair of rehab appearances with Triple-A Toledo before being cleared to rejoin the Tigers ahead of the season finale. Since he wasn't fully stretched out for a starting role, Flaherty ended up making his first appearance out of the bullpen since the 2023 campaign. The 30-year-old righty is scheduled for unrestricted free agency this winter.

headline: Homers again in season finale
story: Valencia went 1-for-4 with a solo home run in Sunday's 4-2 loss to the Pirates.
impact: The 26-year-old backstop along with Kevin McGonigle provided all of Detroit's offense in the regular season finale with a pair of solo home runs, giving Valencia two homers in as many days. The rookie thus wraps up an impressive debut campaign in which he batted .341 with a 1.016 OPS and eight long balls across 42 games. MLB pitchers will certainly make adjustments in how they attack Valencia next year, though he looks like a more-than-capable hitter in the majors who could see his fantasy value climb if his role with the Tigers expands.

headline: Scores first career touchdown
story: Solomon had three receptions (on four targets) for 55 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 62-7 win over William & Mary.
impact: Solomon still isn't a big part of this passing game, but in a huge blowout against a willy overmatched FCS foe, the second-year wideout got involved and found the end zone for his first career touchdown.

headline: Scores vs. FCS foe
story: Moore hauled in all two targets for 32 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 62-7 win over William & Mary.
impact: Moore finally hit paydirt in Week 4, catching just his second and third passes of the season. With just 10 targets through three games, he's not a huge part of this Duke passing game that tends to take a backseat to Nate Sheppard and the running game most of the time regardless.

headline: Gets in on the action vs. William & Mary
story: Tanelus had nine rushes for 69 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 62-7 victory against William & Mary.
impact: Tanelus now has a touchdown in back-to-back Weeks as Duke has been able to go deeper into its bench amidst comfortable victories. Tanelus remains behind Nate Sheppard and CJ Campbell in the pecking order, but it's encouraging to see the freshman put good things on tape early in his career.

headline: Efficient 116 yards in easy win
story: Sheppard compiled nine carries for 116 yards and one touchdown and gathered in their only target for eight yards during Saturday's 62-7 win against William & Mary.
impact: Sheppard racked up 124 yards and a score on just 10 touches, and then Duke decided to call it a day for its star halfback. Sheppard likely could've posted a much bigger stat-line if he remained in the game longer, but the Blue Devils had no need to risk injury to their star halfback. Up next for Sheppard is a road tilt with Georgia Tech in Week 6 following a Week 5 bye.

headline: Three scores in FCS blowout
story: Mahan completed 6 of 7 passes for 126 yards and three touchdowns during Saturday's 62-7 victory over William & Mary.
impact: Mahan was electric as Duke absolutely destroyed William & Mary. Replacing Walker Eget at quarterback, Mahan easily tossed for three scores and just one incompletion to contribute to the Blue Devils' big blowout win. Eget remains the starter, of course, but this was an encouraging performance by the backup signal-caller in Durham.

headline: Meager output in blowout
story: Eget was 16-for-22 passing for 182 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 62-7 victory versus William & Mary.
