impact: Eget only tossed for 182 yards and two scores in the 62-7 victory as Duke played three quarterbacks in the midst of its blowout over the Tribe. Eget has yet to put up big numbers this season, but he's also kept the ball out of harm's way and he's doing what this Duke offense asks of him.

headline: Quiet outing in blowout win
story: Richardson compiled three receptions (on four targets) for 44 yards during Saturday's 35-7 victory over Stanford.
impact: Richardson notched his first three catches of the season in an easy Week 3 win over Stanford, but he didn't make too big of an impact on the stat-sheet as Duke leaned on a dominant running game. He'll look to build off this positive performance next week versus William & Mary.

headline: Leading receiver in comfortable win
story: Hasley gathered in 5 of 6 targets for 88 yards during Saturday's 35-7 win over Stanford.
impact: Hasley was Duke's top receiver in an easy win over Stanford. The tight end has been a consistent target for quarterback Walker Eget, who hasn't put up big numbers consistently but has orchestrated a solid passing game. Hasley will face another poor defense in Week 4 as the Blue Devils host William & Mary.

headline: Continues early-season dominance
story: Sheppard logged 23 rushes for 154 yards and two touchdowns and caught their only target for two yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 35-7 win over Stanford.
impact: Sheppard scored another three touchdowns Saturday as Duke cruised to an easy blowout win over Stanford to move to 3-0. The tailback's 23 carries and 156 total yards were both actually his lowest output yet this season, as the Blue Devils didn't need to run him into the ground during a dominating victory. Sheppard has another great matchup next week against FCS William & Mary.

headline: Takes care of business vs. Stanford
story: Eget was 14-for-24 passing for 202 yards, one touchdown and one interception during Saturday's 35-7 win against Stanford.
impact: Eget didn't have the flashiest stat-line against Stanford, but the quarterback did what he needed to do as Duke blew the Cardinal out of the water. As the Blue Devils continue to lean on star tailback Nate Sheppard and the ground game, Eget may not produce big-time stats every week. Still, he's been very solid for a Duke team that's now 3-0.

headline: Good to go vs. Stanford
story: Nicholas (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game versus Stanford, per the ACC availability report.
impact: Nicholas is set to make his season debut Saturday after missing the first two games of the season due to an undisclosed injury. The wideout should carve out a role in the passing attack this season after hauling in 60 receptions for 740 yards and five touchdowns with Charlotte last year.

headline: Out for Week 3
story: Johnson is listed as out prior to Saturday's matchup against Stanford.
impact: Johnson has yet to appear in a game this season for the Blue Devils. That stretch will continue after being listed as out ahead of Saturday's game. The wide receiver will have the chance to make his season debut Sept. 26 against William & Mary.

headline: Out against Stanford
story: Gardner (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game against Stanford.
impact: Gardner is dealing with an undisclosed injury and will miss his first game of the season. The quarterback is a depth option for the Blue Devils and will aim to suit up against William & Mary next Saturday.

headline: Probable ahead of Saturday's matchup
story: Duke is listing Nicholas (undisclosed) as probable ahead of their matchup against Stanford on Saturday.
impact: After missing the first two games of the season due to an undisclosed injury, Nicholas is officially listed as probable for Saturday's ACC opener against Stanford. The Charlotte transfer logged 60 receptions for 740 yards and five scores in 2025.

headline: Paces receiving corps in win
story: Joseph tallied 10 receptions (on 12 targets) for 141 yards during Saturday's 42-9 win versus North Carolina Central.
impact: Joseph emerged as Emory Williams' top target Saturday, hauling in double-digit receptions for the first time this season. North Carolina Central's secondary had no answer for the wideout as he paced the team by a wide margin in both catches and yards. It is worth noting that Jeremiah Melvin (back) and Brock Spalding (back) did not suit up, which allowed for increased targets. Regardless, it was a highly promising performance for Joseph, who has an opportunity to solidify himself as a staple in the passing attack.

headline: Erupts for three TDs in blowout win
story: Engleman totaled 10 carries for 129 yards and two touchdowns and reeled in all two targets for 33 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 42-9 victory versus North Carolina Centr...
impact: Engleman started in the backfield for the second straight game with Ashton Gray (undisclosed) still recovering from an injury. The running back was dominant against North Central Carolina, recording 162 total yards and three touchdowns. He has now put together back-to-back productive starts, making a strong case to carve out a shared role once Gray returns.

headline: Shines in start
story: Williams was 25-for-36 passing for 341 yards, three touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 42-9 win versus North Carolina Central.
impact: It had been a long time since Williams last earned a start under center, with his previous opportunity coming back in 2023 at Miami. The quarterback lost the competition to Mitch Griffis during fall camp and had been waiting for an opening ever since. He was tasked with facing an FBS team with a lot of pressure to perform well, and he stepped up to the occasion, tossing for three touchdowns and over 300 yards for the first time in his career. After his performance, his starting spot should be secured, and an upcoming bye gives him more time to earn extra reps with the first-team offense.

headline: Shines in first start
story: Griffis was 1-for-2 passing for zero yards during Saturday's 42-9 win versus North Carolina Central.
impact: It had been a long time since Williams last earned a start under center, with his previous opportunity coming back in 2023 at Miami. The quarterback lost the competition to Mitch Griffis during fall camp and had been waiting for an opening ever since. He was tasked with facing an FBS team with a lot of pressure to perform well, and he stepped up to the occasion, tossing for three touchdowns and over 300 yards for the first time in his career. After his performance, his starting spot should be secured, and an upcoming bye gives him more time to earn extra reps with the first-team offense.

headline: Close to returning
story: Melvin (back) is close to returning, and he would've played if Saturday's game against North Carolina Central had been a championship game, according to 94.3 The Game.
impact: Melvin is trending in the right direction and should be back on the field soon. Based on the latest developments, it wouldn't be shocking if he can play against Rice on Oct. 10 after the bye week.

headline: Close to returning
story: Head coach Blake Harrell said Gray (undisclosed) is close to returning to action for East Carolina, per 94.3 The Game.
impact: Gray suffered an injury against Old Dominion in Week 3 and was scheduled to undergo an MRI. It appears that the running back is progressing well, considering Harrell's comments. In his stead, TJ Engleman has stepped into a larger role in the backfield. The running back will aim to return against Rice on Oct. 10, utilizing the upcoming bye week to continue recovering.

headline: Multiple receptions in return
story: Sides (hamstring) logged two receptions for 18 yards during Saturday's 42-9 win against North Carolina Central.
impact: Sides logging multiple receptions in his first game for East Carolina is a promising start, even if he did so against a non-FBS team. It would not be surprising if the Pirates expect a lot from him, knowing that he thrived not only for his previous team but also in American Conference play. Last season, despite scoring zero touchdowns, Sides still made a decent impression by recording 24 receptions for 322 yards, 13.4 averaged per catch.

headline: Out Saturday
story: Melvin (back) is out for Saturday's game against North Carolina Central, per Stephen Igoe of 247Sports.com.
impact: Melvin is dealing with a back injury, and it appears to still be a problem as he will not suit up Saturday. The wideout was breaking out as a reliable target in the Pirates' passing attack, but his momentum will be put on hold. He has an upcoming bye week, giving him extra time to recover and potentially return Oct. 10 against conference foe Rice.

headline: Starting vs. North Carolina Central
story: Williams will start at quarterback against North Carolina Central on Saturday, per 247Sports.
impact: Williams will draw the start under center Saturday after Mitch Griffis has struggled to begin the season. Both quarterbacks competed during fall camp for the starting role, but Griffis ultimately won the job as the initial starter. Williams will get his first chance under center as a starter after handling backup duties previously with Miami. The quarterback saw limited action in previous weeks this year, completing 6 of 10 passes for 45 yards.

headline: Not starting Saturday
story: Griffis is not starting in Saturday's game against North Carolina Central, 247Sports reports.
impact: Griffis will handle backup duties as Emory Williams will get the starting nod under center. The senior quarterback has completed 53.8 percent of his passes for 425 yards, three touchdowns and two interceptions across three appearances.

headline: Dealing with back injury
story: East Carolina head coach Blake Harrell said Melvin has been dealing with back stiffness, which is why he didn't play against Old Dominion, 94.3 The Game reports.
impact: Melvin's absence from the Pirates' third game of the season after a hot start is now clearer. The starting wide receiver will aim to return to the field for this Saturday's game against NC Central, but the severity of his injury could keep him sidelined through the weekend.

headline: Will undergo MRI
story: East Carolina head coach Blake Harrell said Gray (undisclosed) will undergo an MRI on Monday, per 94.3 The Game.
impact: Gray went on to say that Gray played against Old Dominion this past Saturday after suffering the injury that will lead to an MRI. The starting running back's availability moving forward is contingent on the results of the scan.

headline: Sees snaps against Old Dominion
story: Williams was 5-for-7 passing for 22 yards during Saturday's 20-17 victory versus Old Dominion. He also had five rushes for negative one yard.
impact: East Carolina is still sorting out its quarterback situation after Williams saw snaps under center in the first half. He seemingly failed to lock down the job, however, as Mitch Griffis took over once again near the end of the second quarter and finished out the game despite a quiet showing. With conference play right around the corner, the Pirates could continue to utilize both signal-callers moving forward, though Griffis remains the starter.

headline: Manages close win amid struggles
story: Griffis completed 4 of 12 passes for 58 yards during Saturday's 20-17 victory over Old Dominion. He also had six rushes for 22 yards.
impact: Griffis led East Carolina to its first win of the season, but it wasn't a great day for the quarterback, as he completed only four passes and threw for fewer than 100 yards. Emory Williams saw some action under center in the first half, but Griffis handled the duties by himself in the second half. If the lead signal-caller continues to struggle, he could lose his starting spot, especially with conference play approaching.

headline: Active in Week 3
story: Pearson (foot) participated in Saturday's 20-17 win against Old Dominion.
impact: Pearson is fully healthy after dealing with a foot ailment, returning a punt for seven yards during Saturday's game. The wideout wasn't involved in the passing game, as it appears he will be used primarily on special teams.

headline: Sidelined again Saturday
story: Sides (hamstring) remains out for Saturday's game versus Old Dominion, Stephen Igoe of 247Sports.com reports.
impact: Sides wasn't a full participant in practice earlier in the week, so it's not too surprising he'll miss out on another contest as he continues to recover from injury. The Pirates have another non-conference matchup on tap next week versus North Carolina Central, and a bye week after that, so there's a chance the staff will take precautions to ensure the wideout is healthy for conference play when it starts Oct. 10.

headline: Could be sidelined until conference play
story: Spalding (back) may he held out until conference play, which begins with the Pirates' Oct. 10 clash with Rice, per Stephen Igoe of 247Sports.
impact: Spalding has yet to play this season, and there's reportedly a chance he could miss the next two games for the Pirates as well. The wideout, who reeled in 42 catches for 554 yards and three scores last fall for East Carolina, will be a big boost for this passing game once he returns, but that still might not be for another two games.

headline: Not practicing fully
story: Sides (hamstring) was working off to the side at East Carolina's practice on Tuesday, per Stephen Igoe of 247Sports.
impact: Sides still has yet to play this season, and he's clearly still hampered by his hamstring injury as he's not yet a full practice participant for the Pirates. He remains questionable for Saturday at Old Dominion, but he's certainly not trending in the right direction ahead of Week 3.

headline: Heavy workload in defeat
story: Gray logged 16 carries for 99 yards and caught one of two targets for 9 yards during Saturday's 27-24 loss against Appalachian State.
impact: Gray redeemed himself after an underwhelming Week 1, falling just shy of the century mark. The running back handled a heavy workload on the Pirates' second offensive possession before being stopped short of the goal line, allowing Michael Allen to punch in a one-yard score. He did outperform Allen (4-12-1), positioning himself as the lead back for East Carolina.

headline: Paces receiving corps
story: Melvin compiled seven receptions (on 12 targets) for 94 yards during Saturday's 27-24 defeat against Appalachian State.
impact: Melvin led the receiving corps with seven receptions and 94 yards, emerging as Mitch Griffis' favorite target. The wideout has seized his opportunities to begin the season with Landon Sides (hamstring) and Brock Spalding (back) remaining sidelined. Melvin should remain heavily involved while the receiving corps deals with injuries.

headline: Throws two touchdowns in loss
story: Griffis completed 21 of 37 passes for 230 yards, two touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 27-24 loss against Appalachian State. He also had 11 rushes for 52 yards.
impact: It wasn't a great game in terms of efficiency for Griffis, but he was still able to throw two touchdowns. The quarterback doubled his passing attempts from Week 1 and recorded 52 rushing yards, which was second most on the team. His blunder of the game was a reckless throw in the fourth quarter while scrambling to his right, resulting in a toe-tap interception near the sideline. Griffis once again couldn't lead his team to a win, though he put forth a valiant offensive effort Saturday.

headline: Transfers to ETSU
story: Davis is transferring to East Tennessee State University, per On3.com.
impact: Davis spent the 2025 season at Michigan, failing to complete either of his two pass attempts during his lone appearance. He should have four years of eligibility remaining while at East Tennessee.

headline: Scores second TD
story: Mack gathered in 6 of 10 targets for 80 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 29-3 victory against Lindenwood.
impact: Mack crossed the goal line for the second time this season after hauling in a 19-yard pass from Noah Kim in the fourth quarter to extend the lead. In five games, the Indiana native has 20 catches for 215 yards and two touchdowns.

headline: Breaks out against Lindenwood
story: Prosper gathered in 10 of 13 targets for 109 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 29-3 win against Lindenwood.
impact: Prosper led the Eagles in receptions (10) and receiving yards (109) during Saturday's win. The wide receiver found the end zone for the first time this campaign after reeling in a 24-yard pass from Noah Kim in the first quarter to extend the lead. In five games, the Florida native has 21 catches for 220 yards and one touchdown.

headline: Bounces back against Lindenwood
story: Kim was 23-for-38 passing for 257 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 29-3 win over Lindenwood.
impact: After committing two turnovers with just 140 passing yards last week against Wisconsin, Kim flipped the script against Lindenwood. The quarterback threw for two scores and had no turnovers. Through his first five games, the Virginia native has 968 passing yards, eight touchdowns and three interceptions.

headline: Good to go Saturday
story: Blue (undisclosed) is good to go for Saturday's game versus Lindenwood, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Blue is not on the team's injury report, clearing him to play after exiting last week's contest early. Blue has rushed 35 times for 185 yards and one touchdown through four games, so his availability is a big boost for the Eagles.

headline: Ruled out Saturday
story: Minner (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game versus Lindenwood, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Minner has been ruled out for Saturday's contest, though it's unlikely he would've played given his place on the depth chart. His next chance to suit up is next Saturday at UMass.

headline: Unavailable for Week 4
story: Fishwick (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game against Lindenwood.
impact: For the second time since Eastern Michigan's 2026 season began, Holt will be out for the Eagles for undisclosed reasons. The wide receiver's zero receptions suggest he has not been able to make a big impact in earning a coveted spot among EMU's receiver corps.

headline: Sitting out Saturday
story: Shleton won't be available for Saturday's game versus Lindenwood, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Shelton doesn't have any stats under his belt as a freshman, and it appears he won't have a chance to change that Saturday. He'll have plenty more opportunities to don the uniform this season.

headline: Ruled out for Saturday
story: Kokaly (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game versus Lindenwood, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Kokaly will miss Saturday's contest, though it's unlikely the true freshman would've played even if he was available. His next chance to suit up is next Saturday at UMass.

headline: Out for Week 4
story: Holt (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game against Lindenwood.
impact: For the second time since Eastern Michigan's 2026 season commenced, Holt will be out for a game. Between the tight end's absences, he did not log any receptions for EMU.

headline: Questionable for Saturday
story: Isaac (undisclosed) is considered questionable for Saturday's game versus Lindenwood, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Isaac was in the clear for last week's game against Michigan State, but didn't record any stats. He's questionable again for Saturday, so it's unclear if the sophomore will be abck in action Saturday.

headline: Out Saturday
story: Kinsey (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game versus Lindenwood, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Kinsey has been ruled out for Saturday, though it's very unlikely the true freshman would've played even if he was available. His next chance to suit up is next Saturday at UMass.

headline: Good to go for Week 4
story: Mack (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game against Lindenwood.
impact: Eastern Michigan's team will log what should be its easiest game of the season for Week 4, giving Mack a prime opportunity to comfortably catch the ball after an undisclosed problem temporarily put his availability into question. In each of the wide receiver's first three games this season, he was targeted at least three times. Overall, Mack has caught 14 passes for 135 yards and one touchdown, an impressive total for a three-game span.

headline: Returning to practice
story: Mack is expected to return to practice this week, Andrew Graham of Mitten Football reports.
impact: Mack missed the Eagles' most recent loss to Wisconsin, but he looks to be on track for a return versus Lindenwood this week. The sophomore wide receiver could also be in line for more work after his return, as teammate Nick Devereau (undisclosed) is out for several weeks.

headline: Out several weeks with injury
story: Devereaux (undisclosed) will miss several weeks after getting injured against Wisconsin, Andrew Graham of Mitten Football reports.
impact: Devereaux recorded three catches for 38 yards and a touchdown against the Badgers, but he also appears to have suffered a big injury. While the starting wide receiver's return timeline remains unknown, it's very unlikely he'll suit up any earlier than Oct. 3 at UMass.

headline: Scores lone TD in loss
story: Devereaux brought in three catches for 38 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 54-10 defeat versus Wisconsin.
impact: Devereaux reeled in his first touchdown since Week 0 to give the Eagles the early lead Saturday. The wide receiver caught an 18-yard pass from Noah Kim for his second score of the campaign.

headline: Hot start leads to slow finish
story: Kim completed 16 of 28 passes for 140 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions during Saturday's 54-10 defeat against Wisconsin.
impact: Kim gave the Eagles an early lead after tossing an 18-yard touchdown to Nick Devereaux. After that drive, it was rough sledding for the quarterback as he led his team to just three more points. Kim will look to bounce back next week against Lindenwood.

headline: Exits with trainer
story: Blue departed Saturday's game against Wisconsin with a trainer, per the Peacock broadcast.
impact: Blue tallied just four carries for nine yards prior to his departure Saturday. His status will be worth monitoring as the schedule lightens next week with Linenwood on the schedule.

headline: Out Saturday
story: Isaac (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game at Wisconsin, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Isaac will miss his second straight game Saturday as he continues to deal with an undisclosed injury. Isaac has caught two passes through his two appearances this season. His next chance to play is next Saturday versus Lindenwood.

headline: Not playing Saturday
story: Mack is listed out ahead of Saturday's game against Wisconsin.
impact: Mack will be forced to sit out this contest as he deals with an undisclosed injury. The sophomore wide receiver has totaled 14 receptions for 135 yards and one touchdown across three games and will aim to be back on the field for next week's contest against Lindenwood.

headline: Struggles in defeat
story: Kim completed 16 of 26 passes for 118 yards during Saturday's 35-7 defeat to Michigan State. He also had seven rushes for two yards with one touchdown.
impact: Kim registered just 118 passing yards, averaging 4.5 yards per completion. The quarterback picked up the Eagles' lone score on the ground with a four-yard run in the first half. Kim will look to turn it around next week as EMU heads to Wisconsin.

headline: Continues impact in passing game
story: Valsin notched nine receptions (on 11 targets) for 123 yards during Saturday's 45-17 victory over Louisiana-Monroe.
impact: Valsin logged his second 100-yard performance of the season Saturday. The wideout couldn't find the end zone, but his heavy volume was notable as he led the team in yards and tied for a team-high nine receptions. He and Dominique Henry both stood out in a game where Easton Messer was held in check. Through four games, he has been dominant, recording 33 receptions for 386 yards and two touchdowns.

headline: Passes century mark and scores twice
story: Henry compiled nine receptions (on 10 targets) for 121 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 45-17 win against Louisiana-Monroe.
impact: Henry was a major target in Saturday's game, producing his best performance of the campaign. The wideout scored both of FAU's receiving touchdowns and passed triple digits for the first time this season. His longest reception of the night was a 36-yard touchdown in the third quarter. He is part of a competitive receiver room but has held his ground, looking to build on the production he established in the offense last year.

headline: Held in check by ULM
story: Messer reeled in 4 of 6 targets for 15 yards during Saturday's 45-17 win over Louisiana-Monroe.
impact: Messer hauled in a season-low four receptions for 15 yards, which comes as a surprise given that Caden Veltkamp racked up 30 completions. He still managed to see at least five targets even in a game where the Owls led throughout. It was a forgettable outing that the wideout will look to put behind him as he shifts his focus toward a favorable Week 5 matchup against Texas Southern.

headline: Strong showing on ground
story: Ervin logged 21 carries for 139 yards and one touchdown and reeled in all two targets for six yards during Saturday's 45-17 win versus Louisiana-Monroe.
impact: Ervin made his presence known on the ground Saturday after modest production since his season opener. The running back has handled a heavy workload all year, logging double-digit carries in all four games, but he finally broke out with over 20 attempts and 100 yards for the first time this season. His high volume is especially impressive considering Florida Atlantic operates a pass-heavy offense. He capped off a 92-yard scoring drive with a two-yard score, marking his second touchdown of the season.

headline: Commanding performance in victory
story: Veltkamp completed 30 of 39 passes for 313 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 45-17 win against Louisiana-Monroe.
impact: Veltkamp couldn't toss a touchdown last week against FIU, but he found success against UL-Monroe's secondary by connecting on two scoring strikes. The quarterback was efficient and has now logged over 300 yards in two of his four starts. After struggling with turnovers last season, he has stayed clean through his last three games following two interceptions in the opener. Due to the lopsided nature of the blowout, he sat out the team's final two possessions as backup Drew Devillier entered the game.

headline: Logs 56 yards in win
story: Valsin caught 6 of 8 targets for 56 yards during Saturday's 16-10 victory versus Florida International.
impact: Valsin was one of just two receivers to finish with over 20 yards, joining top wideout Easton Messer. It was once again a tale of Valsin and Messer leading the receiving corps, a trend that figures to continue. The wideout has established himself as the clear second option in the passing attack, recording 24 receptions for 263 yards and two touchdowns this season.

headline: Paces FAU receivers in victory
story: Messer gathered in 7 of 11 targets for 83 yards during Saturday's 16-10 win versus Florida International.
impact: Messer continues to be targeted heavily, already recording 33 targets through three games. The wideout led the team with seven receptions and 83 yards, though he couldn't haul in a receiving touchdown. In fact, the passing attack was kept out of the end zone entirely after tossing five scores the previous week against Navy. Still, the pass catcher proved he can put up solid numbers even when quarterback Caden Veltkamp struggles to find a rhythm.

headline: Quiet day in win
story: Veltkamp was 24-for-36 passing for 202 yards during Saturday's 16-10 victory over Florida International. He also had five rushes for -23 yards.
impact: Veltkamp couldn't get past Florida International's secondary, failing to record a passing touchdown for the first time this season. It was a drastic shift considering the quarterback looked unstoppable the previous week while throwing five touchdowns against Navy. On a positive note, he didn't commit any turnovers and led the team to its second win of the season. He will aim to lead the offense to a stronger performance against Louisiana in a Week 4 matchup.

headline: Hauls in second TD of season
story: Valsin totaled eight receptions (on nine targets) for 115 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 38-30 victory against Navy.
impact: Vaslin continues his hot start to the season by going for over 100 receiving yards for the first time in his career and scoring another touchdown on a 30-yard reception. The wideout has made an early statement to be the top option behind Easton Messer, as the two have become a reliable duo for Caden Veltkamp. He once again led the team in receptions, tying for a team-high eight catches, and figures to have the same volume against Florida International in Week 3.

headline: Scores touchdown against Navy
story: Henry hauled in 6 of 7 targets for 63 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 38-30 victory versus Navy.
impact: Henry was quiet in Florida Atlantic's season opener but found his stride against Navy, hauling in his first touchdown of the season and the second most receptions on the team with six. The Owls' receiving corps has big names, as he is competing for targets alongside Easton Messer and Kelby Valsin, making it tough to replicate an outing like this every week.

headline: Huge receiving day in win
story: Messer accrued eight receptions (on nine targets) for 179 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 38-30 victory versus Navy.
impact: Messer made easy work of Navy's secondary, hauling in both of his touchdowns and 151 yards in the first quarter alone. He tied for a team-high eight receptions as he and fellow wideout Kelby Vaslin continue to shine as Caden Veltkamp's favorite targets. It was only a matter of time before Messer would have a breakout game, and it came early in the season.

headline: Tosses for five touchdowns in win
story: Veltkamp completed 27 of 32 passes for 386 yards and five touchdowns during Saturday's 38-30 victory against Navy. He also had five rushes for -22 yards.
impact: Veltkamp rebounded well from his season opener, throwing five touchdowns for the fourth time in his career. Interestingly enough, he's thrown for five touchdowns in the game immediately following the season opener in three straight years, so he knows a thing or two about good performances early in the season. The quarterback was dominant against conference foe Navy, connecting with four different receivers for scores as he looks to establish a top passing attack.

headline: Sidelined for Week 2
story: Johnson (undisclosed) is out for Week 2 against Navy and there's no definite timeline for his return, per FAU Owls Nest.
impact: Johnson has yet to play this season and he may be sidelined for a while as there's no clear timeline for his return. The Owls' No. 2 tight end, who transferred from Coastal Carolina this offseason, reeled in 11 catches for 87 yards and a score with the Chanticleers last fall. However, he may have a hard time surpassing those numbers this season if his ailment continues to limit him.

headline: Paces FAU receivers in loss
story: Valsin caught 10 of 15 targets for 92 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 66-21 defeat against Florida.
impact: Valsin was heavily targeted Saturday night, totaling 15 targets as starting quarterback Caden Veltkamp looked his way often. It was a breakout game for the wideout, who in two years with Texas Tech hauled in just six targets for 56 yards total. He also reeled in his first career touchdown on a 20-yard catch late in the third quarter. Valsin and Easton Messer appear set to lead the receiving corps once again against Navy next Saturday.

headline: Starts season with 73 yards
story: Messer posted seven receptions (on 13 targets) for 73 yards during Saturday's 66-21 loss against Florida.
impact: There is no need to panic early about Messer's performance Saturday, as the entire offense struggled to click against the Gators' relentless defense. The wideout was targeted 13 times, which indicates starting quarterback Caden Veltkamp will continue to lean on his WR1. Even without reaching the end zone, his 73 receiving yards were impressive given the nature of the blowout. Fellow wideout Kelby Valsin had a big first game with the Owls (10-92-1), so it appears the two will become a reliable duo for Veltkamp as the season progresses.

headline: Scores first touchdown of career
story: Ervin posted 16 rushes for 50 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 66-21 defeat versus Florida.
impact: Ervin recorded his first collegiate touchdown on a seven-yard run in the second quarter. He led the Owls' backfield with 16 carries, splitting snaps with Leonard Farrow (10-51-0). Florida Atlantic's offense is pass-heavy, but if Ervin continues to impress in the backfield, the team could rely on him moving forward.

headline: Likely to be game-time decision
story: Brown (knee) is expected to be a game-time decision for Saturday's game at Missouri, Pete Nakos of On3.com reports.
impact: Brown's injury isn't expected to be a long-term problem, but the Gators aren't expected to make a rush decision regarding his availability. As head coach Jon Sumrall said, Brown's availability in Week 5 will come down to "pain tolerance and confidence."

headline: Down day in win over Ole Miss
story: Wilson reeled in 2 of 3 targets for 11 yards during Saturday's 52-28 victory versus Mississippi.
impact: Wilson had his worst performance to this point of the season with just two catches for 11 yards both season lows. This is likely more due to the fact that the Gators put up 302 yards on the ground and not quite as much was needed from the passing game.

headline: Big day in big win over Ole Miss
story: Clark tallied 12 carries for 126 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 52-28 victory against Mississippi.
impact: Despite Jadan Baugh continuing to steal the spotlight, Clark put up his best performance of the season. Clark has been averaging 8.1 yards in relief of Baugh and even topped those numbers on Saturday against the Rebels as he went for 10.5 yards per carry and found the end zone for his third touchdown of the season.

headline: Three touchdowns in win over Ole Miss
story: Baugh posted 29 rushes for 142 yards and three touchdowns and hauled in their only target for 12 yards during Saturday's 52-28 win against Mississippi.
impact: Baugh's magnificent season continues as he had his fourth straight 100 yard and multi-touchdown game. Baugh has been nearly unstoppable on the season as he is averaging 7.2 yards per carry and brings his season touchdown total to 11 after three more against Ole Miss.

headline: Two touchdowns in big win over Ole Miss
story: Philo completed 16 of 23 passes for 196 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 52-28 win versus Mississippi. He also had six rushes for 14 yards with one touchdown.
impact: Philo continues to stack solid performances. Through four weeks, the rushing attack from Florida has really stolen the show as this week the Gators went for 302 yards on the ground with five rushing touchdowns including one from Philo. The Gators have yet to really be in a situation where they have needed to throw the ball to win a game but Philo has proven the ability to get the job done as needed thus far.

headline: Expected to be full-go at practice
story: Singleton (ankle) is expected to be full-go in team practices before Saturday's game at Missouri, Nick Marcinko of GatorCountry.com reports.
impact: Considering that Singleton barely logged multiple targets during Florida's upset win over Mississippi, especially with the Gators' multiple injuries in their receiver corps, his availability may have drawn concern. If the team's head coach Jon Sumrall is to be believed, Singleton seems fine if he can log full-participation practices before Saturday's game. Ideally, the SEC injury report will clear matters up when it gets released mid-week.

headline: Practice limitation due to soreness
story: Stockton (back) will be limited during the week due to soreness, Edgar Thompson of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
impact: Although nothing structurally wrong with Stockton's injured back, its soreness may keep him from preparing and being available for Florida's next game Saturday at Missouri. Stockton has been a central component for UF quarterback Aaron Philo in each of the team's wins, with both connecting for multiple passes every victory, so the wide receiver being available during Week 5 will be crucial.

headline: Strain not expected to be long-term problem
story: Brown (knee) underwent an MRI on Monday, and his strain is not expected to be a long-term problem, Edgar Thompson of the Orlando Sentinel reports.
impact: Fortunately for Brown and Florida, his MRI showed a relatively positive status of his strained knee, which he tweaked back in Week 3's upset win over Mississippi. The wide receiver's availability will depend on how he feels as he and his team prepare for next Saturday's game at Missouri. With the Gators on a roll for the first time in a while, they will love to have all hands on deck.

headline: Sees a little action in Week 4
story: Marker went 6-for-10 for 60 yards Saturday against LIU after JJ Kohl left with a knee injury.
impact: Kohl's injury is considered minor, and he's even been labeled probable for FIU's next game, so the takeaway here is that after Kohl it is Marker who is the next man up.

headline: Reels in TD
story: Carter caught two passes for 54 yards and a score Saturday against LIU.
impact: This is Carter's first touchdown, and also his first game with over 50 yards. Of course, it was against an FCS team, and that likely played a role in all that.

headline: Lucks into TD
story: Anderson caught three passes for 58 yards against LIU on Saturday, and he fell on a loose ball in the end zone and was credited for a rushing touchdown.
impact: Obviously, zero attempts for zero yards and one touchdown is not indicative of anything but good luck, but Anderson was solid in his typical role of catching passes. He's now closing in on 400 receiving yards, and his 24 receptions have almost matched what he did last year.

headline: Rushes for 71 yards
story: Carrie ran 14 times for 71 yards against LIU on Saturday.
impact: This is Carrie's first game of the season with over 50 rushing yards, but it was against an FCS team. Plus, he still doesn't have a touchdown, which is a concern.

headline: Cedes playing time against LIU
story: Kohl went 6-for-11 for 135 yards, one touchdown, and one interception Saturday against LIU.
impact: Kohl started the season strong, but he threw three picks in his last game and after scuffling against an FCS team another transfer, Zach Marker, saw some playing time. Now, Marker wasn't much better, but with a bye coming up, FIU has some thinking to do.

headline: Logs first-ever carry
story: Ford (undisclosed) logged one carry for 11 yards during Saturday's 20-3 win against LIU.
impact: After not playing against FBS teams South Florida, Buffalo and Florida Atlantic, Ford finally logged his first carry against a non-FCS school. Though he was limited to a single rush, it got him more than 10 yards of offense, an impressive feat for a first-time attempt. So going into October, Ford's next objective is regularly earning touches and yardage for FIU.

headline: Has 34 yards receiving
story: Stone had three catches for 34 yards against FAU on Saturday.
impact: Stone has emerged as the complementary receiver to Maguire Anderson, though while he has 13 catches they have gone for 183 yards. However, FIU's next game is against LIU, so there should be a good opportunity there.

headline: Another big day
story: Anderson had eight catches for 139 yards versus FAU on Saturday.
impact: Even though his quarterback JJ Kohl threw three picks, Anderson got plenty of action once again. He now has 21 catches for 324 yards and two touchdowns through three games.

headline: Totals 65 yards
story: Carrie ran 19 times for 44 yards and had two catches for 21 yards Saturday against FAU.
impact: It's three games into the season, and Carrie is really struggling to get anything going on the ground. He's averaged 3.0 yards per carry, and that's not going to cut it for a lead back.

headline: Three picks in rivalry loss
story: Kohl went 22-for-43 for 262 yards and ran six times for 14 yards and a touchdown against FAU on Saturday, but he also threw three picks.
impact: FIU ended up losing to in-state rival FAU 16-10, and without those picks that likely doesn't happen. Kohl has thrown the ball a ton, and he now has five total touchdowns. However, he also has six total turnovers, so clearly Kohl has something to work on.

headline: Won't face Owls
story: McNeal (undisclosed) is out for Florida International's tilt with Florida Atlantic, per Kevin Barral of Fish on First.
impact: McNeal has eight catches for 80 yards through two games as a consistent part of the Panthers' passing attack. However, he'll be sidelined for Week 3, meaning receivers like Jojo Stone, Maguire Anderson and Eric Nelson should have a bigger chance to make an impact Saturday evening.

headline: Catches, throws TD
story: Stones caught four passes for 98 yards and a touchdown against Buffalo on Saturday. He also threw a 19-yard touchdown.
impact: Obviously, the touchdown pass was a gimmick play, but Stone has nine catches through two games, and the schedule is easy the rest of the way.

headline: Two TDs in win
story: Anderson caught five passes for 99 yards an two score against Buffalo on Saturday.
impact: Anderson is clearly the top receiver for JJ Kohl, FIU's new quarterback. He has 13 catches through two games, and he's had over 85 yards in both games as well.

headline: Rushes for 46 yards
story: Lyons ran 11 times for 46 yards Saturday versus Buffalo.
impact: Anthony Carrie got more carries that Lyons again, and Carrie had a couple receptions while Lyons didn't have any. It seems Carrie is the 1A back, but Lyons is going to get his carries as well.

headline: Rushes for 49 yards
story: Carrie ran 13 times for 49 yards and caught two passes for 10 yards against Buffalo on Saturday.
impact: Once again, Carrie had slightly more touches, and was slightly more productive, than Devonte Lyons. Carrie is the top back for FIU, but clearly for now Lyons is going to get his carries as well.

headline: Throws three TDs
story: Kohl went 21-fr-36 for 367 yards and three touchdowns against Buffalo on Saturday. He also ran for 19 yards and caught a 19-yard touchdown.
impact: Kohl had turnover issues in his first start with FIU, but it was against South Florida. He was much better in this matchup, and he's thrown for over 300 yards in both games this year.

headline: Out Saturday
story: Schaeffer is listed out ahead of Saturday's game against Buffalo.
impact: Schaeffer will miss this contest as he works his way back from an undisclosed injury. He will aim to be available for next week's meeting with FAU.

headline: Big day through the air
story: Boggs reeled in all six targets for 122 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-7 victory over Central Arkansas.
impact: Boggs had been limited to a meager offensive output each week, but against weaker competition courtesy of Central Arkansas, he exploded for a career day. This passing game, led by quarterback Ashton Daniels, remains highly questionable, but it was good to see the second-year player finally have a big game. Whether or not he can keep it up into ACC play is a big question mark.

headline: Held to two catches but finds end zone
story: Robinson caught 2 of 3 targets for 52 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-7 victory against Central Arkansas.
impact: Robinson reeled in just two catches, but a touchdown helped him salvage his day from a fantasy perspective. Florida State hardly needed to riddle its star receiver with targets as it easily bested an FCS foe. Still, Robinson will look to get more involved next week against Virginia.

headline: Productive day as FSU rolls
story: Kromah had 11 rushes for 86 yards and two touchdowns and hauled in 1 of 2 targets for 19 yards during Saturday's 34-7 victory over Central Arkansas.
impact: Kromah predictably had his way with the FCS Central Arkansas defense, although he didn't get much of a chance to rack up yardage as he was limited to 12 touches in the blowout win. Kromah is off to a tremendous start this season with 397 rushing yards and five scores on 6.2 yards per carry.

headline: Solid outing in easy win
story: Daniels completed 12 of 18 passes for 224 yards, two touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 34-7 win versus Central Arkansas. He also had three rushes for 34 yards.
impact: Daniels didn't need to do a whole lot as the Seminoles handled business against an overmatched FCS foe. He kept the ball out of harm's way and notched his best completion percentage of the season. Next week, things get tougher as ACC play resumes against Virginia.

headline: Getting close to full recovery
story: Gelsey (undisclosed) is getting close to a full recovery, Kolby Crawford of 247Sports reports.
impact: By getting close to a full recovery, Gelsey is on pace to make his 2026 debut. The wide receiver is still looking for his first counting stats as part of a highly talented receiver corps that Florida State's team has demonstrated in the first few weeks, so his immediate role being a high one is not guaranteed.

headline: Gets into the end zone
story: McClain rang up 39 receiving yards on three catches and a touchdown in the Fresno State 38-24 win over Rice on Saturday.
impact: McClain's touchdown against Rice equaled his one touchdown of 2025. The junior did not record any stats the previous game against San Jose State. McClain does have nine catches for 98 yards this season. The Bulldogs start the Pac 12 season with a contest against Washington State on Oct. 3. While the Cougars defense is in the middle of the country against the pass, Washington State has given up eight touchdowns to opponents through the air.

headline: Leads Bulldogs in receiving
story: Freeman caught six passes for 66 yards and one touchdown in the Fresno State 38-24 win over Rice on Saturday.
impact: Freeman leads the Bulldogs in receiving with 261 yards and is more than halfway to his career best for a season. The senior collected 499 receiving yards in 2025. The Bulldogs start the Pac 12 season with a contest against Washington State on Oct. 3. While the Cougars defense is in the middle of the country against the pass, Washington State has given up eight touchdowns to opponents through the air.

headline: Slumping on the ground
story: Donelson was limited to 19 yards on 9 carries in the Fresno State 38-24 win over Rice on Saturday.
impact: Donelson has seen his numbers drop for the second week in a row. The junior tallied 102 rushing yards against Sacramento State on Sept. 12 including three touchdowns but only had 57 rushing yards on Sept. 19 against San Jose State. Donelson will try to get back on the run against Washington State on Oct. 3. The Cougars defense is in the bottom quarter in the country against the run.

headline: Mammoth game on the ground
story: Luke ran over Rice's defense with 167 yards on the ground on only 11 carries and a touchdown in the Fresno State 38-24 win over the Owls on Saturday.
impact: It was the first time the senior passed the 100-yard mark on the ground. The senior's previous best mark came against Georgia Southern on August 30, 2025, with 96 rushing yards. Luke could have a good shot at topping the century mark in the next game against Washington State on Oct. 3. The Cougars defense is in the bottom quarter in the nation against the run.

headline: Throws for 3 TDs
story: Mandal completed 22-of-34 pass attempts for 210 yards and three touchdowns in the Fresno State 38-24 win over Rice on Saturday.
impact: Mandal also collected 57 rushing yards on five carries. The junior has been consistent after a slow opening game against USC. The Bulldogs start the Pac 12 season with a contest against Washington State on Oct. 3. While the Cougars defense is in the middle of the country against the pass, Washington State has given up eight touchdowns to opponents through the air.

headline: Efficient in win
story: Mandal completed 15-of-29 pass attempts for 186 yards and one touchdown in Fresno State's 26-10 win over San Jose State on Saturday.
impact: Mandal also added 46 rushing yards on nine carries. After giving up a field goal to start the game, Fresno State had the game in control and in turn limited the passing game. The junior could increase his aerial output in the next game against Rice on Sept. 26. The Owls defense is in the bottom third in the country against the pass.

headline: Leads Bulldogs again in rushing
story: Donelson ran for 57 yards on nine attempts and one touchdown to lead Fresno State on the ground in the Bulldogs 26-10 win over San Jose State on Saturday.
impact: Donelson has 174 yards on 28 carries so far in the first three games this season. The junior will have another shot to lead the Fresno State running game against Rice on Sept. 26. The Owls defense is in the middle of the country against the run.

headline: Just misses century mark
story: Freeman led the Fresno State receiving game with 95 yards on six catches in the Bulldogs 26-10 win over San Jose State on Saturday.
impact: This appears to the breakout year for Freeman if the season continues as it has for the first two games. The senior has 195 receiving yards on a dozen catches in two games. He will look to increase his numbers against Rice on Sept. 26. The Owls defense is in the bottom third in the country against the pass.

headline: Cleared to play
story: Duvall (undisclosed) has been cleared to return Saturday against San Jose State, Jackson Moore of 247sports.com reports.
impact: Duvall was a game-time call in Week 2 but ultimately did not play after being injured in the season opener. The sophomore wideout is back to good health and will look to rejoin the offense Saturday.

headline: Career best in win
story: Avit only had two catches, but it totaled 103 yards and a touchdown in the Bulldogs 49-3 win over Sacramento State on Saturday.
impact: For the junior it was by far his top career game. His previous mark came on Sept. 20, 2025, against Hawaii with 46 receiving yards on five receptions. Avit will continue on a roll in the next game as the Bulldogs take on San Jose State on Sept. 19.

headline: Registers career best
story: Freeman rang up 100 receiving yards on six catches in the Bulldogs 49-3 win over Sacramento State on Saturday.
impact: Freeman earned an extra season at the beginning of 2026, and it is showing that he would like to have another career year. The senior had a career best in 2025 when he totaled 52 catches for 642 yards and six touchdowns. He had his previous best game against Colorado State on Oct. 10, 2025, with 89 receiving yards on seven catches and two touchdowns.

headline: Leads Bulldogs on the ground
story: Donelson surpassed the century mark with 102 rushing yards on 13 attempts along with three touchdowns in the Bulldogs 49-3 win over Sacramento State on Saturday.
impact: It was the junior's best results since August 30, 2025. Against Georgia Southern Donelson ran for 167 yards on 23 carries and a touchdown. Donelson will aim to stay on top of the Fresno State rushers when the Bulldogs take on San Jose State on Sept. 19.

headline: Hits paydirt with catch
story: Luke did his damage on the receiving end with 49 yards on six catches in the Bulldogs 49-3 win over Sacramento State on Saturday.
impact: This was the best receiving day for Luke since Sept. 13, 2025, where he caught seven passes for 79 yards in the win over Southern. On the ground Luke only had three yards on three attempts against the Hornets. Fresno State takes on San Jose State on Sept. 19.

headline: Career best in win over Hornets
story: Mandal might have shown his breakout game for Fresno State in completing 23 of 26 for 316 yards and two touchdowns in the Bulldogs 49-3 win over Sacramento State on Saturday.
impact: The junior, who has endured an injury with Fresno State and waiting to get his chance, finally might have arrived. Mandal also added a rushing touchdown in the victory. He will try to continue to show that he has arrived when the Bulldogs take on San Jose State on Sept. 19.

headline: Huge day in win over OU
story: Taylor gathered in 4 of 7 targets for 110 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 41-13 win against Oklahoma.
impact: Taylor had the best game of his young career on Saturday as he hit the 100 yard mark for the first time. Despite rather low usage to this point, Taylor has managed to rack up touchdowns in three-of-four games on the season.

headline: Touchdown in win over OU
story: Phillips logged eight carries for 84 yards and one touchdown and reeled in their only target for seven yards during Saturday's 41-13 victory against Oklahoma.
impact: Phillips saw an uptick in usage with Nate Frazier banged up. Phillips made the most of his expanded work load going for over 10 yards per carry including a 54-yard touchdown run.

headline: Two touchdowns in win over OU
story: Bowens recorded nine rushes for 26 yards and two touchdowns and caught their only target for 24 yards during Saturday's 41-13 victory versus Oklahoma.
impact: With Nate Frazier dinged up, Bowens saw a bit more work in this one, leading the team with nine rushes. The bruising back averaged just 2.9 yards a carry as he is typically known for his short yardage play. Bowens cashed in on his work this week to the tune of two touchdowns.

headline: Less than stellar in win over OU
story: Stockton completed 14 of 25 passes for 171 yards, one touchdown and one interception during Saturday's 41-13 victory over Oklahoma. He also had five rushes for zero yards.
impact: Stockton had a bit of a rocky day against Oklahoma as the Sooners have been known to give opposing quarterbacks a tough time since head coach Brent Venables took over. Little was needed from Stockton either in this one as the Sooners offense had three turnovers giving away a touchdown and short fields. The running game also picked up for Stockton a bit with 129 yards and three touchdowns.

headline: What We Learned
story: ATHENS - It was another stress-free victory for Kirby Smart and the Georgia Bulldogs over the weekend and they smothered John Mateer and the...

headline: Looks in line to sit based on warmups
story: Frazier (undisclosed) appears in line to miss Saturday's game based on his participation level in warmups, Jordan D. Hill of 247Sports.com reports.
impact: A report from Friday suggested the team was optimistic about his status for the contest, but warmups seem to tell a different tale. If the key running back is indeed unable to give it a go Saturday, Chauncey Bowens will presumably see a sizable workload for the Bulldogs, with Bo Walker and Dwight Phillips mixing in.

headline: Two TDs in loss
story: Taylor gathered in six of seven targets for 119 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 42-28 loss to Houston.
impact: Taylor struck for a 40-yard score in the in the second quarter before connecting with Max Johnson for a 23-yard touchdown in the third quarter. Through four games, Taylor has recorded 10 receptions and 166 yards.

headline: Hauls in TD in loss
story: Helms totaled five receptions (on six targets) for 25 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 42-28 defeat against Houston.
impact: Helms connected with Max Johnson for a five-yard score in the fourth quarter. Through four games, the tight end has recorded 16 receptions, 114 yards and one touchdown.

headline: Tosses three TDs in loss
story: Johnson was 26-for-38 passing for 284 yards and three touchdowns during Saturday's 42-28 defeat against Houston. He also had seven rushes for negative eight yards.
impact: Johnson connected for scores of 40, 23 and five yards during Saturday's loss. Through four games, Johnson has thrown for 996 yards, five touchdowns and one interception. Georgia Southern takes on Coastal Carolina at home on Saturday.

headline: Out vs. Houston
story: Hollins (shoulder) is out for Saturday's game against Houtson, per Zach Fox.
impact: Hollins was spotted wearing street clothes and will be unavailable against Penn State. A previous report mentioned that the wideout was scheduled for an MRI for his injured shoulder, though there's been no indication of an official timeline. He's been a reliable target this season, hauling in 14 receptions for 202 yards and three touchdowns in three games. He will aim to return against Coastal Carolina next Saturday.

headline: Three rushing TDs at Jacksonville State
story: Bryan logged six rushing attempts for 27 yards during Saturday's 31-27 defeat versus Jacksonville State.
impact: Interestingly, Bryan is one of college football's most valuable backup quarterbacks based on the scheme that Georgia Southern's team runs. Last season, when GSU's offense was close to the goal line, the team sporadically had Bryan run up for yardage, using his 6-foot-3 and 245-pound profile to plow through defenses for just a slight edge. It looks like the Eagles will be more reliant on Bryan this season, and if so, make him a sneaky quarterback to add to teams. This season, the quarterback has 11 carries for 39 yards and four touchdowns without a single pass to his name.

headline: MRI scheduled for shoulder
story: Hollins is expected to have undergone an MRI for his injured shoulder, Zach Fox of WTOC reports.
impact: Back in Week 3, Hollins left Georgia Southern's game at Jacksonville State in the fourth quarter. The injury to his left shoulder explains why, and an MRI was scheduled for Monday. After beginning his 2026 season with 13 receptions for 203 yards and two touchdowns across as many games, Hollins will be one whose injury status is greatly worth monitoring as GSU's team prepares for Week 4 against Houston.

headline: Over 140 yards from scrimmage
story: Mbadinga tallied 18 carries for 103 yards and reeled in all five targets for 40 yards during Saturday's 31-27 loss against Jacksonville State.
impact: Mbadinga didn't find the end zone in this Week 3 loss, but it wouldn't be a stretch to call him the team's most reliable offensive weapon -- especially given quarterback Max Johnson's struggles. The 18 carries, 103 rushing yards, five catches, five targets and 40 receiving yards were all season-high marks by a wide margin for Mbadinga. He should continue to see touches in the backfield after this impressive performance.

headline: Struggles in Week 3 loss
story: Johnson was 23-for-33 passing for 187 yards and one interception during Saturday's 31-27 loss versus Jacksonville State. He also had seven rushes for 12 yards.
impact: Johnson didn't have his best performance in Week 3, posting a season-low mark in passing yards and recording his first game without a touchdown pass. While his completion percentage hovered around 70 percent, this was a disappointing performance from a fantasy perspective. Things won't get easier in Week 4 against Houston.

headline: Misses another outing
story: Gibbs (undisclosed) did not play in Saturday's 31-27 loss to Jacksonville State.
impact: Gibbs has now missed back-to-back outings with an undisclosed injury. The 6-foot running back will now look to make a return for this Saturday's game against Houston.

headline: Catches touchdown in win
story: Hollins logged five receptions (on nine targets) for 97 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 22-7 defeat to Clemson.
impact: Hollins led the Eagles in receiving on Saturday and hauled in their lone score when he connected with quarterback Max Johnson on a 42-yard score. Through two games, Hollins has recorded 13 catches, 203 yards and two touchdowns.

headline: Tosses TD in loss
story: Johnson was 27-for-47 passing for 244 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 22-7 loss to Clemson. He also had six rushes for negative three yards.
impact: Johnson and wideout Ashton Hollins connected in the third quarter for a 42-yard score to put Georgia Southern on the board. Through two games, Johnson has thrown for 525 yards and two touchdowns. Up next is road matchup with Jacksonville State.

headline: Doesn't play against Tigers
story: Gibbs (undisclosed) did not play in Saturday's 22-7 loss to Clemson.
impact: Gibbs missed his first game of the year as the Eagles lost to Clemson. The 6-foot running back will now look to get healthy before this Saturday's away game at Jacksonville State.

headline: Big day in win
story: Hollins recorded eight receptions (on 11 targets) for 106 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-0 win over Charleston Southern.
impact: Hollins turned in a game-high 106 yards in the win on Saturday. Quarterback Max Johnson found Hollins for a 57-yard score in the first quarter.

headline: Rushing TD in win
story: Samuel compiled four carries for 46 yards and one touchdown and reeled in two of three targets for one yard during Saturday's 31-0 win versus Charleston Southern.
impact: Samuel led the way for the Eagles backfield on Saturday. The running back punched in his first score of the season on a seven-yard run in the first quarter.

headline: Tosses TD in victory
story: Johnson was 28-for-39 passing for 281 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-0 victory over Charleston Southern.
impact: Johnson connected with Ashton Hollins in the first quarter on a 57-yard score for his first touchdown pass of the season. Up next for Johnson and the Eagles is a road matchup against Clemson.

headline: Two carries in season opener
story: Mbadinga (knee) had two carries for 21 yards against Charleston Southern on Friday.
impact: Mbadinga was limited to just two carries, while players such as Terrance Gibbs (five carries, 19 yards) and Jamarian Samuel (4-46-1 rushing line) saw more work out of the backfield. Given his limited involvement, and the fact that Mbadinga played just three snaps, it remains to be seen if he'll continue as the Eagles' RB1 moving forward.

headline: Rushing TD in win
story: McCrary Jr. had 21 rushes for 111 yards and one touchdown and gathered in their only target for nine yards during Saturday's 35-14 victory against Northern Illinois.
impact: McCrary Jr. found the end zone for the third time this season when he punched in a score from one yard out in the third quarter. Through four games, the running back has run for 338 yards on 59 attempts.

headline: Two TDs in win
story: Dorsey had five receptions (on nine targets) for 114 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 35-14 win against Northern Illinois.
impact: Dorsey hauled in touchdown passes on 18 and 50-yard receptions. The wideout has hauled in 16 receptions for 234 yards and four touchdowns across four games this season.

headline: Tosses two TDs in win
story: Brown completed 14 of 21 passes for 148 yards, two touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 35-14 victory against Northern Illinois.
impact: Brown was solid on Saturday, connecting with both Avion McBride and Rodshaun Dorsey for touchdowns during the win. Through four games, Brown has thrown for 873 yards, six touchdowns and four interceptions. Up next for Brown and the Panthers is a home matchup with Old Dominion.

headline: Reduced activity Week 4
story: Hollier logged zero targets during Georgia State's 35-14 win Saturday against Northern Illinois.
impact: Even though Georgia State still includes Hollier for another season, Weeks 3 and 4 indicate that his role is inconsistent. During the earlier gameday, he logged 11 targets. But on Saturday, without an injury update publicized, Hollier recorded fewer snaps.

headline: Even better Week 4
story: Dorsey (undisclosed) logged five receptions for 114 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 35-14 win against Northern Illinois.
impact: Back in Week 3, before an undisclosed injury took Dorsey out of action mid-game at Central Florida, he logged four receptions for 32 yards and two touchdowns. It would be difficult for any wideout to improve upon that kind of impressive log, but the senior did just that. Dorsey not only scored as many TDs but also updated multiple season-highs, including receptions and receiving yards. In one fell swoop, Dorsey almost doubled his yardage, which increased from 120 to 234.

headline: Out for Week 4
story: Murray (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game against Northern Illinois, Brady Weiler of 247Sports reports.
impact: Week 4 will mark back-to-back games in which Murray has sat out with a still-undisclosed issue. Without him available during Week 3 at Central Florida, Qwantavius Wiggins got a bigger spotlight to shine and did so by logging 11 rushing attempts for 125 yards and one touchdown.

headline: Two passes, one interception at UCF
story: Pereira attempted two passes and logged one interception during Georgia State's 44-30 loss Saturday at Central Florida.
impact: Even though Pereira barely attempted multiple passes, defensive back Demari Henderson caught half of them. Until further notice, the quarterback's backup role (to Cameran Brown) will be unchanged.

headline: Touchdown streak ends
story: McCrary posted 10 carries for 51 yards and caught 1 of 2 targets for 13 yards during Saturday's 44-30 loss against UCF.
impact: After logging a touchdown in each of Georgia State's first two games, McCrary failed to score Saturday, ending his TD streak at two. On the plus side, by remaining the Panthers' top option at running back, playing against less formidable teams than Central Florida will allow him more scoring opportunities. Going into Week 4, when the 2026 Panthers will log their last non-conference game, McCrary has 38 rushing attempts for 227 yards and two touchdowns.

headline: Seven receptions for 69 yards
story: Riles reeled in 7 of 8 targets for 69 yards during Saturday's 44-30 defeat versus UCF.
impact: Riles was not a consistent option for Georgia State in 2025, but that trajectory looks set to change in 2026. In each of the Panthers' first three games this year, he has logged multiple targets, and they have increased. With 13 targets, Riles recorded 11 receptions, registering 128 yards to his name. In doing so, 2026 marks the wide receiver's third consecutive year with triple-digit receiving yards, only this time, he is on pace to break out.

headline: Massive rushing line in Week 3
story: Wiggins had 11 carries for 125 yards and one touchdown and gathered in 2 of 3 targets for 23 yards during Saturday's 44-30 defeat to UCF.
impact: Wiggins averaged a monster 11.4 yards per carry in this loss to UCF, and although he isn't the starting RB, the team gave him more touches to ride the hot hand. Wiggins could see a larger role in Week 4 against Northern Illinois based on how good he looked in this Week 3 defeat.

headline: Tosses two scores in Week 3 loss
story: Brown completed 30 of 47 passes for 282 yards, two touchdowns and two interceptions during Saturday's 44-30 defeat against UCF. He also had 12 rushes for 17 yards.
impact: Even though Georgia State came up short in this Week 3 contest, Brown delivered a solid stat line as a passer with two scores. He has tossed four touchdowns and three picks in his first three starts this season, but he's increased his passing yards with each passing game. He's thrown for more than 250 yards in his last two contests, and that bodes well ahead of Saturday's Week 4 matchup against Northern Illinois.

headline: Sits out with injury
story: Murray (undisclosed) was inactive for Saturday's 44-30 loss to UCF, Brady Weiler of 247Sports.com reports.
impact: Murray was questionable ahead of the matchup, but he was ultimately unable to suit up. The 5-foot-9 running back will now aim to make a return for Saturday's showing against NIU.

headline: Appears to tweak something vs. UCF
story: Dorsey (undisclosed) walked off the field within the last two minutes of Georgia State's tilt with UCF, appearing to tweak something, per Brady Weiler of 247Sports.com.
impact: Dorsey was in the midst of a great game, with four catches for 32 yards and two touchdowns against the Knights. It remains to be seen what he's dealing with and if its something that's going to limit the starting wideout.

headline: Rushing TD in win
story: Murray notched nine carries for 41 yards and one touchdown and reeled in one of two targets for 13 yards during Saturday's 31-17 win against Kennesaw State.
impact: Murray recorded his second rushing TD of the season on Saturday when he punched in a 12-yard score. Through two games, Murray has run for 75 yards on 16 carries and hauled in three receptions for 63 yards and a touchdown.

headline: Rushing TD in win
story: Brown completed 16 of 23 passes for 253 yards and one interception during Saturday's 31-17 win over Kennesaw State. He also had nine rushes for 62 yards with one touchdown.
impact: Brown was quiet with his arm on Saturday but was able to use his legs to run for an 18-yard touchdown. Through two games, Brown has thrown for 443 yards, two touchdowns and one interception. Up next is a road matchup with UCF.

headline: Posts large gain
story: Washington hauled in a 40-yard catch along the sideline during Saturday's 31-17 win over Kennesaw State, according to Brady Mweiler of PantherTalk.
impact: Washington logged the longest catch of his collegiate career, helping the Panthers pull off a 31-17 win over the Owls in Week 2. The 5-foot-8 sophomore has been more involved during his second season with the program, tallying three receptions for 63 yards through two games.

headline: Long score in win
story: Savion Hart logged four carries for 61 yards and one touchdown and caught their only target for three yards during Friday's 59-10 victory versus North Carolina A&T.
impact: Hart broke free in the third quarter for a 41-yard touchdown score, the Panthers' longest touchdown of the game.

headline: Goes for two scores in win
story: Dennis Murray logged seven rushes for 34 yards and one touchdown and caught 2-of-3 targets for 50 yards and one touchdown during Friday's 59-10 win against North Carolina A&T.
impact: Murray opened the scoring with a 30-yard receiving touchdown in the first quarter. Murray tacked on his second score of the day by punching in his first rushing touchdown of the campaign from 14 yards out. A meeting on the road with Kennesaw State awaits on September 12.

headline: Tosses two TDs in blowout victory
story: Cameran Brown completed 15-of-20 passes for 190 yards and two touchdowns during Friday's 59-10 win over North Carolina A&T.
impact: Brown opened the scoring with a 30-yard strike to running back Dennis Murray in the first quarter. Brown added his second touchdown pass of the contest when he connected with wide receiver Jamari Miller on an eight-yard score before the half. Up next for Brown and the Panthers is a road matchup with Kennesaw State on September 12.

headline: Productive by air and ground in loss
story: Maddox compiled six carries for 40 yards and one touchdown and gathered in 4 of 5 targets for 48 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-27 defeat versus Stanford.
impact: Maddox had a career day and easily his most impactful offensive performance in a Georgia Tech uniform. The tailback scored by air and ground and thrived in the absence of Malachi Hosley. If the latter remains out, Maddox could remain productive, but Hosley's return would also likely cap Maddox's potential.

headline: Eclipses 100 yards again
story: Haynes tallied 18 rushes for 107 yards and reeled in all two targets for -19 yards during Saturday's 34-27 loss versus Stanford.
impact: Haynes surpassed the 100-yard mark for the second straight week, and the Georgia Tech offense appears to be settling in a bit. It wasn't enough for the win, of course, but Haynes remains an integral part of this offense and that shouldn't change anytime soon.

headline: Solid day not enough to top Stanford
story: Mendoza was 26-for-39 passing for 268 yards, two touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 34-27 defeat versus Stanford. He also had eight rushes for 16 yards.
impact: Mendoza was very solid against the Cardinal and far from the reason why Georgia Tech lost this game. The gunslinger looks to have taken strides the past two games, as in Weeks 3 and 4 he combined to throw for 517 yards, five touchdowns and one interception. He'll look to stay hot against a Duke team that's quite hot itself in Week 6 after a bye.

headline: Ruled out for Saturday
story: Hosley (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game at Stanford, per the ACC availability report.
impact: Hosley will miss his first game of the season and now fellow running backs Trelain Maddox and Shane Marshall should split his workload. He has an upcoming bye week that he'll use to his advantage to recover for his next chance of playing Otc. 10 against Duke.

headline: Good to go Saturday
story: Roche (undisclosed) is not listed on the injury report ahead of Saturday's game at Stanford, per the ACC availability report.
impact: Roche is fully healthy after being placed on Georgia Tech's initial injury report due to an undisclosed issue. The tight end will look to add to his season totals of 12 receptions and 141 yards.

headline: Out for Week 4
story: Jean-Noel (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game at Stanford, per the ACC availability report.
impact: Jean-Noel will miss another game and has yet to appear in a contest this season. The true freshman has an upcoming bye week giving him extended time to recover and potentially return on Oct. 10 versus Duke.

headline: Listed as probable vs. Stanford
story: Roche (undisclosed) is probable for Saturday's contest at Stanford, per the ACC availability report.
impact: Roche is in line to suit up against Stanford in an important conference matchup. The tight end has been a reliable target this season, recording 12 receptions for 141 yards.

headline: Questionable vs. Stanford
story: Hosley (undisclosed) is questionable for Saturday's game at Stanford, per the ACC availability report.
impact: Hosley is in jeopardy of missing his first game of the season Saturday. The running back is currently the backup to Justice Haynes, registering 16 attempts for 61 yards thus far. He still has time to recover in the following days to improve his status.

headline: Rather quiet outing in blowout
story: Penson totaled three receptions (on four targets) for 58 yards during Saturday's 44-11 victory over Mercer.
impact: Penson was held in check as Georgia Tech rolled over Mercer. The receiver has been involved each week, but has yet to produce a truly big outing. Given the Yellow Jackets' somewhat tepid passing game through three weeks, that may remain the case all season.

headline: Hat trick vs. FCS Mercer
story: Haynes recorded 22 carries for 141 yards and two touchdowns and hauled in 2 of 3 targets for 26 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 44-11 victory against Mercer.
impact: Haynes exploded against Mercer as the Georgia Tech offense enjoyed its best outing of 2026 thus far in a tune-up game against extremely overmatched Mercer. Though the Yellow Jackets' offense hasn't been pretty at times, Haynes has seen a big workload on the ground week in and week out and this Saturday's trip to Stanford offers another chance to post a big outing.

headline: Career day in easy win
story: Mendoza was 15-for-21 passing for 249 yards and three touchdowns during Saturday's 44-11 victory over Mercer.
impact: Mendoza was off to something of a shaky start this fall, but there's nothing like an FCS opponent to help you bounce back. The Yellow Jackets destroyed Mercer, and Mendoza was surgical. It was his first multi-touchdown performance of 2026, and he'll look to stay hot as ACC play opens in Week 4 at Stanford, which is a favorable matchup.

headline: One catch, one touchdown
story: Plummer (undisclosed) hauled in his only reception for 37 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 44-11 win against Mercer.
impact: Plummer made his season debut Saturday during the blowout win, hauling in his first touchdown of the year. However, as he remains buried deep on Georgia Tech's depth chart, replicating that production moving forward will likely prove difficult.

headline: Sees 10 targets in loss
story: Uiliata posted six receptions (on 10 targets) for 39 yards during Saturday's 27-10 defeat versus Wyoming.
impact: Uiliata continues to serve as Hawaii's number-one receiver in the absence of Pofele Ashlock (undisclosed). The sophomore's seen 10 targets in three of his first four games this year, totaling 24 receptions for 208 yards and a touchdown.

headline: Falls to Wyoming
story: Alejado was 28-for-44 passing for 226 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 27-10 loss versus Wyoming.
impact: While Alejado's final line was decent, Hawaii's offense struggled overall Saturday, as they were held out of the end zone until their opening drive of the fourth quarter. Through four games, Alejado's completed 60 percent of his passes for 1,017 yards, three touchdowns and one interception. The Rainbow Warriors will look to bounce back next week, when they host San Jose State.

headline: Sits out again
story: Salave'a (undisclosed) didn't play in Saturday's loss versus Wyoming.
impact: Salave'a hasn't appeared in a game since Week 1 due to an undisclosed injury. His next chance to make his return is next week's matchup versus San Jose State.

headline: Four carries and reception Week 4
story: Barfield (ankle) accrued four carries for 17 yards during Saturday's 27-10 loss at Wyoming.
impact: Given that Barfield was probable for Week 4, Hawaii using him at Wyoming should not be so surprising, and the game suggests that he should revert to his supplemental role. It was how, in 2025, he logged 80 rushing attempts for 371 yards and four touchdowns. As a receiving option, the running back also recorded 27 receptions (on 37 targets) for 257 yards and three more TDs. All of Barfield's aforementioned tallies are his career-highs.

headline: Looks set to play Saturday
story: Barfield (ankle) appears ready to play for Saturday's game at Wyoming, Paul Brecht of Hawai'i Sports Radio reports.
impact: Barfield, who is officially listed as questionable, appears ready to go ahead of Saturday's road contest. Barfield has missed the last two games after suffering an ankle injury in Week 0 at Stanford. He should chip into DeVon Rice's workload if he's able to return.

headline: Ruled out Saturday
story: Ashlock (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game at Wyoming, per theMountain West availability report.
impact: Ashlock has been ruled out of Saturday's road contest, his fourth straight missed game this season. He has been highly productive in each of his three seasons with the Rainbow Warriors, so his absence has been notable for the program. His next chance to play is next Saturday versus San Jose State.

headline: Deemed questionable
story: Salave'a (undisclosed) is questionable for Saturday's contest at Wyoming, per the Mountain West availability report.
impact: Salave'a is looking to take the field for the first time since Hawaii's opener against Stanford. The tight end is expected to serve as the backup if good to go Saturday.

headline: Unavailable for Week 4
story: Hickman (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game at Wyoming, per the Mountain West availability report.
