impact: Hickman serves as a depth option at tight end, so his absence won't affect the passing offense Saturday. His next chance to play will come against San Jose State next Saturday in a Week 5 matchup.

headline: Out for Week 4
story: Griffiths (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's matchup at Wyoming, per the Mountain West availability report.
impact: Griffiths won't be an option in the passing attack Saturday after appearing in two games this season, recording one reception for nine yards. The wideout's next chance to suit up is against San Jose State in Week 5.

headline: Good to go for Week 4
story: Heimuli (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game at Wyoming, per the Mountain West availability report.
impact: Heimuli has cleared the injury report and will suit up against Hawaii. The wideout is buried on the depth chart, so he isn't expected to see too many targets.

headline: Questionable for Saturday
story: Barfield (ankle) is questionable for Saturday's game versus Wyoming, per the Mountain West availability report.
impact: Barfield has been hindered by an ankle injury since being forced to leave against Stanford in Hawaii's season opener. The running back is expected to contribute to the backfield this season after a 2025 campaign that saw him rush for 371 yards and four touchdowns on 80 carries.

headline: Officially questionable vs. Wyoming
story: Ashlock (undisclosed) is listed as questionable for Saturday's contest at Wyoming, per the Mountain West availability report.
impact: Ashlock is aiming to make his season debut Saturday after a dominant 2025 campaign where he hauled in 76 receptions for 827 yards and eight touchdowns. If the wideout recovers before kickoff, he will lead the receiving corps and remain a target favorite for Micah Alejado.

headline: Available for Week 4
story: Alejado (arm) is available for Saturday's game at Wyoming, per the Mountain West availability report.
impact: Alejado will suit up for Saturday's game even after being seen in a sling following the win over New Mexico in Week 3. The quarterback presumably benefited from a bye last week, giving him additional time to recover. He will man the helm under center and look to add to his season totals of 791 passing yards and two touchdowns.

headline: Nine grabs in win
story: Carvalho reeled in 9 of 13 targets for 82 yards during Saturday's 29-19 win over New Mexico State.
impact: It was a nice bounce-back showing from Carvalho, after he was held to just one reception for 26 yards against UNLV last week -- the redshirt freshman led Hawaii in targets while his nine receptions accounted for the second-most on the team, behind Tama Uiliata. Carvalho now has 15 receptions (on 24 targets) for 180 yards in his first three games this season.

headline: Big day in win
story: Harris tallied four receptions (on eight targets) for 105 yards during Saturday's 29-19 victory over New Mexico State.
impact: It was a breakout performance for Harris, who had totaled just three receptions for 26 yards in Hawaii's first two games. Expectations were high for Harris coming into the year, after he logged five receptions for 99 yards and a touchdown in five games with Washington last season. The junior should see his role expand in the Rainbow Warriors' offense as the campaign progresses.

headline: Rebounds in Week 2
story: Uiliata recorded 10 receptions (on 11 targets) for 107 yards during Saturday's 29-19 victory against New Mexico State.
impact: After he was held without a catch last week against UNLV, Uiliata responded with a bounce-back performance Saturday, finishing the day as Hawaii's leading receiver. The sophomore would also throw for a touchdown in the win, extending the Rainbow Warriors' lead to 29-19 with a seven-yard lob to Frank Abreu on a fourth-down play. Through three games, Uiliata's totaled 18 receptions (on 23 targets) for 169 yards and a touchdown, filling in as Hawaii's top wideout in the absence of Pofele Ashlock (undisclosed).

headline: Spotted in sling
story: Alejado (arm) was seen wearing a sling on his right arm following Saturday's 29-19 win over New Mexico State, Christian Shimabuku of Aloha State Daily reports.
impact: Alejado, who threw for 346 yards (33-for-45) in the contest, stated that the entire right side of his body was in pain following a big hit in the third quarter. The 5-foot-10 sophomore has started in all three games this season, throwing for 791 yards (80-for-136), two touchdowns and one interception. Alejado will have the benefit of a bye week before his next opportunity to suit up will come in Week 4 against Wyoming.

headline: Good to go for Week 2
story: Alejado (undisclosed) will be ready for Saturday's game against New Mexico State, head coach Timmy Chang said, per Christian Shimabuku of Aloha State Daily.
impact: Alejado will suit up for Saturday's game after initial concern regarding his status due to missing practice Tuesday. Chang also mentioned that the quarterback sat out Tuesday's session simply to rest following two tough games. The signal-caller will look to bounce back against New Mexico State and lead the team to its first win of the season.

headline: Sits out practice Tuesday
story: Alejado (undisclosed) did not participate in Hawaii's practice Tuesday, according to Rob DeMello of KHON.
impact: There is no official indication of why Alejado was unavailable for practice, leaving his status in question for Sunday. He is coming off 176 passing yards and one interception in a 21-6 loss to UNLV in Week 1. Bjorn Jurgensen handled the majority of the quarterback snaps in his absence and would step in as the starter if Alejado is sidelined Saturday. The lead signal-caller will look to recover in time, as his status will be monitored closer to the matchup against New Mexico State in Week 2.

headline: Struggles in loss
story: Alejado completed 17 of 41 passes for 176 yards and an interception during Saturday's 21-6 loss to UNLV. He also had nine rushes for six yards.
impact: It was a tough day for the Rainbow Warriors' offense and Alejado -- the sophomore quarterback was held to fewer than 200 yards passing in just two of his 11 starts last season while throwing a touchdown pass in all but one game. Alejado has now completed 51.6 percent of his passes this year for 445 yards, two touchdowns and one interception. He'll look to overcome an 0-2 start next week when Hawaii hosts New Mexico State.

headline: Not playing in Week 1
story: Heimuli (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game against UNLV.
impact: Heimuli won't be an option for this Week 1 matchup, although, to be fair, he wasn't likely to be a go-to option in the passing game. The sophomore wideout will aim to return against NMSU on Sunday, Sept. 13 in Week 2.

headline: Sidelined vs. Runnin' Rebels
story: Barfield (ankle) is out against UNLV in Week 1.
impact: Barfield was expected to be available, but the tailback has officially been ruled out. He left the Rainbow Warriors' Week 0 loss to Stanford with an ankle ailment, but wasn't on Hawaii's mid-week practice report. In his stead, expect DeVon Rice to lead the way on the ground.

headline: Not facing UNLV
story: Salave'a (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game against UNLV.
impact: Salave'a won't be an option for this contest, and this means Prank Abreu should operate as the backup tight end behind Devon Tauaefa. Salave'a will aim to return against New Mexico State in Week 2 on Sept. 13.

headline: Reels in touchdown Saturday
story: Young hauled in their only target for 22 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 42-28 win over Georgia Southern.
impact: Young only received one target in Saturday's win, but he reeled it in for a 22-yard touchdown in the first quarter. It marked his fourth touchdown reception of the season, all of which have come in his last three games. While his single target in the game is concerning, his connection with Conner Weigman in and around the redzone makes him a solid asset.

headline: Productive in Saturday's win
story: Walker reeled in 6 of 7 targets for 83 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 42-28 victory against Georgia Southern.
impact: Walker had by far his best outing of the season Saturday, highlighted by his 23-yard touchdown reception which marked his first of the season. He also set season highs in receptions, targets and yards after a quiet first three weeks of the season. He'll look to build off this performance Saturday versus UCF.

headline: Touchdown streak continues
story: Thomas caught 5 of 6 targets for 50 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 42-28 win over Georgia Southern.
impact: Thomas hauled in another touchdown Saturday, making it four straight games with a touchdown reception. He gained 50 yards on five receptions which is slightly disappointing for the senior, but his connection with Conner Weigman in the redzone continued to pay off. He'll look to extend his scoring streak again Saturday versus UCF.

headline: Leads backfield Saturday
story: Sanford totaled 17 rushes for 120 yards during Saturday's 42-28 victory against Georgia Southern.
impact: Sanford led the team in rushing attempts for the first time this season, narrowly outpacing Makhi Hughes (16 attempts). He was also much more productive than his teammate, totaling 50 more rushing yards over the course of the game. While Hughes is still the team's No. 1 option, Sanford has played well enough and is getting enough work to be a viable fantasy option alongside Hughes.

headline: Dominant in Saturday's win
story: Weigman completed 17 of 22 passes for 239 yards and four touchdowns during Saturday's 42-28 win against Georgia Southern. He also had six rushes for 14 yards with two touchdowns.
impact: Weigman accounted for all six of his team's touchdowns Saturday, the most in his career. He completed over 77 percent of his passes in the win and threw a touchdown in each quarter of the game. Weigman's combination of passing and rushing upside makes him a very valuable fantasy asset and he's been productive against every type of matchup he's faced this season.

headline: Deemed "pretty close" to returning
story: Tounkara (foot) is "pretty close) to returning at Georgia Southern, per Joseph Duarte of the Houston Chronicle.
impact: The second-year wideout has yet to play this season, but he's reportedly trending in the right direction. However, it remains to be seen if he'll manage to suit up for Week 4 at Georgia Southern.

headline: Signs off Vegas' practice squad
story: The Texans signed Ogunbowale off the Raiders' practice squad Tuesday.
impact: Ogunbowale settled for the Raiders' practice squad after being trimmed from the team's roster during August's cutdown day. The running back now returns to Houston, where he participated in 129 offensive snaps and 281 special-teams snaps over 17 regular-season games in 2025.

headline: Expected to practice this week
story: Platt (undisclosed) is expected to return to practice for the Illini ahead of their game against Purdue in Week 5, per Jeremy Werner of 247Sports.com.
impact: Platt has yet to play this season, but he's certainly nearing a return. The Illini still need to see how Platt responds to a week of practice if he is in fact able to participate with the team this week, but the Florida Atlantic transfer appears to be trending in the right direction at the very least.

headline: Productive in defeat
story: Laughery tallied 11 rushes for 113 yards and hauled in their only target for one yard during Saturday's 42-19 loss to Ohio State.
impact: Laughery found success on the ground against the Buckeyes, leading the way for the Fighting Illini in rushing with 113 yards on an impressive 10.3 YPC. The 5-foot-11 senior outpaced fellow back Ca'Lil Valentine in not only yards but touches on the day, representing a positive shift in his role. He will hope to continue his positive momentum against Purdue on Saturday.

headline: Held in check
story: Dixon notched five receptions (on eight targets) for 63 yards during Saturday's 42-19 loss against Ohio State.
impact: Against a very game Ohio State defense, Dixon was largely held quiet on the day, totaling five catches for a season-low 63 scoreless yards. The 6-foot-1 receiver was the target of a large portion of attention from the Buckeyes on the day, providing opportunities for other receivers in the passing game, including Hudson Clement and Ty Robinson. Dixon remains a top tier option moving forward and will hope to get back on track in a friendlier matchup against Purdue on Saturday.

headline: Leading receiver in defeat
story: Clement hauled in 5 of 10 targets for 87 yards during Saturday's 42-19 loss against Ohio State.
impact: Though he was held out of the end zone for the fourth consecutive game, Clement had his best game of the season, tying a season-high five catches on 10 targets for 87 yards. The 6-foot-1 senior also outpaced fellow receiver Collin Dixon in both yards and targets on the day. He will hope to continue his positive momentum moving forward, starting with a home matchup against Purdue on Saturday.

headline: Scores vs. Buckeyes
story: Robinson logged four receptions (on five targets) for 45 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 42-19 loss versus Ohio State.
impact: Robinson saw his highest volume of the season against Ohio State, catching a season-high four passes for 45 yards. The 6-foot-4 senior connected with quarterback Katin Houser on a 27-yard scoring strike in the fourth quarter, bringing the Fighting Illini within two scores at the time. He will hope to build positive momentum coming off this performance, with his next opportunity coming at home against Purdue on Saturday.

headline: One score in loss
story: Houser completed 21 of 37 passes for 263 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 42-19 defeat against Ohio State. He also had seven rushes for 14 yards.
impact: Houser held his own for the most part against a talented Ohio State defense, throwing for 263 yards and a touchdown without a turnover. The 6-foot-3 senior connected with receiver Ty Robinson on a 27-yard scoring strike in the fourth quarter, bringing the Illini within 16 points at the time. Better days lie ahead, starting with a home matchup against a struggling Purdue squad.

headline: Available Saturday
story: Clement is available for Saturday's game at Ohio State, per the Big Ten availability report.
impact: Clement popped up with a probable tag during the week but he's now off the report heading into Saturday's contest. It's unlikely he sees much of the field given his place on the depth chart though.

headline: Ruled out for Saturday
story: Platt (undisclosed) has been ruled out for Saturday's game at Ohio State, per the Big Ten availability report.
impact: Platt, who was listed as doubtful during the week, will unsurprisingly be left on the sidelines for Saturday's trip to Columbus. The senior has not played in a game yet this season due to an undisclosed injury. His next chance to suit up is next Saturday versus Purdue.

headline: Gets probable tag
story: Clement is probable for Saturday's game against Ohio State.
impact: Clement is a depth piece for the Illini backfield and even if active, he's not expected to hold any sort of fantasy relevance.

headline: Out for Week 4
story: Farrell (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game at Ohio State, per the Big Ten availability report.
impact: Farrell's continued absence will extend into this week with the tight end failing to clear the injury report. He wasn't expected to see targets since he is listed deep on the depth chart and will look to suit up against Purdue next Saturday.

headline: Available for Week 4
story: Forster (knee) is available for Saturday's game at Ohio State, per the Big Ten availability report.
impact: Forster is set to make his season debut after dealing with a knee injury sustained during the 2025 campaign. It will be difficult for the running back to earn carries against a top-ranked Ohio State team.

headline: In line to play Saturday
story: Alston is not on the injury report ahead of Saturday's matchup with the Buckeyes.
impact: Alston will make his season debut against Ohio State on Saturday. The wide receiver missed the previous three games with an undisclosed injury.

headline: Status in jeopardy for Week 4
story: Platt (undisclosed) is listed as doubtful ahead of Saturday's game against Ohio State.
impact: Platt's chances at making his season debut Saturday are in serious doubt. The FAU transfer compiled 46 receptions for 720 yards and six total touchdowns. If the wide receiver is unable to go, his next chance to make his debut will be Oct. 3 against Purdue.

headline: Another big game
story: Dixon posted eight receptions (on nine targets) for 131 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 48-10 win against Southern Illinois.
impact: Another game for Illinois, another dominant performance from Dixon. The 6-foot-1 senior led the Illini in receptions and yards on the day while accounting for both of quarterback Katin Housers touchdown passes on the day, scoring from 45 and 27 yards out in the second quarter. Dixon has gotten off to a red hot start this season, catching 25 passes for 367 yards and seven touchdowns across the team's first three contests. The start of conference play should present a bigger challenge, starting with Ohio State on Saturday.

headline: Explosive play in victory
story: Laughery notched four carries for 93 yards and one touchdown and reeled in 0 of 1 targets for zero yards during Saturday's 48-10 victory against Southern Illinois.
impact: Laughery didn't receive many opportunities on a day in which the Fighting Illini outclassed their opponent, but he certainly made the most of his opportunities. The 5-foot-11 running back ripped off a 77-yard scoring scamper in the first quarter, giving the team a 14-7 lead they would not surrender. While his lack of opportunities would normally be concerning, the blowout nature of the game more than likely led the Illinois coaching staff to sub out impact players. A tougher matchup against Ohio State awaits on Saturday.

headline: Productive in blowout
story: Houser was 23-for-29 passing for 305 yards, two touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 48-10 win over Southern Illinois.
impact: Houser was efficient against the Salukis, completing nearly 80 percent of his pass attempts while throwing for a season-high 305 yards in a blowout victory. The 6-foot-3 senior connected with receiver Collin Dixon on a pair of touchdowns in the second quarter from 45 and 27 yards out, respectively. A tougher matchup against a talented Ohio State team awaits next week with the start of Big Ten play.

headline: Yards leader once again
story: Becker compiled seven receptions (on 11 targets) for 98 yards during Friday's 29-23 win against Northwestern.
impact: Thoguh Becker was held out of the end zone for the first time this season, he still managed to put together a productive outing, leading the way for the Hoosiers in both receptions and yards on the day. The 6-foot-4 junior has been a top target for quarterback Josh Hoover throughout the start of the season and logged a season-high 11 targets against Northwestern,indicating that the relationship between receiver and quarterback is only getting stronger. He will hope to find his way back into the end zone when the Hoosiers travel to face Rutgers on Saturday.

headline: Scores in victory
story: Marsh totaled five receptions (on nine targets) for 52 yards and one touchdown during Friday's 29-23 victory versus Northwestern.
impact: Marsh had a solid day against the Wildcats, catching five passes for 52 yards and a touchdown. The 6-foot-3 junior connected with quarterback Josh Hoover on an eight-yard scoring strike in the second quarter, giving the Hoosiers a 12-0 lead at the half. Marsh has now scored three touchdowns in his first four games with Indiana and will look to continue that trend when the Hoosiers travel to face Rutgers on Saturday.

headline: Monster day in victory
story: Beebe notched 24 rushes for 203 yards and one touchdown and gathered in 1 of 2 targets for two yards during Friday's 29-23 victory against Northwestern.
impact: Beebe was thrust into a larger role due to the injury to fellow running back Turbo Richard, and Beebe certainly made the most of his opportunity. The 5-foot-10 running back ran for a career-high 203 yards and found the end zone on a four-yard scamper in an action-packed fourth quarter, giving the Hoosiers a nine-point lead at the time. Depending on the severity of Richard's injury, Beebe could be in line for an expanded role moving forward, with his next opportunity coming against Rutgers on Saturday.

headline: Two total touchdowns
story: Hoover was 19-for-29 passing for 201 yards and one touchdown during Friday's 29-23 win over Northwestern. He also had six rushes for one yard with one touchdown.
impact: While his numbers certainly weren't prolific, Hoover did what the Hoosiers needed against a game Northwestern squad. The 6-foot-2 senior connected with receiver Nick Marsh on an eight-yard scoring strike in the second quarter, building a 12-0 lead for the Hoosiers at the half. While things tightened up in the second half, Hoover got the job done, contributing a one-yard rushing touchdown in the final minutes of the game to essentially put things out of reach. Better days lie ahead for Hoover and the Hoosiers, starting with a road battle against Rutgers on Saturday.

headline: Day-to-day, could play at Rutgers
story: Richard (ankle) is considered "day-to-day" and there's optimism the tailback could play at Rutgers in Week 5, per Zach Osterman of The Indianapolis Star.
impact: Richard was banged up in Indiana's narrow victory over Northwestern on Friday night, and he didn't return to the game. It was later revealed that Richard is dealing with a high-ankle sprain, but the tailback reportedly still has a shot to play against the Scarlet Knights. If Richard can't go, expect Lee Beebe to hold down the Hoosiers' backfield in his stead.

headline: Dealing with high-ankle sprain
story: Richard is dealing with an apparent high ankle sprain, Matt Zenitz of CBSSports.com reports.
impact: Richard suffered an apparent high ankle sprain during Friday's win over Northwestern, a tough blow for him and the Hoosiers. Richard has rushed 50 times for 383 yards and four touchdowns through four games this season. With Khobie Martin (undisclosed) also injured, Lee Beebe -- who rushed for 203 yards versus Northwestern -- is set to lead the backfield while his teammates remain injured.

headline: Walkoff winner in Ann Arbor
story: Vander Zee caught all five targets for 66 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 20-19 victory versus Michigan.
impact: Vander Zee had a productive day, leading the way for the Hawkeyes in both receptions and yards on the day. The 6-foot-4 junior connected with quarterback Hank Brown for a pair of touchdowns against the Wolverines, the second of which was a 16-yard game winner as time expired. Vander Zee has largely been an afterthought in the Iowa passing game to start the season, and he will be hoping to build momentum off his performance in Ann Arbor. His next opportunity will come against Ohio State on Saturday.

headline: Special teams score in victory
story: Jackson had four rushes for 13 yards and reeled in his only target for six yards while running back a kickoff for a touchdown during Saturday's 20-19 victory versus Michigan.
impact: Jackson was held in check on offense throughout the day, totaling 19 yards on five total touches. His true highlight came on special teams, however, as he ran back a kickoff in the first quarter for a 99-yard touchdown, tying the game at seven at the time. Jackson took advantage of Kamari Moulton's absence against Northern Iowa with a big performance, but with Moulton back in the fold, it looks like he will continue to be limited on offense.

headline: Held quiet vs. Wolverines
story: Moulton notched 13 rushes for 44 yards and gathered in 2 of 3 targets for two yards during Saturday's 20-19 victory over Michigan.
impact: Moulton was largely a non-factor for the Hawkeyes against a tough Michigan defensive front, totaling 44 yards on 3.4 YPC with a long rush of just eight yards. The 5-foot-9 running back came out of the gate red-hot with a monster performance against Northern Illinois but has been unspectacular since, running for 111 scoreless yards on four YPC through his last two games. His next chance will come against Ohio State on Saturday.

headline: Two scores in victory
story: Brown was 21-for-35 passing for 227 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 20-19 victory against Michigan.
impact: The Hawkeyes needed every bit of Brown's best game of the season to pull off the victory over Michigan. The 6-foot-4 senior threw for a season-high 227 yards and connected with receiver Reece Vander Zee for a pair of touchdowns, including a 16-yard game-winning scoring strike as time expired. Brown has done what has been needed of him while avoiding mistakes for Iowa to start the season, throwing for 700 yards and five touchdowns without an interception while adding a rushing score as well. His next chance will come against Ohio State on Saturday.

headline: Suffers knee injury
story: Pabst suffered a knee injury during Saturday's win over Michigan, per the Des Moines Register.
impact: Pabst had caught just one pass for 24 yards this season before getting hurt. He will have a week to get healthy before the team's upcoming matchup versus West Virginia.

headline: Keeps the streak alive
story: Konrardy connected on 1-for-1 field-goal attempts and 2-for-2 point-after tries during Saturday's 31-17 defeat versus Utah.
impact: Konrardy connected on a 47-yard field goal in Iowa State's loss to Utah, extending his streak of four consecutive games with at least one made field goal. While the Cyclones' offense struggled to consistently finish drives against a tough Utah defense, Konrardy continues to provide steady production and remains one of the more reliable kicking options in the Big 12.

headline: Turns opportunity into production
story: Overby accrued three receptions (on nine targets) for 42 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-17 defeat to Utah.
impact: Overby matched Omari Hayes with nine targets and made the bigger fantasy impact, hauling in a 22-yard touchdown as the Cyclones attempted a second-half comeback. With Iowa State showing a willingness to funnel targets his way, Overby's scoring upside gives him an edge when opportunities are split evenly between the team's top receivers.

headline: Continues to command volume
story: Hayes hauled in 5 of 9 targets for 55 yards during Saturday's 31-17 loss against Utah.
impact: Hayes remained heavily involved in Iowa State's passing attack, drawing nine targets to co-lead the team. While he wasn't able to find the end zone, the consistent target volume is encouraging and keeps him firmly on the fantasy radar as one of Jalen Raynor's most trusted options.

headline: Stays busy in defeat
story: Flora accrued 13 rushes for 54 yards and caught 5 of 8 targets for 53 yards during Saturday's 31-17 defeat versus Utah.
impact: Flora followed up last week's breakout performance with another heavy workload against Utah, handling 13 carries while adding five receptions through the air. The receiving usage was especially encouraging, as both his five catches and eight targets were career highs, showing Iowa State is increasingly looking to get the ball in his hands as a runner and receiver. Even in a tough matchup, Flora's volume remained intact, which is exactly what fantasy managers want to see heading into the middle of conference play.

headline: Sees limited action
story: Moberly was 0-for-0 passing for zero yards during Saturday's 31-17 defeat against Utah.
impact: Moberly saw brief action while recording a rushing attempt. Starter Jaylen Raynor handled the vast majority of the offensive workload. At this point, Moberly's fantasy relevance is limited to occasional package usage and injury contingency value.

headline: Hits first bump in the road
story: Raynor completed 21 of 40 passes for 205 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions during Saturday's 31-17 defeat to Utah. He also had 10 rushes for 27 yards with one touchdown.
impact: Raynor posted a respectable fantasy line with a passing touchdown and rushing score, but he also threw multiple interceptions for the first time this season. The Cyclones spent most of the afternoon playing from behind against one of the Big 12's hottest teams, forcing Raynor into a more aggressive game script than usual. While turnovers are a concern, the dual-threat production remains encouraging, and he'll look to bounce back against a less dominant defense next week.

headline: Off injury report
story: Bailey is available for Saturday's game versus Utah, per the Big 12 availability report.
impact: Bailey, who has not appeared in a game this season, is available for Saturday's contest. The TCU transfer has caught three touchdowns over his three collegiate seasons and is not expected to be a major part of the Cyclones' receiving corps.

headline: Ready to roll vs. Utah
story: Galer (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game against Utah, per the Big 12 availability report.
impact: Galer is set to suit up Saturday for the first time since Iowa State's opener. The tight end is a depth option, so he will likely not see much action against conference foe Utah.

headline: Cleared for Saturday
story: Peppers is available for Saturday's game versus Utah, per the Big 12 availability report.
impact: Peppers was listed as questionable on the team's initial report, but his issue was clearly not very serious as he's already been cleared a day later. It's unlikely he will see much of the field though given his place on the depth chart.

headline: Upgraded to probable
story: Galer (undisclosed) is probable for Saturday's game versus Utah, per the Big 12 availability report.
impact: Galer was listed as questionable on the team's initial report, so his upgrade to probable is a positive sign. However, the freshman is unlikely to see much of the field regardless of his health.

headline: Available Saturday
story: Claiborne is available for Saturday's game versus Utah, per the Big 12 availability report.
impact: Claiborne popped up on Wednesday's report as questionable, but clearly he wasn't dealing with anything serious as he's already been cleared. He has three catches (on five targets) for 43 yards through three games this season.

headline: To suit up Saturday
story: Miller (undisclosed) is off the injury report for Saturday's game against Utah.
impact: Miller will be available to provide some depth in the backfield for the Cyclones. He's totaled five touches in two games thus far.

headline: Ready to roll
story: Benetti (undisclosed) is off the injury report for Saturday's game against Utah.
impact: Benetti had a brief appearance on the injury report with a probable tag Wednesday. The 6-4 pass catcher will look to find paydirt for a third time this season.

headline: One catch in Week 3 win
story: Cameron secured one of two targets for a 12-yard touchdown in Sunday's 35-6 win over the Patriots.
impact: Cameron got the scoring started early in the second quarter, catching the first of Trevor Lawrence's three touchdowns. Cameron played 23 offensive snaps against New England, the same amount as Brian Thomas behind Parker Washington and Jakobi Meyers, who both played 50 snaps on offense. Cameron could be pushing Thomas for the WR3 role in Jacksonville.

headline: Plays five offensive snaps in Week 3
story: Hunter played five offensive snaps in Sunday's 35-6 win over the Patriots.
impact: He failed to see a target in the passing game for the second straight week and is clearly not in the team's plans on that side of the ball with everyone healthy at wideout. Hunter would likely need one or even two injuries ahead of him on the depth chart to see significant snaps on offense. On defense against New England, Hunter logged four tackles (three solo) and one pass breakup, including his first career regular-season interception.

headline: Past shoulder injury
story: Delane recorded 10 tackles (seven solo) and a pass breakup in Sunday's 24-10 win over the Dolphins.
impact: Delane picked off a pass in his regular-season NFL debut in Week 1 against the Broncos but injured his shoulder after playing just three defensive snaps. He was cleared for Week 2 versus Indianapolis but was ultimately held out to rest his shoulder. Delane played 98.6 percent of the defensive snaps against Miami and appears to be past the issue.

headline: Piles up 11 tackles in win
story: Bolton recorded 11 tackles (eight solo) and a pass breakup in Sunday's 24-10 win over the Dolphins.
impact: Bolton has now posted double-digit tackles in back-to-back games. He has 100-plus tackles in four of the last five seasons and appears to be well on his way to another. Bolton has 28 tackles (16 solo) and a pair of pass breakups through three games to begin the 2026 campaign.

headline: Catches two targets in win
story: Thornton caught both of his targets for 22 yards in the Chiefs' 24-10 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
impact: Thornton saw less attention from Patrick Mahomes than in the Chiefs' Week 2 overtime win over the Colts. Thornton saw 45 percent of the team's offensive snaps in the contest, down from 59 percent and 68 percent in the prior weeks. The lack of downfield targets and attention to the No. 3 wide receiver could be a result of a strong run game that ran out the clock against a trailing opponent.

headline: Six rushes in win
story: Johnson rushed six times for 17 yards and returned one kick for 31 yards in the Chiefs' 24-10 win over the Dolphins on Sunday.
impact: Johnson played 13 offensive snaps and nine special-teams snaps in Sunday's contest. The rookie fifth-rounder continues to see supplemental carries as a relief option behind Super Bowl MVP Kenneth Walker.

headline: Shifts to restricted list
story: The Royals transferred Cruz (personal) from the paternity list to the restricted list Sunday.
impact: After going on paternity leave Thursday, Cruz spent the maximum three days on the list. Rather than having Cruz return for the season finale Sunday versus the Guardians, the Royals instead shifted him to the restricted list, which opened up a spot on the 40-man roster for James McArthur (elbow), who was reinstated from the 60-day injured list. Cruz finished the 2026 season with a 4.30 ERA, 1.26 WHIP and 65:20 K:BB in 58.2 innings and will likely be added back to the 40-man roster this offseason.

headline: Back at full strength
story: Kudrna (elbow) was activated from the 60-day injured list Monday.
impact: Kudrna has made a full recovery after undergoing olecranon stress fracture fixation surgery in late April. He made one appearance at Triple-A Omaha before landing on the IL, surrendering two runs on two hits and four walks while striking out two over two frames April 5 against Buffalo.

headline: Finishes campaign strong
story: Caglianone went 2-for-4 with a double in Sunday's win over the Guardians.
impact: Caglianone didn't drive in a run or score, but he did record his sixth multi-hit effort over his past seven games, going 14-for-28 (.500) during that stretch. The 23-year-old broke out in a big way in 2026, shaking off a disappointing rookie campaign in 2025 to live up to his lofty prospect pedigree. On the year, Caglianone will finish with a .289/.340/.494 slash line, 23 homers, 75 RBI, 72 runs and seven stolen bases in 143 contests.

headline: Smacks two homers in win
story: Pasquantino went 2-for-4 with a pair of solo home runs in Sunday's 3-2 win over the Guardians.
impact: Pasquantino twice gave the Royals a lead, going deep in the fifth and eighth innings. While injuries and lackluster performances defined parts of the season for Pasquantino, he finished strong with eight homers over 23 games in September. The first baseman hit .249 with a .761 OPS, 17 homers, 63 RBI, 54 runs scored, 20 doubles, two triples and five stolen bases over 114 contests in 2026.

headline: Picks up 13th save
story: Erceg allowed a hit and struck out one over a scoreless inning to earn the save in Sunday's 3-2 win over the Guardians.
impact: Erceg closed out the season with five scoreless innings, earning a save and a hold over five appearances in that span. He had spent a month in Triple-A after giving up 14 runs (11 earned) over 10.2 innings in July and August. Erceg finishes the campaign with a 5.59 ERA, 1.80 WHIP and 34:32 K:BB across 48.1 innings in the majors. He added 13 saves, five holds and six blown saves.

headline: Decent work in no-decision
story: Lynch allowed two runs on seven hits and struck out two without walking a batter over 5.1 innings in a no-decision versus the Guardians on Sunday.
impact: Lynch made his last 10 appearances of the season as a starter, but he had some struggles. He allowed nine home runs over 40 innings in those games while posting a 6.53 ERA in a starting role. Overall, he finished the campaign at a 6-6 record, 4.08 ERA, 1.15 WHIP and 56:26 K:BB through 86 innings over 56 appearances. Lynch's success out of the bullpen compared to his poor showings as a starter could make it tough for him to stick in the rotation in future seasons.

headline: Back from injured list
story: The Royals activated McArthur (elbow) from the 60-day injured list Sunday.
impact: McArthur began the year on the shelf and ultimately required a third elbow procedure in May to combat continued soreness and inflammation in the region. If he ends up pitching in Sunday's season finale for Kansas City, it will be McArthur's first big-league appearance since 2024.

headline: Lands on IL
story: The Royals placed Gonsolin on the 15-day injured list Sunday due to an allergic reaction.
impact: James McArthur (elbow) was reinstated to take Gonsolin's spot on the active roster for the final day of the regular season. Gonsolin spent most of the year on the mend from Tommy John surgery with an internal brace, returning for a lone big-league appearance Sept. 22, when he allowed five runs on four hits and three walks while striking out five over 2.2 innings against the White Sox.

headline: Heading to bench for finale
story: Jensen is not in the starting lineup for Sunday's game against the Guardians.
impact: Maikel Garcia will get a turn atop the order as Luke Maile catches and Salvador Perez serves as the designated hitter to close out the regular season for Kansas City. Jensen currently sits seventh among fantasy catchers in traditional rotisserie leagues, having slashed .239/.323/.467 with 27 homers, 81 RBI, 80 runs scored and two stolen bases in 149 games this season.

headline: Drives in two runs Saturday
story: Caglianone went 2-for-4 with two doubles, two RBI and two runs scored in Saturday's 11-5 loss to the Guardians.
impact: Caglianone laced a pair of doubles, one in the first inning and another in the eighth frame, each of which brought in a run. The 23-year-old is closing the season strong, going 12-for-24 (.500) with five RBI, six runs and a stolen base over his past six contests. On the year, Caglianone is hitting .287/.339/.492 with 23 homers, 75 RBI, 72 runs and seven stolen bases in 142 games.

headline: Moving to running back
story: Commings-Coleman will switch from safety to running back, per Henry Greenstein of the Lawrence Journal-World.
impact: Cummings-Coleman's move to running back comes as the Jayhawks scramble to replenish their backfield with Yasin Willis (foot) set to miss significant time and potentially the rest of the season. Kansas added Kennesaw State transfer Chase Belcher for reinforcements in its backfield, but it'll also convert the 5-11, 200-pound safety Cummings-Coleman into a ball-carrier.

headline: May be available Week 5
story: Kansas' head coach Lance Leipold announced Monday that he is optimistic about Pickett (undisclosed) being available Saturday against Middle Tennessee State, Matt Tait of Wave The W...
impact: Leipold is quoted as saying Pickett has been moving quite well for the first time in a while, welcoming for a Kansas team down one of its top-two running backs (Yasin Willis) heading into the last game of non-conference play. For last season's Jayhawks, Pickett logged 45 receptions (on 66 targets) for 476 yards and three touchdowns, so KU's team knows he can excel when healthy. The question is whether Pickett can log a tune-up game before he and Kansas get stuck in more rigorous conference matchups.

headline: Doubtful to face Blue Raiders
story: Ballard (shoulder) isn't expected to be available in Week 5 against Middle Tennessee State, per Michael Swain of 247Sports.com.
impact: Ballard sat out Week 3, and the backup quarterback appears slated to miss another contest. If he indeed isn't available against the Blue Raiders, Chase Jenkins will be the top backup to starter Isaiah Marshall.

headline: Added to Kansas roster
story: Belcher will transfer to Kansas, per Michael Swain of 247Sports.com.
impact: The tailback spent the 2025 season at Kennesaw State, where he ran for 566 yards and two scores on 5.3 yards per carry, tacking on 13 catches for 194 yards and two scores through the air. He should add depth to the Jayhawks' backfield.

headline: Out indefinitely, may be done for season
story: Willis (foot) is out indefinitely after undergoing surgery and may not return for the remainder of Kansas' 2026 season, Henry Greenstein of the Lawrence Journal-World reports.
impact: Willis suffered an injury to his right foot back in Week 3, and just over a week after the running back got hurt, he underwent surgery. The procedure is expected to require a long-term recovery, currently without a clear return date set for him. Though there is a possibility that Willis returns in time before Kansas' 2026 season concludes, it is unlikely, which explains why the Jayhawks recently acquired Chase Belcher, Michael Swain of 247Sports reports. At the time of Willis' injury, he has 27 rushing attempts for 125 yards and two touchdowns with KU.

headline: Ends up missing game
story: Pickett (undisclosed) did not play in Saturday's 24-17 loss to Arizona State.
impact: Pickett was a game-time decision heading into the matchup, but he ultimately was inactive. The 6-foot wide receiver's next chance to see the field will be after the Jayhawks' bye versus Middle Tennessee State on Oct. 3. He's logged just two catches for six yards this season.

headline: Searching for consistency
story: Connington converted on 1-for-2 field-goal attempts and 2-for-2 point-after tries during Saturday's 24-17 defeat versus Arizona State.
impact: Connington connected on a 46-yard field goal, but he has now missed a field goal attempt in consecutive games. The recent accuracy dip is worth monitoring, but it's not enough to panic about at this point. The bye week comes at a good time, and fantasy managers should get a better read on his reliability when Kansas returns against Middle Tennessee in Week 5.

headline: Produces despite limited volume
story: Cox gathered in all two targets for 68 yards during Saturday's 24-17 defeat against Arizona State.
impact: Cox led Kansas with 68 receiving yards against Arizona State, continuing to flash efficiency whenever the ball comes his way. The challenge is that his opportunities have remained relatively limited compared to some of the other pass catches. For now, Cox is more of a watch-list player heading into the bye, though another efficient performance against Middle Tennessee in Week 5 could boost his fantasy value.

headline: Makes the most of his opportunities
story: Nagy totaled three receptions (on five targets) for 61 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 24-17 loss to Arizona State.
impact: Nagy had one of the more interesting performances of the week, scoring both a 72-yard punt return touchdown and a 38-yard receiving touchdown. Kansas' upcoming bye week makes him more of a stash than a starter, but he's worth monitoring if his offensive role continues to grow when Kansas returns.

headline: Still leads the way in targets
story: McMillan hauled in 4 of 8 targets for 44 yards during Saturday's 24-17 defeat against Arizona State.
impact: McMillan didn't post a huge stat line against Arizona State, but he remains Kansas' most consistently targeted receiver though three games. The production hasn't always followed the volume, yet his role keeps him firmly on the fantasy radar. The Jayhawks are on a bye next week, giving managers a chance to hold him ahead of a favorable matchup with Middle Tennessee in Week 5.

headline: Volume keeps trending up
story: Marshall was 17-for-33 passing for 235 yards, one touchdown and one interception during Saturday's 24-17 loss against Arizona State. He also had 13 rushes for 52 yards.
impact: Marshall's results in London were disappointing, however, the workload remained encouraging for fantasy managers. Marshall attempted 33 passes against Arizona State and continues to see enough passing and rushing volume to maintain fantasy relevance even when Kansas struggles offensively. Kansas is on a bye next week, giving managers a week to hold rather than start him. Looking ahead, a home matchup with Middle Tennessee in Week 5 offers a favorable opportunity for Marshall to build on his recent volume and potentially deliver one of his best fantasy performances of the season.

headline: Slated to miss some time
story: Anciaux (undisclosed) is set to miss time, but the full extent of his injury remains unclear per Kellis Robinett of The Wichita Eagle.
impact: Anciaux was taken to the locker room during Kansas State's loss to Cincinnati, and wouldn't return to the game. There's still no word on his specific injury, or when he might return, but the senior had six catches for 84 yards through three games as a solid part of this passing offense. In his stead, Linkon Cure should see more snaps in the Kansas State tight end room.

headline: Will be fine for Week 6
story: Tibbs (undisclosed) will be fine going into Week 6 against Houston, Kellis Robinett of The Wichita Eagle reports.
impact: Tibbs' latest update is the most positive one possible after he left Week 4 needing help with an undisclosed injury. Fortunately for him and Kansas State, with the benefit of a bye week, he will have much-needed rest before KSU's team returns to action. In the month of September, Tibbs flashed promise with 16 receptions for 168 yards and one touchdown.

headline: Helathy scratch Saturday
story: Duff (undisclosed) was upgraded to healthy prior to Saturday's matchup against Cincinnati but did not play, per Kellis Robinett of The Wichita Eagle.
impact: Duff was previously listed as a game-time decision prior to Saturday's contest, but was upgraded to healthy before kickoff. The 6-foot-2 quarterback is a depth option at quarterback for the Wildcats, so he was a healthy scratch against Cincy.

headline: Healthy scratch Saturday
story: Knuth (undisclosed) was a healthy scratch for Saturday's loss to Cincinnati.
impact: Knuth was listed on the injury report ahead of the matchup but ended up being healthy. He will look to suit up for the Week 6 matchup versus Houston.

headline: Finally gets featured
story: Oakley compiled seven receptions (on 11 targets) for 80 yards during Saturday's 31-26 loss against Cincinnati.
impact: Oakley saw his role in the passing game explode against Cincinnati, drawing 11 targets after totaling just nine targets across Kansas State's first three games combined. The Wildcats' pass-heavy game script certainly helped, but the dramatic increase in usage is impossible to ignore for fantasy managers looking for tight end production. If even a portion of that workload carries forward, Oakley could quickly emerge as one of the more relevant fantasy tight ends in the Big 12.

headline: Stays steady despite the loss
story: Rodriguez connected on both field goal attempts and all two of his extra-point tries during Saturday's 31-26 loss against Cincinnati.
impact: Rodriguez connected on both of his field-goal attempts, hitting from 22 and 36 yards out while accounting for eight points. The Wildcats moved the ball consistently throughout the game, generating 477 total yards and multiple scoring opportunities, which continues to give Rodriguez a solid fantasy floor. Even in defeat, he remained one of the more reliable pieces of the Kansas State offense from a fantasy perspective.

headline: Targets outweigh the box score
story: Manning tallied one reception (on seven targets) for 19 yards during Saturday's 31-26 defeat against Cincinnati.
impact: Manning's stat line was not pretty, finishing with just one catch despite seeing seven targets. Rather than viewing this as a complete dud, fantasy managers should focus on the opportunity, especially with the Wildcats throwing 50 passes and potentially facing changes in the receiver rotation if Jaron Tibbs' injury lingers. Better days could be ahead if that level of involvement continues.

headline: Sees expanded opportunity
story: White gathered in 6 of 8 targets for 25 yards during Saturday's 31-26 defeat to Cincinnati.
impact: White was one of the biggest beneficiaries with Jaron Tibbs exiting early, drawing a season-high eight targets in Kansas State's loss to Cincinnati. While he wasn't able to turn those opportunities into the kind of production that Derrick Salley enjoyed, the increased workload is encouraging and could become more meaningful if Tibbs misses additional time.

headline: Steps up after injury to teammate
story: Salley gathered in 7 of 12 targets for 140 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-26 loss versus Cincinnati.
impact: Salley became the focal point of Kansas State's passing attack and delivered a breakout performance after Jaron Tibbs left the game early with an injury. The Wildcats were forced to throw more than usual while playing from behind, but Salley clearly took advantage of the extra opportunities that opened up after Tibbs' departure. If Tibbs misses additional time, Salley could be in line for a significant increase in targets and fantasy value moving forward.

headline: Lots of touches even in a loss
story: Jackson logged 11 rushes for 59 yards and reeled in all five targets for 10 yards during Saturday's 31-26 defeat to Cincinnati.
impact: Jackson commanded 16 total touches, underscoring that no matter how the Rodney Fields hype builds, this remains very much a shared backfield. Through the first four games of the season, he's already carved out 37 carries for 189 yards and a touchdown to go along with 11 catches for 106 yards and two touchdowns, proof that he's still a versatile option for Collin Klein to move around the formation to create matchups. That receiving role is useful for fantasy purposes, particularly in PPR formats.

headline: Bounces back in a big way
story: Fields totaled 12 rushes for 50 yards and two touchdowns and hauled in 2 of 3 targets for one yard during Saturday's 31-26 loss against Cincinnati.
impact: Fields responded to last week's quiet outing against Tulane with one of his best fantasy performances of the season, scoring twice and providing all of Kansas State's scores on the ground. While Fields got the touchdowns, teammate Joe Jackson still handled 16 total touches and remained heavily involved in the offense, reinforcing that this is a backfield where both players are likely to have weekly roles. Fields won't always lead the backfield in touches, but he's the one most likely to end the drive in the end zone, which keeps his weekly ceiling higher than his volume would suggest.

headline: Volume rises as Wildcats play catch-up
story: Johnson completed 30 of 50 passes for 292 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-26 defeat versus Cincinnati. He also had six rushes for 38 yards.
impact: Johnson was asked to do far more through the air than usual against Cincinnati in Kansas State's first loss of the season. The passing volume led to one of his most productive yardage totals of the year, but the Wildcats' offense never found its usual balance as Cincinnati controlled the second half with its rushing attack. Johnson remains one of the top fantasy quarterbacks in the conference, especially if game scripts continue forcing Kansas State to lean more heavily on his arm.

headline: Taken to locker room in loss
story: Anciaux was carted off to the locker room during the second quarter of Saturday's 31-26 loss to Cincinnati, but head coach Collin Klein didn't have any updates regarding his condit...
impact: Anciaux left the game during the second quarter after being tackled following a long gain that was negated by a penalty. Anciaux needed a cart to get back to the locker room after he made it to the sideline, but based on Klein's words, his status is uncertain. If he misses time and can't suit up for Week 6 against Houston, then Liinkon Cure could be in line for a bigger role at TE behind starter Garrett Oakley.

headline: Helped off field Saturday
story: Tibbs was helped off the field in Saturday's 31-26 loss to Cincinnati, but head coach Collin Klein didn't have any updates regarding his condition in the post-game presser, accordi...
impact: Tibbs, the leading receiver for KSU, was helped off the field with 7:55 left in the first quarter. Derrick Salley took his place and was impressive, catching seven passes for 140 yards and a touchdown but also losing a fumble. Salley should be in line for more playing time and targets if Tibbs misses time.

headline: Probable vs. Cincinnati
story: Knuth (undisclosed) is now probable for Saturday's contest at Cincinnati, per the Big 12 availability report.
impact: Knuth is trending towards suiting up given his probable tag. The quarterback is expected to be the third-string quarterback due to Blake Barnett (lower body) being sidelined.

headline: Carrying questionable tag
story: Knuth (undisclosed) is questionable for Saturday's game at Cincinnati.
impact: Knuth's questionable tag suggests it's uncertain whether he'll play against the Bearcats. That said, he's the third-string quarterback, so even if he's available, he's unlikely to see much action under center.

headline: Will make season debut Saturday
story: Morrell is not on the injury report ahead of Saturday's matchup with Cincinnati.
impact: Morrell will make his season debut Saturday against the Bearcats after missing the previous three games to begin the campaign. The tight end missed the past couple of games due to an undisclosed issue.

headline: Available for Saturday
story: Lovett is not listed on the injury report ahead of Saturday's game against Cincinnati.
impact: Lovett will make his season debut Saturday against the Bearcats after missing the previous three games. The wide receiver missed the first couple games of the season due to an undisclosed injury.

headline: Available for Week 4
story: Koch (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game at Cincinnati, per the Big 12 availability report.
impact: Koch is set to suit up for Saturday after dealing with an undisclosed injury to begin the season. He is a depth option at wideout, so he isn't expected to see many targets.

headline: Questionable for Week 4
story: Duff (undisclosed) is listed as questionable ahead of Saturday's game against Cincinnati.
impact: If Duff is cleared to play Saturday, it will be his season debut for the 2026 campaign. The quarterback has missed the first three games due to an undisclosed injury.

headline: Has five catches
story: Munroe caught five passes for 34 yards against Arkansas State on Saturday.
impact: With a couple players banged up for the Owls, the Northern Colorado transfer Munroe was targeted six times. However, on the season he has 12 catches for 140 yards without a single touchdown.

headline: Takes over on offense
story: Woods ran 19 times for 101 yards and two touchdowns against Arkansas State on Saturday. He also had five catches for 20 yards.
impact: Woods has largely been secondary in the KSU offense, but that all changed here. Not only by a wide margin did he have the most carries for the Owls, he was tied for the team lead in receptions. That makes this an interesting game to follow up on, because Woods may be the go-to guy for the team now.

headline: Little impact in loss
story: Collins went 17-for-24 for 129 yards against Arkansas State on Saturday. He also ran nine times for 52 yards.
impact: Collins was efficient, and he didn't turn the ball over. However, this is also the second game in a row wherein he did not contribute a single touchdown, and his third game in four with under 200 yards passing. Maybe Collins is fulfilling his role in this offense, but clearly his role is not going to yield much in the way of counting stats.

headline: Limited during Week 4
story: Booker was limited to 16 snaps for Saturday's game at Arkansas State.
impact: In between Weeks 0 and 4, Booker's snap count was 49, 38 and 55, which explains how he subsequently logged five, eight and 13 targets. He was not targeted Saturday and sat out the game's second half despite it still being a relatively close affair. Booker's injury status will be worth monitoring as he and Kennesaw State prepare for conference action.

headline: Racks up 10 catches
story: Booker had 10 catches for 78 yards Saturday versus Tennessee.
impact: In a touch matchup, Rickie Collins continually looked for his security blanket Booker. However, Booker's specific role may benefit Collins, but it doesn't lead to numbers that wow. Through three games he has 20 catches, but they have totaled 146 yards and zero touchdowns.

headline: Totals 31 yards
story: Murrell had six carries for 31 yards against Tennessee on Saturday. He also had one reception, but for zero yards.
impact: Murrell looked good in the opener against West Georgia, his former team, but since then he has nine carries for 43 yards against FBS opponents.

headline: No scoring plays vs. Vols
story: Collins went 22-for-34 for 189 yards, ran 14 times for 36 yards, and lost a fumble Saturday against Tennessee.
impact: Much more than this wasn't expected given the circumstances. Collins' schedule is easier going forward, but he has been more serviceable than impressive, having yet to throw for multiple touchdowns in a game and being held under 200 yards passing twice.

headline: Finds end zone
story: Harrold caught two passes for 15 yards and a touchdown against Georgia State on Saturday.
impact: Harrold, a depth tight end, didn't have a catch last season, or in KSU's opener this season. Given that, consider this wholly anomalous for now.

headline: Only gets a few touches
story: Murrell ran three times for 12 yards and had two catches for 14 yards versus Georgia State on Saturday.
impact: The West Georgia transfer had nine carries for 88 yards and two touchdowns in his KSU debut, but he got even fewer touches in this game, not more. That being said, only quarterback RIckie Collins had more than four carries in this game.

headline: Nets 52 yards
story: Booker caught five passes for 52 yards versus Georgia State on Saturday.
impact: On the one hand, the Tulsa transfer gets a lot of looks, as he has 10 catches already. On the other hand, those 10 catches have yielded 68 yards.

headline: Scores first TD of season
story: Clark totaled six receptions (on nine targets) for 73 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 26-13 victory versus Ball State.
impact: Clark hauled in his first score of the campaign Saturday against Ball State. The receiver reeled in a five-yard pass from John Alan Richter in the fourth quarter to extend the lead. Through four games, Clark has 13 catches for 178 yards and one touchdown.

headline: Best start of season
story: DeShields was 16-for-25 passing for 189 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 26-13 win versus Ball State. He also had 13 rushes for 76 yards with one touchdown.
impact: DeShields combined for three touchdowns during Saturday's win over Ball State. The quarterback tossed touchdowns to Brandon White and Da'Realyst Clark while also taking one himself on the ground in the second quarter. Through four games, the Ohio native has 540 passing yards, 183 rushing yards, six total touchdowns and three interceptions.

headline: Ruled out Saturday
story: Thanthanavong (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game versus Ball State, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Thanthanavong has been ruled out for Saturday's contest, though it's very unlikely he would've played even if he was healthy. His next chance to be available is next Saturday versus Ohio.

headline: Subpar performance in loss
story: DeShields was 6-for-15 passing for 35 yards and one interception during Saturday's 59-3 defeat against Ohio State.
impact: DeShields was unable to get anything going during a 56-point loss to Ohio State on Saturday. The quarterback failed to reach 100 passing yards for the second time this season. DeShields will look to bounce back next week as the Golden Flashes open MAC play against Ball State.

headline: Available against Ohio State
story: Armentrout (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game at Ohio State, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Armentrout will suit up against the Buckeyes on Saturday but is not expected to see any carries due to facing one of the country's best teams.

headline: Available Saturday
story: Bierfeldt is available for Saturday's game versus Ohio State, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Bierfeldt, a true freshman who has not played yet this season, is available to make his collegiate debut Saturday. There's a good chance he still doesn't see the field though given his place on the depth chart.

headline: Leading receiver in win
story: Clark hauled in 5 of 6 targets for 90 yards during Saturday's 36-15 win against Wofford.
impact: After a poor performance last week against South Carolina, Clark led the Golden Flashes in receiving yards during their Week 2 win against Wofford. Clark averaged 18 yards per catch on five receptions.

headline: Picks up second career TD
story: Harris totaled three receptions (on seven targets) for 78 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 36-15 victory over Wofford.
impact: Harris registered his first score of the campaign after hauling in a 10-yard pass from Dru DeShields to cement the Golden Flashes' lead. The wide receiver totaled 78 receiving yards, just behind Da'Realyst Clark (90) for most on the team.

headline: Rushes for two TDs in win
story: DeShields completed 16 of 25 passes for 248 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions during Saturday's 36-15 win against Wofford. He also had 10 rushes for 74 yards with two touc...
impact: After rushing for just three scores a season ago, DeShields accounted for two rushing touchdowns during their win Saturday. The quarterback threw for 248 yards and a touchdown, bouncing back from his previous start where he totaled just 63 yards against South Carolina. DeShields will look to carry the momentum over into the Golden Flashes' next matchup against Ohio State.

headline: Out for Week 2
story: Bierfeldt (undisclosed) is out for Week 2 against Wofford.
impact: Bierfeldt won't be available against FCS Wofford, but the reserve wideout wasn't expected to make a big impact offensively regardless.

headline: Huge day in win over USA
story: Patterson recorded 12 rushes for 137 yards and three touchdowns and caught their only target for two yards during Saturday's 45-21 victory against South Alabama.
impact: Patterson continues to share the workload in the Kentucky backfield with CJ Baxter. Baxter has been very much cemented as the lead back of the duo and again outpaced Patterson in carries against South Alabama. Patterson did however get the leg up on him in touchdowns against USA as he found the end zone three times to just one for Baxter.

headline: Touchdown in win over USA
story: Baxter notched 16 rushes for 149 yards and one touchdown and caught 1 of 2 targets for negative one yard during Saturday's 45-21 victory against South Alabama.
impact: Baxter continues to split work with Jason Patterson however continues to slightly outpace his stablemate in workload. Baxter received 16 carries to 12 for Patterson and out gained him 149 to 137.

headline: Big day in win over USA
story: Barnes logged eight carries for 100 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-21 victory over South Alabama.
impact: Barnes saw action for just the second time this season and capitalized. The senior running back had his first 100-yard performance since 2024 against Maine.

headline: Little needed in win over USA
story: Minchey was 19-for-25 passing for 177 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-21 win versus South Alabama.
impact: Minchey wasn't asked to do much against the Sun Belt Conference opponent as the ground game went for 390 yards and five touchdowns. Despite that, Minchey still had a solid day and has strung together some good play since the tough outing against Alabama.

headline: Suffers leg injury Saturday
story: Miller exited Saturday's game against South Alabama due to a leg injury, Mark Story of Kentucky.com reports.
impact: Miller could not return Saturday after leaving in the first half when Kenny Minchey tried to connect with him on a pass. The wideout was targeted once and recorded no stats before exiting. His status will be monitored closely, and a report should surface regarding his availability for Kentucky's upcoming matchup against South Carolina in Week 5.

headline: Yet to take NFL regular-season snap
story: Mendoza did not play in the Raiders' 35-27 Week 3 win over the Saints.
impact: Kirk Cousins again took every snap under center for Las Vegas in the high-scoring victory. There was some thought before the start of the season that Mendoza could eventually work his way into the starting role if Cousins and/or the team struggled early, but instead Las Vegas is 3-0 and Cousins is tied for the NFL lead with nine touchdown passes. Mendoza is likely continue to learn on the sidelines barring an injury to Cousins or a dramatic downturn to the Raiders' success.

headline: Gets spot on active roster
story: The Raiders signed White from their practice squad to their active roster Tuesday.
impact: White began the campaign on Las Vegas' practice squad but has already been elevated for game day the maximum three times. He's collected three catches on six targets for 28 yards, with all three receptions going for touchdowns. Jack Bech (forearm) landed on injured reserve Tuesday, and White could immediately take Bech's role as the Raiders' No. 3 wide receiver.

headline: Heads to IR
story: The Raiders placed Bech (forearm) on injured reserve Tuesday.
impact: Bech will be sidelined for at least the Raiders' next four games after sustaining a fractured left forearm during Sunday's 35-27 win over the Saints. In a corresponding move, the Raiders signed Cody White off their practice squad. White could be the leading candidate to replace Bech as the Raiders' No. 3 wideout behind Tre Tucker and Jalen Nailor.

headline: Could move to left field in 2027
story: Angels interim general manager John Mozeliak said Monday that Trout approached him about playing left field and designated hitter next season, Jeff Fletcher of The Orange County Re...
impact: Trout logged 109 starts in center field and 33 at DH in 2026, but defensive metrics were again unkind as the 35-year-old finished with a minus-5 in Outs Above Average, per Baseball Savant. The three-time American League MVP's 142 games played in 2026 was his highest total since 2016, but he was more good than great offensively, slashing .242/.382/.421 with 22 home runs, 54 RBI and 11 steals.

headline: Homers off bench
story: Siri went 1-for-1 with a two-run home run in Sunday's 7-3 loss to the Mariners.
impact: Siri also supplied a sacrifice bunt in his first plate appearance of the game. The outfielder's homer came in the eighth inning, getting him to 10 long balls on the year. He hit .241 with a .713 OPS, 33 RBI, 36 runs scored, 10 doubles and nine stolen bases over 251 plate appearances across 108 contests with the Angels this year.

headline: Strikes out seven in loss
story: Kikuchi (1-7) allowed three runs on six hits, a walk and a hit batsman while striking out seven over five innings to take the loss Sunday versus the Mariners.
impact: Kikuchi allowed two runs or fewer in four of seven starts after coming back from shoulder inflammation in late August. He allowed 18 runs (17 earned) over 36.2 innings in that span. The 35-year-old southpaw ends the season at a 4.92 ERA, 1.54 WHIP and 67:30 K:BB through 67.2 innings over 14 starts. He has one more year on his contract, so he could be a trade candidate moving forward.

headline: Sitting for Sunday's finale
story: Trout is not in the starting lineup for Sunday's game against the Mariners, Rhett Bollinger of MLB.com reports.
impact: With the Angels having nothing left to play for in 2026, Trout will sit, having already logged 633 plate appearances this season, his most since 2016. Zach Neto will serve as the designated hitter Sunday while Oswald Peraza mans shortstop and bats seventh against right-hander Logan Gilbert.

headline: Gives up four runs
story: Johnson allowed four runs on seven hits and four walks while striking out three over five innings in a no-decision versus the Mariners on Saturday.
impact: Johnson allowed 12 runs over 27.2 innings over his five games in September, a step back from his strong August but still a decent way to wrap up the campaign. He closes out at a 5-9 record, 5.04 ERA, 1.39 WHIP and 79:43 K:BB through 100 innings over 22 games (19 starts). Johnson's work late in the season should keep him in the mix for a spot in the rotation moving forward.

headline: Feeling good after live BP
story: General manager Brandon Gomes said Tuesday that Henriquez is "trending really well" after throwing an encouraging round of live batting practice, Sonja Chen of MLB.com reports.
impact: Henriquez ended the regular season on the injured list due to a low-grade back strain, but because the Dodgers have a bye during the wild-card round, he'll have time to heal before the team begins its postseason run. The 24-year-old righty still has a few boxes left to check off, but assuming he doesn't suffer any setbacks during his remaining workouts, he'll likely be included in the Dodgers' NLDS roster.

headline: Signs to active roster
story: The Rams signed Connors from the practice squad to the active roster Tuesday.
impact: Connors was signed to the active roster after fellow running back Ronnie Rivers (calf) was placed on injured reserve (Sept. 23). Connors was elevated to the active roster ahead of the Rams' Week 3 loss to the Broncos as the No. 3 running back behind Kyren Williams and Blake Corum. The 23-year-old will continue to fill that role for the team on the 53-man roster in Rivers' absence.

headline: Throws two TDs in loss
story: Armenta completed 23 of 29 passes for 278 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 45-17 defeat versus Florida Atlantic. He also had five rushes for -10 yards.
impact: Armenta connected with Jase Hoath for a one-yard touchdown before finding LT Robinson for a 75-yard touchdown in the second quarter. Through three games, Armenta has thrown for 493 yards and three touchdowns. The 0-4 Warhawks take on South Alabama on the road on Saturday.

headline: Long TD in loss
story: Robinson gathered in all two targets for 79 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-17 loss versus Florida Atlantic.
impact: Quarterback Aidan Armenta connected with Robinson for a 75-yard touchdown in the second quarter. Through four games, Robinson has hauled in eight catches for 136 yards and one score.

headline: Misses Saturday''s loss
story: Carlisle (undisclosed) didn't play in Saturday's loss to Florida Atlantic.
impact: Carlisle missed his first game of the campaign and in his absence, Aidan Armenta got the start at quarterback. Carlisle will look to make his return for next week's matchup against South Alabama.

headline: Iffy day as WarHawks lose to FCS foe
story: Carlisle completed 19 of 24 passes for 183 yards, two touchdowns and two interceptions during Saturday's 38-35 defeat to Southeastern Louisiana. He also had 13 rushes for 76 yards.
impact: Carlisle accounted for three turnovers, throwing two interceptions and coughing up a fumble as Louisiana-Monroe lost to an FCS opponent. He completed nearly 80% of his passes, but threw for just 183 yards. He'll look to bounce back in Week 4 at home against Florida Atlantic.

headline: Scores twice in loss
story: Jameson recorded nine rushes for 85 yards and two touchdowns and caught their only target for four yards during Saturday's 38-35 loss to Southeastern Louisiana.
impact: Jameson didn't do much on the ground through the first two weeks of the season, notching 18 and 14 rushing yards, respectively. Against Southeast Louisiana, he finally made an impact as a ball-carrier, only needing nine carries to notch 85 yards and a score. He also remained a factor, if only a small one, as a receiver.

headline: Finally emerges in Week 3
story: Trujillo reeled in 5 of 11 targets for 79 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 38-35 defeat against Southeastern Louisiana.
impact: Trujillo has been extremely quiet through the first two games of the season with just one catch for five yards, but the senior wideout finally managed to make an impact against Southeast Louisiana. He'll look to stay hot in Week 4 against Florida Atlantic.

headline: Scores in loss to FCS foe
story: Fulghum hauled in all five targets for 88 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 38-35 defeat against Southeastern Louisiana.
impact: Fulghum had just one catch in each of the WarHawks' first two games, but the wideout finally got more involved in the Week 3 loss. He'll look to remain a big factor in the passing game in Week 4 against Florida Atlantic.

headline: Struggles in relief role
story: Armenta (undisclosed) completed 10 of his 21 pass attempts for 148 yards and a touchdown and carried the ball twice for a loss of three yards during Saturday's loss versus Southeas...
impact: Armenta was named the team's starter heading into Week 1 but was injured and replaced by Austin Carlisle, who has now started the past two weeks. Carlisle was more efficient during Saturday's matchup, so he will likely start again for the team's Week 5 matchup against Florida Atlantic.

headline: Runs for TD in loss
story: Carlisle was 10-for-19 passing for 56 yards and one interception during Saturday's 26-20 defeat to UAB. He also had 17 rushes for 93 yards with one touchdown.
impact: Carlisle struggled through the air on Saturday but utilized his legs efficiently. Carlisle broke free for a seven-yard score to give the Warhawks a 14-3 lead at the time. Through two games, Carlisle has tossed for 129 yards, one touchdown and one interception. Up next is a home matchup with Southeastern Louisiana.

headline: Misses loss against UAB
story: Armenta (undisclosed) did not play in Saturday's 26-20 loss to UAB.
impact: Armenta left the Warhawks' season-opening loss to Mississippi State after completing 10 of 16 passes for 67 yards. The starting quarterback's injury then trickled into Week 2, as he ceded QB1 duties to Austin Carlisle. Armenta will now look to get healthy before this Saturday's home clash against Southeastern Louisiana, but the severity of his injury remains unknown.

headline: Tosses TD in loss
story: Carlisle completed six of 10 passes for 73 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 62-13 defeat versus Mississippi State. He also had seven rushes for 50 yards.
impact: Carlisle outplayed fellow quarterback Aidan Armenta on Saturday, which could raise question about the need for change. Carlisle's TD pass on a 40-yard strike to running back Derrick Jameson.

headline: Two receptions in loss
story: Buckhaulter (undisclosed) caught two of four receptions for 14 yards in Saturday's 62-13 loss versus Mississippi State.
impact: Buckhaulter was one of five receivers to haul in a reception Saturday. It was a quiet day in the passing department for Louisiana-Monroe as a whole, considering the team collected 140 total yards through the air. He will look for more targets against UAB next Saturday.

headline: Listed as starter
story: Jameson is listed as a starter for Louisiana-Monroe ahead of Week 1 at Mississippi State.
impact: Jameson transferred to ULM from Utah State. He didn't play in 2025, but in 2024 he ran for 140 yards and two scores with the Aggies. In his final year of eligibility, he appears to be the Warhawks' top back.

headline: Transfers to Warhawks
story: Jameson will transfer to ULM, the program announced.
impact: Jameson didn't play in 2025, but he spent the 2024 season with Utah State, where he ran for 140 yards and two touchdowns. The tailback, with presumably one season of eligibility remaining, will land at Louisiana-Monroe.

headline: Lands at ULM
story: Chaney will transfer to Louisiana-Monroe, the program announced.
impact: Chaney announced his intentions to enter the transfer portal in late September, departing Charlotte's program early in the season. The tailback has also spent time with Miami and Louisville, and most recently, he rushed for 178 yards and three touchdowns on 50 carries in 2024 with the Cardinals. He figures to have one year of eligibility remaining with the Warhawks.

headline: Flips commitment, signs with ULM
story: Anderson has flipped his commitment and signed with Louisiana-Monroe, according to the team's X account Thursday.
impact: Previously committed to Marist, Anderson will enroll at Louisiana-Monroe instead. While part of Memphis' 2025 team, the tight end logged 12 receptions (on 17 targets) for 101 yards.

headline: Heading to ULM
story: Murray is transferring to Louisiana-Monroe, per 247Sports.com.
impact: Murray has found his new landing spot after logging this past season with Cal and the previous with Miami. The redshirt freshman kicker will have three years of eligibility to serve out with the Warhawks.

headline: Two scores in win
story: Winfield was 19-for-26 passing for 149 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-7 win against Charlotte. He also had 13 rushes for 28 yards with one touchdown.
impact: Winfield tossed his lone touchdown pass of the day to Steven Blanco for a three-yard score in the second quarter. Winfield then called his own number for a nine-yard rushing touchdown in the fourth. Through four games, Winfield has thrown for 660 yards, two touchdowns and two interceptions, while running for six scores.

headline: Rushing TD in win
story: Reagan posted nine carries for 27 yards and one touchdown and gathered in their only target for 10 yards during Saturday's 34-7 victory over Charlotte.
impact: Reagan closed the scoring during the victory with a four-yard run in the fourth quarter. Through four games, Reagan has run for 135 yards and two touchdowns on 31 attempts.

headline: Getting closer to return
story: Sampson (knee) is nearing a return and he could play in Week 5 against Arkansas State, per Dawson Eiserloh of ESPN-Southwest Louisiana.
impact: Sampson is reportedly "hopeful" to return this week, but the Ragin Cajuns need to see how he responds to a week of practice. Still, the fact that the receiver is getting closer is certainly a good sign, and regardless if he manages to return this week against the RedWolves, a return does appear imminent.

headline: DNP vs. Charlotte
story: Sampson (knee) was held out of Saturday's matchup against Charlotte.
