impact: Brady will make his season debut Saturday against the Bulldogs. The wide receiver missed three consecutive games to begin the campaign due to a knee injury.

headline: Leading receiver in victory
story: Gilmer caught 4 of 9 targets for 101 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-13 victory over Michigan State.
impact: Gilmer had his best game of the season against Michigan State, totaling a season-high 101 yards through the air to lead the team. The 6-foot-2 junior connected with quarterback Anthony Colandrea for a 44-yard scoring strike in the first quarter, giving the Huskers a 7-3 lead at the time. Gilmer will hope to build momentum off his performance on Saturday, with his next opportunity coming against a potentially demoralized Maryland squad.

headline: Scores in victory
story: Nelson logged 15 rushes for 61 yards and one touchdown and reeled in 0 of 2 targets for zero yards during Saturday's 31-13 win against Michigan State.
impact: Nelson saw an expanded role due to fellow running back Jamal Rule's injury, commanding a season-high 15 rushing attempts on the day. The 6-foot sophomore averaged a respectable 4.1 YPC on the day and found the end zone on a four-yard scamper in the second quarter, giving the Huskers a 14-3 lead at the time. If Rule is ruled out long-term, Nelson could continue to see a larger role within the Nebraska backfield. His next opportunity will come against Maryland on Saturday.

headline: Two scores in victory
story: Colandrea completed 15 of 27 passes for 212 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 31-13 victory against Michigan State. He also had 10 rushes for 66 yards.
impact: Colandrea had a solid day against Michigan State, throwing for 212 yards and a pair of touchdowns while accounting for a season-high 66 yards on the ground. The 6-foot senior connected with receiver Kwazi Gilmer for a 44-yard scoring strike in the first quarter before finding running back Vincent Genatone for a 13-yard touchdown toss just before halftime, giving the Huskers a 14-point lead at the break. Colandrea will get his next chance to shine at home against Maryland on Saturday.

headline: Status will be updated Wednesday
story: Barney left Saturday's game against MSU due to an undisclosed injury, and an update on his status will be given Wednesday, according to Journal Star Huskers.
impact: Barney was limited to one catch for 12 yards Saturday, and losing him for a considerable amount of time could be a huge blow for Nebraska. To make things even more complicated for the Cornhuskers, Nebraska also missed star running back Jamal Rule due to an undisclosed injury. Wednesday's report will provide more clarity regarding his potential availability against Maryland in a Week 5 matchup on Saturday, Oct. 3.

headline: Injury update expected Wednesday
story: An injury update regarding Rule's (undisclosed) status is expected Wednesday, per Journal Star Huskers.
impact: It appears that Rule's status will be in question until a further update is given come Wednesday. The running back exited Saturday's game against Michigan State but eventually returned to the sidelines, unable to return. The hope is that it's not long-term, as the freshman was off to a dominant start, rushing for 329 yards and five touchdowns on 38 attempts.

headline: Not expected to return
story: Rule (undisclosed) is not expected to return to Saturday's game against Michigan State, Avarie Howard of Hurrdat Sports reports.
impact: Rule came back out of the locker room attempting to run but is still limping pretty badly, so it seems he's not expected to return to action. If that's the case, Mekhi Nelson will get most of the touches the rest of the way, with Isaiah Mozee operating as the RB2.

headline: Returns to sidelines
story: Rule (undisclosed) is back on the sidelines and could return to Saturday's game at Michigan State, Amie Just of the Lincoln Journal Star reports.
impact: Rule headed to the locker room briefly but sprinted to the sidelines shortly after, so he might be able to return to the game. His return would be a huge boost for the Cornhuskers' rushing attack.

headline: Logs explosive play in loss
story: Douglas caught one of his five targets for 38 yards in the Patriots' 35-6 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.
impact: Douglas played 60 percent of the Patriots' offensive snaps in the loss. The sole ball the wide receiver was able to haul in went for a 38-yard gain, marking quarterback Drake Maye's longest pass of the night. Douglas continues to be a threat out of the slot for a struggling Patriots offense.

headline: Moved to injured reserve
story: The Patriots placed Van Roten (thigh) on injured reserve Tuesday.
impact: Van Roten sustained a thigh injury during the Patriots' 35-6 loss to the Jaguars in Week 3. The injury is severe enough for him to miss at least the next four games, so the earliest he can return is for Week 8 against the Dolphins on Sunday, Nov. 1. With both Van Roten and Mike Onwenu (ankle) on IR, the Patriots will turn to either Ben Brown or Walter Rouse to serve as the starting right guard for Week 4 against the Bills, per Mike Reiss of ESPN.com.

headline: Nets 90 yards
story: Josiah Thomas caught five passes for 90 yards Saturday against New Mexico.
impact: This is a big game for a tight end, but Thomas had five catches for 42 yards total prior to this.

headline: Tough day versus the Lobos
story: King caught four passes for 26 yards against New Mexico on Saturday.
impact: Tough to have your worst game of the season against your in-state rival, but the blame largely sits with quarterback Trey Hedden, who was benched fro his play. King was still involved, at least, and he now has 18 catches through four games.

headline: Over 100 yards
story: Jones ran 14 times for 112 yards versus New Mexico on Saturday.
impact: Jones didn't do much of anything in his first game of the season, fair given that it was against Florida State, but since the he's been over 100 yards twice and has three total touchdowns.

headline: DNP for Week 4
story: Malone-Bradford (undisclosed) did not play during Saturday's game against New Mexico.
impact: After logging multiple targets in each of New Mexico State's first three games, Malone-Bradford was a surprise DNP. He will look to become available when NMSU's team returns to conference actoin Thursday against Western Kentucky.

headline: Steps in at QB
story: Damante went 16-for-19 for 157 yards and a touchdown versus New Mexico on Saturday.
impact: Damante lost the QB battle to Trey Hedden, but after Hedden had three turnovers last week he had three turnovers again in this one, giving Damante his chance. Given how Damante played, don't be surprised if he starts Thursday against Western Kentucky.

headline: Pulls in rivalry game
story: Hedden went 7-for-19 for 106 yards and two interceptions against New Mexico on Saturday. He also lost a fumble.
impact: Hedden was pulled for Adam Damante eventually, and it's not hard to see why. Not only did Hedden have a horrendous game, this was his second game in a row with multiple interceptions and a lost fumble. The job may be Damante's to start NMSU's next game.

headline: Nets 54 yards
story: Williams notched three catches for 54 yards against Hawaii on Saturday.
impact: TK King is the guy for NMSU, but Williams seems to have emerged as the number-two receiver. He has eight catches through three contests, but he's gone over 50 yards twice.

headline: Finds end zone again
story: Jones ran 13 times for 78 yards and a touchdown and added two catches for 14 yards against Hawaii on Saturday.
impact: Jones, a Delaware State transfer, struggled in the opener, but it was against Florida State. He was excellent against Mercyhurst, though, and now he's totaled over 90 yards with a score against FBS competition so it seems like he can hang at this level.

headline: Sloppy in the islands
story: Hedden went 19-for-35 for 256 yards, one touchdown, and two interceptions on Saturday against Hawaii. He ran for 14 yards, fumbled three times, and lost one fumble as well.
impact: Going to Hawaii can be a hurdle for players, but Hedden was too sloppy to blame it on the travel. If you care about QBR, he had a 9.7 QBR, but he's thrown five touchdowns against three picks on the season and has a chance to rebound against New Mexico.

headline: Reels in TD
story: Williams caught two passes for 52 yards and a touchdown against Mercyhurst on Saturday.
impact: Even with a touchdown, two catches against an FCS school is not remarkable, and even his three catches for 29 yards against Florida State doesn't look like much in hindsight after SMU threw for over 400 yards against Florida State in Week 1.

headline: Logs three receptions in Week 3 defeat
story: Vele caught three of six targets for 39 yards Sunday in a loss to Las Vegas.
impact: Tyler Shough had another big day at quarterback for the Saints, with 160 of his 255 passing yards going to the combination of No. 1 wideout Chris Olave and top tight end Juwan Johnson. Vele finished third (behind that duo) in both targets (six) and receiving yards (39). The third-year wideout has been locked into a key role in the Saints' passing game, and through three contests he's registered 15 catches on 22 targets for 172 yards and one touchdown.

headline: Totals 29 yards vs. Tennessee
story: Mooney caught two passes on three targets for 20 yards and logged a nine-yard carry during the Giants' 12-7 win over the Titans on Sunday.
impact: Mooney has logged two catches in each of the first three games of the regular season, and his 95 receiving yards are third-most on the Giants behind Isaiah Likely (124) and Malik Nabers (96). The Giants will stay home for Week 4 against the Cardinals, whose defense has given up the second-most fantasy points to wide receivers this season.

headline: Tallies 19 yards in Week 3 win
story: Fields caught both of his targets for 19 yards during the Giants' 12-7 win over the Titans on Sunday.
impact: Fields' 44 snaps on offense were actually second-most among Giants wide receivers behind Malik Nabers (50), though the former finished fourth on the team in targets behind Nabers (six), tight end Isaiah Likely (five) and running back Cam Skattebo (four). Fields has logged two catches in each of the first three games of the regular season, but the rookie third-rounder and the rest of the Giants pass catchers will take on the Cardinals in Week 4, with Arizona's defense ranking second-to-last in fantasy points allowed to opposing wide receivers.

headline: Operates as RB2 vs. Tennessee
story: Harris turned nine carries into 52 yards during the Giants' 12-7 win over the Titans on Sunday.
impact: Harris finished as a close second to Cam Skattebo (60) in rushing yards Sunday, but the former needed 11 less carries and averaged 5.8 yards per rush in the Giants' Week 3 win. Harris saw his usage on offense increase compared to Week 2 in what was his debut with the Giants, and it looks like he's settled in as the team's RB2 behind Skattebo and ahead of both Tyrone Tracy and Devin Singletary. Up next is a Week 4 road tilt against the Cardinals.

headline: Signed to active roster
story: The Giants signed Jones to the active roster from their practice squad Tuesday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.
impact: Jones will slot in as the team's fifth-string receiver following the release of Odell Beckham earlier in the day. Jones is also expected to serve as the backup punt returner behind Braxton Berrios.

headline: Moved to IR
story: The Giants placed Burns (knee) on injured reserve Tuesday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.
impact: Burns' move to injured reserve comes just one day after the team announced that he would miss the remainder of the season due to a torn ACL suffered during Sunday's win over the Titans. The 2019 first-round pick recorded eight tackles (four solo) across his three outings before getting hurt, and in his absence, Kayvon Thibodeaux should take over as the primary edge rusher opposite Abdul Carter.

headline: Stays on field in loss
story: Williams caught one of his two targets for 21 yards and returned four kicks for 95 yards over 63 total snaps in the Jets' 31-24 loss to the Lions on Sunday.
impact: Williams played 90 percent of the Jets' offensive snaps in the contest alongside an additional eight special-teams snaps as a returner. The wide receiver has stayed on the field longer due to the injuries to Adonai Mitchell (finger) and Omar Cooper (ankle). If Mitchell must miss another week, Williams should see similar playing time as the No. 2 option in the Week 4 matchup with the Bears.

headline: Awarded spot on Jets roster
story: The Jets signed to Sanders off their practice squad Tuesday, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.
impact: Though New York cut him at the conclusion of the preseason, Sanders re-signed with the organization as a member of the practice squad and was elevated for each of the Jets' first three games of the season. He went 5-for-6 on field-goal tries and drilled all five of his point-after attempts during that stretch, with his performance earning him a spot on the 53-man roster. Sanders should have more security as the Jets' kicker moving forward after New York waived Blake Grupe in a corresponding move.

headline: Expected to be ready for spring
story: Mets president of baseball operations David Stearns said Monday that he expects Garrett (elbow) to be a full participant in spring training, Michael Mayer of MetsmerizedOnline.com...
impact: Garrett underwent UCL reconstruction surgery last October. It's unclear how far along the veteran reliever is in his throwing program, but the expectation is that he'll be ready to roll for spring training. Assuming health, Garrett will likely be a high-leverage reliever for the Mets in 2027. He's logged a 4.10 ERA with 163 strikeouts over 129.2 innings during his time with New York.

headline: Will be full-go for spring training
story: Mets president of baseball operations David Stearns said Monday that he expects Megill (elbow) to be 100 percent for the start of spring training, Michael Mayer of MetsmerizedOnlin...
impact: Megill is just over one year removed from Tommy John surgery on his right elbow. It's unclear whether he's currently at in the rehab process, but it sounds like Megill won't be facing any real restrictions once spring training rolls around. The 31-year-old Megill could compete for a spot in the Mets' rotation next season.

headline: Launches 300th home run
story: Lindor went 2-for-4 with a solo home run and an additional run scored in Sunday's 6-4 loss to the Nationals.
impact: Lindor extended the Mets' lead to 4-1 in the second inning with a 409-foot shot off DJ Herz, his 21st homer this season and the 300th of his career. It's a nice way to wrap up what was otherwise a disappointing season for Lindor. He'd gone 14 games without a homer prior to Sunday, going 8-for-55 (.145) in that span. Overall, Lindor will finish an injury-shortened campaign with a .225/.309/.423 slash line, 63 runs scored, 49 RBI and three steals across 469 plate appearances.

headline: Falls to Nats in finale
story: Manaea (6-8) took the loss Sunday against the Nationals, allowing five runs on seven hits and a walk across six innings. He struck out three.
impact: It was a tough way to end the year for Manaea, who'd given up just four earned runs across 11.1 innings while striking out 11 in his previous two outings. The veteran left-hander will finish with a 4.78 ERA, 1.30 WHIP and 144:44 K:BB across 150.2 innings this season. Manaea is under contract with the Mets again in 2027, though it remains to be seen whether or not he'll remain in the starting rotation.

headline: UNC Needs Better QB Production
story: In Bill Belichick’s 24-year NFL tenure with the New England Patriots, his win-loss records during...

headline: Eligible for 2026
story: Verhoff (undisclosed) is eligible for North Carolina's 2026 season, Greg Barnes of On3.com reports.
impact: Barnes' previous ineligibility indicates why he did not play Week 3. During 2025, as part of North Carolina, the placekicker made not only 19 field goals but also 20 extra points.

headline: Tallies 65 yards in blowout win
story: Milliner caught 3 of 4 targets for 65 yards during Saturday's 63-14 win over Houston Christian.
impact: Milliner continues to be a steady target in the Mean Green's receiving corps, having recorded over 60 receiving yards in all four games this season. The wideout only hauled in three receptions, but North Texas was leading the entire game, resulting in the starters getting some rest. Through four games, he has posted 17 receptions for 276 yards and one touchdown.

headline: Reels in TD
story: Stevenson tallied five receptions (on six targets) for 69 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 63-14 victory over Houston Christian.
impact: Stevenson is coming off a 100-yard receiving game and continued his momentum into Saturday, hauling in his first touchdown of the season. He led the team with five receptions and possibly could have added to that total if he wasn't benched due to the blowout. Through four games, the wideout has recorded 19 receptions for 281 yards and one touchdown.

headline: Explodes for four touchdowns
story: White compiled 11 rushes for 133 yards and four touchdowns and gathered in all three targets for 17 yards during Saturday's 63-14 victory over Houston Christian.
impact: Week in and week out, White continues to impress and is making a strong case for being the best back in the American Conference. The running back is off to a dominant start, and it's hard to tell he is coming back from a season-ending knee injury. He recorded four touchdowns for the first time in his career, bringing his season total to nine scores. Saturday was an easy test for White against an FCS opponent, but with conference play upcoming, he'll look to maintain the same workload against Tulsa in Week 5.

headline: Two scores in relief
story: Ditta was 7-for-8 passing for 75 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 63-14 win over Houston Christian. He also had three rushes for five yards with one touchdown.
impact: Ditta relieved Tayven Jackson under center in the third quarter once the Mean Green had built a commanding lead. Making his third appearance of the season, the quarterback tossed his first touchdown pass of the year to Baron Tipton. He added to his performance by rushing for a 4-yard score to further extend the team's lead.

headline: Near perfect in blowout win
story: Jackson completed 16 of 18 passes for 270 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 63-14 victory over Houston Christian.
impact: Jackson was two incompletions away from a perfect passing game, generating a highly efficient outing in the blowout victory. The signal-caller connected with TJ Chukwurah for a 14-yard score, bringing his season total to six passing touchdowns. Following the touchdown pass, his day was done as backup Chaston Ditta came in to relieve him. He will likely see more action against Tulsa this Saturday in the team's first conference matchup of the season.

headline: Downgraded to doubtful
story: Haygood (undisclosed) is described as doubtful for North Texas' game at Tulsa, per Brett Vito of the Denton Record-Chronicle.
impact: The tailback was initially considered questionable moving forward after he sat out the Mean Green's win over Houston Christian, but now, he's considered unlikely to play at Tulsa in Week 5. If he does indeed sit out for a second straight week, expect Nick Osho and Colin Page to see more touches behind Jahiem White in North Texas' backfield.

headline: Questionable for Week 5
story: Martin (undisclosed) is questionable for Saturday's game at Tulsa, Brett Vito of the Denton Record-Chronicle reports.
impact: Though there is not much that has changed about Martin's injury status, which was day-to-day last weekend, the fact that he has a better possibility of returning in Week 5 than Brendan Haygood (undisclosed) perhaps presents a legitimate opportunity for the wide receiver to not miss any time. He has been targeted multiple times in each of his last four games and would like to keep the ball rolling against a Tulsa team that may be down its starting quarterback, Baylor Hayes (knee).

headline: Questionable moving forward
story: Haygood (undisclosed) did not play during Saturday's matchup against Houston Christian and is questionable moving forward, per Haylie Stum of the North Texas Daily.
impact: Haygood was held out of Saturday's contest due to an undisclosed injury and will be questionable moving forward. The 5-foot-10 running back has had a solid start to the season, running for 114 yards and two touchdowns on 3.9 YPC through the team's first two games. His next chance to return will come against Tulsa on Thursday.

headline: Day-to-day with injury
story: Martin (undisclosed) is day-to-day moving forward, per Haylie Stum of the North Texas Daily.
impact: Martin suffered an undisclosed injury during Saturday's contest and is day-to-day moving forward. The 5-foot-11 junior had caught two passes for 38 scoreless yards prior to going down. His next chance to return will come against Tulsa on Thursday.

headline: Records first career touchdown
story: Koch reeled in all five targets for 78 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 49-35 defeat to Texas State.
impact: Koch made noise in the receiving corps after failing to record a target over North Texas' first two contests. The wideout reeled in his first collegiate touchdown on a 13-yard catch in the second quarter. It was a pass-heavy day for the offense, though it remains to be seen if he will maintain consistent involvement moving forward following his breakout performance.

headline: Logs first TD of 2026
story: Milliner gathered in 7 of 9 targets for 80 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 49-35 defeat against Texas State.
impact: Milliner continues to be a consistent pass catcher in North Texas' offense, hauling in his first touchdown of the season on a five-yard reception late in the second quarter. He was one of nine different players to record a catch in the contest. The transfer receiver is enjoying a productive start to his tenure with the Mean Green, cementing a steady role within a crowded receiving corps.

headline: Tallies 122 receiving yards
story: Stevenson hauled in 10 of 12 targets for 122 yards during Saturday's 49-35 defeat versus Texas State.
impact: Stevenson posted a breakout game after hauling in just four receptions for 90 yards over North Texas' first two games. He pulled in a team-high 12 targets and 10 receptions on a busy afternoon for the receiving corps. The wideout also recorded the first 100-yard game of his career, emerging as Tayven Jackson's primary target Saturday.

headline: Punches in rushing score
story: Haygood had 11 carries for 50 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 49-35 loss to Texas State.
impact: Haygood surpassed double-digit carries for the second straight game, firmly establishing himself as the primary backup to Jahiem White in the backfield. The running back helped orchestrate a 93-yard scoring drive in the second quarter, punching in a two-yard touchdown.

headline: Registers a score in two ways
story: White recorded 16 rushes for 34 yards and one touchdown and gathered in 7 of 9 targets for 56 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 49-35 defeat to Texas State.
impact: White scored a pair of touchdowns for the second straight game, continuing to be a bright spot in the Mean Green's offense. The running back struggled to find success on the ground but still handled a heavy workload despite the team relying on the passing game for most of the game. He made an impact as a pass catcher as well, hauling in seven receptions to boost his overall production. White has established himself as a workhorse to begin the season and should continue seeing heavy involvement as conference play approaches.

headline: Delivers three passing touchdowns
story: Jackson completed 43 of 57 passes for 483 yards, three touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 49-35 loss against Texas State.
impact: North Texas resorted to relying on Jackson and the passing attack throughout the contest against Texas State as he attempted a staggering 57 passes. He set a career high in passing yards and touchdowns, adding to his strong season numbers. However, the lead signal-caller and the offense went quiet in the second half, scoring only seven points on an 18-yard touchdown pass to Jahiem White. He once again spread the ball evenly, connecting with nine different pass catchers to highlight the depth of the passing game.

headline: Effective rushing and receiving
story: White totaled 12 rushes for 124 yards and one touchdown and caught 2 of 3 targets for 34 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 44-6 win over UNLV.
impact: White made his presence known Saturday by scoring a rushing and receiving touchdown. The running back torched UNLV's defense, rushing for 124 yards on only 12 attempts while finding the end zone for the second straight game. His workload was limited late in the game due to the blowout, with Brendon Haygood relieving him in the third quarter. White looks comfortable in the Mean Green offense and should remain the focal point heading into Week 3 against Texas State.

headline: Bounces back against UNLV
story: Jackson was 15-for-26 passing for 233 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 44-6 win over UNLV. He also had seven rushes for 15 yards with one touchdown.
impact: Jackson found his rhythm against UNLV, contributing three scores in the blowout win. On paper, it seemed like it could be a tough matchup for the quarterback, but he fared well by putting together one of his best games as a starting quarterback in his career. He distributed the ball evenly, finding eight different pass catchers while no individual target hauled in more than three receptions. Jackson will look to continue his momentum against Texas State in Week 3.

headline: Role growing in offense
story: Bryant recorded six receptions (on 11 targets) for 70 yards during Saturday's 35-14 loss to Georgia State.
impact: Bryant stepped up as the Huskies clear number-two receiver behind DeAree Rogers on Saturday. After totaling just eight receptions on 13 targets for 115 yards in his first three games this year, Bryant finished Saturday's contest with the second-most targets on the team. The redshirt sophomore could have value in a NIU offense that's become more pass-heavy with Taron Dickens under center.

headline: Solid outing in loss
story: Johnson notched 15 rushes for 85 yards and a touchdown and reeled in all three targets for 26 yards during Saturday's 35-14 loss to Georgia State.
impact: While NIU was forced into a pass-heavy game script Saturday, Johnson would finish the day with a season-high 85 rushing yards, while punching in a 14-yard touchdown in the first quarter. Through four games, Johnson's totaled 253 yards with a pair of scores on 57 carries.

headline: Another big day
story: Rogers posted nine receptions (on 13 targets) for 107 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 35-14 loss versus Georgia State.
impact: Rogers remains the unquestioned number-one receiver for NIU -- the senior has at least nine receptions and 11 targets in three of his first four games this season. Overall, Rogers has totaled 31 receptions for 252 yards and a pair of touchdowns this year.

headline: Another encouraging start
story: Dickens was 28-for-42 passing for 320 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 35-14 loss to Georgia State.
impact: While NIU would fall to 0-4 on the season, there have been positive signs from Dickens, who's completed 67.1 percent of his throws for 548 yards, two touchdowns and no interceptions in two games since taking over as the starter. Dickens and the Huskies will head into a bye before taking on Air Force at home in Week 6.

headline: Misses blowout loss
story: Weber (undisclosed) did not play in Saturday's 42-17 loss to Arizona.
impact: Weber didn't have an injury designation ahead of the game and hasn't missed one this season, so his inactive status came as a bit of a surprise. The starting tight end will now make an effort to return this Saturday at Georgia State.

headline: Targeted often again
story: Rogers recorded 10 receptions (on 11 targets) for 68 yards during Saturday's 42-17 loss against Arizona.
impact: Rogers was targeted heavily again Saturday, as the Huskies' passing attack looked much better with quarterback Taron Dickens at the helm. After logging just one reception in Week 1, Rogers' has totaled 21 receptions on 24 targets for 142 yards and a touchdown in his last two games.

headline: Three grabs, touchdown in loss
story: Thompson logged three receptions (on six targets) for 62 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 42-17 loss versus Arizona.
impact: After totaling just one reception (for zero yards) in his first two games this year, Thompson appears to have developed some chemistry with quarterback Taron Dickens. The senior wideout finished the day with the second-most receiving yards on the team, thanks in large part to a 52-yard touchdown grab that gave NIU a 10-0 lead in the first quarter. After spending his first two seasons with the Huskies, Thompson transferred to Mississippi State last year where he failed to record any stats, prompting a return to NIU.

headline: Solid in first start
story: Dickens was 25-for-37 passing for 228 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 42-17 loss versus Arizona. He also had seven rushes for nine yards.
impact: Dickens was sharp in his first start this season, as he completed 67.6 percent of his passes while avoiding turnovers against a power-five Arizona defense. Through three games overall, Dickens has completed 71.8 percent of his passes for 517 yards, two touchdowns and two interceptions. He'll lead the offense again next week in a road matchup at Georgia State.

headline: Benched in defeat
story: Macon completed 1 of 3 passes for three yards and an interception during Saturday's 28-24 loss to Illinois State.
impact: It was another rough outing for Macon, who threw an interception on NIU's opening possession before he was benched in favor of Taron Dickens. Through two games, Macon's completed just five of his 13 pass attempts for 20 yards. Expect DIckens to get the call under center next week when the Huskies visit Arizona.

headline: Heavy volume in loss
story: Rogers hauled in 11 of 13 targets for 74 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 28-24 defeat to Illinois State.
impact: After logging just one reception for five yards in a Week 1 loss to Iowa, Rogers firmly established himself as NIU's number-one receiver in Week 2 -- no other player logged more than two receptions in the contest. After totaling 506 yards and three touchdowns on 46 receptions last season, Rogers looks poised to put up even bigger numbers in 2026.

headline: Productive in loss
story: Johnson recorded 22 rushes for 83 yards and a touchdown and reeled in 2 of 3 targets for 10 yards during Saturday's 28-24 loss to Illinois State.
impact: It was an encouraging showing from Johnson, after he logged just eight rushing attempts for 16 yards in Week 1 against Iowa. The junior punched in his first touchdown of the season while seeing a career-high 22 carries. Johnson should remain the focal point of Northern Illinois' offense this year after he totaled 712 rushing yards and four touchdowns in 2025.

headline: Expanded role Saturday
story: Dickens completed 22 of 27 passes for 193 yards, a touchdown and an interception during Saturday's 28-24 loss to Illinois State.
impact: After Jalen Macon struggled mightily to start the game, Dickens wound up taking over under center in the first quarter. Dickens was solid overall, completing 81.5 percent of his passes, but a late interception proved costly as NIU fell to 0-2 with the loss. Through two games, Dickens has completed 31-of-41 pass attempts for 289 yards, a touchdown and two interceptions. He figures to get another extended look next week in a road matchup with Arizona.

headline: Takes over late vs. Iowa
story: Dickens completed 9 of 14 passes for 96 yards and an interception during Saturday's 40-0 defeat against Iowa.
impact: It was announced just before game time that Dickens would back up Jalen Macon. However, Dickens would ultimately enter the game in the third quarter, after Macon completed just four passes for 17 yards. While things didn't go much better for the redshirt junior, NIU could give Dickens a longer look next week in a more favorable matchup with Illinois State. Dickens joined the Huskies in the offseason as a transfer from Western Carolina, where he completed 74.2 percent of his passes for 3,508 yards, 38 touchdowns and just two interceptions in nine games last year.

headline: Moves to Northern Iowa
story: Terrell has transferred to Northern Iowa, per his personal Instagram.
impact: Terrell will link up with the Panthers as he approaches his redshirt junior season. The 5-foot-8 running back rushed 54 times for 161 yards and three touchdowns across five appearances during the 2025 campaign with FAU.

headline: Carrying doubtful tag
story: McDuffie is doubtful for Friday's game against Penn State due to an undisclosed injury.
impact: McDuffie is not part of the regular depth chart for Northwestern, and the doubtful status suggests he won't be an option for this contest. That shouldn't matter much, however, as he's not expected to play regular snaps even if healthy.

headline: Not playing in Week 5
story: McGlinchey (undisclosed) is out for Friday's game against Penn State.
impact: McGlinchey is out for this contest, but the TE isn't part of the regular depth chart and shouldn't have a big role in most fantasy formats.

headline: Questionable to play Friday
story: Eligon (lower body) is questionable for Friday's game against Penn State.
impact: Eligon has missed Northwestern's last two games, and the questionable tag suggests it's far from a certainty that the wideout will play this weekend. Ricky Ahumaraeze and Frank Covey should see an increase in targets if Eligon remains out for a third consecutive week.

headline: Listed as questionable for Week 5
story: Dehnicke (undisclosed) is questionable ahead of Friday's game against Penn State, per the Big Ten availability report.
impact: Dehnicke's status is in the air as he is in jeopardy of missing his first contest of the year. The tight end is coming off a career game against Indiana last week, where he hauled in seven receptions for 140 yards. He luckily still has time to recover over the coming days to give himself a chance to suit up Friday.

headline: Two scores in defeat
story: Wilde notched six receptions (on seven targets) for 56 yards and two touchdowns during Friday's 29-23 loss against Indiana.
impact: Wilde had another productive day for the Wildcats, catching a season-high six passes and finding the end zone for the first (and second) time of the season. The 6-foot-2 senior connected with quarterback Aidan Chiles on touchdowns from four and eight yards out in the third and fourth quarters, helping the Wildcats in their comeback bid. Wilde will hope to find his way back into the end zone when Penn State comes to town on Friday.

headline: Career day in defeat
story: Dehnicke gathered in all seven targets for 140 yards during Friday's 29-23 loss against Indiana.
impact: Dehnicke had a massive day against the Hoosiers, leading the way for Northwestern in both receptions and yards on the day. The 6-foot-6 tight end logged career-high numbers in both categories on the day and was a driving force for the Northwestern offense as the Wildcats came up just short in their comeback bid against the reigning champs. Dehnicke will be hoping to stay involved in the passing game as the Wildcats host Penn State on Friday.

headline: Productive outing in defeat
story: Chiles was 22-for-29 passing for 293 yards and two touchdowns during Friday's 29-23 defeat against Indiana. He also had 13 rushes for zero yards with one touchdown.
impact: Despite the loss, Chiles did what he could to give the Hoosiers a good game as the Wildcats nearly pulled off the comeback victory over the reigning national champs. The 6-foot-4 quarterback connected with receiver Griffin Wilde for a pair of touchdown tosses in the second half before crossing the goalline from seven yards out in the fourth quarter, bringing Northwestern within two points at the time. Chiles has contributed 10 total touchdowns through three games for the Wildcats this season and will look to continue his positive momentum in a home matchup against Penn State on Friday.

headline: Downgraded to out
story: Eligon (lower body) is out for Friday's game against Indiana.
impact: Eligon will miss a second straight game due to a lower body injury. His next chance to return to action will be Oct. 2 against Penn State,

headline: Leads Irish receiving
story: Gilbert topped the Notre Dame receiving with 83 yards on two catches and one touchdown in the Irish 49-10 win over Purdue on Saturday.
impact: This is the second week in a row that Gilbert has led the Irish in receiving. The junior might be the number one receiver for the Irish. Notre Dame could have a tougher time throwing the ball against North Carolina on Oct. 3. The Tar Heels defense is stingy against the pass and is top 50 in the nation.

headline: Improved outing
story: Faison collected 66 receiving yards on four catches in the Irish 49-10 win over Purdue on Saturday.
impact: Faison has been pretty consistent Notre Dame receiver. The senior has averaged 60 receiving yards in the first four games of the season. Faison might have a tougher time against North Carolina on Oct. 3. The Tar Heels defense is stingy against the pass and is top 50 in the nation.

headline: TD saves day
story: James struggled to 28 rushing yards on seven attempts but was able to get into the end zone on a receiving touchdown in the Irish 49-10 win over Purdue on Saturday.
impact: It was a come down for James who accumulated 121 rushing yards on 26 carries against Michigan State the previous week. The sophomore will look to get going again against North Carolina on Oct. 3. The Tar Heels defense is in the middle of the pack against the run in the nation.

headline: Leads ND on the ground
story: Williams got back on the horse after two poor games and led Notre Dame in rushing with 80 yards on 14 carries and a touchdown in the Irish 49-10 win over Purdue on Saturday.
impact: Williams only averaged 27 rushing yards in the two previous games. The junior will be looking to make it back-to-back quality outings when Notre Dame takes on North Carolina. The Tar Heels defense is in the middle of the pack against the run in the nation.

headline: Efficient in win
story: Carr completed 14-of-22 pass attempts for 237 yards and three touchdowns in the Notre Dame 49-10 win over Purdue on Saturday.
impact: Carr added a three-yard rushing touchdown. The junior has not had to put up big numbers against the competition this season. Carr could put up similar numbers against North Carolina on Oct. 3. The Tar Heels defense is stingy against the pass and is top 50 in the nation.

headline: Will undergo season-ending surgery
story: Porter (kneecap) will undergo season-ending surgery, Pete Sampson of The Athletic reports.
impact: By undergoing season-ending surgery, Porter is finished with his 2026 season before it could even begin. He transferred from another top program, Ohio State, to Notre Dame for more opportunities without drastically changing the tier of his football team. Without him available, to pair up with Jordan Faison and Micah Gilbert, supplemental options like Mylan Graham, Jaden Greathouse and others will have to pick up the slack.

headline: Remains weeks away from debut
story: Porter remains a couple weeks away from playing and still isn't practicing with the offense, Pete Sampson of The Athletic reports.
impact: Porter has yet to play this season, and Thursday's update indicates his return is not imminent. Notre Dame will continue to be without the wide receiver for at least the near term while he progresses in his recovery.

headline: Limited in victory
story: Faison only caught five passes for 38 yards in the Notre Dame 27-10 win over Michigan State on Saturday.
impact: Faison took a backset to Micah Gilbert in the passing game. Gilbert caught eight passes for 170 yards. Faison could rebound against Purdue in the next game on Sept. 26. The Boilermakers defense is in the bottom third in the nation against the pass.

headline: Activated from MiLB IL
story: Baez (undisclosed) was activated from the 7-day injured list Sept. 17.
impact: Baez landed on the injured list Aug. 5 due to an unspecified injury. He ran out of time to appear in a game at Double-A Midland before the end of the season, but he's seemingly made a full recovery.

headline: Tallies two hits in season finale
story: Butler went 2-for-4 in Sunday's 9-0 loss to the Astros.
impact: Butler was the lone Athletics player to record multiple hits in the season finale, depositing a pair of singles. The outfielder really turned things around in the second half, slashing .280/.357/.496 with 12 homers, 40 RBI, 33 runs and four stolen bases in 66 games after the All-Star break. Overall, Butler will close 2026 with a .237/.326/.394 slash line, 17 homers, 62 RBI, 64 runs and 10 stolen bases across 154 contests.

headline: Serving as opener Sunday
story: Johnson will serve as the Athletics' opening pitcher for Sunday's game against the Astros, Martin Gallegos of MLB.com reports.
impact: Sunday is Brady Basso's turn in the rotation, so the Athletics may look to use him in bulk relief once Johnson exits the contest. Johnson has worked exclusively as a reliever this season between stops in the big leagues with the Phillies and Athletics, maxing out at 2.2 innings and 50 pitches over his 27 appearances.

headline: Tallies two hits in loss
story: White went 2-for-3 with an RBI in Saturday's 13-2 loss to Houston.
impact: White tallied a pair of hits, including an RBI single in the seventh inning with the contest already well out of hand. The rookie has logged 12 multi-hit games, with three such efforts coming in September. In 55 games, White is slashing .257/.275/.332 with three homers, 10 RBI and 19 runs while seeing action at both first base and third base.

headline: Records 113 receiving yards
story: Neer recorded five receptions (on six targets) for 113 yards during Saturday's 35-7 win against Stonehill.
impact: Despite not recording a touchdown, Neer posted a season-high 113 receiving yards during Saturday's win over Stonehill. The wide receiver brought in five passes for an average of 22.6 yards per catch, including a 34-yard reception from Matt Vezza. In four games, the Ohio native has brought in 21 catches for 316 yards and four touchdowns.

headline: Finds end zone twice in win
story: Rosa compiled 20 carries for 87 yards and two touchdowns and hauled in their only target for four yards during Saturday's 35-7 victory versus Stonehill.
impact: Rosa has scored in three consecutive games after finding the end zone twice Saturday against Stonehill. The running back crossed the goal line on a four-yard run in the second and later scored on a six-yard burst to cement the lead. Through four games, Rosa has 46 rushes for 189 yards and four touchdowns.

headline: Held out vs. Stonehill
story: Brune (undisclosed) did not play during Saturday's 35-7 victory over Stonehill.
impact: Brune was previously listed as questionable for Saturday's cintest due to an undisclosed injury, but he was unable to give it a go against Stonehill. His next chance to return will come against Kent State on Saturday.

headline: Rushes for two TDs in win
story: Vezza was 14-for-20 passing for 207 yards, one touchdown and one interception during Saturday's 35-7 win against Stonehill. He also had six rushes for 39 yards with two touchdowns.
impact: In his second start of the season, Vezza completed 70 percent of his 20 passes while also running in for two scores on the ground. The quarterback started the scoring with an 18-yard rushing touchdown in the first and capped it off with a one-yard score in the third. Vezza also found Dom Dorwart on a 42-yard touchdown in the third quarter. In two starts, the Illinois native has 320 passing yards, 85 rushing yards, five touchdowns and two interceptions.

headline: Out Saturday
story: Ver Steeg (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game versus Stonehill, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Ver Steeg has not appeared in a game yet this season, so his absence won't have much of an effect on the contest. His next chance to suit up is next Saturday at Kent State.

headline: Out vs. Stonehill
story: Grand (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game versus Stonehill, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Grand will continue to miss the start of the season due to an undisclosed issue. The quarterback serves as a depth option and will aim to return against Kent State next Saturday.

headline: Questionable for Saturday
story: Brune (undisclosed) is questionable for Saturday's game versus Stonehill, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Brune, who missed Week 3 due to an undisclosed injury, is still a question mark less than an hour before kickoff versus Stonehill. He had 29 touches for 121 total yards over the first two games of the season, clearly establishing himself as the Bobcats' top back. If he's unable to go, Victor Rosa will likely lead the backfield.

headline: Unavailable for Week 4
story: Poulos (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game against Stonehill, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Poulos will miss his second straight game as he continues to recover from an undisclosed injury he sustained in Week 2. In his absence, Matt Vezza should be the starter under center. The quarterback will aim to return next Saturday against Kent State.

headline: Scores twice in loss
story: Neer reeled in 6 of 8 targets for 61 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 41-36 loss versus South Alabama.
impact: Neer brought in two scores from Matt Vezza during Ohio's narrow loss to South Alabama. The wide receiver reeled in a five-yard pass in the first quarter for a score and another nine-yard reception in the third to cut the lead. This season, Neer has 16 catches, 203 yards and four touchdowns.

headline: Catches first career TD
story: Dorwart had five receptions (on six targets) for 61 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 41-36 loss against South Alabama.
impact: Dorwart tied Riley Neer for the team-high in receiving yards (61) while corralling his first career touchdown. Levi Davis found Dorwart on a 21-yard reception in the end zone as time expired.

headline: Leading rusher in loss
story: Rosa accrued 13 rushes for 78 yards and one touchdown and gathered in all two targets for 13 yards during Saturday's 41-36 defeat versus South Alabama.
impact: Rosa recorded his season-high in rushing yards (78) after averaging six yards per carry on 13 attempts. The running back crossed the goal line on a 33-yard run to cut the lead in the third quarter.

headline: Contributes pair of scores
story: Davis completed 9 of 15 passes for 121 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 41-36 defeat against South Alabama. He also had four rushes for 27 yards.
impact: Davis relieved Matt Vezza in the fourth quarter with the Bobcats trailing by 17. Davis found AJ Miller in the end zone on a 10-yard pass and tossed another score to Dom Dorwart as time expired in regulation.

headline: Scores twice in defeat
story: Vezza was 12-for-16 passing for 113 yards, two touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 41-36 loss against South Alabama. He also had nine rushes for 46 yards.
impact: Vezza completed 75 percent of his passes for 113 yards while also recording 46 yards on the ground. The quarterback found Riley Neer in the end zone twice before being relieved by Levi Davis later in the game. The Bobcats will have a decision to make about who will be under center next week against Stonehill.

headline: Won't play Saturday
story: Brune (undisclosed) is listed as out for Ohio's game at South Alabama, per the MAC injury report.
impact: Brune was expected to play as of Friday, but the tailback will sit out for Week 3 against the Jaguars. He's notched 27 carries for 98 yards this season as well as two catches for 23 yards, but in his stead, expect Victor Rosa and Mike Taylor to handle more carries.

headline: Will start Saturday at QB, share some snaps
story: Vezza will start at quarterback for Ohio on Saturday at South Alabama,Pete Thamel of ESPN reports. However, he will share some snaps with freshman Levi Davis.
impact: This puts Vezza in line to handle the Bobcats' first snaps after Nick Poulos' status had been in question, and Poulos has now officially been ruled out. Vezza performed well in relief last week and will aim to back it up with another strong performance Saturday.

headline: Out vs. South Alabama
story: Poulos (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game at South Alabama, per Pete Thamel of ESPN.com.
impact: Poulos will sit out his first game of the season after suffering a late hit against Jacksonville State last week. Ohio will turn to New Hampshire transfer Matt Vezza to man the helm at quarterback, but true freshman Levi Davis is also expected to take snaps. Poulos will continue to recover and aim to return against Stonehill next Saturday.

headline: Expected to be available Week 3
story: Vezza (undisclosed) is expected to be available for Saturday's game at South Alabama, Pete Nakos of On3.com reports.
impact: Nakos' update indicates that Vezza is probable going into Week 3, which is an excellent development for him, especially knowing that Ohio's starting quarterback Nick Poulos (undisclosed) may be out Saturday. In place of Poulos, Vezza completed all but two of his 12 pass attempts for 80 yards and one touchdown. The dual-threat quarterback also logged 12 rushing attempts for 67 yards, a balanced output whose continuation could earn him the team's QB1 role if he can harness said output.

headline: Questionable for Week 3
story: Poulos (undisclosed) is questionable for Saturday's game at South Alabama, Pete Nakos of On3.com reports.
impact: Poulos suffered a Week 2 injury against Jacksonville State because of a late hit from a defensive player, which explains his questionable status going into Week 3. If the senior cannot go, his backup is Matt Vezza (undisclosed), also injured mid-game Week 2 but entering Saturday's game probable. Poulos has not proven to be an excellent option under center just yet, so it is imperative that he makes himself available to give himself a shot at maintaining the team's QB1 role.

headline: Expected to be available Week 3
story: Brune (undisclosed) is expected to be available for Saturday's game at South Alabama, Pete Nakos of On3.com reports.
impact: Brune's injury status improves from questionable to probable, and he can be fully cleared with the MAC availability report by the time Saturday comes around. This is a welcome development for him, as Ohio relied on his expertise back in Weeks 1 and 2, particularly the latter. Brune logged 18 rushing attempts for 66 yards against Jacksonville State in Week 2, and playing a far-from-excellent South Alabama could allow him a prime opportunity to get a lot of touches in Week 3.

headline: Question mark for Iowa game
story: Bey (ankle) is questionable to play in Ohio State's clash with Iowa on Saturday, per Dan Hope of ElevenWarriors.com.
impact: The tailback has battled an ankle issue in the early part of the 2026 campaign for the Buckeyes. He was technically available for Week 4 as he was absent from the injury report, although he didn't see the field. Bey will look to return for a big showdown with Iowa, but head coach Ryan Day says his availability depends on how he looks in practice.

headline: Ties team record with four touchdowns
story: Smith recorded 12 receptions (on 16 targets) for 217 yards and four touchdowns during Saturday's 42-19 victory against Illinois.
impact: Smith's Ohio State record-tying four-touchdown performance went along with a career-high 12 catches for 217 yards, adding to a Heisman campaign that's looking brighter every week. He leads the FBS with 617 recieving yards and is tied with Collin Dixon and KJ Duff atop the ladder with seven touchdowns.

headline: Modest output in blowout
story: Jackson totaled 11 rushes for 53 yards and reeled in 3 of 4 targets for 16 yards during Saturday's 42-19 victory over Illinois.
impact: Jackson shared running back duties evenly with Ja'Kobi Jackson last week against Illinois, but Bo Jackson is usually the first man up in Ohio State's backfield. He will face a stern test next week against an Iowa defense that is strong against the run.

headline: Finds end zone in decisive win
story: Jackson had 10 carries for 56 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 42-19 victory versus Illinois.
impact: The impending margin of victory gave both Jacksons ample opportunities in the backfield, as Jackson logged a total similar to teammate Bo Jackson in the blowout. The Florida transfer has logged 206 yards and five touchdowns this season and is a perfect change-of-pace option for the Buckeyes.

headline: Logs season-best passing performance
story: Sayin was 27-for-36 passing for 367 yards and four touchdowns during Saturday's 42-19 win over Illinois. He also had seven rushes for 29 yards with one touchdown.
impact: Sayin shines with season highs in passing yards (367) and touchdowns (4) in a decisive beatdown over Illinois. Sayin has the luxury of throwing to Jeremiah Smith, who built on his resume with all four of Sayin's touchdown passes. The opposing defense tightens up next week against Iowa, but Sayin's connection to Smith is proving to be matchup-proof.

headline: Strong outing in loss
story: Sategna gathered in 8 of 9 targets for 81 yards during Saturday's 41-13 loss to Georgia.
impact: Sategna matched tight end Rocky Beers for the team lead with eight catches. The senior wide receiver has back-to-back games with at least six receptions combined with 80 receiving yards and will hope to extend his streak against the Longhorns on Oct 10.

headline: Productive outing in loss
story: Beers reeled in 8 of 9 targets for 84 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 41-13 loss versus Georgia.
impact: Beers led Oklahoma in receiving yards while also reeling in a 17-yard touchdown from quarterback John Mateer. The eight receptions were a season high, giving him another productive his second outing with at least six receptions. The 6-foot-5 tight end will aim to build on this performance for the team's meeting against Texas Oct. 10.

headline: Tosses two scores in loss
story: Mateer completed 25 of 34 passes for 231 yards, two touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 41-13 loss against Georgia. He also had 15 rushes for seven yards.
impact: Mateer's passing line was respectable against Georgia, completing 73.5 percent of his attempts, but also finished with two turnovers. The senior quarterback has not thrown for more than 238 yards this season as the offense continues to struggle getting into rhythm. He will face the Longhorn at home next.

headline: What We Learned
story: ATHENS - It was another stress-free victory for Kirby Smart and the Georgia Bulldogs over the weekend and they smothered John Mateer and the...

headline: Cashes in on Cowboys' breakout
story: Keltner converted on 4-for-4 field-goal attempts and 3-for-3 point-after tries during Saturday's 41-24 victory versus West Virginia.
impact: Keltner played a key role in Oklahoma State's 41-point outburst, connecting on all four of his field-goal attempts from 19, 29, 30, and 47 yards. The Cowboys' offense moved the ball almost at will against West Virginia, creating plenty of scoring opportunities and allowing Keltner to deliver his best fantasy performance of the season. If Drew Mestemaker and company continue operating at this level, Keltner could become one of the more reliable kicking options in the Big 12.

headline: Keeps finding the end zone
story: Lewis gathered in 2 of 3 targets for 31 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 41-24 victory over West Virginia.
impact: Lewis scored for the second consecutive game, hauling in a touchdown as part of Oklahoma's second-half offensive explosion. The interesting wrinkle is that Lewis has managed to score in back-to-back weeks despite seeing just five combined targets during that span, highlighting both his efficiency and reliance on finding the end zone. Until the target volume increases, he'll remain more touchdown-dependent than some of his teammates, but it's hard to ignore a player who keeps producing when called upon.

headline: Consistency continues
story: Bowick hauled in 4 of 6 targets for 63 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 41-24 win over West Virginia.
impact: Bowick continued to carve out a dependable role in the Cowboys' offense. While Wyatt Young commands the spotlight, Bowick now has seen at least six targets in all four games this season, providing a steady volume floor that fantasy managers can trust. His consistent involvement makes him a valuable secondary option in a passing attack that continues to generate big plays.

headline: Continues his WR1 campaign
story: Young reeled in 8 of 9 targets for 192 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 41-24 win versus West Virginia.
impact: Young further cemented himself as Oklahoma State's clear number one receiver, erupting for a season-high 192 yards. He now has a touchdown in three straight games and remains the centerpiece of one of the Big 12's most explosive passing attacks. With Drew Mestemaker playing at a high level, Young is quickly becoming one of the most reliable fantasy receivers in the conference.

headline: Handles workhorse workload
story: Hawkins had 31 carries for 180 yards and one touchdown and gathered in 0 of 1 targets for zero yards during Saturday's 41-24 victory over West Virginia.
impact: Hawkins turned in his best performance of the season, carrying the ball 31 times with a touchdown. The workload was every bit as impressive as the production, as Hawkins set season highs in both carries and rushing yards while helping the Cowboys control the second half. With Oklahoma State's offense firing on all cylinders and Hawkins emerging as the clear lead back, his fantasy stock is trending sharply upward entering the heart of Big 12 play.

headline: Dismantles the Mountaineers
story: Mestemaker was 20-for-27 passing for 389 yards, three touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 41-24 win against West Virginia.
impact: Mestemaker delivered one of the best quarterback performances in the Big 12 this season, carving up West Virginia for a season-high 389 passing yards in a comeback victory. He bounced back immediately after a third-quarter interception, guiding the Cowboys to scores on five straight possessions and finishing with his third straight 300-yard passing game. With Oklahoma State's offense clicking and a deep group of playmakers around him, Mestemaker is rapidly becoming one of the conference's most reliable fantasy quarterbacks.

headline: Will play against West Virginia
story: Barnes (undisclosed) will play in Saturday's game against West Virginia, per Marshall Scott of Pistols Firing.
impact: Barnes was spotted in full uniform running routes before kickoff, confirming that the wideout will be an option in the Cowboys' offense Saturday. The wideout is set to return after a one-game absence and has hauled in seven receptions for 87 yards in two appearances this season.

headline: Officially game-time call for Saturday
story: Barnes (undisclosed) is listed officially as a game-time decision for Saturday's contest against West Virginia, per the Big 12 availability report.
impact: Barnes was deemed probable on the previous report, but he's not officially clear as the contest approaches. It will be worth monitoring Barnes' status as the contest approaches, but consider him a probable lean, given his previous designation on the report.

headline: Huge day in loss to Florida
story: Alexander totaled seven receptions (on eight targets) for 134 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 52-28 defeat versus Florida.
impact: Alexander continues to be the most consistent target in the Ole Miss offense as he now has three straight games with seven or more receptions. Alexander also put up his second 100-yard receiving performance of the season while reeling in his fourth touchdown grab on the year as well.

headline: Five grabs in loss to Florida
story: Odom caught 5 of 6 targets for 47 yards during Saturday's 52-28 defeat to Florida.
impact: Odom had a very solid five grabs against the Gators as he has truly become a consistent piece of the Ole Miss passing attack. unfortunately Odom wasn't able to break loose for any big plays or touchdowns in this one. The continued volume for Odom is very encouraging for his fantasy outlook going forward.

headline: Three touchdowns in loss to Florida
story: Chambliss was 25-for-34 passing for 298 yards, one touchdown and one interception during Saturday's 52-28 loss to Florida. He also had seven rushes for 44 yards with two touchdowns...
impact: Chambliss put together another high-level performance as he racked up over 300 total yards for the third time in four games on the season. Chambliss continues to be one of the most effective quarterbacks in college football as he has now accumulated 8 passing touchdowns and four rushing touchdowns with over 1,200 yards through the air.

headline: Finds end zone in victory
story: Moore posted three receptions (on five targets) for 42 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 41-27 win over USC.
impact: Moore's involvement was lower than normal, but he still found his way to the end zone for the fourth time this season. The wideout should keep thriving as the team faces UCLA after the bye week.

headline: Shares backfield with Hill
story: Davison compiled 16 rushes for 66 yards and one touchdown and hauled in their only target for four yards during Saturday's 41-27 victory over USC.
impact: While Diierre Hill turned heads as a pass-catcher, Davison stuck to the ground game and finished with a total similar to Hill's in the win. Oregon tends to ride the hot hand, but the backs fulfilled slightly different roles against the Trojans.

headline: Finds end zone against USC
story: Stewart tallied seven receptions (on nine targets) for 56 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 41-27 win against USC.
impact: Stewart was once again a preferred target for the offense, and there was very little drop-off after Dylan Raiola entered the game to relieve Dante Moore (concussion). Regardless of who throws the ball, Stewart is an NFL-ready wideout with all the necessary skills to be a difference-maker.

headline: Stellar in cirtical win
story: Johnson gathered in all seven targets for 119 yards during Saturday's 41-27 win versus USC.
impact: Johnson grabbed all seven of his targets, completing a masterful performance. Although he failed to score a touchdown, an opportunity is sure to come his way again soon, potentially after the bye week against UCLA.

headline: Excels as pass-catccher
story: Hill posted 15 carries for 63 yards and two touchdowns and caught 4 of 5 targets for 105 yards during Saturday's 41-27 victory against USC.
impact: Hill had a nose for the end zone against USC, and his biggest contribution was out in the open as a passing target. He'll continue to share the backfield with Jordon Davison, but the Ducks will use him often in passing situations.

headline: Continues frosh run
story: Legree led Oregon State again in receiving, this time with 109 yards on 10 catches and two touchdowns in the Oregon State 33-7 win over UTEP on Saturday.
impact: Legree has hit the right time to show up at Oregon State. The Beavers have become a pass-happy team. As a freshman, Legree has 23 catches for 585 yards and six touchdowns. The true freshman has a good chance of adding to his receiving numbers against Colorado State on Oct. 3. The Rams defense is in the middle of the nation against the pass.

headline: Career best on the ground
story: Newberry registered his personal best in rushing yards to lead Oregon State with 111 yards on 11 carries and one touchdown in the Oregon State 33-7 win over UTEP on Saturday.
impact: Newberry leads the Beavers on the ground with 181 yards. While the seniors is the top ball carrier for Oregon State, the Beavers are more of a passing team. Newberry has a good chance of putting up quality rushing numbers in their next game against Colorado State on Oct. 3. The Rams defense is near the bottom in the country against the run and have allowed a dozen touchdowns so far this season.

headline: Continues to pile up yards, TDs
story: Atkinson completed 24-of-34 pass attempts for 301 yards and three touchdowns in the Oregon State 33-7 win over UTEP on Saturday.
impact: Atkinson has averaged 356 passing yards and approximately three touchdowns per game in his first four contests at Oregon State. The sophomore will look to add to his passing numbers against Colorado State on Oct. 3. The Rams defense is in the middle of the country against the pass.

headline: Continues prolific year
story: Atkinson completed 22-of-30 pass attempts for 333 yards and five touchdowns in the Oregon State 52-17 win over Montana on Saturday.
impact: Atkinson also contributed a rushing touchdown on only two carries for four yards. The Mercer transfer has already accumulated 1,122 passing yards including eight touchdowns. The Beavers take on UTEP on Sept. 26. UTEP defense is top 40 in the country against the pass, but the Miners were blown out by both Oklahoma and Michigan who mainly utilized the running game.

headline: Contributes on the ground, air
story: Newberry accumulated 100 total yards in the Oregon State 52-17 win over Montana on Saturday.
impact: Newberry caught four passes for 55 yards and also ran seven times for 45 yards in the Beavers first victory of the year. Oregon State takes on UTEP on Sept. 26. The Miners defense is in the bottom third against the run.

headline: Hits paydirt in win
story: Olsen only had three catches for 35 yards including a 19-yard touchdown in the Oregon State 52-17 win over Montana on Saturday.
impact: It was the first touchdown of the season for the senior tight end. The Beavers take on UTEP on Sept. 26. UTEP defense is top 40 in the country against the pass, but the Miners were blown out by both Oklahoma and Michigan who mainly utilized the running game.

headline: Career best in win
story: Hampton had a personal best 94 receiving yards on six catches and a touchdown in the Oregon State 52-17 win over Montana on Saturday.
impact: As a true freshman, Legree has already caught 476 receiving yards on only 17 catches, averaging 28 yards per reception and four touchdowns. The Beavers take on UTEP on Sept. 26. UTEP defense is top 40 in the country against the pass, but the Miners were blown out by both Oklahoma and Michigan who mainly utilized the running game.

headline: Leads Beavers in receiving
story: Legree continues to be the favorite in the Oregon State passing game with another triple digit receiving game, this time 100 yards on four catches and a touchdown in the Oregon Sta...
impact: As a true freshman, Legree has already caught 476 receiving yards on only 17 catches, averaging 28 yards per reception and four touchdowns. The Beavers take on UTEP on Sept. 26. UTEP defense is top 40 in the country against the pass, but the Miners were blown out by both Oklahoma and Michigan who mainly utilized the running game.

headline: Plays against Montana
story: Freauff (lower body) failed to haul in his lone target during Saturday's 52-17 win over Montana.
impact: Freauff made his season debut Saturday but couldn't log a stat. It's possible that the team is easing him back into live action due to him dealing with a lower body ailment since the beginning of the season. In 2025 with Oregon, he hauled in 12 receptions for 144 yards and one touchdown.

headline: Dressed ahead of kickoff
story: Freatuff (lower body) is dressed out ahead of kickoff, per James Crepea of The Oregonian.
impact: Freauff was spotted in early warmups, and now he's suited up ahead of kickoff. He's certainly trending towards playing for the Beavers, although nothing is official.

headline: Participating in early warmups
story: Freauff (lower body) was spotted in early warm-ups ahead of Saturday's game against Montana, James Crepea of The Oregonian reports.
impact: Freauff is going through the early portion of warmups, but it remains to be seen whether he'll stay involved in the latter portion of the pre-game workout to determine his availability. The wideout has yet to play this season, and his return would give the Beavers a huge boost in the passing game since he was the team's leading WR in 2025.

headline: Questionable vs. Grizzlies
story: Freauff (lower body) is questionable to face Montana on Saturday, per James Crepea of OregonLive.
impact: Freauff was reportedly able to run this week at practice, but he remains a question mark for Week 3. The wideout, who's the Beavers' leading returning receiver, has yet to play this season. He could change that against Montana come Saturday night.

headline: Good to go for Week 5
story: Black (undisclosed) is available for Friday's game at Northwestern.
impact: Black was a DNP in the Week 4 contest against Wisconsin, but he should be available for this contest. That said, he's a depth option in the receiving corps, so his return to action shouldn't cause a big impact in most fantasy formats.

headline: Questionable vs. Northwestern
story: Rosa (undisclosed) is questionable for Friday's game against Northwestern.
impact: Rosa is a depth option at kicker and isn't expected to see regular playing time. Thus, his absence won't cause a big issue in most fantasy formats.

headline: Lone bright spot in loss
story: Sowell compiled six receptions (on nine targets) for 70 yards during Saturday's 24-20 loss against Wisconsin.
impact: Sowell was the only offensive option to deliver positive results, as Wisconsin neutralized Rocco Becht and the running game. The Nittany Lions will try to turn things around against Northwestern next week.

headline: Sees heavy regression in upset loss
story: Becht completed 12 of 29 passes for 114 yards and one interception during Saturday's 24-20 loss against Wisconsin. He also had 10 rushes for 23 yards with one touchdown.
impact: Becht was a shell of himself against Wisconsin, looking nothing like the efficient signal-caller he has been so far this season. I'ts obvious that the Nittany Lions have some things to work out before facing Northwestern in Week 5.

headline: DNP vs. Wisconsin
story: Black (undisclosed) did not play during Saturday's 24-20 loss to Penn State.
impact: Black was previously noted to be trending in the right direction ahead of Saturday's contest but he was once again held out against the Badgers. It's unclear whether his absence was due to the injury or simply his position on the depth chart, but his status will continue to be worth monitoring moving forward. His next chance to return will come against Northwestern on Friday.

headline: Starting vs. Wisconsin
story: Rappleyea (undisclosed) is starting in Saturday's game against Wisconsin, Noah Aberegg of The Daily Collegian reports.
impact: Rappleyea was listed as a game-time decision as he was dealing with an undisclosed injury but appears to be ready to go. The redshirt junior tight end will aim to build on his performance last week, where he totaled three receptions for 24 yards and his first touchdown of the season.

headline: GDT Saturday
story: Rappleyea (undisclosed) is listed as a game-time decision ahead of Saturday's game against Wisconsin.
impact: Rappleyea is in danger of missing his first game of the season as he tends an undisclosed injury. The junior tight end has totaled five receptions for 47 yards and one touchdown this season. More news regarding his status should surface shortly.

headline: Posts nine tackles in Week 3 loss
story: Campbell totaled nine tackles (four solo) in Monday's loss to the Bears.
impact: Campbell was one of three Philadelphia defenders to co-lead the squad with nine stops. The second-year linebacker has gotten off to a strong start to the campaign in the tackling department, as he is tied for seventh in the NFL with 28 stops through three contests. Campbell had 80 tackles over 17 regular-season games last year, and he's well above pace to surpass that mark in 2026.

headline: Goes back to practice squad
story: Ertz reverted to the Eagles' practice squad Tuesday, per the NFL's transaction log.
impact: Ertz brought in one of two targets for nine yards during Monday's 27-7 loss at Chicago. It was a mostly uneventful return to his old team, but given he was just signed a week ago, it's relatively impressive he led Philadelphia's tight ends in targets in Week 3. With starter Dallas Goedert's (knee) near-term availability still uncertain and rookie second-rounder Eli Stowers (hamstring) still on IR, Ertz has a good chance of being called up again for a Week 4 matchup versus the Rams.

headline: Joins Philly's active roster
story: The Eagles signed Moore from the practice squad to the active roster Tuesday.
impact: The Colts released Moore in early May, and the defensive back joined up with the Eagles' practice squad Sept. 22. The deal was always that Moore would eventually be promoted to the 53-man roster and given a one-year, $3 million contract with the team. That time has come, and Moore is set to be the primary depth option in the Eagles' secondary for the remainder of the 2026 season.

headline: Held quiet in Week 3 loss
story: Wicks recorded two receptions for 32 yards on five targets in Monday's 27-7 loss to the Bears.
impact: Though he didn't find paydirt, Wicks played a critical role on the Eagles' lone scoring drive on the night late in the second quarter, leading off the possession with a 13-yard catch and run. He was otherwise held in check while the game was still competitive, with his lone other reception coming with 6:30 remaining, when the Bears had built a 20-point lead. Through his first three games with Philadelphia, Wicks has produced a 9-179-1 receiving line on 15 targets.

headline: Notches three receptions in loss
story: Lemon recorded three receptions for 29 yards on four targets in Monday's 27-7 loss to the Bears.
impact: After taking the field for north of 60 percent of the snaps in both of the Eagles' first two contests, Lemon wasn't a major beneficiary of the absence of tight end Dallas Goedert (knee). Even though the Eagles leaned more heavily on three-wide formations, Lemon saw only a slight uptick in playing time Monday, logging 35 of 50 snaps (70 percent). The rookie first-round pick appears to be little more than a tertiary option in the passing game at this stage of his career, as he's thus far been held to seven catches for 38 yards on nine targets through his first three NFL games.

headline: Good to go for Week 5
story: Wright is good to go for Week 5 against Virginia Tech on Friday, according to Brendan Howe of On3.com.
impact: Wright didn't play against FCS Bucknell in Week 4, but the tailback shouldn't have problems suiting up Friday in this ACC matchup. Wright has 31 carries for 141 yards and a touchdown, as well as three catches for 33 yards on seven targets, in three games this season.

headline: Probable vs. Virginia Tech
story: Cook (undisclosed) is listed as probable ahead of Friday's game at Virginia Tech, per the ACC availability report.
impact: Cook is on the right track to suit up Friday after carrying a probable tag on Pittsburgh's initial injury report. The running back serves as a depth option, so he isn't expected to see a heavy workload if he takes the field.

headline: Officially questionable for Week 5
story: Turner (undisclosed) is questionable ahead of Friday's game at Virginia Tech, per the ACC availability report.
impact: Turner has not played since Week 1 and his status remains uncertain as he carries a questionable tag. The running back is the lead option in Pittsburgh's backfield, but Damon Ferguson has seen increased work in his stead. He will aim to recover in the coming days to potentially upgrade his status ahead of Friday's game.

headline: Totals 66 receiving yards in win
story: Hicks secured three receptions for 66 yards during Saturday's 59-0 win against Bucknell.
impact: Hicks was outshined by his fellow starting receiver Censere Lee, who had three touchdowns in the rout. Hicks was unable to get in on the scoring fun, but the 66 yards were respectable, as he didn't play the entire game. The second half saw the reserves take over and get valuable playing time. Hicks will look to re-discover the end zone Friday at Virginia Tech, as conference play resumes.

headline: Scores TD vs. Bucknell
story: Kent recorded six catches for 57 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 59-0 victory over Bucknell.
impact: It was another Oprah game for the Pitt passing game on Saturday. You get a touchdown, you get a touchdown...everybody gets a touchdown! Pitt had eight receiving scores on Saturday in rout of the Bison, and Kent led the team with six receptions. He'll look to carry over the momentum on a short week Friday at Virginia Tech, as the Panthers return to conference play.

headline: Finds end zone three times in rout
story: Lee logged five receptions, 47 yards and three touchdowns during Saturday's 59-0 victory versus Bucknell.
impact: The senior has hooked up with QB Mason Heintschel for four touchdowns through four games this season, and he has five catches in two of those four outings. It was his first multi-score game since he had two touchdowns at Chattanooga playing for Western Carolina in 2023. He'll look to keep up the good work in Friday's game at Virginia Tech.

headline: Good for two touchdowns in win
story: McCray totaled three receptions, 73 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 59-0 victory over Bucknell.
impact: McCray was seeing some extra snaps with the game out of hand, and he showed the coaching staff that he is more than equal to the task if needed. The freshman has posted multiple receptions in his two appearances this season. The two touchdowns were the first of his collegiate career.

headline: Racks up 77 receiving yards
story: Yates had four receptions for 77 yards during Saturday's 59-0 win versus Bucknell.
impact: The sophomore from Ettrick, Va. has carved out a nice role for himself in the Pitt offense, and he has multiple receptions in every game this season. However, he hasn't found the end zone since Week 1 against Miami (Ohio). Yates might play with a little extra intensity in Friday's game at Virginia Tech, likely playing in front of plenty of family and friends.

headline: Explodes onto scene in rout of Bucknell
story: Robinson totaled five receptions for a game-high 78 yards and his first collegiate touchdown during Saturday's 59-0 victory versus Bucknell.
impact: The five receptions were easily Robinson's career high. In fact, he only appeared in two games on offense in 2024, including two receptions for seven yards in the GameAbove Sports Bowl against Toledo on Dec. 26, 2024, while posting just one grab in the regular season. He didn't play in 2025, so this was a big day for Robinson.
