As long as Cataurus Hicks and Censere Lee stay healthy, there aren't a lot of targets for the wideout, but Robinson showed he can do the job if his number is called.

headline: Registers six carries in lopsided win
story: Brown tallied six rushes for 41 yards during Saturday's 59-0 win over Bucknell.
impact: Brown did a good job when his number was called, as the Panthers went three-deep with Damon Ferguson Jr., Synkwan Smith and Brown seeing six or more carries and at least 41 rushing yards each against the Bison. The schedule gets a lot tougher from here, and Brown's chances might dry up as a result. Plus, RB Ja'Kyrian Turner (undisclosed) might also return soon, adding to the difficulty in finding touches going forward.

headline: Leads backfield with solid average
story: Ferguson accrued nine carries for 56 yards during Saturday's 59-0 win against Bucknell.
impact: Ferguson racked up a team-high in rushing yards, but it was a community effort in a lopsided game. He averaged 6.2 yards per carry, including a 21-yard scamper, but then he ceded touches to Synkwan Smith and Jaylin Brown. RB Ja'Kyrian Turner continues to miss time with an undisclosed injury, but once he joins the mix, it should push everyone down a spot on the depth chart, so beware.

headline: Six more TD passes in rout
story: Heintschel was 29-for-37 passing for 403 yards and six touchdowns during Saturday's 59-0 victory versus Bucknell. He also had three rushes for 33 yards.
impact: It's been feast or famine for Heintschel so far this season, as he has six or more TD passes in routs of Miami (Ohio) and Bucknell, and no TD throws against UCF or Syracuse. He and the Panthers take the trip to Blacksburg to visit Virginia Tech, and it might be a big-time regression against a Hokies team playing well under new coach James Franklin.

headline: Opportune time for return
story: Smith (undisclosed) logged 10 carries for 47 yards during Saturday's 59-0 win against Bucknell.
impact: After beginning Pittsburgh's 2026 season on the mend, Smith finally logged backfield action Saturday. Ja'Kyrian Turner (undisclosed) being limited and Pitt dominating Bucknell allowed the Panthers to experiment. In doing so, among their running backs, Smith led them in carries. Though the redshirt freshman's role is unknown, especially once Turner returns and with competition like Week 4 starter Damon Ferguson, his performance against Bucknell indicates that he has at least a small chance to immediately flourish.

headline: Out without timetable to return
story: Knight (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game versus Bucknell and does not have a timetable for return, Brendan Howe of On3.com reports.
impact: Though Knight's injury is not season-ending, it's currently unclear when he'll be able to return to the field for the Panthers. He caught seven passes for 73 yards and a touchdown across the first two games of the season, so he will be missed while he's out of the lineup.

headline: Unlikely to play Week 4
story: Turner (undisclosed) is unlikely to play in Saturday's game against Bucknell, Brendan Howe of On3 reports.
impact: Damon Ferguson is taking first-team snaps in Pittsburgh's pregame warm-up instead of Turner, who is on pace to sit out for the third time across four games Pitt has played this month. Though the running back's previous update suggests that him sitting out Week 4 was more likely than not, it looks like he will have little leeway before Pitt immediately returns to conference action in October.

headline: Secures three receptions in win
story: Yates reeled in all three targets for 36 yards during Thursday's 27-13 win against Syracuse.
impact: Yates was second in receiving yardage in a rough night for the Pittsburgh offense. There weren't a lot of bright spots, but Yates was one of them, outperforming the more heralded receivers like Cataurus Hicks and Censere Lee. We'll see if Yates gets more targets when Bucknell pays a visit next Saturday.

headline: Limited to just one catch
story: Hicks posted one reception on three targets for eight yards during Thursday's 27-13 win over Syracuse.
impact: Hicks ended up with a single grab, while his fellow starting receiver, Censere Lee, also had just a single 9-yard grab. It's not time to hit the panic button just yet, however. The Panthers offense could right the ship in a favorable matchup against FCS Bucknell next Saturday.

headline: Nearly non-existent in home win
story: Lee tallied one reception on four targets for nine yards during Thursday's 27-13 victory against Syracuse.
impact: Lee and Cataurus Hicks combined for just two receptions and 17 yards, as QB Mason Heintschel struggled for a second consecutive game. Don't panic yet, especially if you have fantasy stock in the receivers, as the Panthers face a very favorable matchup against Bucknell of the FCS next time out.

headline: Paces Panthers with 63 receiving yards
story: Kent hauled in two of his four targets for 63 yards during Thursday's 27-13 victory over Syracuse.
impact: Kent was a nice weapon in the passing game, posting receptions for 38 and 25 yards. The 38-yard hook-up with QB Mason Heintschel was the longest play from scrimmage for either side. If Kent could see a few more targets, Kent could be a solid option at a position which can be a bit of a fantasy wasteland.

headline: Runs for 81 yards, touchdown
story: Wright compiled 14 carries for 81 yards and one touchdown and reeled in 1 of 2 targets for five yards during Thursday's 27-13 victory over Syracuse.
impact: Wright and Damon Ferguson Jr. (10-102-1) made for a tremendous one-two punch for the Panthers, as they won their ACC opener while staying unbeaten overall through three games. The Panthers rolled up 245 rushing yards and 6.6 yards per attempt, while scoring three times on the ground. Wright entered the game averaging just 3.5 yards per carry, but he had a breakout performance against the Orange. The Panthers should have another big rushing performance next time out against Bucknell of the FCS in a favorable matchup.

headline: Doesn't do much against Syracuse
story: Heintschel completed 10 of 23 passes for 123 yards and one interception during Thursday's 27-13 victory over Syracuse. He also had 11 rushes for 41 yards with one touchdown.
impact: Heintschel was able to find the end zone with his legs, but after tying a school record with seven passing touchdowns in the opener against Miami (Ohio), Heintschel has been shut out on passing touchdowns in each of the past two games. The Panthers face Bucknell of the FCS next time, so he could use that game to get back on track.

headline: Homers in finale
story: Griffin went 2-for-4 with a home run and two RBI in Sunday's 4-2 win over the Tigers.
impact: Griffin opened the scoring with a leadoff blast before adding an RBI single in the fourth inning. The 20-year-old posted middling numbers in September in his return from injury, hitting .264 with eight extra-base hits, eight RBI, eight runs scored and three stolen bases over 21 games. While his first stint in the majors didn't exactly live up to the hype, Griffin slashed a respectable .272/.324/.404 with six homers, 33 RBI, 43 runs scored and 23 steals across 339 plate appearances and still remains one of the game's top dynasty assets.

headline: Throws four scoreless in finale
story: Jones did not factor into the decision in Sunday's 4-2 win over the Tigers, allowing one hit and no walks while striking out five over four scoreless innings.
impact: Jones was dominant, throwing 36 of 55 pitches for strikes with 10 whiffs while retiring the first six batters he faced. It was an exclamation point on an excellent September in which he went 3-0 with a 0.93 ERA and 40:4 K:BB over five outings. The 25-year-old enjoyed a strong bounceback campaign after undergoing elbow surgery in 2025, posting a 3.72 ERA, 1.08 WHIP and 123:31 K:BB across 101.2 innings after making his season debut May 29.

headline: Rebounds for 18th save
story: Montgomery earned the save in Sunday's 4-2 win over the Tigers, striking out two in a perfect ninth inning.
impact: Montgomery was called on one night after blowing a save and closed the door on 14 pitches. It was a strong end to a stellar second half in which he went 17-for-18 in save chances with a 1.42 ERA over 32 appearances. Overall, the southpaw enjoyed a breakout campaign, posting a 2.88 ERA, 1.03 WHIP and 105:26 K:BB across 68.2 innings while tallying nine holds and 18 saves.

headline: Logs one tackle in win
story: Watt made one tackle in the Steelers' 30-27 win over the Bengals on Sunday.
impact: Despite playing 43 defensive snaps in the contest Watt did not log more than a single tackle assist in the Steelers' win. The pass rusher had a quiet night, contributing to Joe Burrow's 282 passing yards and three passing touchdowns in the shootout.

headline: Leads game in tackles
story: Queen logged 13 tackles (four solo) and one pass defensed in the Steelers' 30-27 win over the Bengals on Sunday.
impact: Queen once again played all of the Steelers' defensive snaps in the contest and was on the field for 56 defensive plays. The linebacker led both teams in tackles, punishing the divisional-rival Bengals repeatedly in a game that went down to the wire.

headline: Diagnosed with broken wrist
story: Ramsey revealed Tuesday that he played through a broken right wrist during Sunday's 30-27 win over the Bengals, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.
impact: Ramsey broke his right wrist on the Steelers' first defensive series of Sunday's game, but he powered through the injury and finished with eight tackles (four solo) while playing every single defensive snap. Ramsey's status for Thursday's game against the Browns is dependent on whether he can wear a cast that would be protective enough to significantly reduce the risk of aggravation. Brandin Nichols (concussion) and Asante Samuel would both be in line for more defensive snaps if Jalen Ramsey is unable to play in Thursday's AFC North showdown.

headline: Officially sits again Tuesday
story: Dowdle (toe) was estimated as a non-participant on Tuesday's injury report, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.
impact: The Steelers held a walkthrough for the second time in as many days, and as was the case Monday Dowdle was unable to get any work in. He was at least present Tuesday after not being spotted during the media-viewing portion the day before, but he will presumably have to practice in at least some capacity Wednesday in order to have any chance to suit up for Pittsburgh's Week 4 matchup with Cleveland on Thursday.

headline: Notches TD in Week 3
story: Skowronek hauled in his lone target for a 23-yard touchdown during Sunday's 30-27 win over the Bengals.
impact: Skowronek ranked fifth among Steelers receivers by playing 11 of the team's 62 offensive snaps, but the 29-year-old was able to connect with quarterback Aaron Rodgers on a pass to the end zone during his limited time on the field. Despite coming up with a big play in the Week 3 win, Skowronek remains likely to see most of his field time on special teams moving forward.

headline: Held to two catches in Week 3
story: Freiermuth recorded two receptions for 30 yards on four targets and carried once for one yard in Sunday's 30-27 win over the Bengals.
impact: Freiermuth took the field for 37 of the Steelers' 62 offensive snaps, with his 60 percent share placing him slightly behind fellow tight end Darnell Washington (47 snaps, 76 percent). The Steelers should continue to make ample use of two-tight-end sets to keep Freiermuth involved in their game plans, but since he doesn't project to see heavy target volume week to week, he'll remain a largely touchdown-dependent fantasy option.

headline: Sits out Tuesday's practice
story: Dowdle (toe) was present for Tuesday's practice but was a non-participant, Nick Farabaugh reports.
impact: With Dowdle having missed Monday's walkthrough and having been ruled out for Sunday's win over the Bengals, his continued lack of participation is a concerning sign ahead of Thursday's game at Cleveland. If the Steelers' running back remains sidelined, Pittsburgh could again be forced to lean more heavily on its available backfield options on the quick turnaround.

headline: Stifled in loss
story: Ijeboi tallied 12 carries for 41 yards and gathered in 2 of 3 targets for six yards during Saturday's 49-10 defeat to Notre Dame.
impact: Ijeboi found no room to run against Notre Dame, following the same script plaguing most of the offense in Week 4. He should be able to turn things around against Illinois, which allowed Ohio State running backs to run all over them last week.

headline: Non-factor in blowout loss
story: Townsend had five receptions (on seven targets) for 16 yards during Saturday's 49-10 loss versus Notre Dame.
impact: Townsend scored some targets but couldn't do much with them against Notre Dame's stern defense. The talented senior will loook to turn things around next week against Illinois.

headline: Regresses against Irish
story: Waseem gathered in all four targets for 34 yards during Saturday's 49-10 defeat to Notre Dame.
impact: Purdue's offense wilted against an oppressive Notre Dame defense, and the roster produced no standout performances. Wasee will hope for a change in fortune against Illinois next week.

headline: Massive regression against Irish
story: Browne was 18-for-28 passing for 111 yards during Saturday's 49-10 loss to Notre Dame. He also had six rushes for -23 yards.
impact: Browne's numbers took a nosedive against an imposing Notre Dame defense, and the rest of the offense suffered as a result. The Boilermakers had very little success in all aspects of the offense, and things won't get much easier as the team barrels headlong into the conference schedule. Browne's numbers could be slightly better next week against Illinois.

headline: Out for Saturday
story: Burhenn (undisclosed) is not dressed for Saturday's game versus Notre Dame, Tom Dienhart of On3.com reports.
impact: Burhenn is dealing with some sort of undisclosed injury, one that is keeping him out of Saturday's contest. He has five catches for 80 yards and one touchdown through three games this season so he will be missed in the difficult matchup. His next chance to play is next Saturday at Illinois.

headline: Logs massive yardage total in loss
story: Waseem gathered in 8 of 13 targets for 149 yards during Saturday's 52-38 loss against UCLA.
impact: Xavier Townsend had the big touchdown total, but Waseem had a monstrous game thanks to a great passing performance from Ryan Browne. While Purdue's passing game is on fire, their defense isn't cooperating, and that'll be a problem next week as they take on Notre Dame at home

headline: Stellar line in loss
story: Townsend reeled in all six targets for 162 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 52-38 loss against UCLA.
impact: Townsend posted an incredible number and worked seamlessly alongside Asaad Waseem, who also excelled in the loss to UCLA. If only Purdue's defense could cooperate, the Boilermakers would be very competitive, as their passing game is humming right now.

headline: Steady production not enough
story: Browne completed 19 of 30 passes for 378 yards, three touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 52-38 defeat against UCLA.
impact: Browne threw for 378 yards, but his defense let him down and couldn't contain Wayne Knight and Nico Iamaleava. Browne has put up some stellar lines this season, but he faces an uphill battle against Notre Dame and its imposing defense.

headline: Scores twice in loss
story: Ijeboi totaled 17 carries for 47 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 52-38 defeat versus UCLA.
impact: Although Ijeboi found the end zone twice, UCLA's run defense kept Ijeboi mostly in check, limiting him to only 2.67 yards per carry in the loss. The Hoosiers still performed as a cohesive unit despite the loss, and they'll need to use it to boost morale as they face a tough home matchup against Notre Dame next week.

headline: Makes most of lone reception
story: Mosey caught their only target for 40 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 38-24 defeat against Fresno State.
impact: Mosey hauled in his second reception of the season and took it all the way for a 40-yard score. That ended up being the wideout's only target of the game, though he has now logged a reception in two consecutive games. With Rice's offense relying on a heavy rushing attack, it will be hard for him to replicate the same production on a weekly basis.

headline: Break out day against Fresno State
story: Grice logged two receptions (on four targets) for 20 yards during Saturday's 38-24 loss versus Fresno State.
impact: Grice found success in the backfield Saturday after attempting only three carries for 12 yards in the Owls' season opener. The wideout rushed for an 88-yard touchdown to score the team's first points of the day, which accounted for the bulk of his production. He finished with seven carries and five targets, suggesting he will be utilized as a dual-threat option moving forward.

headline: Excels on ground in defeat
story: Brown completed 8 of 17 passes for 119 yards, one touchdown and one interception during Saturday's 38-24 defeat versus Fresno State. He also had 19 rushes for 141 yards with one to...
impact: Brown continues to be the focal point of the Owls' offense, accounting for two scores --one passing and one rushing -- against a tough Fresno State defense. The quarterback was one rushing attempt short of logging back-to-back games with at least 20 carries. He did end up committing two turnovers, with his first interception of the season on the Owls' first offensive possession and then a fumble later in the second half. With Quinton Jackson (undisclosed) out for the season, Brown's role is more vital than ever.

headline: Out for season
story: Jackson (undisclosed) will miss the rest of the 2026 season, per The Roost.
impact: Jackson suffered a significant injury during Rice's season opener against Houston Christian and has now been officially ruled out for the remainder of the season. The 5-foot-9 back had a solid performance prior to his injury and was expected to be a major contributor for the Owls heading into this season. D'Andre Hardeman and Tyvonn Byars are the likely candidates to lead the way for the Rice backfield.

headline: Grabs first touchdown since 2023
story: Jackson caught 4 of 6 targets for 47 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 28-21 defeat to Western Michigan.
impact: Rice rarely relies on its passing game, but the offense turned to the air late in the fourth quarter when trailing, allowing Jackson to reel in a touchdown with nine seconds remaining. The wideout hauled in a team-high four receptions for 47 yards as he looks to establish himself as a reliable target. He has seen a surge in volume early this season after recording just seven receptions for 122 yards and one touchdown across three seasons with Cincinnati.

headline: Bounces back with two scores in loss
story: Brown was 11-for-18 passing for 121 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 28-21 loss to Western Michigan. He also had 23 rushes for 128 yards with one touchdown.
impact: After a low-production blowout loss to Notre Dame, Brown produced a much-needed rebound in Week 3. He wasn't able to lead Rice to a victory, but the offense revolved heavily around the quarterback as he racked up over 100 rushing yards and more than 20 carries for the first time this season. Late in the fourth quarter, he connected with Barry Jackson for an eight-yard touchdown pass, marking his first passing score of the year. Brown's usage should continue spiking moving forward due to Quinton Jackson's (undisclosed) absence.

headline: Remains sidelined Saturday
story: Falk (undisclosed) didn't play in Saturday's 28-21 loss to Western Michigan.
impact: Falk continues to deal with an undisclosed injury as he aims to make his season debut. The tight end appeared in 2025 with Rice, hauling in three receptions for 30 yards, and is looking for a bigger role this season. His next chance to suit up is at Fresno State next Saturday.

headline: Sits out vs. WMU
story: Lane (undisclosed) did not play in Saturday's 28-21 loss to Western Michigan, Matthew Bartlett of The Roost reports.
impact: Lane hurt himself in last week's game against Notre Dame, and the injury trickled into Saturday's loss to the Broncos. The 6-foot-1 wideout's next chance to see the field will be this Saturday at Fresno State.

headline: Held in check by Notre Dame
story: Brown was 8-for-12 passing for 64 yards during Saturday's 52-0 defeat versus Notre Dame. He also had 16 rushes for 32 yards.
impact: Brown couldn't lead a scoring drive as the Owls were shut out by one of the country's top teams. The quarterback played out the entire game despite the blowout and capped his afternoon off by fumbling during the team's final offensive possession in the fourth quarter. The entire offense couldn't get anything to go against Notre Dame after the triple-option attack worked to perfection in Week 1. Brown led the team with 16 carries and 32 rushing yards, aiming to bounce back against Western Michigan in Week 3.

headline: Inactive Week 2
story: Falk (undisclosed) did not appear in Saturday's 52-0 loss against Notre Dame.
impact: Falk remained out for a second-straight game as the Owls were routed by the Fighting Irish in Week 2. The 6-foot-6 redshirt junior, who tallied three receptions for 30 yards last season with Rice, will have his next chance to suit up against Western Michigan in Week 3.

headline: Unable to play against old team
story: Zinter (leg) did not play Saturday's 52-0 loss at Notre Dame.
impact: According to Mike Berardino of the South Bend Tribune, who reports for Notre Dame, Zinter was seen wearing a compression sleeve on his left leg, its injury the likely reason why he did not play Week 2. With multiple tight ends out for Rice, now would be a good time for him to be available, but it is unknown when he will return from injury.

headline: Sustains significant injury
story: Jackson (undisclosed) is dealing with a "significant" injury according to head coach Scott Abell, per Steve Helwick of SB Nation.
impact: Jackson had a very strong opener for the Owls, notching 10 carries for 61 yards and two touchdowns. However, the tailback also sustained what appears to be a serious injury, and there's no telling at this point how severe it is or when he might return. In Jackson's stead, expect more touches for D'Andre Hardeman and Tyvonn Byars.

headline: Scores in win vs. Houston Christian
story: Hardeman compiled 11 rushes for 77 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-3 win versus Houston Christian.
impact: Hardeman was one of three running backs to score Saturday, punching in a two-yard touchdown for the first score of the Owls' season. Last season with Rice, he backed up Quinton Jackson and had a productive campaign, rushing for 325 yards and two touchdowns on 82 attempts. The running back room appears to be a three-headed attack with Jackson, Hardeman, and Tyvonn Byars looking to lead the offense this season, though the team's matchup against Notre Dame next Saturday raises questions about whether they will continue to split the workload.

headline: Leads backfield in win
story: Byars recorded 16 carries for 104 yards during Saturday's 31-3 victory versus Houston Christian.
impact: Byars reached the century mark in the Owls' season opener along with a team-high 16 rushing attempts. The triple-threat option worked in Rice's favor as the team rushed for 464 total yards against Houston Christian. Byars emerged as the top rusher, but Quinton Jackson still figures to be a focal point of the backfield moving forward. Even so, he should still see a steady share of carries against Notre Dame next Saturday.

headline: Two rushing touchdowns in win
story: Jackson recorded 10 rushes for 61 yards and two touchdowns and caught their only target for six yards during Saturday's 31-3 victory over Houston Christian.
impact: Jackson is coming off a breakout season where he had 180 rushing attempts for 889 yards and six touchdowns with Rice. The running back decided to return to the program and scored twice in his season debut. The Owls took the lead early and never looked back, producing 464 total rushing yards to allow Jackson a light workload as he logged only 11 carries. The experienced back is poised for a heavy workload against a Notre Dame defense next Saturday.

headline: Excels again in blowout
story: Duff reeled in 5 of 8 targets for 131 yards and one touchdown during Friday's 58-7 victory versus Howard.
impact: Duff is in rarefied air, leading the FBS in receiving yards (550) and touchdowns (7) despite his team's early misfortunes. He's proven to be matchup-proof so far, and he may exceed expectations next week against an Indiana defense that surrendered 293 passing yards to Northwestern.

headline: Mops up in garbage time
story: Thevenin compiled 16 carries for 69 yards and one touchdown during Friday's 58-7 victory over Howard.
impact: Antwan Raymond was pulled once the game was well in hand, giving Thevenin a chance to shine in the blowout win. The Louisiana Tech transfer likely had his last chance at a featured role, as Raymond will own most of the carries as Rutgers starts its conference schedule next week.

headline: Plays relief role in blowout
story: Surace was 3-for-7 passing for 40 yards and one touchdown during Friday's 58-7 victory versus Howard.
impact: Dylan Lonergan has won the quarterback competition after getting benched for Surace in Week 2, but Surace's four interceptions against Boston College all but sealed Lonergan's second opportunity. Only a serious misstep from Lonergan would change this narrative, but overall expectations should be tempered against Indiana next week.

headline: Explodes for three touchdowns
story: Raymond compiled 16 rushes for 140 yards and three touchdowns during Friday's 58-7 victory versus Howard.
impact: Raymond capitalized on an inferior Howard defense and racked up his third straight 100-plus-yard performance of the season. He currently ranks fourth in the FBS with 438 rushing yards and 14th nationally with four rushing touchdowns. He'll face a tough opponent in Indiana next week, which held Northwestern to just 33 yards on the ground.

headline: Continues to improve in blowout
story: Lonergan completed 12 of 17 passes for 214 yards and two touchdowns during Friday's 58-7 victory versus Howard. He also rushed twice for 14 yards.
impact: Lonnergan built on the late surge he directed against USC last week and picked apart an inferior FCS opponent. Lonergan's total would have been higher, but he was pulled and replaced by AJ Surace once the game was well out of hand. It appears that Lonergan has successfully separated himself from Surace in the quarterback race after getting benched in Week 2 following a horrible performance in the opener against UMass.

headline: Finds end zone in loss
story: Duff notched seven receptions (on 12 targets) for 86 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 42-35 loss to USC.
impact: Unsurprisingly, Duff was Dylan Lonergan's favorite target in the narrow loss. Despite the team's record, Duff is among the nation's best, ranking third nationally in the FBS with 419 receiving yards. He's also ranked third in the country among FBS receivers with six touchdowns.

headline: Surpasses 100 yards once again
story: Raymond (undisclosed) logged 21 rushes for 122 yards and one touchdown and caught 3 of 4 targets for 39 yards during Saturday's 42-35 defeat to USC.
impact: Raymond held a questionable status for most of the week leading up to the conference opener, but he ended up playing and led the ground attack once again for the Knights. The junior ball carrier has now recorded back-to-back outings with 100-plus rushing yards, and he's totaled 62 rushes for 298 yards and one touchdown across three games.

headline: Reels in TD
story: Reed caught two passes for 16 yards and a score Saturday versus Texas Tech.
impact: Not the busiest day for Reed, but he has a touchdown in three of four games this year. Plus, in all the other games this season he's been over 50 yards receiving.

headline: Tallies five receptions
story: O'Neill caught five passes for 24 yards against Texas Tech on Saturday.
impact: The yardage total was low on the road against a top-25 team, but clearly O'Neill was still involved in the offense. He has at least five catches in every game this season.

headline: Nets 50 yards
story: Berry-Johnson caught four passes for 50 yards against Texas Tech on Saturday.
impact: This is the highest number of receptions Berry-Johnson has had in a game, and it is his second game with at least 50 yards, so perhaps the Wisconsin transfer is working his way into a role for the Bearkats.

headline: Two TDs, two INTS
story: Locke went 23-for-37 for 195 yards, two touchdowns, and two interceptions against Texas Tech on Saturday. He also ran eight times for 25 yards.
impact: Not his best game by any means, but Locke threw multiple touchdowns on the road against Texas Tech, and he also led the team in rushing yards. It wasn't an easy non-conference schedule, but Lock has thrown for over 1,000 yards with 11 touchdowns against three interceptions and seems to be in a good place.

headline: Nets 59 yards
story: Reed had two catches for 59 yards versus Nicholls on Saturday.
impact: Reed didn't get in on the touchdown party for the Bearkats, but he got his four targets and he got a couple touches, and it's not like he was shut down. However, he may be shut down in Week 4, as Sam Houston visits Texas Tech.

headline: Reels in TD
story: Berry-Johnson caught two passes for 63 yards and a score Saturday versus Nicholls.
impact: In addition to this being an FCS opponent, Berry-Johnson was only targeted twice, so it's not like he was a major part of the offense in this game. He's accumulated six total targets through the first three tilts, racking up six grabs for 95 yards and a score thus far.

headline: Finds end zone
story: O'Neill caught five passes for 44 yards and a touchdown against Nicholls on Saturday.
impact: Sam Houston is airing it out, and Landyn Locke has thrown for over 300 yards in every game, but offense is multi-faceted. Somebody has to be the top guy, though, and that is O'Neill. He has at least five catches in every games, and he's found the end zone twice.

headline: Reels in long TD
story: Maxwell caught two passes for 86 yards and a score Saturday versus Nicholls.
impact: Maxwell is down the depth chart, and he has four catches all season. This game was a blowout, so several guys got chances, and Maxwell made the most of his, which is to his credit.

headline: Rushes for TD
story: McCaskill rushed eight times for 41 yards and a touchdown against Nicholls on Saturday.
impact: The Bearkats are airing it out offensively, and then in the run game divvy out the carries. McCaskill gets the most of them, but he's finished between 41 and 51 rushing yards in every game, because without a big run there is only so much he can do as one cog in a machine.

headline: Big game against FCS school
story: Lock went 19-for-28 for 322 yards and four touchdowns against Nicholls on Saturday. He also ran four times for 24 yards.
impact: Locke was thrown in the deep end as a true freshman, and it was a mixed bag, but here in his sophomore season it would seem Sam Houston has found something. He's thrown for over 300 yards in every game, and he's toss nine touchdowns against one pick.

headline: Catches five passes
story: O'Neill caught five passes for 62 yards against Tulsa on Saturday.
impact: O'Neill was third in receiving yards, but first in receptions, and 62 yards isn't bad. He had seven catches in Sam Houston's season opener, so he does seem to be the top target in this offense.

headline: Reels in TD
story: Reed caught four passes for 93 yards and a score Saturday versus Tulsa.
impact: Reed has a touchdown in both games this season. He only had 30 catches last year, but they went for 460 yards and five touchdowns, an he seems primed to clear those numbers with ease.

headline: Catches long TD
story: Parker caught two passes for 101 yards and a score against Tulsa on Saturday.
impact: Parker is a running back, but he didn't get a carry. Instead, he got a couple catches, one of them for 94 yards, which seems like a fluke.

headline: Rushes for 48 yards
story: McCaskill ran 14 times for 48 yards versus Tulsa on Saturday.
impact: Well, this pretty much tracks for McCaskill. In his season opener he ran 13 times for 51 yards, and this time he had 14 carries for 48 yards. He's the lead back for the Bearkats, but he also has averaged under 4.0 yards per carry.

headline: Throws two TDs
story: Locke went 24-for-34 for 316 yards and two touchdowns against Tulsa on Saturday, but he also lost a fumble.
impact: Locke is a statue in the pocket, he's been sacked left and right already, but he also can air it out. Locke has thrown for over 300 yards in both of his games, and he has thrown five touchdowns against one pick as well.

headline: Brings in TD
story: Bledsoe caught four passes for 26 yards and a score Saturday versus Troy.
impact: Well, all of last season Bledsoe had seven catches for 86 yards. Sam Houston really divvied out the targets, so the pecking order remains unclear, but what is clear is that Bledsoe has more of a role than in 2025.

headline: Reels in TD
story: Reed caught three passes for 52 yards and a touchdown Saturday against Troy.
impact: Reed was targeted eight times, which is notable given that he only ended up with three receptions. Last season he had 30 catches for 460 yards and five touchdowns, so he would need a larger role to really make a splash in 2026.

headline: Records 13 tackles in Week 3
story: Green recorded 13 tackles (seven solo) and one pass breakup in Sunday's 36-30 win over the Cardinals.
impact: With the Cardinals running 87 offensive plays, it led to inflated tackle numbers across the board for the San Francisco defenders, and it was Green's second career game with double-digit tackles. Through three games this season, Green has 18 tackles (10 solo) and two pass breakups, including one interception.

headline: Piles up 17 tackles in Week 3 win
story: Warner recorded 17 tackles (eight solo) in Sunday's win over Arizona.
impact: The Cardinals ran a whopping 87 offensive plays Sunday, and Warner was on the field for all of them, leading to the inflated tackles number. The 17 tackles were the most Warner has ever recorded in a single game during his nine-year career. Through three games this season, Warner has 33 tackles (14 solo), including 0.5 sacks, two forced fumbles and one pass breakup.

headline: Sees workload dip vs. Arizona
story: Black turned four carries into 17 yards and failed to haul in his lone target during the 49ers' 36-30 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
impact: Black accumulated 95 scrimmage yards on 22 touches through the first two games of the regular season and was a regular rotational piece in the offense behind Christian McCaffrey. However, Black observed most of Sunday's game from the sidelines, seeing the field for only eight of the 49ers' 54 offensive snaps (14.8 percent) compared to McCaffrey's 45 snaps. Keeping McCaffrey healthy is a top priority for the 49ers, so Black figures to see more playing time moving forward compared to what he had in Week 3. The 49ers will remain home for Week 4 to host the Broncos this Sunday.

headline: Resuming workouts in November
story: Winn (elbow) continues to go through physical therapy and is slated to begin his normal offseason workouts in November, Justice delos Santos of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
impact: Winn was sidelined for the last month-plus of the regular season while dealing with right elbow neuritis. Barring any setbacks, he will be ready to roll by the time spring training rolls around.

headline: UCL surgery scheduled
story: Tidwell will undergo a right elbow UCL repair in mid-October, Justice delos Santos of The San Jose Mercury Newsreports.
impact: Surgery for the right-hander was the expected outcome, and now it has officially been scheduled. If Tidwell winds up needing a full Tommy John surgery -- which is likely since he's dealing with a high-grade tear -- he'll be sidelined until the 2028 season.

headline: Will face hitters in October
story: Peguero (hamstring) has expanded his flat-ground throwing to 105 feet and is schedule to throw live batting practice sessions by late October, Justice delos Santos of The San Jose...
impact: Peguero missed much of the 2026 season with a recurring left hamstring strain, with his last appearance coming in mid-August. However, the reliever appears set for a normal offseason before competing for a bullpen job with the Giants in 2027.

headline: Typical offseason throwing program
story: Houser (forearm) is expected to have a normal offseason throwing program and be ready for spring training, Justice delos Santos of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
impact: Houser missed the final month-plus of the regular season while dealing with a right forearm strain. He will continue going through physical therapy for now but is expected to begin his offseason throwing at his normal time. Houser posted a 4.02 ERA and 75:34 K:BB over 109.2 innings in 2026 covering 16 starts and 10 relief outings.

headline: Receives clean bill of health
story: Gage (elbow) has been fully cleared and will have a normal offseason, Justice delos Santos of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
impact: Gage had to be pulled off his rehab assignment Sept. 1 due to renewed discomfort in his left elbow, but he's recovered well since then and heads into the offseason sans limitations. The southpaw held a 5.60 ERA and 22:17 K:BB over 27.1 frames this season.

headline: Cleared for normal offseason
story: Adames (elbow) has been cleared to go through his normal offseason workout routine, Justice delos Santos of The San Jose Mercury News reports.
impact: Adames went down with a left (non-throwing) elbow sprain in late August, but he was ramping up workouts toward the end of the regular season and will not have any restrictions over the winter. The veteran shortstop put together a .230/.289/.424 batting line with 21 home runs over 121 games for the Giants this season.

headline: Effective as opener
story: Seymour threw a clean first inning Sunday against the Dodgers, striking out one. He didn't factor into the decision.
impact: The Giants went with a bullpen game in the season finale, deploying 10 arms in total, and Seymour did his part as the opener. The right-hander yielded mixed results with San Francisco in 2026, so he could begin next season in the minor leagues for more seasoning. Through 31.2 big-league frames, he posted a 4.55 ERA, 1.48 WHIP and 23:16 K:BB with eight holds plus one save (four chances).

headline: Productive in defeat
story: Bates tallied 19 rushes for 94 yards and gathered in his only target for eight yards during Saturday's 26-10 loss to Fresno State.
impact: While San Jose State's offense struggled as a whole Saturday, Bates still managed to put together another productive outing. The senior's tallied 376 rushing yards on 66 carries in his last three games. Bates and the Spartans will get a bye before traveling to Hawaii in Week 5 to open their conference schedule.

headline: Quiet in loss
story: Hoch had two receptions (on three targets) for 23 yards during Saturday's 26-10 loss to Fresno State.
impact: Hoch was held in check Saturday after totaling 192 yards and three touchdowns on 12 receptions in his previous two games. The redshirt junior will look to bounce back in Week 5, following a bye, when the Spartans visit Hawaii.

headline: Snags third touchdown
story: Clark tallied five receptions (on six targets) for 27 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 26-10 loss versus Fresno State.
impact: Clark was responsible for SJSU's lone touchdown Saturday -- he cut the Spartans' deficit to 13-10 with his one-yard grab in the third quarter. Through four games, the freshman wideout's tallied 24 receptions (on 34 targets) for 240 yards and three scores.

headline: Bright spot in loss
story: Ivey had seven receptions (on 10 targets) for 150 yards during Saturday's 26-10 defeat to Fresno State.
impact: While it was a tough night overall for the Spartans' offense, Ivey's breakout certainly offered a silver lining. The senior led SJSU in receptions and receiving yards after logging just two receptions for 34 yards across his first three games. Ivey, a one-time four-star recruit out of high school, joined San Jose State prior to the season after he failed to carve out a role with Penn State.

headline: Throws four picks in loss
story: Weaver completed 21 of 38 passes for 244 yards, a touchdown and four interceptions during Saturday's 26-10 loss to Fresno State.
impact: It was a tough night for Weaver, who had thrown just one interception in his first three games this season. Overall, the senior quarterback's completed 60.8 percent of his passes this year for 1,032 yards and nine touchdowns. Weaver and the Spartans will head into a bye before they'll look to bounce back in Week 5 on the road against Hawaii in their conference opener.

headline: Returns in Week 3
story: Kopa-Kaawalauole (undisclosed) was active for Saturday's 26-10 loss to Fresno State.
impact: Kopa-Kaawalauole (undisclosed) did not record a catch in the matchup, but his being on the field is a good indication of his health moving forward. He'll aim to play once again after the Spartans' bye week against Hawaii on Oct. 4.

headline: Another big day
story: Hoch caught 7 of 12 targets for 77 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 30-20 win over Cal Poly.
impact: Hoch's now totaled 12 receptions for 192 yards and three touchdowns in his last two games, after logging just two receptions for 24 yards in San Jose State's opener against USC. The redshirt junior looks to be emerging as one of quarterback Luke Weaver's go-to options, alongside freshman Carson Clark.

headline: Logs 27 carries in win
story: Bates notched 27 rushes for 163 yards and hauled in his only target for 14 yards during Saturday's 30-20 victory over Cal Poly.
impact: While he's yet to find the end zone this season, Bates has now eclipsed 100 yards and 20 carries in back-to-back games. San Jose State has deployed a more balanced approach on offense to open 2026, running the ball on 49 percent of their plays compared to 39 percent last season. This certainly boosts Bates' fantasy outlook -- the senior's totaled 319 yards on 58 carries through three games this season.

headline: Efficient in win
story: Weaver completed 22 of 34 passes for 238 yards and three touchdowns during Saturday's 30-20 victory over Cal Poly. He also had 10 rushes for 44 yards.
impact: It was another solid showing from Weaver, who's now thrown for 788 yards with eight touchdowns and just one interception through his first three games. The senior's made an impact on the ground as well, totaling 96 rushing yards with another score. Weaver and the Spartans will host Fresno State in Week 3.

headline: Inactive Week 2
story: Kopa-Kaawalauole (undisclosed) did not appear in Saturday's 30-20 win over Cal Poly.
impact: Kopa-Kaawalauole was held out due to undisclosed reasons as the Spartans took down the Mustangs in Week 2. The 6-foot-4 redshirt junior wideout logged two receptions for eight yards across SJSU's first two games. Kopa-Kaawalauole's status for Week 3 against Fresno State is uncertain at this time.

headline: Seven targets in win
story: McClure accrued four receptions (on seven targets) for 39 yards during Friday's 27-21 victory over Eastern Michigan.
impact: While McClure didn't put up a huge stat line Friday, the junior wideout seems to have carved out a significant role in San Jose State's offense in the early going. Through two games, McClure's brought in 10 of 16 targets for 107 yards and a touchdown.

headline: Tops 100 yards in win
story: Bates had 20 carries for 119 yards and hauled in 1 of 4 targets for 13 yards during Friday's 27-21 win against Eastern Michigan.
impact: After he was held to just 37 rushing yards in Week 0 against USC, Bates rebounded with an impressive showing against Eastern Michigan, averaging six yards per carry to top the 100-yard mark. While San Jose State features a pass-first offense, Bates should still see ample opportunity as the clear lead back. The senior rushed for 192 yards and two touchdowns in 2025 before a leg injury cut his season short after four games. Expect Bates to put up big numbers again next week in the Spartans' home opener against FCS Cal Poly.

headline: Breaks out in Week 1
story: Hoch reeled in all five targets for 115 yards and two touchdowns during Friday's 27-21 win over Eastern Michigan.
impact: After logging just two receptions for 24 yards in SJSU's opener against USC, Hoch broke out Friday against Eastern Michigan, leading the team with 115 yards while hauling in a pair of touchdowns, including a 40-yard grab that put the Spartans ahead 24-21 in the fourth quarter. After logging just five receptions for 43 yards in 2025, the 6-foot-3 Hoch looks primed for a big year as a featured weapon in San Jose State's air-raid offense.

headline: Leads Spartans to win
story: Weaver completed 23 of 39 passes for 316 yards, three touchdowns and an interception during Friday's 27-21 win versus Eastern Michigan. He also had 10 rushes for 10 yards.
impact: It was another solid showing from Weaver, who's now completed 44 of his 71 pass attempts for 550 yards and five touchdowns through his first two games with San Jose State. Weaver should be poised for another big game next week, when the Spartans host FCS Cal Poly in their home opener.

headline: Two receptions vs. Washington
story: Shaheed caught two passes on three targets for 14 yards during the Seahawks' 33-31 loss to the Commanders on Sunday, He also returned three punts for 29 yards and added 63 yards on...
impact: Shaheed continued to operate as the Seahawks' primary returner on special teams, and his 31 offensive snaps were third-most among Seattle wide receivers behind Jaxson Smith-Njigba (58) and Cooper Kupp (45). Shaheed has yet to find the end zone this season, with his last touchdown taking place in the 2025 NFC divisional round against the 49ers, when he took the game's opening kickoff 95 yards to the house. The Seahawks will play five of their next six games at home, starting this Sunday against the winless Chargers.

headline: Question mark for Week 5
story: Knight (undisclosed) is questionable for SMU's clash with Boston College in Week 5, per Lia Assimakopoulos of The Dallas Morning News.
impact: Knight is coming off a huge performance against Missouri State, reeling in 11 catches for 164 yards and a score. The Mustangs' top wideout, who's totaled 27 grabs for 345 yards and two touchdowns this fall across four games, is dealing with an undisclosed ailment that's thrown his status for the Boston College game into question, although the good news for SMU is that it's reportedly not a long-term concern.

headline: Questionable but trending in right directoin
story: Smith (undisclosed) is questionable but trending in the right direction for Saturday's game against Boston College, Lia Assimakopoulos of The Dallas Morning News reports.
impact: Although there is a chance Smith is out Week 5, him trending in the right direction indicates that he is leaning more toward available than unavailable against Boston College. He did not play Week 4 after marking his 2026 season's ACC debut by catching a majority of five targets for 60 yards at Louisville.

headline: Sits out Saturday
story: Smith (undisclosed) didn't play in Saturday's win over Missouri State, per Lia Assimakopoulos of The Dallas Morning News.
impact: Smith missed his first game of the season after having racked up 20 yards and two touchdowns across the first three games. He will look to make his return next week versus Boston College.

headline: Good for three receptions
story: Pittman gathered in three of five targets for 27 yards during Saturday's 34-24 victory versus Missouri State.
impact: The senior tight end has posted at least three receptions in three of his four games this season, but he has now been held out of the end zone in each of the past two games after posting scores in his first two outings. He'll look to re-discover the end zone next Saturday against Boston College.

headline: Secures two touchdowns in victory
story: Ohrstrom notched three receptions (on four targets) for 49 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 34-24 victory versus Missouri State.
impact: Ohrstrom has rolled up some huge numbers, jelling nicely with Kevin Jennings. He has at least three receptions in all three of his appearances, and he has a pair of multi-touchdown games already this season. He'll look to keep up the good work when Boston College pays a visit next Saturday.

headline: Good for 125 receiving yards in win
story: Cooper gathered in all eight targets for 125 yards during Saturday's 34-24 victory over Missouri State.
impact: The sophomore from Cibolo, Texas entered the game with just six receptions for 120 yards and a touchdown, and he more than doubled up his season numbers thanks to this performance against the Bears. He'll look to keep up the good work when Boston College pays a visit next Saturday.

headline: Goes bonkers against Missouri State
story: Knight compiled 11 receptions for 164 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 34-24 victory versus Missouri State.
impact: Knight produced his third collegiate 100-yard game, and the yardage total marked a new career best. His previous high was 162 yards in a win at Boston College on Nov. 8, 2025. Oddly enough, the Eagles are next up on the schedule as ACC play resumes next Saturday in Dallas.

headline: Totals 12 touches in home victory
story: Green tallied 10 carries for 26 yards during Saturday's 34-24 win against Missouri State.
impact: Green averaged just 2.6 yards per carry, giving starter Kendrick Raphael occasional breathers. The Mustangs struggled against the Missouri State rushing defense, averaging just 3.2 yards per tote, with Raphael doing most of the damage. The team is back in action next Saturday at home against Boston College.

headline: Flirts with century mark in win
story: Raphael logged 23 carries for 98 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-24 victory against Missouri State.
impact: Raphael just missed out on a triple-digit yardage total, but he totaled 146 scrimmage yards with a score, while out-touching Dramekco Green at a 27-to-12 clip. Raphael is the lead back, and he is doing nothing to hurt that status. He'll get a shot at Boston College next Saturday, as ACC play resumes.

headline: Rolls up 464 passing yards in win
story: Jennings completed 33 of 39 passes for 464 yards, three touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 34-24 victory over Missouri State. He also had five rushes for three yards...
impact: Jennings and the Mustangs bounced back nicely after suffering a road loss at Louisville last weekend. Jennings has thrown for at least 337 yards in three of his four games, while tossing three or more touchdowns in three of those four outings, too. He'll look to keep it going in another favorable matchup against Boston College next Saturday.

headline: Tosses two TDs in loss
story: Hollins was 23-for-43 passing for 266 yards, two touchdowns and two interceptions during Saturday's 45-21 loss against Kentucky. He also had 10 rushes for 25 yards.
impact: Hollins found Anthony Eager for a 36-yard touchdown in the second quarter before connecting with Jeremiah Jones-Thomas for a 19-yard score later on in that quarter. Through three games, Hollins has thrown for 458 yards, three touchdowns and two interceptions. Hollins and the Jaguars take on Louisiana-Monroe on Saturday at home.

headline: Rushing TD in loss
story: Martin tallied nine rushes for 48 yards and one touchdown and hauled in their only target for negative one yard during Saturday's 45-21 defeat to Kentucky.
impact: Martin punched in his fourth touchdown of the season in the second quarter to put the Jaguars on the board. Through four games, Martin has run for 270 yards on 63 carries while also hauling in six receptions for 33 yards.

headline: Scores TD in loss
story: Eager notched four receptions (on nine targets) for 67 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-21 loss versus Kentucky.
impact: Eager and quarterback Jared Hollins teamed up for a 36-yard score in the second quarter to give the Jaguars a 14-7 lead at the time. Through four games, Eager has a receiving line of 7/137/2.

headline: Slow day in loss
story: Jenkins reeled in two of six targets for 26 yards during Saturday's 45-21 loss against Kentucky.
impact: Jenkins was bottled up in the loss and now only has three catches over his past two contests. Through four games this season, Jenkins has recorded 17 receptions, 228 yards and two touchdowns.

headline: Goes for TD in loss
story: Jones-Thomas posted six receptions (on 11 targets) for 91 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 45-21 defeat against Kentucky.
impact: Jones-Thomas connected with quarterback Jared Hollins in second quarter for the wideouts first touchdown of the season. Through four games, Jones-Thomas has recorded 19 receptions for 236 yards.

headline: Not starting Saturday
story: Davenport (undisclosed) is not South Alabama's starting quarterback Saturday at Kentucky, Creg Stephenson of AL.com reports.
impact: Davenport not starting allows Jared Hollins another opportunity to start in what will be a difficult game against a team in one of college football's premier conferences. As for the former, his injury status has been downgraded to doubtful.

headline: Scores again in win
story: Martin recorded 21 rushes for 80 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 41-36 win over Ohio.
impact: Martin now has a touchdown in each of the Jaguars' first three games, and though this is a crowded backfield with Keenan Phillips and Trae'von Dunbar also getting lots of touches, South Alabama is proving it has the ability to sustain multiple productive backs in this offense.

headline: Two scores in big win
story: Dunbar totaled six rushes for 52 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 41-36 victory versus Ohio.
impact: Dunbar found the end zone again after he was blanked in Week 2 at Tulane. The running back is the firm No. 3 back for the Jaguars at this point, but that's still resulted in some impressive production as this South Alabama offense looks pretty potent. Behind PJ Martin and Keenan Phillips, Dunbar won't always be this productive, but the tailback is squeezing just about all the production he can from his current role.

headline: Silenced by Bobcats
story: Jenkins gathered in 1 of 3 targets for five yards during Saturday's 41-36 victory versus Ohio.
impact: Jenkins has a tremendous first two games this season, totaling 14 catches for 197 yards and two scores. In the win against Ohio, however, he was limited to just one meager reception. The receiver was also only targeted three times, which is a curious development considering he notched 22 targets through the first two weeks of the season. He'll look to bounce back at Kentucky in Week 4.

headline: Big day on the ground
story: Phillips accrued 18 rushes for 116 yards and one touchdown and gathered in 2 of 3 targets for 25 yards during Saturday's 41-36 win against Ohio.
impact: Phillips eclipsed the 100-yard mark for the first time this season, and also found the end zone for the first time as well. Though he got fewer carries than PJ Marin, the Jaguars' other co-starter at running back, Phillips has still be quite productive week in and week out on what looks like a potent South Alabama offense.

headline: Scores first touchdown of 2026
story: Gibbs notched two receptions (on three targets) for 33 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 41-36 win over Ohio.
impact: Gibbs found the end zone for the first time this season as the Jaguars topped Ohio for a big Week 3 win. The tight end still has just six targets through three games, however; his production might be hit or miss on a weekly basis.

headline: Sits out with nagging injury
story: Davenport (undisclosed) did not play in Saturday's 41-36 win over Ohio due to a nagging injury, Ava Rath of the AL.com reports.
impact: The Jaguars got the sneaky win over the Bobcats, but they were without starting quarterback Davenport. He'll now look to make a return for this Saturday's outing at Kentucky, pending how his lingering injury is during the practice week.

headline: Starting vs. Ohio
story: Hollins is the starting quarterback for Saturday's game against Ohio, Creg Stephenson of AL.com reports.
impact: Hollins got the starting nod due to the absence of Bishop Davenport (undisclosed), an issue that head coach Major Applewhite will address after the game. This will be the first start of the 2026 season for the junior signal-caller.

headline: Not starting vs. Ohio
story: Davenport isn't starting in Week 3 against Ohio, per Creg Stephenson of AL.com.
impact: Davenport, who's tossed for 450 yards, three touchdowns and zero interceptions through two games with a rushing score as well, has been replaced by Jared Hollins. It's not entirely clear why, but head coach Major Applewhite is expected to address the situation after the game.

headline: Big day in loss
story: Jenkins posted nine receptions (on 14 targets) for 119 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 28-24 defeat to Tulane.
impact: Jenkins hauled in his second touchdown of the season on a 17-yard strike from Bishop Davenport in the fourth quarter. Through two games, Jenkins has recorded 14 catches for 197 yards.

headline: Rushing TD in loss
story: Martin had 15 carries for 73 yards and one touchdown and hauled in all four targets for 32 yards during Saturday's 28-24 defeat versus Tulane.
impact: Martin led the way for the Jaguars' backfield on Saturday in both carries and rush yards. Martin's score came in the first quarter on a 16-yard run to put the Jaguars up 10-0 at the time. Through two games, Martin has run for 142 yards and two touchdowns on 33 carries.

headline: Tosses two TDs in loss
story: Davenport completed 22 of 32 passes for 296 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 28-24 defeat against Tulane. He also had nine rushes for 50 yards.
impact: Davenport and the Jaguars battled Tulane all the way to the end on Saturday. Davenport connected on scores from 43 and 17 yards out and has now thrown for 450 yards and three touchdowns through two weeks. Up next is a home matchup with the Ohio Bobcats.

headline: Back in action
story: Eager (hand) reeled in 2 of 4 targets for 64 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 28-24 defeat versus Tulane.
impact: Eager, who was limited to special teams' work in Week 1 against SE Louisiana, tallied two receptions for 64 yards and a score against Tulane in Week 2. The 6-foot-1 senior wideout is expected to be one of the focal points of the Jaguars' offense moving forward.

headline: Scores touchdown in loss
story: Harbor caught 3 of 6 targets for 42 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 49-18 loss versus Alabama.
impact: Nearly all of Harbor's production came on a 41-yard connection with LaNorris Sellers for a touchdown just before halftime. The senior wide receiver has struggled to get much volume going, finishing with more than 50 yards in just one contest this season. He will aim to build on this performance during next week's meeting with Kentucky.

headline: Rushes over 100 yards in loss
story: Fuller recorded 19 rushes for 112 yards and one touchdown and reeled in 5 of 6 targets for 20 yards during Saturday's 49-18 loss to Alabama.
impact: Fuller remained the leader of the South Carolina backfield, topping 100 rushing yards for the second time this season while totaling a season-high 19 carries.He also has back-to-back games with at least five receptions, demonstrating he can handle all downs. The redshirt sophomore will want to carry the momentum over to the team's next meeting against Kentucky.

headline: Totals over 250 yards in loss
story: Sellers was 18-for-30 passing for 185 yards, one touchdown and one interception during Saturday's 49-18 loss versus Alabama. He also had 13 rushes for 72 yards.
impact: Sellers continued to provide significant production with his legs, averaging 5.5 yards-per-carry and finishing second on the team in rushing. He threw a costly interception that resulted in a touchdown as he finished below 200 passing yards for the second time this season. The redshirt junior quarterback will aim to get the passing game going against Kentucky.

headline: Ready to roll vs. Alabama
story: Brown (undisclosed) is off the injury report ahead of Saturday's contest at Alabama, per the SEC availability report.
impact: Brown will suit up for Saturday's game after being listed as probable in South Carolina's initial injury report. The tight end has caught four passes for 19 yards this season.

headline: Probable Saturday
story: Brown (undisclosed) is probable for Saturday's game at Alabama, per the SEC availability report.
impact: Brown popped up on Thursday's availability report, suggesting he's dealing with some sort of minor injury. There's a good chance he'll be able to play and hope to build off his good performance versus Mississippi State where he caught four passes for 19 yards and a touchdown.

headline: Available for Week 4
story: Anderson (undisclosed) is not on the injury report ahead of Saturday's matchup against Alabama.
impact: After missing last week's matchup against Mississippi State, Anderson has been cleared to return Saturday against the Crimson Tide. The quarterback has registered 29 total yards through his first two games of the campaign.

headline: Minimal output in loss
story: Coleman accrued four rushes for 18 yards and hauled in 2 of 3 targets for 14 yards during Saturday's 41-34 loss versus Mississippi State.
impact: Coleman remained involved behind Fuller but failed to score for the first time this season. His efficiency remained solid at 4.5 yards-per-carry, though Matthew Fuller's larger workload continues to cap his volume. The redshirt freshman running back will work to earn more opportunities for next week's game against Alabama.

headline: Tosses three TDs in loss
story: Lyddy was 18-for-29 passing for 243 yards and three touchdowns during Saturday's 24-21 defeat against Tulane. He also had eight rushes for negative two yards.
impact: Lydia connected for scores on 32, 14 and 22-yard passes during the loss. Through four games (one start), Lyddy has thrown for 508 yards, four touchdowns and one interception. It will remain to be seen if Lyddy starts on October 6 when the Golden Eagles travel to face Troy.

headline: Strong day in loss
story: Robinson posted 16 rushes for 73 yards and gathered in their only target for six yards during Saturday's 24-21 defeat against Tulane.
impact: Robinson continued his strong start to 2026 with another nice showing. The running back has now run for 319 yards and four touchdowns on 72 carries, while also hauling in three receptions for 16 yards and a score.

headline: Touchdown in loss
story: Dalton gathered in three of seven targets for 75 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 24-21 defeat versus Tulane.
impact: Dalton teamed up with quarterback Landry Lyddy for a 32-yard score in the second quarter for the wideouts first touchdown of the season. Through two games, Dalton has five receptions for 92 yards.

headline: Two TDs in loss
story: Sanders compiled four receptions (on six targets) for 69 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 24-21 defeat versus Tulane.
impact: Sanders and quarterback Landry Lyddy connected for a 14-yard touchdown in the second quarter before popping a 22-yard touchdown in the third quarter. Through four games, Sanders has hauled in 20 receptions for 302 yards and three touchdowns.

headline: Not warming up ahead of Week 4
story: Briggs (undisclosed) was not spotted in warmups ahead of Saturday's game against Tulane, Dima Mixon of PineBeltSPORTS reports.
impact: Briggs was trending toward playing in Week 4, but the fact that he wasn't warming up Saturday is far from ideal. If Briggs ends up being ruled out, Steven Robinson and Jamarice Wilder would be in line for more touches in the backfield.

headline: Set to miss several weeks
story: Himes is expected to miss around four weeks due to a foot injury, Pete Thamel of ESPN.com reports.
impact: Southern Miss will be without several key offensive contributors for the next few games, as they're also without Ethan Hampton (hand) and Grant Page (elbow) for at least a month. The loss of Himes and Page means names like Eelijah Singleton, MJ Johnson and Kaden Saunders should see more playing time in upcoming contests.

headline: Will miss multiple weeks
story: Hampton (hand) is expected to miss between four and six weeks due to a hand fracture, Pete Thamel of ESPN.com reports.
impact: Hampton suffered what was initially deemed as a "pretty significant hand injury" in Week 3, and he'll be on the shelf for a considerable time as he works his way back from a fracture. Landry Lyddy will remain Southern Miss's starting quarterback as long as Hampton is out.

headline: Dealing with elbow injury
story: Page is dealing with a dislocated elbow and will be out "for some time," head coach Blake Anderson told Dima Mixon of Pine Belt Sports.
impact: Page is coming off his best game of the season in Week 3 against UConn, catching all three of his targets for 35 yards. However, this injury will sidelined for a few games even in a best-case scenario. There's no clear timetable for his return.

headline: Trending toward playing
story: Briggs (undisclosed) is "trending toward playing" against Tulane on Saturday, head coach Blake Anderson told Dima Mixon of Pine Belt Sports.
impact: Briggs didn't play in Week 3 and has missed Southern Miss' last two games, but he seems to be leaning toward being available in Week 4. His return would be huge for the team, but his production in 2026 hasn't stood out. The tailback had just two carries for 22 yards in the opener, but he's expected to be the team's RB1 if he stays healthy. His return would translate to fewer touches for Steven Robinson and Jamarice Wilder.

headline: Finds end zone vs. Huskies
story: Robinson accrued 18 carries for 72 yards and one touchdown and reeled in their only target for nine yards during Saturday's 48-20 defeat against Connecticut.
impact: Robinson got back into the end zone after he was blanked in that category last week against Auburn. The tailback once again took the majority of the carries for the Golden Eagles, and despite the lopsided loss, he made the most of them. Robinson will look to stay productive next week at Tulane.

headline: Racks up 11 targets in loss
story: Sanders caught 7 of 11 targets for 81 yards during Saturday's 48-20 defeat versus Connecticut.
impact: Southern Miss quarterbacks looked Sanders' way early and often during the blowout loss to UConn, and it resulted in a solid seven-catch, 81-yard day for the receiver. He's been a consistent part of this offense through three weeks, and that shouldn't change in Week 4 at Tulane regardless of who's playing quarterback for the Golden Eagles.

headline: Not expected to be available in Week 4
story: Hampton (hand) suffered "a pretty significant hand injury" in the loss against UConn in Week 3 and is not expected to be available against Tulane in Week 4, head coach Blake Anders...
impact: Even though Hampton hasn't been completely ruled out ahead of Saturday's game, Anderson said they "do not expect him to play this week," so his chances of suiting up look slim to none. If that's the case, Landry Lyddy will get the nod under center, while John White and Hugh Price would be the backups.

headline: Expected to start in Week 4
story: Lyddy is expected to start in Week 4 against Tulane due to Ethan Hampton's hand injury, head coach Blake Anderson told Dima Mixon of The Pine Belt News.
impact: Lyddy will get the nod under center since Hampton isn't expected to be available for the time being. John White will operate as the backup, while freshman Hugh Price will be the QB3. Lyddy has appeared in all three games for Southern Miss this season, completing 20 of 33 passes for 265 yards and a 1:1 TD:INT.

headline: Doubtful at Tulane
story: Hampton (hand) is doubtful at Tulane in Week 4, per Davis Wilson of the Hattiesburg American.
impact: Hampton suffered what Southern Miss head coach Blake Anderson referred to as a "pretty significant hand injury" in the loss to UConn. Thus, it wouldn't be shocking to see the gunslinger miss multiple weeks of action, not just Week 4 in New Orleans. In his stead, expect Landry Lyddy to get the start in the Big Easy.

headline: Sidelined Saturday night
story: Briggs (undisclosed) is out for Southern Miss's clash with UConn on Saturday night, per Dima Mixon of PineBeltSports.
impact: Briggs will miss his second straight game. The tailback, who had just two carries for 22 yards in the opener, was expected to be a starting running back for the Golden Eagles, but he won't get a chance to suit up until at least Week 4 at Tulane.

headline: Expected to play Saturday
story: Dalton (hamstring) should be good to go for Saturday's game versus Connecticut, per Dima Mixon of Pine Belt Sports.
impact: Dalton is warming up for the first time this season after battling a hamstring injury. He caught four passes for 82 yards and touchdown during the 2025 campaign and should make his season debut against the Huskies.

headline: Sheds non-contact jersey, could return
story: Dalton (hamstring) could return to action Saturday against UConn, per Davis Wilson of the Hattiesburg American.
impact: Dalton has yet to suit up for the Golden Eagles this fall, but after shedding his non-contact jersey in practice on Tuesday, the tailback looks to be trending towards making his 2026 debut. Last season, he reeled in four catches for 82 yards and one touchdown.

headline: Game-time call vs. UConn
story: Briggs (undisclosed) is a game-time decision for Southern Mississippi's clash with UConn in Week 3, per Davis Wilson of the Hattiesburg American.
impact: Briggs missed Week 2 against Auburn, but the tailback has a shot to return against the Huskies. Briggs was initially listed as a co-starting running back for Southern Miss ahead of the 2026 season.

headline: Expected to be ready for spring
story: Cardinals president of baseball operations Chaim Bloom said Monday that Fitts (lat) is on track to be ready at the start of spring training but will have his workload monitored, De...
impact: Fitts underwent right lat surgery in April after getting hurt while pitching at Triple-A Memphis. It's unclear where Fitts currently is in the rehab process, but Bloom said the righty is "hellbent on being part of this picture from the jump" next season. Assuming health, Fitts will be in the mix for a rotation spot next season. However, after all the time off there's a good chance he'll begin the campaign back at Memphis.

headline: Lingering hip pain down stretch
story: Cardinals president of baseball operations Chaim Bloom said Monday that Walker was playing through some hip pain and other discomfort late in the season, Derrick Goold of the St. L...
impact: The lingering hip issue could at least partly explain Walker's fade in September, as he slashed just .172/.232/.287 in the final month. The good news is the Cardinals do not expect the injury to linger into the offseason, as Walker has simply been prescribed rest. It was a breakout 2026 campaign for the 24-year-old outfielder, with Walker sporting a .269/.327/.466 batting line with 29 home runs, 102 RBI and 22 stolen bases.

headline: Totals 65 receiving yards
story: Robinson tallied two receptions for 65 yards during Saturday's 34-27 win versus Georgia Tech.
impact: Robinson's day was highlighted by a 61-yard reception, which was the longest play from scrimmage from any player on either side. The freshman from Mansfield, Texas showed he can do the job when his number is called. With Nico Brown, Caden High and Robinson, the Cardinal have an impressive trio of receivers to build around.

headline: Finds end zone twice vs. Ramblin' Wreck
story: High totaled four receptions for 91 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 34-27 victory over Georgia Tech.
impact: High had a 49-yard touchdown midway through the third quarter, and he had the eventual game-winning touchdown from seven yards out at 11:52 of the fourth quarter. He jelled nicely with QB Davis Warren, who had a career outing. The two will continue to make beautiful music together at Wake Forest next Saturday.

headline: Comes up just short of triple digits
story: Brown had five receptions for 98 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 34-27 victory over Georgia Tech.
impact: Brown rolled up 71 receptions for 1,085 yards and 11 touchdowns in 2025 for Yale, but he was biding his time for an opportunity at Stanford. He finished got his chance, and he kicked the door in. Look for Brown to see more opportunities going forward, starting at Wake Forest next Saturday.

headline: Totals 42 scrimmage yards in win
story: Irvin recorded 11 carries for 33 yards during Saturday's 34-27 win versus Georgia Tech.
impact: It was a slow-go for the Stanford rushing attack in the home victory on The Farm, with the Cardinal averaging just 2.3 yards per rushing attempt. Irvin was the best of the lot at 3.0 yards per attempt, but that's not saying much. He'll look to do better at Wake Forest next Saturday.

headline: Finds end zone vs. Georgia Tech
story: Ford logged 19 carries for 55 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-27 win against Georgia Tech.
impact: Ford struggled a bit with 2.9 yards per carry, but his backfield mate, Sedrick Irvin, averaged just 3.0 yards per tote. The Cardinal struggled on the ground, and it had most of its success through the air. Ford and the run game will try to bounce back at Wake Forest next Saturday.

headline: Flirts with 400 yards in home win
story: Warren was 22-for-36 passing for 396 yards and three touchdowns during Saturday's 34-27 win versus Georgia Tech.
impact: Warren bounced back from an ugly showing at Duke last week. It was his second 300-yard passing performance of the season, and his yardage total and touchdown total each set new career highs. He had managed just two touchdowns in the first three games. He'll look to keep up the good work in a cross-country trip to Wake Forest next Saturday.

headline: Pulls down two receptions
story: Blackburn compiled two catches for 28 yards during Saturday's 35-7 defeat versus Duke.
impact: Blackburn had managed 12 total receptions for 101 yards in his first two games, but he was an afterthought in the offense in Saturday's loss. He'll look to rebound in next Saturday's game against Georgia Tech on The Farm.

headline: Accounts for Stanford's only TD
story: High posted five receptions for 43 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 35-7 defeat versus Duke.
impact: The senior from Atlanta missed the Week 0 win against Hawaii, but he has registered at least five receptions in both of his matchups against ACC opponents, and his touchdown was the only score for Stanford in its cross-country trip Saturday afternoon. He is a fantastic fantasy option on a Stanford roster with few offensive weapons not named Micah Ford.

headline: Limited to five total touches
story: Irvin notched four rushes for 18 yards during Saturday's 35-7 defeat to Duke.
impact: Irvin had been seeing some solid snap totals, and he even outproduced Micah Ford against Miami. However, Irvin's offensive touches were rather limited, as Stanford was forced to abandon the run early in the second half as the game started to get away. He'll look to bounce back next Saturday against Georgia Tech, but that's a matchup against another tough defense.

headline: Totals 110 scrimmage yards
story: Ford had 11 rushes for 76 yards during Saturday's 35-7 loss to Duke.
impact: Ford was easily the most explosive player for Stanford in an otherwise moribund game for the offense. He averaged 6.9 yards per rushing attempt, while the Cardinal managed just 3.3 yards per carry overall. As the game got away from Stanford, it abandoned the run, though, and the team got away from the only thing actually working.

headline: Struggles in cross-country trip
story: Warren was 18-for-32 passing for 151 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 35-7 loss versus Duke.
impact: Warren had very little time to throw, as the Blue Devils were able to record four sacks, showing off a surprising pass rush and pressure. He was also credited with a lost fumble, as the Cardinal dropped its second straight ACC game. Warren and the Cardinal will look to rebound next week as Georgia Tech visits The Farm. It will likely be another difficult matchup for the offensive line.

headline: Available against Duke
story: Brown (undisclosed) is not listed on the injury report for Saturday's game at Duke.
impact: Brown was trending toward playing Saturday and is now set to make his season debut. The wideout is coming off a big season with Yale, where he recorded 71 receptions for 1,085 yards and 11 touchdowns. He should carve out a role in the passing attack and emerge as a reliable target for Davis Warren.

headline: Available vs. Duke
story: Bironas (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game at Duke.
impact: Bironas is set to make his season debut in Week 3. However, he's not expected to play any time soon as long as the No. 1 kicker, Emmet Kenney, is healthy.

headline: Cleared to play Saturday
story: Shaw is not on the injury report ahead of Stanford's matchup against Duke on Saturday.
impact: Shaw will make his 2026 debut after missing the previous two games to begin the season. The UCLA transfer has logged just two catches for 45 yards over two years. Stanford will matchup against Duke on Saturday.

headline: Trending towards playing Saturday
story: Brown (undisclosed) is trending towards playing on Saturday at Duke, per Jason Burke of Stanford Roundtable.
impact: Brown has yet to play this season, but he's trending towards changing that Saturday against the Blue Devils. The Yale transfer, who reeled in 71 catches for 1,085 yards and 11 touchdowns in New Haven last season, looks poised to make an instant impact on the Cardinal passing game once healthy.

headline: Set to debut vs. UConn
story: Russell (achilles) will make his debut in Week 5 at UConn and will play "as much as possible," per Syracuse On SI.
impact: Russell has yet to play this season, but the intriguing two-sport freshman will finally suit up in Week 5. The 6-5 receiver should get every opportunity to make an impact in this offense, and it'll be interesting to see how concerted of an effort there is to get him the ball.

headline: Disappears in Steel City
story: Bacheyie didn't record any receptions on just one target during Thursday's 27-13 loss to Pittsburgh.
impact: Bacheyie had a touchdown in each of the first two games against New Hampshire and Cal, but he was an afterthought in Thursday's loss. The team has two full weeks to get things together before it takes the field Oct. 3 at UConn. It might be a good idea to try and focus on getting the ball more to some of the younger, up-and-coming players like Bacheyie.

headline: Secures five receptions in loss
