story: Johnson caught 5 of 6 targets for 42 yards during Thursday's 27-13 defeat versus Pittsburgh.
impact: Johnson led the team with five receptions, just ahead of RB Ju'Juan Johnson (hand), who exited the game with a hand injury. The freshman from Miami-Carol City (Fla.) has eight touches through two games, and he looks like a player with some decent upside going forward.

headline: Totals 86 scrimmage yards
story: Hatcher tallied three receptions (on six targets) for 58 yards during Thursday's 27-13 defeat against Pittsburgh.
impact: Hatcher also was able to add a 28-yard gain on a rushing attempt, the second-longest play from scrimmage in the game. His 34-yard reception was actually the longest. He has been an explosive player for the struggling Orange, and they need to try and get the ball in his hands more than just four total times. The Orange have more than two full weeks to rectify the scuffling offense, as they do not play again until Oct. 3 at UConn.

headline: Finds end zone against Pitt
story: Miller logged 14 rushes for 78 yards and one touchdown and reeled in their only target for two yards during Thursday's 27-13 defeat against Pittsburgh.
impact: There weren't a lot of bright spots in the 14-point road loss, but Miller did a good job averaging 5.6 yards per carry while accounting for the team's only touchdown. The junior from Memphis was making the start with Ju'Juan Johnson (hand) exiting the game due to a hand injury after six rushing attempts. While Johnson will have more than two full weeks to recover, if he needs more time to recuperate, Miller could be in line to start at UConn on Oct. 3.

headline: Replaces starter, shows off accuracy
story: Odom completed 7 of 7 passes for 44 yards during Thursday's 27-13 defeat versus Pittsburgh.
impact: Odom did a good job after starter Steve Angeli was benched in the fourth quarter after interceptions on back-to-back drives. He had a lot of high-percentage, short-to-intermediate passes, but he was accurate, and he didn't throw to the other team. Angeli has five interceptions in the past two games, and with more than two full weeks before the next game at UConn, it wouldn't be surprising to see Odom given a shot to start next time out.

headline: Dismal performance in Pittsburgh
story: Angeli completed 13 of 25 passes for 161 yards and two interceptions during Thursday's 27-13 defeat against Pittsburgh. He also had five rushes for negative five yards.
impact: Angeli started the season fine with three touchdowns against New Hampshire of the FCS. However, in a pair of ACC losses against Cal and Pitt, he has just one touchdown and five interceptions. It might be too early to say, but Amari Odom came on and completed 7 of 7 passes, and it's possible with more than two full weeks before a trip to UConn, Angeli could potentially be replaced. We'll track it closely.

headline: Unable to continue post-injury
story: Johnson suffered a hand injury during Syracuse's game Thursday at Pittsburgh, Adam Hipsky of WAER Sports reports.
impact: During the Syracuse-Pittsburgh game, Johnson logged six rushing attempts. He also recorded four receptions (on as many targets) for 27 yards. But because of his subsequent injury, the running back required a locker-room visit that ultimately indicates why he will be questionable before Syracuse's next matchup Week 5 at UConn. For its remainder, Johnson did not log any carries or targets.

headline: Sitting out vs. Pitt
story: Russell (achilles) will remain out in Week 3 against Pitt, per Javon Edmonds of Syracuse.com.
impact: Russell had a chance to make his collegiate debut as he was listed as a game-time decision, but the receiver will officially sit out Thursday night in Pittsburgh. His next chance to take the field comes in Week 5 at UConn after a bye week.

headline: Game-time call Thursday night
story: Russell (achilles) is a game-time decision for Syracuse's clash with Pittsburgh on Thursday.
impact: Russell was reportedly expected to make his debut in Week 3 against the Panthers, but he's still not fully cleared and remains a game-time call for the Orange. The true freshman is expected to make an immediate impact on this passing attack, but it remains unclear if that'll happen in Week 3.

headline: Expected to debut vs Huskies
story: Russell (achilles) is expected to make his season debut against UConn on October 3, though he is currently doubtful for Thursday's matchup against Pitt, per Pete Thamel of ESPN.com...
impact: Russell will make his team debut against the Huskies after missing the start of the 2026 season due to recovery from an achilles injury. The 6-foot-5 receiver is expected to attempt the two-sport option at Syracuse, joining the basketball team as well. Though he has yet to be officially ruled out against Pitt, his debut is expected to come against UConn.

headline: Available for Week 3
story: Hill (undisclosed) is not listed on the injury report for Thursday's game at Pittsburgh.
impact: Hill was previously listed as questionable but was able to recover from an undisclosed injury. The running back will look to lead the backfield against Pittsburgh and continue to build on his season, during which he has recorded 17 rushing attempts for 146 yards and one touchdown.

headline: Plays one offensive snap in Week 3
story: Tucker didn't touch the ball in Sunday's 23-16 loss to the Vikings.
impact: After playing just one special-teams snap in his Week 2 season debut against the Browns, Tucker played one offensive snap and seven on special teams versus Minnesota. He's well behind both Bucky Irving and Kenny Gainwell on the backfield depth chart and is little more than a prospective bench stash in fantasy should something happen to Irving or Gainwell.

headline: Signed to Bucs' active roster
story: The Buccaneers signed Melifonwu from the practice squad to the active roster Tuesday, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.
impact: Melifonwu was elevated from the practice squad to the active roster for each of the Buccaneers' first three games of the regular season. He played solely on special teams in each of those contests, and he'll continue to serve that role now that he's on the 53-man roster while providing depth in the secondary.

headline: Another muted performance
story: Godwin gathered in three of four targets for 25 yards during Sunday's 23-16 loss to the Vikings.
impact: Godwin ranked third among Buccaneers wide receivers in snap share (62 percent) behind Ted Hurst (75 percent) and Emeka Egbuka (74 percent) in Week 3, resulting in his least productive performance of the season. On top of that, Godwin hasn't been targeted more than four times in a game so far on the campaign. With undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels set to take over Tampa Bay's offense for at least a few contests in the wake of Baker Mayfield's dislocated right thumb, Godwin doesn't have an ideal situation in which to build momentum from week to week.

headline: Outrighted by Rays
story: The Rays outrighted Woodford to Triple-A Durham on Sunday.
impact: Woodford passed through waivers after being booted off the 40-man roster. The righty is set to become a minor-league free agent this offseason after posted a 7.81 ERA across 19 relief outings between the Brewers, Cubs and Rays in 2026.

headline: Moving to Tarleton State
story: Frier has committed to Tarleton State, per the team's X account.
impact: Frier will look to make more of a mark with the Texans after not appearing in either of his two seasons with Florida State. The 6-foot wide receiver will have three years of eligibility remaining to use up with Tarleton State.

headline: Commits to Tarleton State
story: Locke announced his commitment to Tarleton State on Monday.
impact: In terms of FBS stats, 2025 is Locke's worst year. The quarterback completed only one-third of 15 pass attempts and logged a 0-1 TD-INT ratio. For 2026, Locke will transfer to a non-FBS college.

headline: Finally gets multiple chances
story: McCashland converted 2 of 3 field goal attempts and his only extra-point try during Saturday's 21-13 loss to UCF.
impact: McCashland still delivered his first multi-field-goal game of the season by connecting on kicks from 29 and 45 yards out despite missing a field-goal attempt. The Horned Frogs' offense moved the ball well enough to create scoring opportunities, and if that continues, McCashland's fantasy outlook should improve even if the occasional miss remains part of the equation.

headline: Emerges as reliable TE option
story: Ashley logged four receptions (on seven targets) for 43 yards during Saturday's 21-13 defeat against UCF.
impact: Ashley continued to be heavily involved in TCU's passing attack, hauling in four catches for 43 yards as one of Jaden Craig's most trusted targets. At a position where consistent volume is hard to find, Ashley's 6.3 targets per game stands out as one of the better usage profiles in the Big 12. Even without a touchdown this week, the steady target share gives him a strong fantasy floor and keeps him firmly in the TE1 conversation.

headline: Comes back down to Earth
story: Small tallied three receptions (on five targets) for 41 yards during Saturday's 21-13 defeat to UCF.
impact: Small's production naturally took a step back once TCU's top receiver in Jordan Dwyer returned to the lineup. Small still contributed with a few catches, but the target distribution looked much more balanced with Dwyer back in his usual role. He's still involved enough to matter in deeper formats, though his path to consistent fantasy production is much narrower with a healthy Dwyer on the field.

headline: Role remains steady
story: Scott gathered in all five targets for 80 yards during Saturday's 21-13 loss against UCF.
impact: Scott continued to do what he's done all season, turning a healthy workload into productive numbers with five catches. While Jordan Dwyer's return may cap some of his upside, Scott's usage appears largely unchanged, keeping him firmly in the conversation as a fantasy contributor in deeper leagues.

headline: Reclaims the top receiver spot
story: Dwyer accrued five receptions (on eight targets) for 100 yards during Saturday's 21-13 loss against UCF.
impact: Dwyer looked every bit like TCU's number one receiver in his return from injury, leading the Horned Frogs with a 100-yard receiving game. His immediate impact was a reminder that he's still the focal point of the passing attack, making him the most attractive fantasy option in the receiving corps moving forward.

headline: Finds the end zone again
story: Payne notched 15 carries for 48 yards and one touchdown and reeled in 6 of 9 targets for 21 yards during Saturday's 21-13 defeat against UCF.
impact: Payne scored TCU's lone touchdown in the loss to UCF, giving him rushing touchdowns in back-to-back games. While the Horned Frogs continue to lean heavily on QB Jaden Craig and the passing attack, Payne has started to carve out valuable goal-line work and scoring opportunities. The rushing volume remains modest, but a growing touchdown streak is helping keep him fantasy relevant.

headline: Piles up yards but questions remain
story: Craig was 25-for-40 passing for 310 yards and two interceptions during Saturday's 21-13 loss to UCF. He also had six rushes for -16 yards.
impact: Craig topped 300 passing yards for the third straight game, but the performance was again overshadowed by two interceptions and a lack of touchdowns. The trend is becoming clear through four games: Craig has been highly productive against overmatched opponents but has struggled to deliver the same level of efficiency against Power Four competition. The volume keeps his fantasy floor intact, but he'll need to cut down on mistakes if he's going to become a dependable starter during Big 12 play.

headline: Officially available vs. UCF
story: Denman (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game against UCF, per the Big 12 availability report.
impact: Denman has seemingly recovered from an undisclosed injury and will take the field for the Horned Frogs on Saturday. The running back should be involved in the backfield after combining for 60 yards and two touchdowns on 14 attempts through the team's first two games.

headline: Good to go for Week 4
story: Dwyer (foot) is not listed on the injury report ahead of Saturday's game at Central Florida, per the Big 12 availability report.
impact: Dwyer is set to make his season debut after missing the start of TCU's season due to a lingering foot injury. This is huge news for the receiving corps after he hauled in 54 receptions for 730 yards and seven touchdowns with the Horned Frogs last season.

headline: Listed as probable for Week 4
story: Denman (undisclosed) is probable for Saturday's game against UCF.
impact: Denman was initially listed as questionable for Saturday's contest, but the bump in status to probable suggests the tailback should be available and handle his regular workload this weekend. Denman has 14 carries for 60 yards and two touchdowns in two games in 2026.

headline: Upgraded to probable for Saturday
story: Dwyer (foot) is now probable for Saturday's game at Central Florida, per the Big 12 availability report.
impact: Dwyer is on track to suit up for Saturday's game and make his season debut. The wideout will be a huge addition to the passing attack and should serve as a favorite target for starting quarterback Jaden Craig. In 2025 with TCU, he hauled in 54 receptions for 730 yards and seven touchdowns.

headline: Out vs. UCF
story: Lemmermann (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game at UCF, per the Big 12 availability report.
impact: Lemmermann hasn't played since the opener against North Carolina, where he made his lone field goal, and his absence will extend another week. The kicker will aim to return against BYU next Saturday.

headline: Available for Week 4
story: Ezukanma (head) is not listed on the injury report for Saturday's game at USF, per the Big 12 availability report.
impact: Ezukanma is set to make his season debut following a recovery from a locker-room altercation with ex-teammate Jacob Fields in early August. It is worth monitoring how many snaps he plays, but he is expected to have a role in the passing attack this season.

headline: Finds end zone on limited targets
story: Chase reeled in 2 of 3 targets for 76 yards and one touchdown during Friday's 21-17 loss versus Army.
impact: Chase hauled in only two receptions against Army, but one was a big-time play resulting in a 67-yard touchdown. He's now recorded two consecutive games with a receiving touchdown and is continuing to build his status as a top target. The wideout has been a deep threat this season, averaging 24.5 yards per reception.

headline: Maintains steady role in loss
story: Mason compiled 11 rushes for 57 yards and hauled in all two targets for 19 yards during Friday's 21-17 loss against Army.
impact: Mason was one of three players to share the backfield mix Friday, but he logged a team-high 11 carries. The touches appear to be split between him and Sam Brown, which is a positive sign given that Brown's return from injury risked cutting his workload. Mason will continue to see steady carries, but he has yet to find the end zone since the team's opener against Rhode Island.

headline: Logs 174 yards of total offense
story: Brown tallied 10 rushes for 96 yards and gathered in their only target for 78 yards and one touchdown during Friday's 21-17 defeat against Army.
impact: Brown played a role in both the rushing and receiving departments, collecting 174 total yards. The running back hauled in a 78-yard touchdown on Temple's first offensive play of the game to extend his scoring streak to two games. He doesn't appear bothered by the undisclosed injury that kept him sidelined to begin the season, showing no signs of restriction. Momentum is high heading into a Week 5 matchup at South Florida, where he'll aim to continue replicating his offensive success.

headline: Splits reps with Smolik
story: Sheppard split reps with Jaxon Smolik (foot) during Monday's practice and did not close the session with the first-team offense, 247Sports reports.
impact: In place of the injured Smolik, Sheppard started Saturday's game against the Army and flourished, completing 11 passes for 242 yards and two touchdowns, nearly reaching 300 all-purpose yards by rushing for 48 on the ground. Even though Smolik seems to be making an adequate recovery, Sheppard splitting quarterback reps indicates that he still has a shot to be Temple's starting quarterback. Notably, Temple's first-team offense finished the session with a two-minute drill, and Sheppard was at QB, suggesting a legitimate chance he can start again next Saturday at South Florida in Week 5.

headline: Splits reps in practice, may not be QB1
story: Smolik (foot) split reps with Ajani Sheppard during Monday's practice and did not close the session with the first-team offense, 247Sports reports.
impact: Smolik being able to complete reps is a positive step toward his recovery, given he has been inactive since suffering a foot injury in Week 3. Notably, Temple's practice ended with a two-minute drill with the first-team offense, and Sheppard was under center. Smolik's injury status and role will be worth monitoring before the Owls play at South Florida on Saturday. The former will be updated via the American Conference's availability report.

headline: Doesn't play Friday
story: Logan (undisclosed) didn't play in Friday's 21-17 loss to Army.
impact: Logan was questionable before the game, but the wideout didn't suit up, meaning he hasn't played since Week 1. His next chance to feature will come against USF in a Week 5 matchup on Oct. 3.

headline: Doesn't play against Army
story: Smolik (foot) did not play in Friday's 21-17 loss to Army.
impact: Smolik was spotted in full pads ahead of Friday's game but didn't draw the start as Ajani Sheppard started under center once again. He is dealing with a lingering foot issue and does not appear to be at 100 percent. He will aim to return against South Florida next Saturday, with hopes of reclaiming his starting job.

headline: Gets start in Week 4
story: Sheppard is starting Friday's game against Army, according to OwlSports Update.
impact: Sheppard and Jason Smolik (foot) were spotted warming up in pads before the game, but the former has gotten the starting nod. This might mean Smolik isn't 100 percent ready to play, but it's also a reward for Sheppard after he tossed three touchdowns in relief in Week 3 against Toledo.

headline: Not starting Friday
story: Smolik (foot) is not starting Friday's game against Army, according to OwlSports Update.
impact: Smolik was warming up in pads before the game, but he won't get the start. Ajani Sheppard has gotten the nod instead.

headline: Fully padded in warm-ups
story: Smolik (foot) is warming up in full pads ahead of Friday's game against Army, Mike Livingston of The Temple News reports.
impact: Smolik was handed a questionable tag in the latest edition of the injury report, but seeing him warming up in full pads suggests he should be available at least in some capacity Friday. Ajani Sheppard was also warming up, so it seems the Owls' starter under center will be a true game-time decision.

headline: Ruled out vs. Army
story: Uzoma (undisclosed) is out for Friday's game against Army.
impact: Uzoma hasn't played for Temple this season, and he won't return to the active roster in Week 4. His next chance to play will come against USF on Saturday, Oct. 3, in a Week 5 matchup.

headline: Cleared to play Friday
story: Stocksdale (hamstring) is available for Friday's game against Army.
impact: Stocksdale didn't play in any of Temple's first games of the season, but the 5-foot-10 wideout is set to make his return to the WR rotation here. The senior had four catches for 23 yards in five games with Bowling Green in 2025.

headline: Questionable for Week 4
story: Logan (undisclosed) is questionable for Friday's game against Army.
impact: Logan hasn't played since Week 1, when he logged nine snaps against Rhode Island. The freshman is buried on the WR depth chart, however, so his potential absence shouldn't cause a big shock in most lineups.

headline: Officially listed as questionable
story: Smolik is questionable for Friday's game against Army.
impact: Smolik will be a game-time decision for Friday's contest, and while the questionable tag might be a bit concerning, he was expected to play earlier this week. The signal-caller left Temple's game against Toledo with an injury in Week 3 and didn't return, and if he's out, Ajani Sheppard would get the nod under center.

headline: Catches TD in overtime loss
story: Chase gathered in 3 of 6 targets for 77 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 49-48 overtime loss to Toledo.
impact: After a quiet first two games, Chase was able to lead Temple's receiving corps, sparked by a 69-yard touchdown reception in the fourth quarter. While a majority of his yardage came on that single play, he has been one of the most reliable pass catchers this season in an Owls' passing offense that hasn't been as dominant as its rushing attack. With the quarterback situation seemingly uncertain for Week 4, he will look to remain a top target for Jaxon Smolik (foot) and Ajani Sheppard.

headline: Expected to be available
story: Smolik (foot) is expected to be available for Temple according to head coach K.C. Keeler, per OwlSports Update.
impact: Smolik left Temple's game against Toledo with an injury in Week 3 and didn't return. Keeler said the quarterback "moved around" on Monday and he's looking to get him team reps in practice, but also said that he'll probably be available. If he's unable to go, expect Ajani Sheppard to play in his stead.

headline: Totals 16 touches in OT loss
story: Mason compiled 15 rushes for 49 yards and gathered in their only target for four yards during Saturday's 49-48 overtime defeat against Toledo.
impact: Even with Sam Brown returning, Mason logged a heavy workload, recording 15 carries on the ground. He couldn't find much success, gaining only 49 yards, but it is still promising that he maintained a steady share of the touches, considering Brown is the expected starter. The running back should continue to split work with Brown as the two look to become a formidable duo in the backfield for Temple.

headline: Two TDs in season debut
story: Brown recorded 15 rushes for 109 yards and two touchdowns and caught all three targets for 27 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 49-48 overtime loss versus Toledo.
impact: Brown made his team and season debut, impressing by surpassing 100 rushing yards and collecting two touchdowns on the ground. The running back wasn't limited even after a short absence, handling 15 carries with his longest run of the night going for 50 yards. Keveun Mason started in his stead to begin the year and also totaled 15 carries in this contest, so it appears that they will continue to split work moving forward.

headline: Logs zero offensive snaps Sunday
story: Singleton didn't get a carry or a target in Sunday's Week 3 loss to the Giants.
impact: Though head coach Robert Saleh suggested near the end of the week that Singleton could get more carries in Week 3, the rookie running back didn't end up seeing any action at all on offense. He did record 10 snaps on special teams, but that probably wasn't what fantasy managers had in mind if they picked him up based on Saleh's statement. It appears that Singleton isn't immediately going to have a significant role in the backfield in games during which Tony Pollard and Tyjae Spears are both healthy.

headline: Logs lesser role in Week 3 loss
story: Ridley didn't catch his only target Sunday in a loss to the Giants.
impact: For the first time this season, Ridley was not among the Titans' top three wideouts in terms of offensive snaps. Carnell Tate (53 snaps) led the WR corps in that category, with Elic Ayomanor (48 snaps) and Wan'Dale Robinson (38 snaps) also both ahead of Ridley (20 snaps). That could be an indication that Tennessee is turning toward the younger Ayomanor over the veteran Ridley, who has caught just two passes for 35 yards through three contests on the campaign.

headline: Heading to IR
story: The Titans placed Slater (foot) on their injured reserve list Tuesday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.
impact: Slater sustained a serious foot injury during Sunday's game against the Giants, and his immediate backup, Fernando Carmona (ankle), was also hurt badly when he stepped into Slater's place. Both will have to miss at least Tennessee's next four games, potentially leaving free-agent acquisition Atonio Mafi or rookie sixth-rounder Pat Coogan as starting options at right guard.

headline: Signs to Tennessee's active roster
story: The Titans signed Carter off their practice squad to their 53-man roster Tuesday, Jim Wyatt of the team's official site reports.
impact: Carter was elevated from the practice squad for this past Sunday's loss to the Giants yet ended up being a healthy scratch. He reverted back to the practice squad Monday, but Tennessee has subsequently decided to give him a spot on the active roster. Carter has ample NFL experience, having logged 61 regular-season games, including 27 starts, over five seasons split between the Jets and Cardinals. However, he's unlikely to see much work on offense with Titans since all of Tony Pollard, Tyjae Spears, Nicholas Singleton and Julius Chestnut are potentially ahead of him in the RB pecking order.

headline: Finds end zone in loss
story: Matthews hauled in 4 of 10 targets for 72 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 20-17 loss to Texas.
impact: Matthews was Tennessee's most productive receiver and connected with Faizon Brandon on a 30-yard score late in the fourth quarter. The junior wide receiver will look to build on this performance against Auburn during next week's contest.

headline: Underwhelming performance in loss
story: Morris compiled nine carries for 33 yards and caught their only target for two yards during Saturday's 20-17 loss against Texas.
impact: Morris remained involved alongside DeSean Bishop, but both struggled to find running room against a strong Longhorns defense. The sophomore running back will work to bounce back in the team's next meeting against Auburn.

headline: Rough outing in loss
story: Bishop accrued 11 rushes for 34 yards and reeled in all three targets for eight yards during Saturday's 20-17 loss against Texas.
impact: Bishop returned after being limited by an injury against Kennesaw State, but was unable to get much going on. His 11 carries led Tennessee's running backs, though he averaged only 3.1 yards-per-attempt. The senior running back will aim to bounce back during next week's meeting with Auburn.

headline: Solid production in loss
story: Brandon completed 17 of 29 passes for 145 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 20-17 loss against Texas. He also had 23 rushes for two yards.
impact: The freshman quarterback endured by far his toughest afternoon yet, as Texas sacked him 10 times. Brandon finished with the lowest passing volume of the season across four games and will aim to bounce back in next week's meeting with Auburn.

headline: Underwhelming performance in loss
story: Craver notched three receptions (on six targets) for 31 yards during Saturday's 35-6 loss against LSU.
impact: Craver came crashing back to earth after his 11-catch performance against Kentucky, as quarterback Marcel Reed struggled generating much through the air. The junior wide receiver will work to bounce back in next week's clash with Arkansas.

headline: Modest production in loss
story: Horton recorded three receptions (on eight targets) for 43 yards during Saturday's 35-6 loss against LSU.
impact: Horton led Texas A&M in receiving yards amidst the offense producing only 106 yards through the air. The senior wide receiver has back-to-back games without reaching the end zone and will look to break that drought against Arkansas at home during the team's next matchup.

headline: Rough outing in loss
story: Reed completed 10 of 26 passes for 106 yards and one interception during Saturday's 35-6 defeat to LSU. He also had 10 rushes for -13 yards.
impact: Reed never found a rhythm against LSU, completing just 38.5 percent of his passes while averaging 4.1 yards-per-attempt. After accounting for multiple touchdowns in each of his first three games, the senior quarterback has thrown for a 6:6 touchdown-to-interception ratio and will need to protect the ball against Akansas.

headline: Returns to field Saturday
story: Craver (undisclosed) returned to the field during Saturday's game against LSU, per TexAgs.com.
impact: Craver was able to return to Saturday's game even after heading to the locker room in the second quarter. This is huge news for the Aggies' passing attack, as he led the receiving corps before exiting.

headline: Taken to locker room Saturday
story: Craver (undisclosed) was taken to the locker room during Saturday's game against LSU, per TexAgs.com.
impact: Craver went into Texas A&M's medical tent twice in the first half and eventually had to be taken to the locker room after the second visit. The wideout hauled in three receptions for 31 before exiting. It's unclear if he will return, and if he can't, Isaiah Horton and Ashton Bethel-Roman should see an increase in targets.

headline: Receiving leader in win
story: Wingo caught all six targets for 74 yards during Saturday's 20-17 victory over Tennessee.
impact: Wingo led Texas in both receptions and receiving yards, accounting for a big portion of quarterback Arch Manning's passing production. After relatively quiet outings the past few weeks, the six receptions in the matchup were the highest since Week 1. The junior wide receiver will aim to build on this performance for the team's next matchup against the Sooners on Oct. 10.

headline: Struggles in loss
story: Coleman (back) had one reception (on two targets) for 30 yards during Saturday's 20-17 win against Tennessee.
impact: Coleman was held to a single reception, his lowest mark across Texas' first three games. Running back Raleek Brown scored twice in a matchup where the run game was effective. The Auburn transfer will work to bounce back in the team's next meeting against Oklahoma following the bye week.

headline: Scores twice in win
story: Brown accrued 17 rushes for 67 yards and two touchdowns and reeled in all two targets for eight yards during Saturday's 20-17 win over Tennessee.
impact: Brown was responsible for both of Texas' touchdowns, scoring from nine yards in the first quarter and four yards in the fourth. His 19 touches led the Longhorns' backfield and will hope to carry this momentum to the clash against the Sooners on Oct. 10.

headline: Rough outing in win
story: Manning was 14-for-19 passing for 201 yards and one interception during Saturday's 20-17 win versus Tennessee. He also had 11 rushes for negative one yard.
impact: Manning averaged an impressive 10.6 yards-per-attempt when he was able to get the ball away.. He failed to find the end zone for a touchdown for the first time this season and will look to bounce back when they face Oklahoma on Oct. 10.

headline: Returns from IL
story: Osorio (undisclosed) was activated from the 7-day injured list Sept. 21.
impact: Osorio landed on the 7-day IL on July 24 due to an undisclosed injury and missed the remainder of the 2026 campaign, though it appears he's healthy heading into the offseason. He began the year at Single-A Hickory before finishing the season at High-A Hub City, where he slashed .275/.370/.489 with eight home runs, 22 RBI and 23 runs in 34 games.

headline: Might require minor elbow surgery
story: Rangers president of baseball operations Chris Young said Monday that Seager could require minor offseason surgery for a bone spur in his elbow "that he's dealt with for a few mont...
impact: It's not a given that Seager will choose the surgical route, but if he does, the expectation is that he will be fully recovered in time for the start of spring training. Injuries limited Seager to 102 games for the second season in a row, and he regressed at the plate year-over-year, finishing with a .227/.312/.424 batting line with 20 home runs during the 2026 campaign.

headline: Reaches 20 homers in finale
story: Seager went 1-for-4 with a two-run home run in Sunday's 6-4 loss to the Twins.
impact: Seager went deep in his final at-bat of the year to reach at least 20 home runs for the fifth straight campaign. The shortstop posted an .804 OPS with 10 homers in 51 second-half games after entering the All-Star break with a lowly .666 mark. Overall, he'll wrap up his 12th major-league season slashing a disappointing .227/.312/.424 with 20 long balls, 51 RBI, 57 runs scored and two steals across 436 plate appearances.

headline: Early hook in finale
story: Gore did not factor into the decision in Sunday's 6-4 loss to the Twins, allowing one run on one hit and one walk over 2.1 innings. He did not record a strikeout.
impact: Gore started a major-league-leading 34th game but did not last long, throwing 15 of 25 pitches for strikes and departing with one out in the third inning. It's unclear if the southpaw was injured Sunday, but he'll finish the campaign having completed five frames in only five of his final seven outings. He'll conclude his first season in Texas with a 4.58 ERA, 1.34 WHIP and 174:71 K:BB across a career-high 173 innings.

headline: Optioned by Texas
story: O'Hoppe was optioned to the ACL Rangers on Sunday.
impact: The move corresponds with the Rangers recalling utility man Cam Cauley from Triple-A Round Rock. O'Hoppe has appeared in 10 games for the Rangers since being acquired from the Angels in late July, going 6-for-17 with an RBI and five runs scored with Texas.

headline: Called up by Texas
story: The Rangers recalled Cauley from Triple-A Round Rock on Sunday.
impact: Cauley will provide the Rangers with infield depth for Sunday's regular-season finale against the Twins, with catcher Logan O'Hoppe being optioned in a corresponding move. Cauley has appeared in 34 major-league games this season and has a .626 OPS with one steal and a solo home run across 65 plate appearances.

headline: Head coach feels good about potential return
story: Carter (shoulder) could return to action this week as Red Raiders head coach Joey McGuire expressed optimism about him suiting up at Colorado in Week 5, per Lane Self of On3.com.
impact: Carter sat out Week 4 against Sam Houston, but McGuire said "I feel good about Terrance Carter being back" in Week 5 in Boulder. Carter has already missed two games this fall but he certainly appears to be trending in the right direction ahead of the Red Raiders' Big 12 opener. That would provide a big boost for Texas Tech's passing game.

headline: Steps into bigger role
story: Carpenter reeled in all two targets for 39 yards during Saturday's 49-14 victory against Sam Houston State.
impact: Carpenter saw an expanded role against Sam Houston with Terrance Carter sidelined by a shoulder injury. While he remains behind the top options in Texas Tech's passing attack, his increased usage is worth monitoring if Carter is forced to miss additional time. For now, Carpenter looks like a name to watch in deeper formats rather than a player to rush into lineups.

headline: Cashes in on second TD
story: Simmons logged one reception (on two targets) for 27 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 49-14 victory versus Sam Houston State.
impact: Simmons found the end zone against Sam Houston, this time catching a touchdown from backup QB Tommy Castellanos late in the game. Despite recording just two catches on three targets through four games, Simmons has turned both receptions into scores, making him one of the Big 12's most efficient fantasy producers on a per-touch basis. The touchdown rate is unlikely to be sustainable, but his ability to earn scoring opportunities keeps him on the radar in deeper formats.

headline: Makes the most of his chances
story: Eakin recorded four receptions (on five targets) for 50 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 49-14 victory against Sam Houston State.
impact: Eakin found the end zone for the second time this season, hauling in a 21-yard touchdown as part of Texas Tech's second-half surge against Sam Houston. While he continues to be a big-play threat in the passing game, Eakin's weekly volume trails that of Kenny Johnson, who remains the clear leader in opportunities. Eakin's touchdown upside keeps him fantasy relevant, but he'll likely remain a more boom-or-bust option unless his target share begins to climb.

headline: Remains the target leader
story: Johnson had three receptions (on eight targets) for 60 yards during Saturday's 49-14 victory versus Sam Houston State.
impact: Johnson continued to operate as the focal point of Texas Tech's passing game, drawing eight targets against Sam Houston after averaging seven targets per game through the first month of the season. While he turned those opportunities into just 60 receiving yards, he remains the most dependable volume play in the Red Raiders receiving corps. As long as the target share holds steady, Johnson should remain a strong fantasy option even if the offense continues to spread touchdowns around to other players.

headline: Still searching for a breakthrough
story: Joyner had eight carries for 12 yards during Saturday's 49-14 win over Sam Houston State.
impact: Joyner continued to see touches in the Texas Tech backfield, but once against took a back seat to Cameron Dickey's production. Unless the workload becomes more evenly distributed, Joyner projects as a difficult player to trust in fantasy lineups despite remaining part of the weekly rotation.

headline: Stays involved against Sam Houston
story: Williams compiled six carries for 36 yards and reeled in all three targets for 24 yards during Saturday's 49-14 victory versus Sam Houston State.
impact: Williams remained part of Texas Tech's rushing rotation and contributed with a key kickoff return that helped set up a second-half touchdown. However, with Cameron Dickey handling the scoring opportunities and making more of his touches, Williams' fantasy value remains tied to big plays and secondary usage.

headline: Takes control of the backfield
story: Dickey logged 12 carries for 91 yards and two touchdowns and gathered in all two targets for 24 yards during Saturday's 49-14 victory versus Sam Houston State.
impact: Dickey delivered his best fantasy performance yet after a quiet start to the season. His workload and efficiency were both encouraging signs that he's emerging as the lead back in the Red Raider offense. While both J'Koby Williams and Quinten Joyner continued to see work in the backfield, Dickey was clearly the most productive and efficient option, strengthening his case as the Red Raiders' lead back entering Big 12 play.

headline: Keeps finding the end zone
story: Castellanos was 1-for-2 passing for 27 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 49-14 victory over Sam Houston State. He also had four rushes for 26 yards.
impact: While Castellanos remains in a backup role, he continued his string of production by throwing a late touchdown against Sam Houston, giving him at least one score in three straight games. With Will Hammond enduring another uneven outing, Castellanos' continued involvement is worth monitoring. He remains more of a deep-league stash for now, but his weekly touchdown streak is becoming difficult for fantasy managers to ignore.

headline: Shakes off turnover troubles
story: Hammond was 17-for-29 passing for 224 yards, one touchdown and three interceptions during Saturday's 49-14 victory against Sam Houston State. He also had two rushes for 36 yards wi...
impact: Hammond's day was a mixed bag, adding his first rushing score of the season while also tossing three interceptions on three straight first-half drives as Texas Tech's 21-point lead nearly evaporated. The Red Raiders starting QB responded well after halftime, helping lead a 28-0 second-half surge to put Sam Houston away. The fantasy production has been okay with at least one touchdown in each game, but turnovers have been a recurring theme early this season. Against tougher Big 12 competition, Hammond's value will hinge on turning those explosive plays into cleaner outings.

headline: Out with shoulder injury
story: Carter (shoulder) is out for Saturday's game against Sam Houston, Pete Thamel of ESPN reports.
impact: Back in Week 2, Texas Tech played without Carter because he was dealing with a foot injury. Going into Week 4, it seemed that the aforementioned problem was what affected him, but Thamel indicates that the tight end's current issue involves an AC joint, in the shoulder. TTU's team will have to rely on its other TEs, including Jett Carpenter and Matt Ludwig, the latter of whom logged a touchdown in Week 2 and no targets when Carter was healthy. As for him, his next opportunity to play comes Oct. 3, when the Red Raiders will return to conference action by visiting Colorado.

headline: Scores TD in win
story: Dabbs tallied three receptions (on five targets) for 62 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 41-16 victory over San Diego State.
impact: After going scoreless a week ago against Temple, Dabbs found the end zone Saturday against SDSU. The wide receiver started the scoring for the Rockets after reeling in a 19-yard pass from John Alan Richter in the first quarter to take the lead. Through four games, the Tennessee native has 19 catches for 285 yards and four touchdowns.

headline: Scores first two TDs
story: Hammer hauled in all six targets for 133 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 41-16 win against San Diego State.
impact: Hammer had his best performance through his first four games after reeling in two scores and going for 133 receiving yards. The wide receiver scored on a 78-yard pass from John Alan Richter in the second quarter and later reeled in a 38-yard pass for his second touchdown in the third quarter to extend the lead. The Ohio native now has 15 catches for 286 yards and two touchdowns to begin the campaign.

headline: Scores fifth TD
story: Walendzak tallied 16 rushes for 61 yards and one touchdown and reeled in all two targets for 13 yards during Saturday's 41-16 win against San Diego State.
impact: Walendzak crossed the goal line for the fourth consecutive game to start the season. The running back scored on a one-yard run in the fourth quarter to extend the lead. Through his first four games, the Ohio native has 41 carries for 233 yards and seven total touchdowns.

headline: Tosses three scores in win
story: Richter completed 16 of 22 passes for 284 yards and three touchdowns during Saturday's 41-16 win over San Diego State.
impact: Richter recorded his third consecutive game with at least three passing touchdowns Saturday against SDSU. The quarterback found Bryson Hammer twice in the end zone and Adjatay Dabbs once. The Georgia native is off to a great start, accounting for 1,161 passing yards, 12 touchdowns and just one interception through four games.

headline: Out Saturday
story: Smith (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game versus San Diego State, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Smith will miss his second consecutive game Saturday as he continues to deal with an undisclosed injury. His next chance to suit up is next Saturday at Ball State.

headline: Still unavailable
story: Jones (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game against San Diego State.
impact: Jones will have finished his September without a single target to his name. Prior to joining Toledo, he played for Mercer, registering a couple of catches and a few rushing attempts before joining the MAC team.

headline: Targeted 12 times in OT win
story: Dabbs had eight receptions (on 12 targets) for 88 yards during Saturday's 49-48 overtime victory versus Temple.
impact: The wide receiver reeled in eight catches, averaging 11 yards per reception. Dabbs led the Rockets in receptions for the second time in the first three games. The Tennessee native has 16 catches for 223 yards and three touchdowns this season.

headline: Scores in OT win
story: Barnett gathered in all three targets for 47 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 49-48 overtime victory versus Temple.
impact: Barnett hauled in his first career touchdown during Saturday's win over Temple. The wide receiver reeled in a 23-yard pass from John Alan Richter to tie the game late in the fourth quarter.

headline: Leading receiver in OT win
story: Crosby gathered in 7 of 10 targets for 95 yards during Saturday's 49-48 overtime win over Temple.
impact: Crosby led the Rockets with 95 receiving yards on seven catches, averaging 13.6 yards per reception. The wide receiver came into Saturday's game with just two catches for 22 yards on the campaign.

headline: Scores first TD since 2024
story: Newell gathered in all three targets for 36 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 49-48 overtime victory versus Temple.
impact: In Newell's season debut for the Rockets, he was able to cross the goal line for the first time since 2024. The Akron transfer hauled in a nine-yard pass from John Alan Richter to cut the lead at the start of the second half.

headline: Scores pair of TDs in OT win
story: Miller recorded nine rushes for 33 yards and one touchdown and caught all four targets for 15 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 49-48 overtime victory versus Temple.
impact: Miller followed up his first touchdown of the season from a week ago with two more during Toledo's overtime win Saturday. The running back started the scoring for the Rockets with a one-yard run and then hauled in a crucial score from John Alan Richter late in the fourth quarter. The Alabama native now has 26 carries for 111 yards and three total touchdowns through the first three games of the year.

headline: Scores trio of TDs in OT win
story: Walendzak had 12 carries for 62 yards and two touchdowns and gathered in 1 of 3 targets for nine yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 49-48 overtime victory versus Temple.
impact: After recording two touchdowns a week ago, Walendzak topped his performance with three scores Saturday. One of his three scores was the eventual game-winning touchdown in overtime that put the Rockets ahead for good. The running back now has 25 carries for 172 yards and six total touchdowns through three games this season.

headline: Tosses four TDs in OT win
story: Richter was 36-for-51 passing for 429 yards and four touchdowns during Saturday's 49-48 overtime victory versus Temple.
impact: Richter led the Golden Flashes to a 14-point comeback with four passing touchdowns, including two late in the fourth quarter. The quarterback completed 35 of 51 passes, maintaining a 70.6 completion percentage. Through his first three games, the Georgia native has completed 63-of-96 passes with 877 passing yards, nine touchdowns and just one interception.

headline: Logs 88 yards in win
story: Dabbs (undisclosed) recorded eight receptions (on 12 targets) for 88 yards during Saturday's 49-48 overtime win versus Temple.
impact: Dabbs was questionable heading into the matchup against the Owls, but he ended up playing and delivering for the Rockets. The junior wideout was a major contributor in what would be a close OT win for Toledo. He's now totaled 223 receiving yards and three touchdowns on 16 catches across three games this year.

headline: Out Saturday
story: Smith is listed out ahead of Saturday's game against Temple.
impact: Smith will be forced to sit out this contest as he deals with some type of injury. The sophomore running back will aim to be back on the field for next week's game against San Diego State. He has total seven carries for 30 yards this season.

headline: Available Saturday
story: Gilbert (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game against Temple, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Gilbert is set to return to the field after missing Week 2 due to an undisclosed problem. The wideout isn't expected to have a big role in the passing attack but will add depth to the receiving corps Saturday.

headline: Listed as questionable vs. Temple
story: Dabbs (undisclosed) is questionable for Saturday's game against Temple, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Dabbs' status against Temple is up in the air as he has minimal time to recover before kickoff, making him presumably a game-time decision. The wideout is off to a great start this season, hauling in eight receptions for 135 yards and three touchdowns. His availability will be monitored closely leading up to kickoff, given his heavy involvement in Toledo's passing attack.

headline: Scores pair of TDs in win
story: Walendzak totaled six rushes for 34 yards and one touchdown and gathered in their only target for four yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 63-10 victory versus Central Connec...
impact: Walendzak opened the scoring for the Rockets after catching a four-yard pass from John Alan Richter early in the first quarter. The running back later crossed the goal line on a one-yard run to pad the lead further. Walendzak has now compiled three scores over his first two games along with 110 rushing yards, averaging 8.5 per carry.

headline: Scores long TD in win
story: Bond reeled in 4 of 6 targets for 135 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 63-10 win against Central Connecticut State.
impact: The Lindenwood transfer recorded his first touchdown as a Rocket in 2026. Bond hauled in an 85-yard pass from John Alan Richter for a score to extend Toledo's lead in the first quarter. The wide receiver led the team in receiving yards (135) and tied Adjatay Dabbs for the team-high in receptions (4).

headline: Records third TD of 2026
story: Dabbs recorded four receptions (on seven targets) for 34 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 63-10 victory over Central Connecticut State.
impact: After going for two scores a week ago, Dabbs recorded his third score of the year Saturday against Central Connecticut State. The wide receiver reeled in a four-yard pass from John Alan Richter for his lone score of the day.

headline: DNP for Week 2
story: Gilbert (undisclosed) did not play during Saturday's 63-10 win against Central Connecticut State.
impact: Gilbert is still looking to log his first counting stats since transferring from Southeast Missouri State. Though the team's 2025 season proved he can excel, doing the same with an FBS side may prove to be quite difficult.

headline: Dazzles in big win
story: Richter was 15-for-24 passing for 252 yards and three touchdowns during Saturday's 63-10 win against Central Connecticut State.
impact: Richter tossed three touchdowns during Toledo's blowout win over Central Connecticut State. The quarterback now has five touchdowns compared to just one interception through his first two games. Richter will look to continue his hot start next week against Temple.

headline: Struggles with turnovers in loss
story: Crowder completed 25 of 49 passes for 226 yards, one touchdown and three interceptions during Saturday's 21-10 defeat to Utah State. He also had five rushes for 48 yards.
impact: Crowder struggled in the loss, committing three turnovers to send the Trojans to 2-2 on the season. Crowder connected with Howard Kinchen in for his lone touchdown pass on a 13-yard score in the first quarter. Through four games, Crowder has thrown for 822 yards, seven touchdowns and four interceptions. The Trojans host Southern Miss on October 6.

headline: Leads Trojan receivers in loss
story: White posted six receptions (on 10 targets) for 75 yards during Saturday's 21-10 defeat against Utah State.
impact: White posted a team-high and personal season-high 75 yards during the loss on Saturday. His longest catch went for 36 yards and the wideout now has 122 yards on 10 receptions through four weeks.

headline: Held in check in loss
story: Keyes accrued three receptions (on nine targets) for 20 yards during Saturday's 21-10 loss to Utah State.
impact: Keyes and the rest of the Trojan offense really struggled to get going on Saturday. The 20 yards were a season low and the wideout will head into Week 5 with 12 receptions, 270 yards and three touchdowns across four contests.

headline: Touchdown in loss
story: Kinchen reeled in six of seven targets for 58 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 21-10 loss versus Utah State.
impact: Kinchen reeled in the Trojans' only touchdown of the contest when he connected with quarterback Goose Crowder for a 13-yard score. Through two games, Kinchen has hauled in 11 passes for 138 yards and two touchdowns.

headline: Limited in return
story: Lott (undisclosed) played just two snaps during Saturday's 21-10 loss to Utah State.
impact: Lott was previously listed as questionable for Saturday's contest due to an undisclosed injury that held him out of last week's matchup agianst Missouri. Though he was able to get back onto the field agianst Utah State, his extremely limited snapcount indicates that he may not be at 100 percent. He will have Troy's upcoming bye week to get healthy before his next chance against Southern Mississippi.

headline: Held in check vs. Mizzou
story: Merriweather logged nine carries for 44 yards during Saturday's 27-17 defeat versus Missouri.
impact: Merriweather exploded in Week 2 against FCS Alcorn State, but the back came back down to earth in Week 3 against an SEC team. That's not to say he was completely silenced, but as the No. 3 back in this rotation behind Gavin Griffin and Jordan Lovett, it's going to be hard for Merriweather to produce on a consistent basis. Still, he figures to continue to receive touches in this offense.

headline: Solid outing vs. SEC defense
story: Crowder completed 18 of 32 passes for 230 yards, two touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 27-17 loss to Missouri. He also had six rushes for -11 yards.
impact: Crowder threw two touchdowns against an SEC secondary and kept his team in the game during what wound up being a very narrow defeat. He did lose a fumble in addition to his interception, which is tough considering how close the final score was. However, this was a promising performance for the gunslinger, as he notched his best yardage output and completion percentage (56.3) ahead of Week 4 at Utah State.

headline: Scores in loss
story: Keyes caught 2 of 5 targets for 83 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 27-17 defeat to Missouri.
impact: Keyes now has a touchdown and multiple receptions in each of Troy's first three games. With 16 targets through three weeks, it's safe to say Keyes is a steady, consistent part of this passing game, and he'll look to stay hot in an easier matchup next week at Utah State.

headline: Suffers leg injury
story: Rogosch suffered a leg injury in Saturday's 27-17 loss to Missouri, Josh Boutwell of The Troy Messenger reports.
impact: Rogosch did not record a stat before leaving the game due to the leg injury. The 6-foot-5 tight end's status for this Saturday's outing at Utah State is now in question.

headline: Misses Week 3
story: Worley (undisclosed) did not play in Saturday's 27-17 loss to Missouri, per Josh Boutwell of The Troy Messenger.
impact: Worley missed his first outing of the year as the Trojans took a loss against the Tigers. The senior tight end is now questionable for this Saturday's away game at Utah State.

headline: Dominant in loss
story: Kinchen (undisclosed) caught five passes for 80 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's loss to Missouri.
impact: Kinchen had a dominant outing in his season debut despite the loss, as he led the team in receptions and finished second in receiving yards. He will look to build on this strong performance and keep producing during the Week 4 matchup against Utah State.

headline: Sits against Missou
story: Lott (undisclosed) did not play in Saturday's 27-17 loss to Missouri.
impact: Lott looked to be dealing with an injury while the Trojans took the loss to the Tigers. The senior wide receiver will now aim to make a return for this Saturday's game at Utah State.

headline: Explosive in win
story: Merriweather accrued 13 carries for 127 yards and three touchdowns and caught their only target for three yards during Saturday's 34-17 win against Alabama State.
impact: Merriweather couldn't be stopped on Saturday as the running back ran for three scores. Merriweather found the end zone on 69, six, and one-yard runs and now has 149 yards on 19 carries this season.

headline: Long TD in win
story: Keyes caught five of six targets for 119 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-17 win against Alabama State.
impact: Keyes opened the scoring on Saturday when he and quarterback Goose Crowder teamed up for a 73-yard score. Through two weeks Keyes has seven receptions for 167 yards and two touchdowns.

headline: Tosses TD in win
story: Crowder completed 14 of 27 passes for 201 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 34-17 win over Alabama State. He also had five rushes for negative one yard.
impact: Crowder's lone touchdown pass of the afternoon came on a 73-yard strike to TK Keyes in the first quarter to give the Trojans a 7-0 lead. Through two games, Crowder has thrown from 366 yards and four touchdowns. Up next for Crowder and the Trojans is a road matchup against Missouri.

headline: Tosses three touchdowns in win
story: Crowder was 12-for-24 passing for 165 yards and three touchdowns during Saturday's 24-21 victory against Sam Houston State. He also had nine rushes for 38 yards.
impact: Crowder helped lead the Trojans to victory on Saturday by tossing three touchdowns on 19, 28, and 18 yards out. Up next for Crowder and the Trojans is a home matchup with Alabama State.

headline: Goes for touchdown in victory
story: Rogosch reeled in all three targets for 37 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 24-21 victory versus Sam Houston State.
impact: Rogosch scored the Trojans' first touchdown of the season after he connected with quarterback Goose Crowder on a 19-yard score in the first quarter.

headline: Tallies 55 yards of total offense
story: Woods compiled seven rushes for 41 yards and one touchdown and reeled in all two targets for 14 yards during Saturday's 54-3 win versus Maryland.
impact: Although Woods is the clear backup to Wayne Knight, the senior has 269 yards and four touchdowns in four games, and he is well on his way to outdoing his previous season totals with the Bruins. After a week off, the Bruins will face Oregon on the road, where Woods will get his share of carries.

headline: Dolid totals in mop-up duty
story: Leigber totaled five carries for 83 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 54-3 win against Maryland.
impact: With the game well in hand, Leigber made the most of his opportunities. He had zero carries heading into Week 4 and only 33 yards during his college career, so it's realistic to assume that this line is an aberration due to the lopsided total held by the Bruins.

headline: Surpasses century mark again
story: Knight logged 10 carries for 100 yards and one touchdown and reeled in all three targets for 35 yards during Saturday's 54-3 win against Maryland.
impact: Kngith generated 135 yards of total offense in the decisive victory. The Bruins remain undefeated heading into the bye week, and Knight has been a critical piece of the team's success. His prolific rushing totals rank him 6th in the FBS with 445 rushing yards

headline: Logs efficient line in blowout
story: Iamaleava completed 15 of 24 passes for 209 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 54-3 win versus Maryland. He also had six rushes for two yards.
impact: The most glaring element of Iamaleava's result was the lack of rushing production, considering he averaged 47.0 yards per game prior to Saturday's contest. He leaned on his arm, recording over 200 passing yards for the second straight week, and left most of the running production to Wayne Knight and a host of backups after the game was well in hand. The team gets a break in Week 5, and Iamaleava will get some extra time to prep for a tough game against Oregon.

headline: Good to go Saturday
story: Phifer is available for Saturday's game at Maryland, per the Big Ten availability report.
impact: Phifer was listed as probable on Friday, so his availability is not a major surprise. The senior missed the last two games due to an undisclosed injury after receiving one target in the season opener.

headline: Available for Week 4
story: Mizell (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game at Maryland.
impact: Now that Mizell is healthy, he will look to log his first reception since transferring from Florida. The wide receiver has logged a target for UCLA, but he failed to catch the targeted pass back in Week 2 against San Diego State.

headline: Could play Saturday
story: Mizell (undisclosed) is probable for Saturday's game at Maryland.
impact: Mizell has logged just 13 snaps this season, being targeted once in Week 2. If he's back in the mix, don't expect him to have a big role in the passing game, as Mizell is buried down the WR depth chart, but the probable tag suggests he should be likely to suit up.

headline: Hits paydirt
story: Brown caught four passes for 44 yards and a touchdown in the UConn 24-21 loss to Miami of Ohio on Saturday.
impact: Brown will have a tough time against Bowling Green who the Huskies face on Oct. 3. The Falcons defense is stingy against the pass and is top 30 in nation.

headline: Hits paydirt in defeat
story: Bowers saw a drop in rushing numbers with 48 yards on the ground on seven attempts but did have a running touchdown in the UConn 24-21 loss to Miami of Ohio on Saturday.
impact: Bowers had a career best rushing yardage the previous week, 84 yards on 11 attempts, against Southern Mississippi on Sept. 19. UConn will take on Bowling Green on Oct. 3. Bowers could be ready for a big day. The Falcons defense against the run is in the bottom of the country.

headline: Leads UConn in rushing
story: Bowers topped the Huskies runners with 84 yards on 11 carries and one touchdown in the UConn 48-20 win over Southern Mississippi.
impact: It is the junior's top game on the ground. Bowers might struggle in the next game against Miami of Ohio on Sept. 26. The Redhawks defense is in the top 50 in the nation against the run. Miami of Ohio defense is near the bottom against the pass in the nation.

headline: Tallies 100 total yards
story: Christian accumulated 100 total yards, including 64 rushing yards on 15 carries in the UConn 48-20 win over Southern Mississippi.
impact: Christian also caught a pair of catches for 36 yards. The Huskies take on Miami of Ohio on Sept. 26. UConn will probably succeed through the air since the Redhawks defense is near the bottom in the nation against the pass.

headline: Tallies 4 TDs
story: Osborne completed 16-of-22 pass attempts for 214 yards and two touchdowns while also rushing 10 times for 32 yards and an additional two touchdowns in the UConn 48-20 win over Sout...
impact: With the statistics against Southern Mississippi, Osborne has accumulated 10 touchdowns this season in only the first three games. The junior has a shot to add to his passing stats as well as his touchdown numbers against Miami of Ohio on Sept. 26. The Redhawks defense is near the bottom in the nation against the pass.

headline: Hits paydirt
story: Willoughby had only one catch, but it was for a 36-yard touchdown in the UConn 28-14 loss to Maryland on Saturday.
impact: Willoughby, who transferred from Toledo, celebrated his first career college touchdown. The junior is one of several Huskie receivers who are looking to take the number one receiver spot on the Huskies.

headline: Leads Huskies in receiving
story: Porter led UConn in receiving yards with 62 yards on three catches in the UConn 28-14 loss to Maryland on Saturday.
impact: In addition, the total against Maryland was a career best for the senior. Coming into the season Porter was looking to fill the void of the departures from the UConn team of 2025. He will look to continue to build his case the Huskies number on receiver when UConn takes on Southern Mississippi on Sept. 19.

headline: Pair TDs in loss to Terps
story: Osborne collected 186 total yards and two touchdowns in the UConn 28-14 loss to Maryland on Saturday.
impact: Osborne completed 10-of-21 pass attempts for 156 while rushing for 30 yards on 13 attempts against the Terps. In the first game of the season, the junior compiled 355 total yards and four total touchdowns including completing 19-of-26 pass attempts for 265 yards and two throwing scores in the win over Lafayette. He will try to rebound against Southern Mississippi on Sept. 19.

headline: Quiet day in defeat
story: Christian only tallied 31 total yards in the UConn 28-14 loss to Maryland on Saturday.
impact: The senior ran nine times for 17 yards while grabbing a pair of receptions for 14 yards. Christian was listed as the starter before the season opener versus FCS Lafayette on Sept. 5. Against Lafayette the senior ran seven times for 46 yards and a touchdown. Christian will look to break out against Southern Mississippi on Sept. 19.

headline: Remains out for Week 2
story: Merklinger (undisclosed) is out for UConn in Week 2, per Sam Calhoun of UConn On3.
impact: Merklinger will miss his second straight game. Tucker McDonald should be the primary backup to starter Kalieb Osborne against Maryland on Saturday.

headline: Fills in during blow out
story: McDonald completed 6-of-7 pass attempts for 105 yards including an 80-yard touchdown as he came in the third quarter in UConn's 56-7 victory over FCS Lafayette on Sept. 5.
impact: The senior entered with the Huskies ahead 42-0. McDonald has only seen limited time under center the last couple seasons at UConn. Last season he was 1-for-3 with 45 yards in two games.

headline: Leads Huskies in debut
story: Osborne, who transferred from Toledo, collected 355 total yards and four total touchdowns including completing 19-of-26 pass attempts for 265 yards and two throwing scores in UConn...
impact: The junior also ran for 90 yards on eight carries and two touchdowns. It was only the second time in Osborne's career that he threw for more than 20 pass attempts. Osborne will have a much stiffer test on Sept. 12 when UConn takes on Maryland.

headline: Limited by blowout
story: Christian ran seven times for 46 yards and a touchdown in U Conn's 56-7 victory over FCS Lafayette on Sept. 5.
impact: The Toledo transfer also caught a pair of passes for 22 yards and a touchdown. The senior was listed as the starting running back before the Lafayette game, but the Huskies were already ahead 42-0 when many of the starters were pulled. Christian will see more of a workload in a more competitive contest against Maryland on Sept. 12.

headline: Hits paydirt in victory
story: Cornist ran six times for 76 yards of which 55 of those yards were for a touchdown in U Conn's 56-7 victory over FCS Lafayette on Sept. 5.
impact: It was the first game for Cornist since he transferred from Central Michigan where he logged 105 carries for 470 yards and a touchdown. Cornist will try to add to his resume in the early going for U Conn when they take on Maryland on Sept. 12.

headline: Leads U. Conn in rushing attempts
story: Bowers had the most attempts for U. Conn with 10 for 42 yards and a rushing touchdown in the Huskies' 56-7 victory over FCS Lafayette on Sept. 5.
impact: Several running backs got into the act in the victory over Lafayette and that included Bowers who transferred from West Virginia. It will be a bigger test for the Huskies when they take on Maryland on Sept. 12.

headline: Leads U Conn in receiving
story: Brown caught six passes for 92 yards and a touchdown in U. Conn's 56-7 victory over FCS Lafayette on Sept. 5.
impact: It was the junior's best outing since last season where he caught five passes for 94 yards in U. Conn's win over Morgan State on Sept. 13, 2025. Brown is trying to finally make his mark with the Huskies. His next challenge will be against Maryland on Sept. 12.

headline: Accounts for three TDs in win
story: Watson completed 11 of 16 passes for 101 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 35-6 victory against Sacramento State. He also had seven rushes for 72 yards with two touchdowns.
impact: Watson led the Minutemen to their first 4-0 start since 2007 on Saturday against Sacramento State. The quarterback set a season-high in rushing yards (72) and scored a touchdown on the ground for the third consecutive game. Through the first four games, the Massachusetts native has 610 passing yards, 154 rushing yards, 10 total touchdowns and one interception.

headline: Held out Saturday
story: Griffin (undisclosed) did not play during Saturday's 35-6 victory over Sacramento State on Saturday.
impact: Griffin was seen warming up in pregame but was unable to give it a go against Sacramento State. The 6-foot-4 senior will hope to make his return when the Minutemen host Eastern Michigan on Saturday.

headline: Spotted in warmups
story: Griffin (undisclosed) is spotted in warmups ahead of Saturday's game against Sacramento State, Cam Pellegrino of The Boston Globe reports.
impact: Seeing Griffin in warm-ups is a good sign, but his availability will be monitored prior to the 9 p.m. ET kickoff. The senior wideout is having a strong start to the year with eight catches for 134 yards and a score in three contests in 2026.

headline: Not playing once again
story: Williams-Thomas (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game against Sacramento State.
impact: Williams-Thomas will miss a second straight game due to an undisclosed injury. The senior tailback will aim to return against Eastern Michigan on Saturday, Oct. 3.

headline: Deemed questionable for Saturday
story: Griffin (undisclosed) is questionable for Saturday's game at Sacramento State, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Griffin is dealing with an undisclosed issue that has put him in jeopardy of missing his first game. The wideout's official status is expected to be announced prior to kickoff. This season, he has hauled in eight receptions for 134 yards and one touchdown.

headline: Rushes for 61 yards in win
story: Faulkner posted 11 carries for 61 yards and two catches for 15 yards during Saturday's 36-14 win against Stonehill.
impact: Faulkner led the team in rushing yards for the second consecutive game. The running back averaged 5.5 yards per carry on 11 attempts. The sophomore has totaled at least 60 yards on the ground in each of his first three games.

headline: Scores pair of TDs in win
story: Harding notched four catches for 73 yards and one touchdown, while rushing for 56 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 36-14 victory versus Stonehill.
impact: Harding housed a 56-yard run in the first quarter to give the Minutemen the early lead. Later in the game, the receiver reeled in a 51-yard pass from William Watson to cement the lead. Harding now has four total touchdowns through three games this season.

headline: Scores twice in Week 3
story: Watson completed 15 of 25 passes for 160 yards, one touchdown and one interception during Saturday's 36-14 win against Stonehill. He also had nine rushes for two yards with one tou...
impact: Through three games, Watson has compiled seven total touchdowns to lead the Minutemen to a rare 3-0 start. The quarterback contributed both scores in the fourth quarter after running one in from a yard out and tossing a 51-yard pass to T.Y. Harding for the second score. Watson will look to preserve the perfect start to the season as UMass opens up MAC play next week at Sacramento State.

headline: Won't play Saturday
story: Williams-Thomas will sit out Saturday's game against Stonehill, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Williams-Thomas has totaled just four carries through the first two games, and it appears the senior won't add to that total Saturday. He'll have another opportunity to return to the fold next week against Sacramento State as conference play fires up.

headline: Available vs. Stonehill
story: Washington (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game versus Stonehill, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Washington will make his season debut Saturday and is expected to share a role in the backfield with Elijah Faulkner. Last season with Murray State, he recorded 86 rushing attempts for 340 yards and three touchdowns.

headline: Good to go barring setback
story: Washington (undisclosed) should be available to play this week barring a setback, per Christian McCollum of MinutemanCommand.com.
impact: "He should be cleared, minus a setback this week. So I'm really excited about him," Minutemen head coach Joe Harasymiak said of the tailback. Washington has yet to play this season, but he was productive last fall at Murray State where he totaled 546 yards and five touchdowns as both a productive receiver and ball-carrier.

headline: Leading receiver in win
story: Griffin tallied three receptions (on four targets) for 59 yards during Saturday's 37-10 win over Sacred Heart.
impact: Griffin tallied the most receptions (3) and yards (59) during a blowout victory for the Minutemen on Saturday. The Wisconsin transfer has led the team in receiving yards for consecutive games to begin the 2026 campaign.

headline: Scores on lone reception
story: Harding gathered in their only target for 49 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 37-10 victory versus Sacred Heart.
impact: Harding was featured once, early in the game for the Minutemen during the win over Sacred Heart on Saturday. The receiver corralled a 49-yard catch from William Watson for a touchdown just 44 seconds into the game.

headline: Leads team in rushing
story: Faulkner had 11 carries for 72 yards during Saturday's 37-10 win against Sacred Heart.
impact: Faulkner led the Minutemen in rushing yards (72), averaging 6.5 yards per carry. The sophomore running back has now gone consecutive weeks with at least 10 carries and 60 rushing yards.

headline: Scores twice in win
story: Watson was 9-for-10 passing for 152 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 37-10 win over Sacred Heart. He also had four rushes for 40 yards with one touchdown.
impact: Watson followed up his Minutemen debut with a solid performance during their second win of the season. The Virginia Tech transfer started the scoring early in the first with a 49-yard touchdown pass to T.Y. Harding to give the Minutemen the lead. Watson later scored on an eight-yard rush to pad the lead. Watson will look to lead UMass to a 3-0 start for the first time since 2007.

headline: Unavailable vs. Sacred Heart
story: Washington (undisclosed) is out against Sacred Heart in Week 2, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Washington wasn't available for the Minutemen's huge upset win over Rutgers in Week 1, and the tailback will now miss his second straight game. Elijah Faulkner and Curtis Kimmons should lead the way at running back for UMass.

headline: First TD since 2023
story: Griffin gathered in 2 of 4 targets for 61 yards and one touchdown during Thursday's 37-21 victory versus Rutgers.
impact: Griffin reeled in a 31-yard pass from William Watson for a touchdown to extend the lead for UMass. The wide receiver had just two receptions, but both went for at least 30 yards. Despite just having two catches, Griffin led the team in receiving yards, narrowly beating out T.Y. Harding.

headline: Sees first meaningful action of season
story: Anderson gathered in 2 of 7 targets for 50 yards during Saturday's 41-27 loss against Oregon.
impact: Although Anderson eased into special teams work over the past few weeks, he finally took snaps with the offense and showed the promise he demonstrated during his tenure at NC State. He could ba a dynamo in this offense if he gets enough opportunities.

headline: Hits paydirt
story: Robinson caught four passes for 67 yards and a touchdown in the Aggies 21-10 over Troy on Saturday.
impact: Robinson caught four passes for 67 yards and a touchdown in the Aggies 21-10 over Troy on Saturday. Utah State takes on Boise State on Oct. 3. The Broncos defense is near the bottom against the pass.

headline: Career best in receiving
story: Wood led Utah State in receiving with seven catches for 96 yards with a touchdown that was a personal best in the Aggies 21-10 over Troy on Saturday.
impact: Wood's previous best came in the season opener against Idaho State with 90 yards on six catches. Utah State takes on Boise State on Oct. 3. The Broncos defense is near the bottom against the pass.

headline: Leads RBs on the ground
story: Jacobs ran for 84 yards on 14 carries in the Aggies first win of the season, 21-10 over Troy on Saturday.
impact: It was the best game since Nov. 28, 2025, for the senior where he ran for 92 yards against Boise State and a touchdown. Jacobs will be looking to repeat that feat against the Broncos on Oct. 3. The senior could have a tough time against a Boise State defense that is in the top 30 against the run.

headline: Breaks out in win
story: Brosterhous had his best outing under center in completing 18-of-28 pass attempts for 242 yards and two touchdowns in the Aggies first win of the season, 21-10 over Troy on Saturda...
impact: Brosterhous showed his strength at running the ball with 89 yards on the ground on 15 carries. The senior could have another good game throwing the ball against Boise State on Oct. 3. The Broncos defense is near the bottom against the pass.

headline: Past arm injury
story: Hillstead is no longer dealing with a forearm injury, per Carson Hilton of Deseret.com.
impact: Hillstead is healthy again after having dealt with a forearm injury. He is expected to serve as the backup quarterback behind Grady Brosterhous going forward.

headline: Struggles in blowout
story: Brosterhous completed 15-of-29 pass attempts for 130 yards while being intercepted once and sacked four times as Utah State was shutout by rival Utah, 33-0, on Saturday.
impact: The senior also ran 17 times for 17 yards. Brosterhous could not build on a relatively quality outing against Washington when he completed 17-of-28 for 196 yards and two touchdowns in the loss on Sept. 12. Utah State takes on Troy on Sept. 26. The Aggies could have a chance to pass the ball against a Trojans defense that is in the bottom third in the nation against the pass.

headline: Leads Aggies in receiving
story: Wood collected 47 receiving yards on four catches as the Utah State offense struggled in the 33-0 verdict to instate rival Utah on Saturday.
impact: Wood missed out in getting into the end zone against Utah. The senior had a touchdown in each of the first Utah State games of the season. The Aggies could have a chance to pass the ball against a Trojans defense that is in the bottom third in the nation against the pass.

headline: Not starting Saturday
story: Hillstead (forearm) did not take the field as the starter for Saturday's game versus Utah, Joe Coles of the Deseret News reports.
impact: Hillstead split reps during warmups, which seemingly indicates the junior will not give it a go Saturday. Assuming that's the case, look for Grady Brosterhous to man the helm for the Aggies against a difficult Big 12 opponent.

headline: Starting vs. Utah
story: Brosterhous is starting at quarterback for Utah State on Saturday versus Utah, per Joe Coles of the Deseret News.
impact: Brosterhous draws the start at quarterback for the second consecutive game, with McCae Hillstead (forearm) remaining sidelined.
