During his Week 2 start against Washington, Brosterhous tossed for 277 total yards and a pair of touchdowns while being intercepted three times. If he can clean up his efficiency, he can be a capable starter for the Aggies and has a chance to redeem himself against Utah.

headline: Splits starter reps in warmups
story: Hillstead (forearm) was seen splitting starter reps in warmups ahead of Saturday's game at Utah, per Josh Furlong of Utah Athletics.
impact: Grady Brosterhous was the first quarterback to take starting first-team reps for Utah State until Hillstead came in right after him. It's still unclear whether the quarterback will play, and a final call on his status should come closer to kickoff. If he is unavailable, Brosterhous should draw the start against Utah.

headline: Hits century mark
story: Robinson only needed three catches to collect 100 yards in the 16-14 loss to Washington on Saturday.
impact: The senior, who transferred from Georgia State, registered his third 100-plus receiving day in his career that also included playing at Grambling. The Aggies take on in-state rival, Utah, on Sept. 19.

headline: Hits paydirt against Huskies
story: Wood is becoming a consistent target for Utah State and caught six passes for 53 yards and a touchdown in the 16-14 loss to Washington on Saturday.
impact: The senior is already on his way, barring an injury, to surpass last season's numbers of 16 catches and 205 yards and two touchdowns. He has collected a dozen receptions for 143 yards and two touchdowns in the first two games of the 2026 season. The Aggies take on in-state rival, Utah, on Sept. 19.

headline: Delivers and misses an opportunity
story: Curtis connected on 1 of 2 field goal attempts and all four of his extra-point tries during Saturday's 31-17 win versus Iowa State.
impact: Curtis had a solid, if unspectacular, fantasy outing against Iowa State, connecting on one field goal while missing another attempt. The good news for managers is that Utah's offense continues to generate scoring chances at an elite rate, even if many of them are ending in touchdowns rather than field-goal opportunities. As long as the Utes keep rolling through opponents, Curtis should remain a reliable kicking option with a strong weekly floor.

headline: Quiet week comes in a win
story: Bennee gathered in 2 of 4 targets for 18 yards during Saturday's 31-17 victory over Iowa State.
impact: Bennee took a back seat statistically against Iowa State as Utah's offense ran almost entirely through RB Wayshawn Parker. The lack of volume isn't particularly concerning given how little the Utes needed to throw, and Bennee remains the top tight end option in one of the Big 12's most efficient offenses. If opponents do a better job slowing down Utah's ground game, expect Bennee's involvement in the passing attack to rise once again.

headline: Capitalizes on limited opportunities
story: Pegan accrued two receptions (on five targets) for 29 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 31-17 victory against Iowa State.
impact: Pegan made the most of his touches, finding the end zone on a 24-yard touchdown reception. While the box score wasn't overwhelming with volume for Utah's receivers, that's more a reflection of Wayshawn Parker's huge day and the Utes' balanced offense attack than any concern about Pegan's role. He remains a useful fantasy option, particularly in games where Utah is forced to throw more often.

headline: Stays in the mix
story: Whittemore caught all three targets for 44 yards during Saturday's 31-17 victory over Iowa State.
impact: Whittemore turned in a solid performance against Iowa State, but Utah simply didn't need to lean on its passing game with Wayshawn Parker dominating touches and production from start to finish. Whittemore remains a regular part of the offense, though his weekly fantasy ceiling may be capped when the Utes are controlling games on the ground.

headline: Passing streak comes to an end
story: Ficklin completed 0 of 0 passes for zero yards during Saturday's 31-17 win against Iowa State.
impact: Ficklin didn't attempt a pass for the first time this season as Utah leaned heavily on Devon Dampier and cruised past Iowa State. Ficklin still found a way onto the stat sheet with a rushing attempt, showing the Utes remain interested in finding situational ways to keep him involved. For fantasy purposes, however, his value remains limited unless his package expands beyond occasional gadget usage.

headline: TD streak rolls on
story: Dampier completed 18 of 27 passes for 206 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 31-17 victory over Iowa State. He also had seven rushes for 21 yards.
impact: Dampier stayed red hot while extending his streak of multi-touchdown passing games to four straight this season. Utah has yet to be seriously challenged during its 4-0, and Dampier continues to post efficient numbers without needing gaudy passing volume. With the Utes averaging over 30 points per game and their ground game demanding defensive attention, Dampier remains one of the safest fantasy quarterback options in the Big 12 heading into the heart of conference play.

headline: Available for Week 4
story: Carvalho (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game against Iowa State, per the Big 12 availability report.
impact: Carvalho has seemingly recovered from his undisclosed issue and has cleared Utah's injury report. The wideout has appeared in every game this season, recording two receptions for 38 yards.

headline: Upgraded to probable
story: Carvalho (undisclosed) is probable for Saturday's game against Iowa State.
impact: Carvalho is trending in the right direction to suit up Saturday. He's seen limited action through three weeks and figures to slot in as more of a depth option.

headline: Continues to lead backfield
story: Jones recorded 10 rushes for 34 yards during Saturday's 33-7 defeat versus Oregon State.
impact: Jones has served as UTEP's lead back the past two weeks, with Lamar Sperling (undisclosed) unavailable Saturday and limited in Week 3. Jones, a redshirt junior, hasn't been able to fully take advantage of the opportunity, totaling 68 yards on 19 carries against a pair of tough defenses in Michigan and Oregon State. If Sperling is able to return, it'll be worth monitoring UTEP's backfield next week, when they'll visit New Mexico to open conference play.

headline: Grabs third touchdown
story: Cheeks hauled in 4 of 6 targets for 46 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 33-7 defeat to Oregon State.
impact: Cheeks now has a touchdown in three straight games, despite failing to log more than four receptions in any of his four contests this season. Overall, the senior wideout has brought in 10 of his 14 targets this year for 143 yards.

headline: Leading receiver Saturday
story: Smith posted eight receptions (on 10 targets) for 62 yards during Saturday's 33-7 loss to Oregon State.
impact: Smith emerged as EJ Colson's go-to option Saturday, as the wideout led the team in targets, receptions and yards. Coming into the day, Smith had totaled just three receptions (on five targets) for 18 yards in his first three games. Expect the senior wideout to have a significant role in UTEP's offense going forward. Smith was limited to just four games over his previous two seasons after tearing and subsequently re-tearing his ACL. He did log 781 yards and five touchdowns on 73 receptions with Eastern Kentucky in 2023, his last full season.

headline: Falls to Oregon State
story: Colson completed 16 of 23 passes for 119 yards, one touchdown and one interception during Saturday's 33-7 loss to Oregon State. He also had 19 rushes for 15 yards.
impact: While it was another tough day for the UTEP offense, Colson did finish with a respectable 69.6 completion percentage. In his last two games, the redshirt sophomore's completed 71.9 of his passes, but for only 205 yards. Colson and the Miners should have more favorable matchups going forward -- they'll open conference play next week at New Mexico.

headline: Not playing in Week 4
story: Sperling (undisclosed) is unavailable for Saturday's game against Oregon State, according to Adrian Broaddus of 600 ESPN El Paso.
impact: Sperling usually operates as UTEP's No. 2 running back, but he's unavailable for this contest, so Chris Hunter will see more work out of the backfield in his place. Sperling's next chance to return to action will come against New Mexico in a Week 5 matchup on Oct. 3.

headline: Finds end zone in win
story: Cheeks caught all three targets for 39 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 51-10 win against Texas Southern.
impact: Cheeks was expected to be UTEP's top receiver this season, though he's only totaled five receptions for 52 yards in his first two games. He did find the end zone Saturday, however, bringing in a 13-yard touchdown reception in the third quarter. Cheeks transferred this offseason from Northern Colorado, where he totaled 929 yards and six scores on 71 receptions.

headline: Two grabs, two touchdowns in win
story: Cheeks caught two targets for 29 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 51-10 win versus Texas Southern.
impact: The 6-foot-7 Cheeks emerged as a red zone weapon for the Miners' on Saturday, as he brought in his first two collegiate touchdowns on his only two targets. Cheeks transferred to UTEP this offseason from Northern Colorado, where he totaled 18 receptions for 171 yards last year.

headline: Touchdown in win
story: Thomas gathered in 2 of 4 targets for 92 yards and a touchdown during Saturday's 51-10 victory against Texas Southern.
impact: Thomas didn't log a carry Saturday but he made a quick impact as a receiver, as he broke free for an 83-yard touchdown reception on UTEP's first offensive play from scrimmage. Thomas missed all but one game last season with a knee injury, but he totaled 47 receptions for 532 yards and two touchdowns in 2024.

headline: Leads backfield in win
story: Jones had 16 rushes for 104 yards and a touchdown and hauled in his only target for three yards during Saturday's 51-10 victory over Texas Southern.
impact: Jones took over as UTEP's lead back in Week 2 after totaling just five rushes for 24 yards in a Week 1 loss to Oklahoma. The redshirt junior looks to have earned the lead-back role in El Paso, as he out-carried Lamar Sperling 16-to-2. Jones, a former four-star recruit out of high school, transferred to UTEP from Missouri, where he totaled 86 rushing yards on 20 attempts across two seasons.

headline: Totals five scores in win
story: Colson was 14-for-21 passing for 239 yards and four touchdowns during Saturday's 51-10 victory versus Texas Southern. He also had 12 rushes for 49 yards with another touchdown.
impact: It was quite a bounce-back performance from Colson, following a rough debut in UTEP's opener against Oklahoma. He was certainly efficient in much more favorable matchup, averaging 11.4 yards per pass attempt while accounting for five total touchdowns. Colson will have another tough assignment next week, however, in road matchup with Michigan.

headline: Productive in loss
story: Sherrill caught 6 of 7 targets for 95 yards during Saturday's 21-15 loss against Auburn.
impact: Sherrill was Vanderbilt's most productive receiver, as he continues to build chemistry with Jared Curtis. The senior wide receiver now has three consecutive games with at least five receptions combined with 90 receiving yards. He will face Georgia on the road next.

headline: Plows into end zone in loss
story: Alexander totaled 11 carries for 13 yards and one touchdown and caught all two targets for 13 yards during Saturday's 21-15 loss versus Auburn.
impact: Alexander was bottled up on the ground, averaging just 1.2 yards-per-carry, but he saved his day with a three-yard touchdown in the third quarter. The senior running back has scored in three of four games but will need to find more running room after a season-low 13 rushing yards. He will face Georgia next.

headline: Tough outing in loss
story: Curtis was 22-for-33 passing for 199 yards and one interception during Saturday's 21-15 defeat versus Auburn. He also had 18 rushes for 46 yards.
impact: Curtis couldn't replicate his three-touchdown performance against NC State, failing to account for a touchdown. The freshman quarterback still totaled 245 total yards, but will need to improve his performance during next week's clash with Georgia.

headline: Observed in warmups Saturday
story: Spence (leg) was seen wearing uniform ahead of Saturday's game against Auburn, Joey Dwyer of SI.com reports.
impact: Spence was observed participating in pregame warmups in uniform, indicating he may be available to his season debut. The senior tight end is expected to be an important part of this offense.

headline: GTD vs. Auburn
story: Spence (leg) is listed as a game-time decision ahead of Saturday's game against Auburn.
impact: Spence has yet to make his season debut as he continues to work his way back from a leg injury but appears to be nearing his return. Should he miss this game, the senior tight end will aim to be back for next week's meeting with Georgia. Moree news regarding his status should surface shortly.

headline: Officially listed as questionable
story: Spence (leg) is questionable for Saturday's game at Auburn.
impact: Spence was described as "day-to-day" by head coach Clark Lea earlier this week, and it seems a decision on the availability of the tight end willl be made closer to Saturday's 4:15 p.m. ET kickoff. Spence has yet to play this season, but the questionable tag suggests he could be primed to see action soon, especially after Lea said he's day-to-day.

headline: Questionable for Friday
story: Davis (undisclosed) is listed as questionable ahead of Friday's contest versus Pittsburgh, per the ACC availability report.
impact: Davis is once again listed as questionable on Virginia Tech's initial availability report, mirroring his status from last week. The running back has been dealing with an undisclosed injury since the beginning of the season. He will aim to make his season debut Friday to earn an opportunity to showcase why he deserves snaps in the backfield.

headline: Officially listed as probable
story: Greene (undisclosed) is probable for Friday's game at Pittsburgh.
impact: Greene was expected to be available for the Week 5 contest against Pittsburgh earlier this week, and the official injury report confirms the wideout is on track to play Friday. Greene has eight catches for 125 yards through three games this season, and his return would be a huge boost for the Hokies' passing attack.

headline: Expected to be available Week 5
story: Virginia Tech's head coach James Franklin announced Monday that he anticipates Greene (undisclosed) to be available Friday against Pittsburgh, Damien Sordelett of The Roanoke Times...
impact: Because of an undisclosed injury, Greene did not play Franklin's first case of ACC action with Virginia Tech back in Week 4 at Boston College. Having the senior available would fortify his receiver corps against a tougher Pittsburgh team, as his September stats of eight receptions (on 12 targets) for 125 yards suggest. Greene's injury status may be cleared in the ACC availability report before their game.

headline: Scores only receiving TD of game
story: Jackson posted three receptions for 41 yards with a touchdown during Saturday's 21-14 victory against Boston College.
impact: Jackson had the only receiving touchdown of the game, as big plays through the air were a rarity in a game featuring rain and whipping winds up to gale force. Jackson will look to carry over the momentum in Friday's game at Lane Stadium against Pittsburgh, as ACC play continues.

headline: Registers eight catches at B.C.
story: Brown secured game highs with eight catches and 51 yards during Saturday's 21-14 win against Boston College.
impact: Brown's stat line might not look that impressive, but there were gale force winds and rain due to a passing nor'easter, and it was mostly a run-based offense on both sides. So, his line was actually quite impressive. In fact, only one other player had more than three catches in the game, and nobody on B.C. had more than two.

headline: Weather dooms prolific tight end
story: Reynolds compiled zero targets during Saturday's 21-14 victory over Boston College.
impact: Reynolds has been one of the more productive tight ends, but Virginia Tech's offensive attack was mostly ground-based due to gusty winds and rain in Chestnut Hill due to a passing Nor'easter. Reynolds still had five catches, but it was almost all on short routes with no reception going for more than seven yards. The star TE will look to bounce back Friday against Pitt.

headline: Outshined by backfield mate
story: Hawkins recorded 10 rushes for 19 yards during Saturday's 21-14 victory over Boston College.
impact: Hawkins was mostly bottled up, and he also lost a fumble, and that's bad news on a day when it was a run-heavy attack. HC James Franklin stayed with the hot hand, as RB Jeffrey Overton had a career-high 209 rushing yards and a TD, pushing Hawkins to the back burner. Hawkins still saw double-digit touches, but 1.9 yards per attempt won't cut the mustard. He'll look to rebound Friday against Pitt.

headline: Weather keeps stats down
story: Grunkemeyer was 22-for-35 passing for 147 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 21-14 victory over Boston College.
impact: Grunkemeyer was limited to mostly short routes, as the winds up to gale force were kicking up due to a Nor'easter. The offensive attack was mostly ground-based, much to the dismay of Grunkemeyer's fantasy managers who forgot to check the weather forecast. He'll look to bounce back Friday against visiting Pittsburgh.

headline: Makes most of opportunities in career day
story: Overton notched 25 carries for 209 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 21-14 victory against Boston College.
impact: The weather in Chestnut Hill was gloomy due to a Nor'easter, so Virginia Tech ran the ball 42 times. Overton was more than ready, posting a career-best day. In fact, it was just the second 100-yard day of his career, and his previous yardage high was 104 against VMI on Sept. 5. He has four rushing touchdowns through four games. He'll look to keep up the good work when Pitt pays a visit Friday.

headline: Joins starting lineup Saturday
story: Jackson is set to start Saturday's game at Boston College, Andy Bitter of TechSideline.com reports.
impact: With Ayden Greene (undisclosed) out, Jackson is set for a more significant role in the ACC opener. Jackson only has two targets through three games this season though, so he likely still won't be a major fantasy contributor.

headline: Ruled out Saturday
story: Booker (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game at Boston College, per the ACC availability report.
impact: Booker is not available for Saturday's contest, though it's unlikely he would've played even if he was. His next chance to suit up is Friday versus Pittsburgh.

headline: Unavailable for Week 4
story: Heath (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game at Boston College.
impact: Heath joins multiple players previously doubtful, now out for Saturday's game at Boston College. The wide receiver is still looking for production following his 2025 season with Virginia Tech.

headline: Ruled out Saturday
story: Stuewe (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game at Boston College, per the ACC availability report.
impact: Stuewe will miss his fourth straight game Saturday, though he was unlikely to play even if he was healthy. His next chance to suit up is Friday versus Pittsburgh.

headline: Rolls up 12 points in road upset
story: Calvert converted on 3-for-3 field-goal attempts and 3-for-3 point-after tries during Saturday's 30-27 win against Louisville.
impact: Calvert knocked through a go-ahead 32-yard field goal with 6:20 left in regulation, and it stood up as the game-winning tally. His other two makes were from 35 and 39 yards, doing his job, and notching 12 points for the third time in four games this season. He has proven to be a very dependable fantasy option.

headline: Records pair of catches in win
story: Dickmann accrued14 receiving yards on two catches during Saturday's 30-27 win against Louisville.
impact: It's been a slow go for the junior from Georgetown, Texas, posting two or fewer receptions in each of his four games in 2026. He has had a total of six touches to date, and he has four receptions for 36 yards in the past two outings. Until he starts seeing more responsibilities on offense, he can be avoided for fantasy purposes.

headline: Limited to just one reception
story: Johnson logged a single 17-yard reception during Saturday's 30-27 win against Louisville.
impact: Only three receivers were able to record a reception, and it was WR Carlos Hernandez dominating in receptions and yardage. Johnson had a touchdown last week against Miami, but he has been held to two or fewer receptions, and 25 or fewer receiving yards, in all three games. Look for your TE fantasy assistance elsewhere.

headline: Goes off in road victory
story: Hernandez recorded zero targets during Saturday's 30-27 victory over Louisville.
impact: Hernandez posted the fourth 100-yard game of his collegiate career. The senior from Alhambra, Calif. actually has 88 or more receiving yards in six of his past eight games, as least 69 receiving yards each of the eight outings. He has also scored at least once in three of four games this season. Hernandez has emerged as one of the better receivers in the ACC, and he'll look to keep up the eye-popping numbers against Stanford next Saturday.

headline: Gets back on track in Louisville
story: Lawrence had 10 rushes for 64 yards during Saturday's 30-27 win against Louisville.
impact: Lawrence fired out of the box against Akron in the opener, but he had a pair of mediocre showings at Purdue and against Miami. He is a complementary tailback to Ty Clark III, and when those two are humming, it gives Wake a nice one-two punch that it needs to make some noise in the ACC. He'll look to keep up the good work against Stanford next Saturday.

headline: Flirts with triple digits, scores twice
story: Clark had 21 rushes for 91 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 30-27 win over Louisville.
impact: Clark had struggled in the previous two games, averaging just 3.0 yards in a 2OT win at Purdue, while going for just three yards on three carries against Miami last week. The Demon Deacons piled up 177 rushing yards and 4.2 yards per carry in the upset win of the Cardinals, and that's how the Deacs will have to run the ball if they want to continue its success in the ACC.

headline: Leads Deacs to upset road win
story: Lopez was 12-for-19 passing for 225 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 30-27 victory versus Louisville. He also had eight rushes for 15 yards.
impact: Lopez has done a great job in Winston-Salem after a lost year under Bill Belichick in Chapel Hill last season. He has regained the form he showed at South Alabama, and he has repositioned himself as one of the top signal callers in the ACC, and a potential NFL Draft pick. Next up is a visit from Stanford on Oct. 3.

headline: Officially available vs. Louisville
story: Lopez (undisclosed) is available for Saturday's game at Louisville, per the ACC availability report.
impact: Lopez will suit up for Saturday's game, an outcome that followed expectations after head coach Jake Dickert expressed optimism regarding his availability. The quarterback will man the helm under center and look to add to his season totals of 887 passing yards and seven touchdowns.

headline: Expected to be ready for Saturday
story: Lopez is expected to be available for Saturday's game at Louisville, Cam Lemons Debro of 247Sports.com reports.
impact: Head coach Jake Dickert said that Lopez is "gonna be ready to go. Had a great day of practice today, he's feeling in rhythm and he's a tough son of a gun." Lopez was listed as questionable on the Demon Deacons' initial injury report, but Dickert's comments suggests Lopez will play in the tough road matchup. Lopez has accounted for nine total touchdowns through three games this season.

headline: Will miss Week 4
story: Carr (undisclosed) is listed as out ahead of Saturday's matchup against Louisville.
impact: Carr's season debut will remain on hold as he will miss his fourth consecutive game Saturday. The Miami transfer will have a chance to make his season debut against Stanford on Oct. 3.

headline: Questionable for Week 4
story: Lopez (undisclosed) is questionable for Saturday's game at Louisville.
impact: Lopez has been an amazing feat in Wake Forest, and he's coming off a three-TD performance in Week 3 in a loss to Miami (FL). The questionable tag suggests a decision on the junior signal-caller will be made later in the week, but if he doesn't start, it'd be a huge blow for the Demon Deacons' offense. Lopez has posted a 7:1 TD:INT in his first three starts in 2026.

headline: Doesn't do much against Miami
story: Meeks caught 2 of 4 targets for nine yards during Friday's 33-20 defeat versus Miami (FL).
impact: Meeks was targeted frequently, but he just didn't have enough room against the suffocating defense of the Hurricanes. The senior from Las Vegas opened with a strong 93 receiving yards and TD against Akron on Sept. 3, but he has been limited to four catches for just 41 yards across his past two games.

headline: Secures TD in loss to Canes
story: Johnson logged two receptions (on three targets) for 25 yards and one touchdown during Friday's 33-20 defeat to Miami (FL).
impact: The touchdown was the first for Johnson since he had a score in the Duke's Mayo Bowl against Mississippi State last December. It was his first regular-season score since he had a 6-yard touchdown grab in Vanderbilt's 40-35 upset of Alabama on Oct. 5, 2024. The senior tight end will look to carve out a bigger piece of the offense for himself on Saturday at Louisville.

headline: Registers 10 receptions in home loss
story: Hernandez caught 10 of 14 targets for 69 yards and one touchdown during Friday's 33-20 defeat against Miami (FL).
impact: Hernandez showed out against the Hurricanes, and he was very vocal woofing back and forth with the Miami secondary. His 10 catches marked a season high, and he is just one of three players in the country with 30-plus receptions for more than 700-plus receiving yards since Nov. 15, 2025. He'll look to keep up the good work at Louisville next Saturday.

headline: Will remain out for Week 4
story: Cross (illness) won't travel to London with the Commanders and has been ruled out for Sunday's matchup against the Colts.
impact: It will be the second straight absence for Cross, and what was originally deemed an "internal injury" is now being called an "illness." It's not quite clear what he's dealing with, but the fifth-year safety's inability to suit up will leave a hole in Washington's secondary. Quan Martin logged a greater defensive snap share in Week 3 and will likely do so again Sunday in Cross's stead.

headline: Hauls in two passes vs. Seattle
story: Williams caught two passes on four targets for 15 yards during the Commanders' 33-31 win over the Seahawks on Sunday.
impact: The rookie third-rounder's two catches both came in the second quarter, and his six-yard reception at the 0:41 mark helped lead to a 57-yard field goal from Drew Stevens two plays later to give the Commanders a 17-10 lead heading into halftime. Williams' 28 offensive snap were third-most among Washington's wide receivers, ahead of Treylon Burks (25) and Dyami Brown (21) but well behind Terry McLaurin (52) and Stefon Diggs (41). Williams will take a 9-103-1 receiving line (on 11 targets) into a Week 4 clash against the Colts this Sunday in London, England.

headline: Won't return for Week 4
story: Cosmi (concussion) isn't traveling with the Commanders to London and won't play Sunday versus Indianapolis.
impact: Cosmi suffered a concussion in Week 2 against Dallas and wasn't able to play this past Sunday versus Seattle. He's now slated to miss a second straight game while remaining in concussion protocol. With Cosmi out Week 3, Nick Allegretti slid over to right guard while Lucas Patrick started at center.

headline: Limited to special teams in Week 3
story: Allen played 15 snaps on special teams and didn't show up in the box score otherwise during the Commanders' 33-31 win over the Seahawks on Sunday.
impact: After being limited mostly to garbage time through the first two games of the regular season, the rookie sixth-rounder didn't see the field on offense against Seattle. Allen saw a heavy workload during the preseason, but he figures to be an afterthought in the Commanders' offensive gameplan unless one of Jacory Croskey-Merritt or Rachaad White were to miss time. The Commanders head to London for a Week 4 tilt against the Colts this Sunday.

headline: Traveling with team to London
story: Okonkwo (hamstring) will travel with the Commanders to London ahead of the team's Week 4 game against the Colts this Sunday, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
impact: A hamstring injury has prevented Okonkwo from playing in each of the Commanders' last two games, leading to the team leaning more heavily on Ben Sinnott, John Bates and Colson Yankoff at tight end. Okonkwo's practice participation over the coming days will be worth monitoring, as a full session would greatly increase his chances of being cleared to play against Indianapolis. He signed a three-year contract with the Commanders in March following four years with the Titans, and he finished the 2025 regular season with career highs in receptions (56), yards (560) and targets (79) across 17 games.

headline: Making trip to London
story: Daniels (elbow) is traveling with the Commanders to London ahead of Sunday's game against the Colts, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
impact: As expected, Daniels will make the trip across the pond and participate in practices over the coming days. He has a lot of work ahead of him in order to be cleared to play Sunday as he continues to recover from a dislocated elbow, so it wouldn't be surprising to see Marcus Mariota get the starting nod for a second week in a row. Logging a full practice at least once this week would go a long way in Daniels' efforts to return to the field.

headline: Iffy for Week 4
story: Butler is recovering from a concussion ahead of the Commanders' matchup in London against the Colts in Week 4, Ben Standig of The Team 980 Washington D.C. reports.
impact: It's not immediately clear when Butler suffered the concussion, but his availability for Week 4 is now up in the air. In the event he can't suit up against Indianapolis, Tyler Owens could be in line to see a few snaps in the secondary.

headline: Lands on IR
story: The Commanders placed Chenal (neck) on injured reserve Tuesday.
impact: Chenal's move to injured reserve doesn't come as a surprise since it was previously announced he would undergo season-ending neck surgery. The 2022 third-round pick had racked up 18 tackles (nine solo) across three games before getting hurt and will now shift his focus to getting healthy for the 2027 campaign.

headline: Could need surgery after season
story: Daniels will avoid a procedure on his dislocated left elbow for the time being, but Adam Schefter of ESPN reports that the quarterback could undergo surgery after the season.
impact: Daniels is slated to practice in some capacity this week, and the Commanders haven't ruled him out from playing this Sunday in London against the Colts.

headline: Totals three touchdowns in loss
story: Williams completed 18 of 28 passes for 239 yards, two touchdowns and two interceptions during Saturday's 27-24 defeat against Minnesota. He also had 15 rushes for 15 yards with one...
impact: Like Washington's other games this season, Williams started slow and didn't put on the gas until the second half, after trailing 21-10 at intermission. Losing a dimension of the running game with multiple backs injured didn't help Williams, who rushed 15 times but was neutralized by a revitalized Minnesota defense. Things won't get easier next week against USC, which gave up a lot of yards to Oregon but kept quarterback running to a minimum.

headline: Not playing Saturday
story: McMahan is out Saturday against Minnesota due to a foot injury, according to Aaron Coe of Emerald City Spectrum.
impact: McMahan was spotted in a boot, so he won't play in Week 4. The running back is deep on the RB depth chart, so he's not expected to see touches even if he's healthy moving forward.

headline: Logs team-high 121 receiving yards
story: Roebuck reeled in all nine targets for 121 yards during Saturday's 48-16 win against Eastern Washington.
impact: Demond Williams targeted Roebuck nine times, and he brought down every pass. Amid Williams' dual-threat antics, it's easy to forget Washington's receiver depth, as Roebuck and Rashid Williams could be among the best receiving tandems in the Big Ten.

headline: Romps for two scores
story: Williams reeled in all six targets for 86 yards and two touchdowns during Saturday's 48-16 win over Eastern Washington.
impact: Williams delivered a spectacular line, showcasing the team's wideout talent on a night when Demond Williams threw with pinpoint accuracy. Saturday's win was a glimpse of what Washington's offense can do, but they need to make it happen against a tougher opponent.

headline: Explodes in blowout win
story: Williams was 27-for-33 passing for 373 yards, four touchdowns and one interception during Saturday's 48-16 victory over Eastern Washington. He also had seven rushes for 33 yards.
impact: Williams has struggled to get going in the first quarter of every game this season, but he shed that habit against Eastern Washington. When dialed in, Williams is one of the best dual-threat quarterbacks in the country, and the Huskies will need that consistency as they begin their conference schedule next week.

headline: Grabs fifth save
story: Tolman earned the save in Sunday's 6-4 win over the Mets, allowing a walk and no hits while striking out two over 1.1 innings.
impact: Tolman quickly worked his way into a high-leverage role in Washington, after making his MLB debut in late August. He'll finish the year with five saves, a 2.93 ERA, 1.43 WHIP and 17:9 K:BB across 15.1 innings. The left-handed Holman will likely be in the mix for a late-inning role again with the Nats in 2027.

headline: Handed loss in piggyback role Saturday
story: Irvin (2-10) took the loss Saturday, giving up five runs (four earned) on seven hits and two walks over five innings of relief as the Nationals were downed 7-1 by the Mets. He stru...
impact: Piggybacking with Connelly Early in the southpaw's Washington debut, Irvin inherited a 1-0 lead but couldn't make it hold up, serving up seventh-inning homers to A.J. Ewing and Ronny Mauricio. Irvin ends the campaign having lost all six of his decisions since returning from a shoulder strain in late July, stumbling to a 5.73 ERA, 1.42 WHIP and 52:26 K:BB over 55 innings in that span while getting tagged for 13 homers.

headline: Impressive in short Nats debut
story: Early didn't factor into the decision in Saturday's 7-1 loss to the Mets, allowing just one hit over three scoreless innings. He struck out one without walking a batter.
impact: Making his first appearance as a National after being acquired from the Red Sox in late July for Curtis Mead (wrist), Early was on a strict pitch count after recovering from elbow inflammation that had kept him on the shelf since June 30. The 24-year-old southpaw made the most of his limited workload, firing 21 of 34 pitches for strikes and facing just one batter over the minimum. Early wraps up his season with a 3.33 ERA, 1.23 WHIP and 94:34 K:BB through 94.2 innings, and with a healthy offseason he'll head into 2027 as one of the top arms in the Washington rotation alongside Cade Cavalli.

headline: On bench Saturday
story: Young isn't in the lineup for Saturday's game against the Mets.
impact: Young will get some rest Saturday after going 2-for-4 during a win in Friday's series opener. While he sits, Daylen Lile, Dylan Crews and James Wood will start across the outfield.

headline: Switching back for year five
story: Young is transferring to Western Carolina, he announced via X.
impact: Young will make the switch back to the Catamounts after playing with the team in back-to-back seasons before logging this past campaign with Charlotte. The 6-foot-3 tight end brought in 28 passes for 321 yards and a pair of touchdowns when he last played for WCU in 2024.

headline: Has 66 yards receiving
story: Stafford caught six passes for 66 yards versus Mercyhurst on Saturday.
impact: Stafford, a true freshman, is a cog in this offense. He's been targeted 30 times and has 20 catches, and he's gotten six carries as well. On the other hand, he has totaled 175 yards with zero touchdowns, so he's not yet a dynamic player.

headline: Reels in TD
story: Taylor caught two passes for 66 yards and a score against Mercyhurst on Saturday.
impact: Prior to this game Taylor had totaled two catches for 19 yards, so this seems like a guy down the depth chart making the most of his opportunity in a blowout of an FCS team.

headline: Scores in blowout
story: Johnson caught one pass for a 72-yard score Saturday against Mercyhurst.
impact: This is Johnson's first catch of the season, and second target. Clearly, this is a fluke against an FCS team.

headline: Progressing without definite timeline
story: Hutchinson (knee) is making good progress, but it is unclear when he will be ready to return to action, Jeff Nations of the Bowling Green Daily News reports.
impact: Hutchinson has missed a pair of games due to his injured knee, and the wide receiver's unavailability has given Western Kentucky one less big piece in the receiver corps. After logging 700-plus all-purpose yards and five touchdowns last season, Hutchinson is set for a down year with all the time he has missed, not to mention the potential time he may miss.

headline: Shows up big in limited role
story: Glenn went 4-for-6 for 101 yards and two touchdowns against Mercyhurst on Saturday. He also ran five times for 50 yards and a score.
impact: Glenn got a chance to start over Rodney Tisdale in WKU's last game, but against this FCS opponent both quarterbacks got to play. Complicating matters further, both played well. Next week against NMSU is going to be quite interesting in terms of this QB battle.

headline: Piles it on FCS team
story: Tisdale went 19-for-23 for 309 yards and four touchdowns against Mercyhurst on Saturday. He also ran for 18 yards.
impact: Tisdale started the season slow, and seemed to lose the starting job to Brock Glenn. However, he got a chance to play against an FCS team here, and he certainly took advantage. That being said, Glenn also played, and Glenn totaled three touchdowns, so don't be so sure that Tisdale is back atop the WKU depth chart.

headline: DNP for Week 4
story: Reimer (undisclosed) logged 10 snaps during Saturday's 52-7 win against Mercyhurst.
impact: Since transferring to Western Kentucky, Reimer has played all but one of WKU's subsequent games. However, considering his lack of targets post-transfer, he projects to be supplemental depth in the Hilltoppers' tight end room.

headline: Ends up missing loss
story: Hutchinson (knee) did not play in Saturday's 38-0 loss to Indiana.
impact: Hutchinson was taken off the injury report leading up to the game, but he still ended up being inactive. The 5-foot-8 wide receiver has yet to see the field this season, but he'll aim to make it happen this Saturday against Mercyhurst.

headline: Nets 30 yards
story: Ezirim caught two passes for 30 yards against Indiana on Saturday.
impact: Ezirim transferred in from Toledo, and he won the starting tight end job. However, he also has four catches for 65 yards through three games with the Hilltoppers.

headline: Nine touches against Hoosiers
story: Stafford had six catches for 27 yards and rushed three times for 14 yards against Indiana on Saturday.
impact: Stafford didn't do much against the defending champs, but the true freshman touched the ball nine times, and even though he is a receiver he got three carries. It would seem somebody likes getting him the ball, and that is encouraging with the rest of the schedule decidedly easier than the last two games.

headline: Another rough day
story: Allen ran 10 times for 22 yards versus Indiana on Saturday.
impact: Allen impressed in his first outing with WKU, but his last two games have been rough. However, his last two games have been on the road against Georgia and Indiana. Expect things to go much better the rest of the way, especially against Mercyhurst in WKU's next game.

headline: Gets start against IU
story: Glenn went 17-for-32 for 120 yards and an interception against Indiana on Saturday. He ran 11 times for 30 yards as well and fumbled twice, but lost neither fumble.
impact: A road trip to Indiana was always going to be rough. What matters here is that Glenn, not Rodney Tisdale, got the start, and Tisdale did not attempt a pass. It would appear that the job is Glenn's for now.

headline: Off injury report vs. Indiana
story: Hutchinson (knee) is not listed on the injury report ahead of Saturday's meeting with the Hoosiers.
impact: Hutchinson was questionable leading up to the matchup as he tended a knee injury that has held him out through the first games of the season but appears to have moved past it and will be available to play. The senior wide receiver will aim to make the most of his season debut.

headline: Won't play Saturday
story: Reimer (undisclosed) is out for Saturday's game at Indiana, per the CUSA availability report.
impact: Reimer will sit out his first game of the season after appearing in Western Kentucky's first two contests without recording a stat. The tight end will aim to recover in time for next Saturday's matchup against Mercyhurst.

headline: Out Saturday
story: Boyd is listed out ahead of Saturday's game against Indiana.
impact: Boyd will not be available to play as he deals with an injury of sort. The redshirt running back will aim to be back on the field for next week's meeting with Mercyhurst.

headline: Reels in TD
story: Arends had two catches for 18 yards and a touchdown against Georgia on Saturday.
impact: When Arends caught his touchdown, Georgia was leading 70-13. He didn't have a target in WKU's opener. This was solely a product of what a blowout this game was, but Arends will always be able to tell people he scored a touchdown against the Georgia Bulldogs.

headline: Day to forget in Athens
story: Allen ran 11 times for 19 yards against Georgia on Saturday.
impact: Don't worry too much about this. Allen was, after all, visiting the Bulldogs and facing an elite SEC defense. He did run for over 102 yards and two touchdowns against Nevada in WKU's opener, after all. Of course, in Week 3 Allen will have to visit Indiana, which won't be much easier.

headline: Day-to-day for Broncos
story: Chenault (hand) is considered day-to-day for Western Michigan, per Andrew E. Graham of Mitten Football.
impact: Chenault sat out Week 4, but the star receiver reportedly has a chance to return in Week 5 at Buffalo. The wideout has 13 catches for 216 yards and a score through three games this season.

headline: DNP for Week 4
story: Chenault (undisclosed) did not play during Saturday's game against Boise State.
impact: Chenault active did not prevent Western Michigan from deciding not to use him in Week 4. He had an excellent September, with 13 receptions for 216 yards and one touchdown.

headline: Struggles in Week 4
story: Lowry was 15-for-28 passing for 110 yards and one interception during Saturday's 32-7 defeat against Boise State.
impact: Lowry had his lowest passing total since Week 1 on Saturday against Boise State. The quarterback committed his first turnover of the season after throwing an interception. Through four games, the Ohio native has 527 passing yards, 116 rushing yards, five total touchdowns and one interception.

headline: Active vs. Boise State
story: Chenault (undisclosed) will play in Saturday's game versus Boise State, per Andrew Graham of MittenFootball.com.
impact: Chenault will suit up Saturday after being marked questionable ahead of kickoff. The wideout is set to lead the receiving corps and help bolster the offense against Boise State.

headline: Ready to roll Saturday
story: Cabana (undisclosed) is not listed on the injury report ahead of Saturday's game against Boise State, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Cabana will suit up Saturday, adding depth to Western Michigan's backfield as the backup to Jalen Buckley. The running back has 12 yards on 7 attempts so far this season.

headline: Good to go Saturday
story: Domschke is available for Saturday's game versus Boise State, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Domschke is back healthy ahead of Saturday's important out-of-conference game. He is set to take over kicking duties from Dieter Kelly who took field goals and extra points for the first three games of the season.

headline: Questionable vs. Boise State
story: Chenault (undiscloseD) is questionable ahead of Saturday's game against Boise State, per the MAC availability report.
impact: Chenault will likely be a game-time decision for Saturday's game, as the team has listed him as questionable. The wideout has had a strong start to his season, hauling in 13 receptions for 216 yards and one touchdown. A final call on his status should be made before kickoff.

headline: Gets on board for first time in 2026
story: Chenault tallied three receptions (on four targets) for 62 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 28-21 win versus Rice.
impact: Chenault caught his first touchdown of the season during Saturday's win. The wide receiver reeled in a 34-yard pass from Broc Lowry to give the Broncos a first-half lead. After three games, Chenault has recorded 13 catches for 216 yards and one touchdown.

headline: Scores first TD of campaign
story: Mataele totaled 11 rushes for 62 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 28-21 victory versus Rice.
impact: Mataele found the end zone for the first time this season during the Broncos' win Saturday. The running back scored on a one-yard rush to extend the lead late in the fourth quarter.

headline: Records season-high in rushing yards
story: Buckley accrued 13 rushes for 117 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 28-21 victory versus Rice.
impact: Buckley attempted 13 rushes, averaging nine yards per rush during Saturday's win. The running back found the end zone early in the fourth quarter to put the Broncos ahead. Through three games, Buckley has 42 carries for 207 yards and four touchdowns.

headline: Efficient passing in win
story: Lowry completed 14 of 20 passes for 116 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 28-21 win against Rice. He also had 17 rushes for 39 yards with one touchdown.
impact: Lowry completed 70 percent of his 20 passes during Saturday's win. The quarterback opened up the scoring with a five-yard run in the first quarter and later found Aveion Chenault for another score. Through three games, the Ohio native has 417 passing yards, 114 rushing yards and five total touchdowns.

headline: Remains sidelined
story: Domschke (undisclosed) didn't play in Saturday's win over Rice.
impact: Domschke has yet to appear in a game in this season as he continues to deal with an undisclosed injury. If he's forced to to miss next week's matchup versus Boise State as well, Zak Zeman should continue to handle the team's kicking duties.

headline: Doesn't play Saturday
story: Cabana (undisclosed) did not play in Saturday's 28-21 win against Rice.
impact: Cabana was questionable leading up to the game with an unknown injury, but he ultimately was inactive. The 5-foot-11 running back will now look to make a return this Saturday against Boise State.

headline: Questionable to play Saturday
story: Cabana is questionable for Saturday's game against Rice due to an undisclosed injury.
impact: Cabana has been limited to seven carries for 12 yards, as well as two catches for one yard on two targets, in his two appearances this season. The tailback isn't expected to play a big role even if deemed healthy ahead of Saturday's 7 p.m. ET kickoff.

headline: Question mark at Rice
story: Domschke (undisclosed) is questionable to face Rice in Week 3.
impact: Domschke has yet to play this season, and he looks like a game-time call for the Broncos. If he can't go, expect Zak Zeman to handle place-kicker duties.

headline: DNP vs. Penn State
story: Jackson (undisclosed) did not play during Saturday's 24-20 victory over Penn State.
impact: Jackson was previously listed as a game-time decision for Saturday's contest, but he was unable to make the field against the Nittany Lions. His next chance to return will come against Michigan State on Saturday.

headline: Injury revealed as upper-body problem
story: Sama suffered an upper-body injury during Saturday's game at Penn State, Mark Stewart of the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reports.
impact: Sama's latest update reveals his injury type, but not how severe it is going into October. For now, he is questionable for next Saturday's game against Michigan State. During the month of September, Sama logged 28 rushing attempts for 190 yards and one touchdown.

headline: Non-factor in uoset win
story: Henry gathered in 2 of 5 targets for 14 yards during Saturday's 24-20 win over Penn State.
impact: Henry had a nice run heading into Week 4, but he posted a season-low total in the dramatic upset. Penn State kept Henry in check but surrendered massive production to Jacob Harris, and Colton Joseph spread the ball evenly to his other receivers. He should have a better result next week against Michigan State.

headline: Romps for late score in updet
story: Harris accrued five receptions (on six targets) for 105 yards and one touchdown during Saturday's 24-20 victory over Penn State.
impact: Harris made the most of his five catches, highlighted by a 72-yard pass from Colton Joseph in the fourth quarter. Harris also led the receiving corps with 105 yards, and his five receptions were also a team high. He practically doubled his production over the first three games, and now has 11 catches for 203 yards and a touchdown so far this season.

headline: Directs game-winning drive in upset
story: Joseph completed 18 of 38 passes for 235 yards, two touchdowns and three interceptions during Saturday's 24-20 win versus Penn State. He also had 13 rushes for 39 yards with one to...
impact: Things looked bleak for the Badgers as Joseph quickly rattled off two interceptions in the first half, but he came alive in the fourth quarter when it counted. Joseph was far from mistake-free, but he took advantage of a Penn State squad that failed to find a rhythm on either side of the ball for much of the contest. Now 3-1, Joseph and company will take on Michigan State at home, a very winnable contest given the considerable momentum generated by the surprise win on the road.
